summary_sections.result: 使用11种攻击的集成评估（最坏情况），无防御时89-91%行为被攻破，最佳guard+放大器后仍有63-65%。放大器在10个guard-target对中仅4对有显著提升。reguard层可大幅降低残留风险，但将过度拒绝率推高至81-92%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前基于恢复的防御存在安全-效用天花板，无法同时达到低攻击成功率和低过度拒绝。研究绘制了恢复型VLM防御有效和无效的边界。

papers.title: From Tokens to Watt-hours: Analytical Energy Estimation for LLM Inference on Modern GPUs
papers.abstract_en: The operational energy consumption of large language model (LLM) inference is becoming an increasingly important component of the environmental footprint of deployed AI systems. However, direct measurement of inference energy often requires hardware telemetry, power instrumentation, or infrastructure-specific monitoring, limiting its applicability in comparative studies, early-stage system design, and sustainability reporting. This report presents an analytically structured, empirically calibrated, GPU-level methodology for estimating LLM inference energy on NVIDIA H100-class accelerators without direct runtime measurement. The proposed estimator combines parameter-scaled transformer FLOP accounting, calibrated memory-traffic factors, and hardware-specific energy coefficients for FP16/BF16 tensor-core computation and high-bandwidth-memory movement. It explicitly separates prompt prefill from autoregressive decoding, enabling energy estimates for input tokens, output tokens, and complete inference requests. The methodology further decomposes total energy into compute, parameter-access, key-value-cache write, and attention-read components, allowing the scaling behavior with model size, context length, and generated-token count to be analyzed. The resulting estimates are not intended to replace physical power measurements; rather, they provide transparent, reproducible, and assumption-explicit approximations suitable for model comparison, green-coding analysis, and design-time evaluation of LLM inference workloads.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the GREEN-AI Workshop, co-located with ECML-PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分析性的、经验校准的GPU级能耗估计方法，用于估算LLM在NVIDIA H100上的推理能耗，无需直接运行时测量。该方法将变换器FLOP计数、内存流量因素和硬件特定能耗系数相结合，区分预填充和解码阶段，并将总能耗分解为计算、参数访问、KV缓存写入和注意力读取等组件，适用于模型比较和绿色编码分析。
Motivation: LLM推理的能耗日益重要，但直接测量需要硬件遥测或基础设施监控，限制了在比较研究、早期设计和可持续性报告中的应用。
Method: 提出一个结合参数规模变换器FLOP计数、校准内存流量因子和FP16/BF16张量核心及高带宽内存移动的硬件能耗系数的估算器，明确区分预填充和自回归解码，并分解能耗为计算、参数访问、KV缓存写入和注意力读取四个部分。
Result: 该方法在NVIDIA H100上提供透明的、可复现的能耗近似，可用于模型比较和设计阶段评估，但摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该方法并非替代物理测量，而是提供透明、可复现的近似，适用于LLM推理工作负载的比较和绿色编码分析。

papers.title: Speech2Grasp: Data-Efficient Transfer of Text-Conditioned Grasp Detection to Speech in Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots increasingly require multi-modal understanding for natural interaction with humans. Despite the prominence of vision-language models, they generally assume textual rather than the more natural speech inputs. In this paper, we investigate whether a well-established text-conditioned model can be transferred to speech in a data-efficient manner. Using ALBEF as a case study, we conduct diagnostic analyses showing that a lightweight MLP-based projector effectively adapts it to speech, while preserving semantic discrimination and robustness. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Speech2Grasp, a framework for data-efficient transfer of text-conditioned grasp detection to speech. Real-world humanoid robot experiments show that Speech2Grasp outperforms cascaded ASR-based pipeline, while reducing inference latency. Our findings suggest a practical paradigm for extending established text-conditioned systems to speech.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否将文本条件下的抓取检测模型高效迁移到语音输入。以ALBEF为例，诊断分析表明轻量级MLP投影器能有效适应语音，同时保持语义区分性和鲁棒性。基于此提出Speech2Grasp框架，在真实人形机器人实验中优于级联ASR方法，并降低推理延迟。
Motivation: 人形机器人需要多模态理解，但现有视觉语言模型通常假设文本输入而非更自然的语音输入，缺乏从文本到语音的高效迁移方法。
Method: 使用ALBEF作为基础模型，通过轻量级MLP投影器将语音特征映射到文本特征空间，实现文本条件模型向语音的数据高效迁移。
Result: 真实世界人形机器人实验表明，Speech2Grasp在抓取检测任务上优于级联ASR流水线，并减少推理延迟。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种实用范式，将成熟的文本条件系统扩展到语音输入，无需大量语音数据重新训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ServerlessT2I: Efficient Text-to-Image Workflow Serving on a Serverless Platform
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) workflows are increasingly deployed on serverless platforms because users often compose customized workflows and invoke them intermittently. Existing platforms typically deploy each workflow as an opaque GPU function, provisioning, placing, and scaling all constituent models in the workflow together. This monolithic design obscures workflow structure, inflates scaling overhead, forces users to manage low-level GPU coordination, and limits fine-grained fairness in multi-tenant clusters. In this paper, we present ServerlessT2I, a serverless-native system that decomposes a T2I workflow into loosely coupled model functions that can be independently managed and scheduled. By explicitly managing individual model execution, ServerlessT2I enables per-model scaling, declarative workflow composition, transparent GPU-resident communication, and fairness-aware scheduling. To make this decomposition efficient, ServerlessT2I harvests slack GPU memory left idle by compute-bound T2I inference to build a data plane that reduces model loading and data communication overheads. \sys{} further introduces a fair scheduler for multi-tenant serving. Using production traces, ServerlessT2I sustains up to 2$\times$ higher request rates than existing T2I workflow serving systems with the same GPU budget; for a fixed request rate, it saves up to 3$\times$ GPU resources while satisfying service level objectives (SLOs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ServerlessT2I，一个基于无服务器架构的文本到图像工作流服务系统，通过将工作流分解为松耦合的模型函数，实现独立管理和调度。利用闲置GPU内存构建数据平面减少开销，并引入公平调度器。基于生产轨迹的评估表明，与现有系统相比，在相同GPU预算下可支持高达2倍请求率，或在固定请求率下节省3倍GPU资源。
Motivation: 现有无服务器平台将T2I工作流部署为不透明的GPU函数，导致扩展开销大、用户需管理底层GPU协调、缺乏细粒度公平性等问题。
Method: 将T2I工作流分解为独立的模型函数，支持按模型扩展、声明式工作流组合、透明GPU通信和公平感知调度；利用计算密集型T2I推理空闲的GPU内存构建数据平面，减少模型加载和数据通信开销。
Result: 基于生产轨迹，在相同GPU预算下，请求率比现有系统高2倍；固定请求率下，满足SLO的同时节省3倍GPU资源。
Conclusion: 分解式无服务器架构能有效提升T2I工作流服务的效率和资源利用率，并支持多租户公平调度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation Trajectories Matters: Complementary Evidence for OOD Detection and Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Vision models do not form a representation at once; each block revises it. We ask whether the resulting computation path contains evidence that the final representation discards, and whether that evidence improves OOD detection and image classification on clean and shifted data. Unlike approaches that treat intermediate layers as separate snapshots, we retain sample identity across depth and study the transformations connecting successive states. We separate class-coherent transport from input-specific innovation, and coordinate movement from relational reorganization. Across supervised, self-supervised, vision--language, hierarchical, and convolutional encoders, these paths show strong sample-specific continuity and architecture-specific depth profiles that recur across datasets. They are also practically useful. An ID-only transition-surprise score complements strong final-state detectors, reducing FPR95 in 131/152 non-saturated comparisons on a balanced OpenOOD grid; gains are largest for visually disruptive and semantically far shifts, and remain positive on near-OOD for most detectors. Frozen update probes improve 71/72 clean model--dataset cases, while shifted-data gains vary with architecture and corruption type. Computation paths therefore provide a broadly useful reliability signal whose value is determined jointly by model organization and the shift encountered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉模型中逐层表示轨迹（representation trajectories）是否包含最终表示丢弃的互补证据，并利用这些证据改善分布外（OOD）检测和图像分类。作者提出两类特征：一是基于类间传输与输入特异性创新的过渡惊喜分数（transition-surprise score），用于OOD检测；二是冻结更新探针（frozen update probes），用于分类。实验在多种编码器（监督、自监督、视觉-语言、层级、卷积）上验证，表明计算路径提供了广泛有用的可靠性信号。
Motivation: 现有OOD检测和分类方法多关注最终层表示或中间层的独立快照，忽视了表示形成过程中连续计算路径所包含的、被最终层丢弃的互补证据。本文旨在探索这些轨迹能否提升模型在干净和分布偏移数据上的鲁棒性。
Method: 保留样本在深度维度的同一性，研究连接连续状态的变换。分离出类间协调传输（class-coherent transport）与输入特定创新（input-specific innovation），以及协调运动（coordinated movement）与关系重组（relational reorganization）。基于此提出两类信号：仅用ID数据的过渡惊喜分数（transition-surprise score）和冻结更新探针（frozen update probes）。
Result: 过渡惊喜分数在OpenOOD平衡网格的152个非饱和比较中，有131个降低了FPR95；对视觉破坏性和语义遥远分布偏移收益最大，对近OOD也持续正向。冻结更新探针在71/72个干净模型-数据集组合上提升分类准确率，但分布偏移上的提升因架构和扰动类型而异。
Conclusion: 计算轨迹为OOD检测和分类提供了可靠且互补的信号，其价值由模型组织和遇到的偏移共同决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Gradient-Based Methods for a Broader Class of Optimization Problems under Performative Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We study optimization under performative prediction, where deploying a model affects the future data distribution. For this setting, several gradient-based approaches have been proposed. However, they typically assume specific data distributions or loss functions, which limit their practical applicability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a gradient-based optimization method with convergence guarantees under substantially weaker assumptions. Our method explicitly estimates the induced distribution shift through finite differences. It enables higher-dimensional optimization across broader classes of loss functions and data distributions. We also propose a practical variant that reduces the number of samples required. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our proposed algorithms converge faster and more consistently than existing ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究执行性预测（performative prediction）下的优化问题，即模型部署会影响未来数据分布。现有梯度方法通常假设特定数据分布或损失函数，限制了适用性。作者提出一种梯度优化方法，通过有限差分显式估计分布偏移，在更弱的假设下保证收敛，适用于更高维优化和更广的损失函数与数据分布类别，并提出了减少样本需求的实用变体。数值实验表明所提算法比现有方法收敛更快、更稳定。
Motivation: 现有执行性预测中的梯度方法通常依赖特定的数据分布或损失函数假设，缺乏通用性，亟需一种在更宽松条件下仍能保证收敛的优化方法。
Method: 提出一种基于梯度的优化方法，通过有限差分（finite differences）显式估计模型部署引起的分布偏移，并设计了一个实际变体以降低样本复杂度。
Result: 数值实验显示，所提算法比现有方法收敛更快、更一致。
Conclusion: 该方法在更弱的假设下提供收敛保证，适用于更广泛的损失函数和数据分布，提升了执行性预测优化的实用性和可扩展性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MedARC: Training-Free Adaptive Redundancy Compression of Visual Tokens for 3D Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Integrating 3D medical images with vision-language models (VLMs) holds substantial promise for computer-aided diagnosis. However, volumetric images generate prohibitively long visual-token sequences with considerable spatial and inter-slice redundancy. Existing token compression methods typically apply uniform reduction or rely on a single importance signal, increasing the risk of removing regions that are clinically relevant to the query or structurally distinctive. To address this limitation, we propose MedARC, a unified, training-free framework for Adaptive Redundancy Compression of visual tokens in 3D medical VLMs. MedARC estimates token importance by integrating three complementary cues: self-attention from the VLM vision encoder, which reflects the model's intrinsic visual focus; similarity between projected visual tokens and text embeddings, which identifies query-relevant regions; and deviations of local visual foundation model features from the volume-level feature center, which highlight structurally distinctive anatomy. The resulting importance distribution guides a saliency-aware merging strategy that preserves informative tokens while consolidating redundant ones rather than simply discarding them. Experiments on CT-RATE and MR-RATE show that MedARC reduces visual-token overhead and inference time while preserving or improving diagnostic performance. Its multi-cue scoring cost is outweighed by the savings from processing fewer tokens, with greater benefits expected for larger language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedARC，一种无需训练的自适应冗余压缩框架，用于3D医学视觉语言模型中的视觉令牌压缩。它通过联合三种互补线索（VLM视觉编码器的自注意力、视觉令牌与文本嵌入的相似性、局部视觉基础模型特征与全局特征中心的偏差）估计令牌重要性，然后基于重要性进行感知显著性合并，保留信息令牌而合并冗余令牌。在CT-RATE和MR-RATE上实验表明，MedARC减少了视觉令牌开销和推理时间，同时保持或提升诊断性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通常采用统一压缩或单一重要性信号，增加了移除临床相关或结构独特区域的风险。
Method: 提出MedARC，利用三种互补线索（自注意力、文本相似性、特征偏差）估计令牌重要性，并采用感知显著性的合并策略。
Result: 在CT-RATE和MR-RATE上，MedARC降低了视觉令牌开销和推理时间，同时保持或提升诊断性能。
Conclusion: 多线索评分成本被处理更少令牌的节省所抵消，且对于更大的语言模型收益更显著。

papers.title: A Persona-based Rate Action Index
papers.abstract_en: We propose an index for predicting the U.S.\ Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decision to hike/hold/cut the current federal funds target rate based on how a collection of personas responds to current market conditions. To construct the index, we collected a new dataset consisting of nearly $25{,}000$ retrievable chunks from publicly available data. We partition the data into per-member corpora and use each as the retrieval database of a generative system we refer to throughout as a ``persona''. We first evaluate the personas across two complementary components of likeness: identifiability and detectability. Each persona's behavior is highly attributable (average member-conditional recall is $ 8\times $ chance) and generated content is nearly indistinguishable from held-out real content ($\hatτ_{\mathrm{det}} = 0.23$ against a $0.15$ floor). We then present evidence that query-conditioned representations of the personas capture members' monetary-policy stance relative to a known hawk--dove reputational ordering (Kendall's $τ= 0.63$, $p < 0.001$), substantially outperforming retrieval-only representations. These representations vary with time and current market conditions and form the basis of our proposed persona-based rate action index. For the $2022$--$2025$ period the index tracks the rate cycle (Kendall's $τ= 0.68$, $p < 10^{-6}$) and can be used to construct a simple classifier that predicts per-meeting outcomes at non-trivial accuracy ($0.69$ versus a $0.47$ base rate). Importantly, the index outperforms informative baselines and leads the federal funds target rate by roughly three quarters. As far as we are aware, our results are the first to demonstrate the ability to capture time-varying group behavior via a collection of digital personas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多个“人物角色”(persona)的指数，用于预测美国联邦公开市场委员会(FOMC)的利率决策（加息/维持/降息）。作者从公开数据中收集约25,000个文本片段，为每位FOMC成员构建一个检索增强生成系统作为角色，并评估其可识别性和可检测性。实验表明，这些角色能够捕捉成员相对于已知鹰鸽声誉排序的货币政策立场，并且角色表征随时间变化，基于此构建的利率行动指数在2022-2025年间跟踪利率周期，提前约三个季度预测联邦基金目标利率。
Motivation: 现有方法难以动态捕捉FOMC成员的货币政策立场变化，且缺乏基于数字角色的集体行为建模。
Method: 收集公开数据构建每位成员的语料库，作为生成式系统的检索数据库（称为“角色”）；通过可识别性和可检测性评估角色真实性；利用查询条件下的角色表征估计成员货币政策立场，并构建指数。
Result: 角色行为高度可归因（平均成员条件召回率为随机基线的8倍），生成内容与真实内容几乎不可区分（检测偏差τ̂=0.23，基线0.15）；角色表征与鹰鸽声誉排序显著相关（Kendall τ=0.63）；指数跟踪利率周期（Kendall τ=0.68），提前约三个季度，且基于指数的简单分类器预测准确率达0.69（基线0.47）。
Conclusion: 结果表明，通过数字角色集合捕捉时变群体行为是可行的，该指数可有效预测FOMC利率行动，且领先于传统基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Spatial Semantics to Temporal Context: Leveraging Gaze Trajectory for Weakly Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation heavily depends on labor-intensive and time-consuming pixel-level annotations. Eye tracking offers a cost-effective solution that can be naturally integrated into clinical workflows. Recorded by eye trackers, gaze conveys the spatial regions of clinicians' attention through fixations and the temporal context of clinicians' progressive visual perception from trajectories. Nevertheless, effective modeling of temporal trajectories remains challenging, and noise in gaze caused by exploratory fixations greatly limits segmentation performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Trajectory-guided Uncertainty-aware Network (TrailNet), which exploits gaze-supervised medical image segmentation from spatial semantics modeling to temporal context by jointly leveraging fixations and trajectories. Specifically, the proposed trajectory-guided spatio-temporal encoder models temporal context and establishes complementary interactions with image spatial semantics to strengthen target perception. Furthermore, the multi-scale uncertainty decoder leverages category mutual-exclusivity constraints to produce deterministic predictions and mitigate supervision uncertainty induced by noise. To enable gaze-free inference, we further introduce a cycle distillation strategy that transfers feature-level knowledge via teacher-student networks. Experimental results on two public datasets demonstrate that TrailNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving Dice scores of 81.25% and 81.85%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TrailNet，利用注视轨迹（gaze trajectory）进行弱监督医学图像分割，通过联合注视点和轨迹的空间语义与时序上下文，并引入循环蒸馏实现无注视推理。在两个公共数据集上达到81.25%和81.85% Dice。
Motivation: 医学图像分割依赖像素级标注成本高，眼动追踪可自然融入临床工作流，但注视噪声和时序轨迹建模困难。
Method: 提出轨迹引导的时空编码器建模时序上下文并与图像空间语义互补；多尺度不确定解码器利用类别互斥约束产生确定性预测并缓解噪声；采用循环蒸馏策略转移特征知识实现无注视推理。
Result: 在两个公共数据集上Dice达到81.25%和81.85%，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: TrailNet通过联合注视点和轨迹有效提升了弱监督分割性能，并支持无注视推理。

papers.title: TPCD: Tone-Pressure Contrastive Decoding and the Label-Free Gating Bottleneck in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: High-pressure prompts can push vision-language models (VLMs) into unsupported commitments, such as reading illegible text, reporting indeterminate times, or affirming absent objects. This paper asks whether the pressure-induced distribution itself can serve as a contrastive-decoding negative branch. Tone-pressure contrastive decoding (TPCD) subtracts logits produced under a high-pressure instruction from logits produced under a safe neutral instruction. On the 800-example tone-matters benchmark, LLaVA-1.5-7B under pressure reaches 66.75% attack success rate (ASR); safe neutralization reduces ASR to 9.88%; full TPCD reaches 0.50% but collapses positives to 15.56%. A benchmark-specific task-prior/disagreement gate preserves measured positive accuracy (54.44%) while lowering ASR to 1.63% on LLaVA. Treating this LLaVA analysis as the design split, full $n=800$ negative and $n=780$ matched-positive held-out runs on GLM-4.6V and Llama-3.2-Vision show that simple gates can improve over safe neutralization, with sensitivity analyses bounding the weak time-positive subtask. A category-prior-free answer-disagreement router reduces held-out aggregate ASR to 6.93%, improving over both safe neutralization (10.98%) and branch disagreement (9.67%) while matching branch disagreement's 79.94% positive accuracy, although it remains post-hoc and surface-form based. We conclude that pressure is a useful probe of commitment bias and a viable mitigation signal, but the current gates are not yet independently validated grounding-aware detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出音调压力对比解码（TPCD）方法，通过减去高压指令下的logits来减少视觉语言模型（VLM）在高压提示下的虚假承诺。在tone-matters基准上，LLaVA-1.5-7B的攻击成功率从66.75%降至0.50%，但正例准确率也降至15.56%；通过任务先验/分歧门控，正例准确率恢复至54.44%，攻击成功率降至1.63%。在GLM-4.6V和Llama-3.2-Vision上的留出实验表明，简单的门控方法可以改善安全中性化，但当前门控仍基于后验和表面形式，缺乏独立验证的接地感知检测器。
Motivation: 高压提示可能迫使VLM做出无根据的承诺，如阅读模糊文本或确认不存在的物体。现有方法缺乏利用压力本身作为对比解码负分支的有效手段。
Method: 提出音调压力对比解码（TPCD），从安全中性指令的logits中减去高压指令下的logits；并设计了任务先验/分歧门控和类别无关的答案分歧路由器来平衡攻击成功率和正例准确率。
Result: 在tone-matters基准上，TPCD将LLaVA-1.5-7B的攻击成功率从66.75%降至0.50%，但正例准确率跌至15.56%；通过门控，正例准确率恢复至54.44%，攻击成功率降至1.63%。留出实验中，答案分歧路由器将聚合攻击成功率降至6.93%，优于安全中性化（10.98%）和分支分歧（9.67%），正例准确率匹配79.94%。
Conclusion: 压力是探测承诺偏差的有效探针和缓解信号，但当前门控方法仍是后验的且基于表面形式，尚未成为独立验证的接地感知检测器。

papers.title: AgentGFM: A Graph Foundation Model with Node-Agent Information-Flow Control
papers.abstract_en: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable knowledge from multi-domain graphs and adapt to unseen scenarios. As a fundamental source of relational semantics in graphs, the transferability of topological patterns has long been central to GFM research. However, local structural patterns may vary across graphs and even among nodes within the same graph. Despite such structural variation, most existing GFMs rely on manually designed propagation schemes and apply them to new graphs largely unchanged. Such fixed schemes may not suit the diverse structural patterns of different nodes. This raises a key question: can each node autonomously determine how information should be propagated through the graph? We refer to this capability as information-flow control. Inspired by recent advances in agent technology, we formulate this problem as agent-based decision making and treat each node as an agent. Accordingly, we propose AgentGFM, in which all node agents follow a shared end-to-end trainable policy rather than using independent models. For adaptive information-flow control, each node interacts with the graph through a predict-act-observe-correct process. During the act stage, the node makes three decisions: source reception, signal-channel selection and gain-aware node-wise halting. The resulting observation is compared with the prediction and their discrepancy is used to correct the node state and guide subsequent interactions. Extensive experiments across node-level, graph-level and large-scale transfer scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of AgentGFM across diverse graph topologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentGFM，一种图基础模型，将每个节点视为智能体，通过端到端可训练的策略进行自适应信息流控制。节点通过预测-行动-观察-纠正过程决定信息传播，包括源接收、信号通道选择和增益感知节点停止。实验在节点级、图级和大规模迁移场景中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有图基础模型依赖手动设计的固定传播方案，无法适应不同节点的多样化结构模式，需要节点自主决定信息如何传播。
Method: 将节点视为智能体，共享端到端可训练策略，在行动阶段做出源接收、信号通道选择和增益感知节点停止三个决策，并通过预测-观察-纠正过程更新节点状态。
Result: 在节点级、图级和大规模迁移场景中的实验表明AgentGFM在不同图拓扑上有效。
Conclusion: 节点智能体方法可以实现自适应信息流控制，提升图基础模型的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CineWeaver: Training-Free Reference-Controllable Multi-Shot Long Video Generation for Cinematic Storytelling
papers.abstract_en: Cinematic video generation is challenging for text-to-video diffusion models due to concurrent requirements on multi-shot generation, fine-grained controllability over characters and scenes, and long-form generation across extended temporal horizons. Existing methods rely on customization and retraining to separately address specific requirements, and cannot simultaneously fulfill all the requirements with a unified framework. In this paper, we shed light on the training-free paradigm with the key insight that the difficulty of multi-shot generation arises from a structural bias toward temporal continuity in pretrained video diffusion models, and consequently, propose a unified framework named CineWeaver to achieve reference-controllable multi-shot long-video generation without retraining. We manipulate positional encoding and attention patterns to break temporal continuity during inference to enable clear shot transitions using pretrained video diffusion models. Furthermore, we extend the proposed framework with a shot-routed reference conditioning mechanism for per-shot fine-grained controllability, and develop an anchor memory mechanism to allow long-form generation with consistent global appearance cues. To our best knowledge, CineWeaver is the first unified framework to simultaneously enable \textbf{long-form}, \textbf{reference-controllable}, and \textbf{multi-shot} video generation in a training-free fashion. Experimental results demonstrate that CineWeaver produces high-quality cinematic videos of long durations with consistent identities, stable global appearance, and clear shot transitions. The project page is available at: https://cineweaver.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电影级视频生成中的多镜头、参考可控和长视频需求，提出 CineWeaver，一个无需重训练的统一框架。通过操纵位置编码和注意力模式在推理时打破时间连续性实现清晰镜头切换，结合镜头路由参考条件和锚点记忆机制，实现长视频生成并保持全局外观一致性。实验表明能生成高质量长视频，具有一致身份和清晰镜头切换。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频扩散模型难以同时满足多镜头生成、细粒度角色/场景控制和长视频生成的需求，通常需要针对特定需求进行定制和重训练，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 提出训练无关的 CineWeaver 框架：1）通过修改位置编码和注意力模式在推理时打破时间连续性实现多镜头切换；2）引入镜头路由参考条件机制实现每镜头的细粒度控制；3）开发锚点记忆机制用于长视频生成，保持全局外观一致性。
Result: 实验表明 CineWeaver 能生成高质量电影级长视频，具有一致的身份、稳定的全局外观和清晰的镜头切换。

papers.title: Shared Symbolic Backbones for Physically Consistent Multi-Output Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression provides analytical expressions, but it is usually applied one output at a time. This is limiting in process systems, where state variables are often coupled through shared physical parameters. Independent symbolic regression can give accurate individual equations that are difficult to interpret as one model. We present a neuro-evolutionary symbolic regression method for coupled multi-output systems. The method searches for a shared symbolic backbone: a set of latent symbolic units that is discovered once and reused by several outputs through sparse additive or multiplicative read-outs. The discrete model structure is evolved by mutation and crossover, whereas the continuous parameters are tuned by gradient descent and inherited by the offspring. The method is assessed on a set of benchmarks with known ground truth and on a hydrothermal liquefaction yield case. The results show that coupling is not a general route to lower prediction error. Its main contribution is the enforcement and diagnosis of cross-output consistency when a physically shared factor is embedded in a latent expression and is weakly identifiable from the data. This occurs for Langmuir-Hinshelwood and site-coverage denominators, for which independent PySR does not close the consistency gap or recover the same shared form. Conversely, when each output is already identifiable, as in the Van de Vusse benchmark, independent symbolic regression matches or improves the coupled model. The proposed framework, rather than a general purpose predictor, is a structured shared-mechanism extractor. Its value is highest when the target structure is sparse, shared, weakly identifiable or constrained by closure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经进化符号回归方法，用于耦合多输出系统，通过共享符号骨架（shared symbolic backbone）实现跨输出的一致性。该方法在多个基准和热解液化案例上评估，发现耦合不一定降低预测误差，主要价值在于强制和诊断跨输出一致性，尤其是当共享物理因子弱可识别时。
Motivation: 传统符号回归通常一次只处理一个输出，忽略了过程系统中状态变量通过共享物理参数的耦合，导致独立回归得到的方程难以作为统一模型解释。
Method: 提出一种神经进化符号回归方法，搜索共享符号骨架（一组潜在符号单元），通过稀疏加性或乘积型读出被多个输出重用。离散模型结构通过变异和交叉进化，连续参数通过梯度下降调优并遗传给后代。
Result: 在已知真值的基准和热解液化案例上，耦合不一定是降低预测误差的通用途径；其主要贡献是当共享物理因子（如Langmuir-Hinshelwood分母）弱可识别时，强制和诊断跨输出一致性，而独立PySR无法闭合一致性差距或恢复相同共享形式。
Conclusion: 该框架是结构化共享机制提取器，而非通用预测器，最适合目标结构稀疏、共享、弱可识别或受闭合约束的场景。

papers.title: The Art of Not Forgetting A Local Learning Architecture for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CMP (Cognitive Memory Primitive), a continual-learning architecture that repre?sents inputs as sparse relational codes, stores them in a two-tier competitive memory, and learns through local updates without end-to-end backpropagation through its feature-generating system. We investigate whether combining sparse representations, local learning, and persistent memory can reduce catastrophic forgetting relative to conventional backpropagation-based continual?learning approaches. On a controlled domain-incremental byte-level language modeling protocol, CMP demonstrates substantially lower backward transfer than a parameter-matched Trans?former trained with online Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC). Across a three-seed replicated 15-domain experiment, CMP exhibits stable forgetting behavior, while separate head-to-head comparisons and domain-order analyses show consistently lower forgetting than the evaluated Transformer baseline under the reported experimental settings. We report these findings alongside a substantial single-domain accuracy gap relative to the Transformer, a null result on a vision benchmark, and a documented failure to combine CMP with an independent accuracy-improving mechanism, reflecting our commitment to reporting both positive and negative outcomes. These results suggest that the combination of sparse representations, local learning, and persistent memory is a promising direction for continual learning, while motivating further investigation into the respective roles of learning rules, representations, and architectural design in mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CMP（认知记忆原语）持续学习架构，将输入编码为稀疏关系代码，存储于两级竞争记忆中，并通过局部更新学习，无需端到端反向传播。在域增量字节级语言建模协议上，CMP相比参数匹配的Transformer结合在线弹性权重巩固（EWC）表现出更低的负向后向迁移（遗忘），但在单域准确率上存在显著差距，且在视觉基准上无效，与独立准确率提升机制结合也失败。结果表明稀疏表示、局部学习和持久记忆的组合是持续学习的有希望方向。
Motivation: 传统基于反向传播的持续学习方法容易遭受灾难性遗忘，本文旨在探索稀疏表示、局部学习和持久记忆的组合是否能减少遗忘。
Method: 提出CMP架构，包含稀疏关系编码、两级竞争记忆存储以及局部更新规则，不使用端到端反向传播来训练特征生成系统。
Result: 在15个域的域增量语言建模实验中，CMP相比Transformer+EWC表现出更低的遗忘（负向后向迁移），但单域准确率低于Transformer，且在视觉基准（如ImageNet）上无改善，与独立准确率提升机制结合也失败。
Conclusion: 稀疏表示、局部学习和持久记忆的组合是减少灾难性遗忘的有前途方向，但需要进一步研究学习规则、表示和架构设计各自的作用，当前方法在准确率上仍有不足。

papers.title: From Unsupervised Subgroups to Hypothetical State-Intervention Policies: An Evaluation of Selected Subgrouping Methods in Observational Health Data
papers.abstract_en: Conventional subgroup analyses can yield unstable and difficult-to-interpret conclusions, especially in observational biomedical data where each individual is observed under only one exposure state, true individual treatment effects are unavailable, and causal structure is uncertain. We investigate whether subgroups constructed from pretreatment characteristics, without using exposure, outcome, or estimated treatment-effect information, can serve as interpretable units for budget-constrained policy prioritization. We propose a framework combining causal-discovery-informed covariate selection, discovery-evaluation sample splitting, inductive unsupervised clustering, uncertainty-aware subgroup selection, and held-out doubly robust policy evaluation. We compare K-means, hard, membership-weighted, and stochastic Fuzzy C-means, Bayesian Gaussian mixture models, and a supervised causal-forest-derived CATE-tree comparator. Policies are evaluated under a 70% budget for hypothetical obesity-to-non-obesity and elevated-to-lower-glucose state shifts in the PIMA Indians Diabetes dataset and for a lifetime-smoking-history contrast in NHANES. The highest estimated ungated utilities were 0.799 for the BMI policy using Bayesian GMM, 0.735 for the glucose policy using hard or membership-weighted FCM, and 0.775 for the smoking-history policy using K-means. All paired 95% confidence intervals for policy-risk differences included zero, and no comparison remained statistically significant after Holm adjustment. Bayesian pooling generally preserved ungated allocations, whereas Empirical Bernstein gating was more conservative. Policies with similar estimated utility could nevertheless prioritize different individuals. The findings should be interpreted as assumption-dependent decision-support evidence for hypothetical state contrasts rather than proof of intervention benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了多种无监督聚类方法在观察性健康数据中构建亚组的能力，并提出一个结合因果发现、样本分割、不确定性感知亚组选择和双重稳健策略评估的框架。在PIMA印第安人糖尿病数据集和NHANES上，针对BMI、血糖和吸烟史等假设性状态转变，在70%预算约束下评估了政策效用，但所有比较在统计调整后均不显著。
Motivation: 传统亚组分析在观察性生物医学数据中不稳定且难以解释，因为每个个体只观测到一种暴露状态，真实个体治疗效果未知，因果结构不确定。需要找到可解释的亚组用于预算约束的政策优先级排序。
Method: 提出一个框架：基于因果发现选择协变量，样本分裂用于发现和评估，使用无监督聚类（K-means、模糊C均值、贝叶斯高斯混合模型等）构建亚组，通过不确定性感知选择亚组，最终用双重稳健方法在留出集上评估政策。
Result: 在PIMA和NHANES数据集上，贝叶斯GMM在BMI政策上获得最高未门控效用0.799，硬/隶属度加权模糊C均值在血糖政策上0.735，K-means在吸烟史政策上0.775。但所有配对95%置信区间包含零，经Holm校正后无显著差异。
Conclusion: 本方法提供的是依赖于假设的决策支持证据，而非干预效益的证明；不同方法虽效用相似，但优先级可能不同。

papers.title: A Graph-Native Bitemporal Memory Store for Conversational AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI agents commonly lack persistent memory across sessions. The obvious fixes like injecting full chat histories into the context window, or delegating to a third-party memory service, either exhaust the model's context budget or send personal data through infrastructure the user does not control. We describe a memory store that avoids both problems: an agent-local Neo4j property graph augmented with HNSW vector indexes and a full bitemporal data model. Each memory is stored as an immutable identity node linked to versioned content nodes carrying two closed-open time intervals: valid time (when the fact was true in the world) and transaction time (when the database recorded it). This design supports point-in-time semantic retrieval without physically overwriting history. Semantic edges between related memories are maintained automatically at write time using cosine similarity over 1024-dimensional embeddings. We evaluate the system on LongMemEval, a 500-question benchmark spanning six question types designed to stress long-term memory. Across 60 sampled questions, the current-state semantic search path achieves 46.7% R@10 overall, rising to 80% on knowledge-update questions. The time-travel path yields 80% R@10 on knowledge-update but decreases recall on temporal-reasoning questions (50% to 37.5%), a consequence of post-filter dilution that points directly to a concrete design improvement. We discuss what these results reveal about the limits of pure retrieval for different question types and what each failure mode suggests for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图数据库的本地化双时态记忆存储方案，用于解决对话AI代理的跨会话持久记忆问题。系统利用Neo4j属性图、HNSW向量索引和双时态数据模型，支持时间点语义检索和历史重写。在LongMemEval基准上，当前状态语义搜索路径达到46.7% R@10，时间旅行路径在知识更新问题上达到80% R@10，但在时序推理问题上召回下降。
Motivation: 对话AI代理缺乏跨会话的持久记忆，现有方案或耗尽上下文预算，或将个人数据交由第三方控制。
Method: 构建基于Neo4j的图存储，为每个记忆创建不可变标识节点和版本化内容节点，使用有效时间和事务时间双时态模型，并通过余弦相似度自动维护语义边。
Result: 在LongMemEval的60个样本上，当前状态搜索R@10为46.7%，知识更新问题达80%；时间旅行在知识更新上同样80%，但时序推理问题从50%降至37.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要指出纯检索对不同问题类型有局限性，后过滤稀释是时序推理性能下降的原因，为未来设计改进提供方向。

papers.title: EgoSafe: A First-Person Mobile-Captured Benchmark for Visual Safety Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Reliable visual safety understanding in real-world scenarios demands more than just object recognition; it requires causal reasoning under epistemic uncertainty. While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive semantic alignment on standard benchmarks, they often struggle to distinguish between superficial correlation and genuine forensic logic when grounded in the dynamic, partially observable nature of first-person experiences. Existing evaluations, dominated by third-person surveillance footage and binary classification metrics, fail to expose this cognitive gap. To address this, we introduce EgoSafe-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to probe forensic reasoning in egocentric safety scenarios. It comprises 12,000 unique evaluation samples, generated by pairing each of the 3,000 video clips with a QA chain governed by our proposed Hierarchical Reasoning Evaluation (HRE) protocol. Unlike standard benchmarks, HRE mandates a rigorous reasoning trajectory from initial feature anchoring to blind-spot deduction and intent inference, thereby enforcing logical consistency and penalizing shortcut-based predictions.Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art LVLMs (e.g., Qwen3-VL, Gemini, VideoLLaMA 3) reveal a significant perception-reasoning decoupling: models often achieve high descriptive scores but exhibit notable fragility in causal reasoning and logical closure. Our work provides both a challenging dataset and a systematic evaluation framework to foster the development of logically robust video understanding systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EgoSafe-Bench，一个面向第一人称视角的视觉安全理解基准，包含12000个评估样本，通过层次化推理评估（HRE）协议测试大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的因果推理能力。评估发现现有LVLM存在感知-推理解耦问题，即高描述性得分但因果推理脆弱。
Motivation: 现有视觉安全评估多基于第三人称监控视频和二元分类，无法暴露LVLM在动态、部分可观测的第一人称场景中混淆表面相关性与真正法医逻辑的认知缺口。
Method: 构建EgoSafe-Bench基准，包含3000个视频片段，每个片段配对基于HRE协议的QA链，强制从特征锚定到盲点推断和意图推理的严格推理轨迹，惩罚捷径预测。
Result: 对Qwen3-VL、Gemini、VideoLLaMA 3等先进LVLM的评估显示，模型在描述性任务上得分高，但在因果推理和逻辑闭合上表现脆弱。

papers.title: HiFloat4 Format for End-To-End Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present, to our knowledge, the first end-to-end FP4 RL post-training, in which both the rollout and training policies, including their forward and backward passes, operate at 4-bit precision. A systematic study reveals that the dominant source of degradation in FP4 RL is not training-side quantization error but rollout activation quantization: outliers stretch the dynamic range so far that a large number of activation values underflow to zero under FP4. Counterintuitively, restoring the training policy to higher precision while keeping the rollout in FP4 makes accuracy worse than full FP4 baseline, exposing rollout-training mismatch as the principal failure mode and ruling out standard pretraining-style fixes. We address this with Rollout Residual Quantization (Rollout-ResQ): a single residual correction term constrained to a hardware-friendly sparsity pattern, added only to the FP4 rollout matmul -- a lightweight correction that recovers most of the precision lost to outlier-driven underflow without inflating the rollout's compute footprint. On Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Rollout-ResQ paired with the HiFloat4 (HiF4) format -- whose three-level hierarchical scaling preserves resolution under FP4's tight 4-bit budget -- closes the accuracy gap to BF16 from 4.9% to 1.1%, bringing fully quantized FP4 RL within striking distance of full precision. Applied to the open-standard MXFP4, the same recipe narrows the gap from 13.6% to 5.3%, revealing that FP4 format choice is a key factor that determines the ceiling on recoverable accuracy. Together, these results establish HiF4 as the enabling format for end-to-end FP4 RL post-training, and Rollout-ResQ as the activation-side mechanism that makes the gap to BF16 closable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出端到端的FP4强化学习后训练，即rollout和训练策略的前向/反向传播均在4位精度下运行。研究发现FP4 RL的主要精度损失来源是rollout激活量化中的异常值导致大量激活值下溢为零，而非训练端量化误差。通过提出Rollout Residual Quantization (Rollout-ResQ)——在FP4 rollout矩阵乘法中添加单个残差校正项并约束为硬件友好的稀疏模式——结合HiFloat4 (HiF4)格式的三级层次化缩放，在Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上将与BF16的精度差距从4.9%缩小至1.1%。
Motivation: 现有FP4强化学习后训练面临精度退化问题，主要瓶颈被识别为rollout激活量化中的异常值导致大量值下溢为零，而训练端量化误差并非主因。标准预训练量化修复方法（如将训练策略保持高精度）反而加剧rollout-训练不匹配，需要新的激活端机制。
Method: 提出Rollout Residual Quantization (Rollout-ResQ)：在FP4 rollout矩阵乘法中添加单个残差校正项，并约束为硬件友好的稀疏模式，以恢复因异常值下溢丢失的精度。同时采用HiFloat4 (HiF4)格式，其三级层次化缩放可在4位预算下保持分辨率。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，Rollout-ResQ配合HiF4将FP4 RL与BF16的精度差距从4.9%缩小至1.1%；应用于MXFP4格式时，差距从13.6%缩小至5.3%，表明FP4格式选择是决定可恢复精度上限的关键因素。
Conclusion: HiF4是端到端FP4 RL后训练的使能格式，Rollout-ResQ是使精度接近BF16的激活端机制，且FP4格式选择对精度恢复至关重要。

papers.title: Evidence-Ledger Adjudication for Claim-Evidence Traceability
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can draft claims faster than authors can check whether the cited or retrieved evidence supports them. We study evidence-ledger adjudication: a claim-evidence traceability workflow that pairs each claim with an evidence packet, assigns a support relation, and routes unsupported, contradicted, or mixed-evidence claims back to the author. The empirical core is a 2,335-row blind benchmark built from independent external labels in AVeriTeC, CLIMATE-FEVER, and SciFact. Gold relations and source evidence labels are hidden during prediction and joined only for scoring. On this benchmark, the agent evidence-ledger condition achieves 0.676 relation accuracy and 0.601 macro-F1, compared with 0.383 accuracy and 0.303 macro-F1 for the best non-agent baseline. It also routes 1270/1435 claims whose gold labels indicate contradiction, missing evidence, or mixed evidence, while routing 295/900 supported claims. These results show that evidence-ledger adjudication can turn heterogeneous evidence packets into an auditable traceability layer for AI-assisted writing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出证据账本裁决（evidence-ledger adjudication）工作流，将每个主张与证据包配对，分配支持关系，并将无支持、矛盾或混合证据的主张退回作者。在2335行盲标基准上（来自AVeriTeC、CLIMATE-FEVER、SciFact），基于智能体的证据账本条件达到0.676关系准确率和0.601宏F1，显著优于非智能体基线。该方法可将异质证据包转化为可审计的可追溯层，用于AI辅助写作。
Motivation: AI代理生成主张的速度超过作者验证引用或检索证据是否支持主张的能力，需要一种可审计的追溯方法。
Method: 提出证据账本裁决流程，将主张与证据包配对并分配支持、矛盾或无支持关系，使用智能体（agent）进行判决。
Result: 在2335行盲标基准上，智能体条件达到0.676关系准确率和0.601宏F1，优于非智能体基线（0.383准确率，0.303宏F1）；并成功路由大量矛盾/缺失/混合证据的主张。
Conclusion: 证据账本裁决可以将异质证据包转化为可审计的追溯层，提升AI辅助写作的可靠性。

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Temporal Adaptation for UAV Anti-UAV Tracking
papers.abstract_en: UAV Anti-UAV tracking is an emerging low-altitude security task for localizing an adversarial UAV using the onboard camera of a moving observer UAV. It differs from conventional UAV tracking and ground-based Anti-UAV tracking because both the camera platform and the target move simultaneously. This dual-dynamic setting induces rapid viewpoint changes, motion blur, scale variation, and visually similar distractors, making reliable appearance matching difficult. Under such rapidly changing conditions, fixed visual representations are often insufficient because target appearance becomes unreliable and feature distributions may deviate from the training domain. The target language description remains stable across frames and can therefore serve as a semantic anchor for temporal state propagation, while online feature-distribution alignment can reduce video-specific test-time shifts. In this paper, we propose \emph{SATATrack}, a Semantic-Aware Temporal Adaptation framework for UAV Anti-UAV tracking. SATATrack introduces Semantic-Aware Context Propagation (SACP), which uses the target description to guide temporal context propagation across backbone stages and preserve target identity under rapid appearance changes. An auxiliary contrastive regularizer is used during training to discourage responses to semantically similar background regions. During inference, Temporal-Aware Distribution Alignment (TADA) aligns feature distributions online without updating model parameters, combining recent-frame estimates with training-time statistics for stability. SATATrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on the UAV-Anti-UAV benchmark while remaining competitive in Anti-UAV and UAV object tracking tasks. The code will be available at https://github.com/XiaozhenQiao/SATATrack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SATATrack框架，用于解决UAV Anti-UAV跟踪中双动态设置导致的快速视角变化、运动模糊、尺度变化和相似干扰问题。框架包含语义感知上下文传播（SACP）和时域感知分布对齐（TADA），利用目标语言描述作为语义锚点，并在测试时在线对齐特征分布。在UAV-Anti-UAV基准上取得最先进性能，同时在Anti-UAV和UAV目标跟踪任务中保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有UAV跟踪方法在双动态场景下目标外观不可靠，特征分布偏离训练域，导致匹配困难。
Method: 提出语义感知上下文传播（SACP）利用目标描述引导时序上下文传播，并引入辅助对比正则化；测试时使用时域感知分布对齐（TADA）在线对齐特征分布，不更新模型参数。
Result: 在UAV-Anti-UAV基准上达到最先进性能，并在Anti-UAV和UAV目标跟踪任务中保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 利用稳定语义描述和在线分布对齐能有效应对UAV Anti-UAV跟踪中的快速变化，代码已开源。

papers.title: Collaborative Weighting with Pessimistic Critic for Mitigating Overestimation in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep off-policy reinforcement learning algorithms for continuous control typically rely on neural value function approximation to guide policy improvement. However, temporal-difference (TD) learning introduces noisy targets, resulting in non-stationary optimization, while greedy policy updates amplify early-stage estimation errors. The recursive propagation of such errors leads to persistent overestimation bias and degraded training stability in actor-critic methods. Existing approaches attempt to alleviate this issue via prioritized sampling or modified value learning objectives, but often overemphasize high-uncertainty transitions caused by limited data coverage or bootstrapping errors, thereby further amplifying bias.In this paper, we propose Collaborative Weighting Actor-Critic (CWAC), a unified framework that explicitly accounts for predictive uncertainty in value estimation. CWAC employs distributional critic to model return uncertainty and introduces a collaborative weighting mechanism that jointly reweights TD-errors and uncertainty, enabling robust learning from reliable samples while suppressing noisy updates. In addition, we incorporate a stochastic pessimistic value estimation scheme via sampling from the return distribution, which effectively mitigates error propagation during policy improvement. CWAC can be seamlessly integrated into existing off-policy algorithm frameworks such as SAC, TD3, and DDPG with minimal overhead. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed method significantly enhances performance across a diverse range of simulated tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CWAC-348E.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协作加权演员-评论家（CWAC）框架，通过分布性评论家建模回报不确定性，并引入协作加权机制联合重加权TD误差和不确定性，同时采用随机悲观值估计来缓解离策略强化学习中的高估偏误。实验表明该方法在多种连续控制任务中提升了性能。
Motivation: 离策略强化学习中，TD学习引入噪声目标导致非平稳优化，贪婪策略更新放大早期估计误差，递归传播造成持续高估偏误和训练不稳定。现有方法常过度强调高不确定性转移，进一步放大偏误。
Method: CWAC框架包含三个组件：分布性评论家建模回报不确定性；协作加权机制联合重加权TD误差和不确定性；从回报分布采样实现随机悲观值估计，减少策略改进中的错误传播。
Result: 在多种模拟任务上显著提升性能，可无缝集成于SAC、TD3、DDPG等算法，开销小。
Conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了高估偏误，提高了训练稳定性和性能。

papers.title: From Interface to Inference: Eliciting Any-Order Inference from Any-Order Models
papers.abstract_en: Many discrete reasoning tasks, such as code generation, are inherently non-causal: programmers move between high-level structure and local details, a process we call any-order inference. For autoregressive language models, which lack a native any-order interface, non-causal abilities such as infilling and next-edit prediction require hand-designed mechanisms. Can we instead design models that natively support any-order inference? Masked diffusion models have recently emerged as compelling candidates, as their any-order training objective naturally offers an any-order prediction interface. This interface, however, does not automatically yield any-order inference. We demonstrate that this interface-inference gap stems from positional uncertainty: fixed-canvas, token-level models may know what semantic component should appear without knowing where to place it. In light of this, we propose two complementary approaches: (1) Insertion-based masked diffusion, building on FlexMDM (Kim et al, 2025), relaxes fixed-position commitments via insertions, enabling generation across non-contiguous regions. (2) Latent-space masked diffusion shifts prediction to coarser semantic segments, enabling search over latent generation orders. Empirically, we train a 7B FlexMDM for Python coding and a 125M LatentMDM for GSM8K and show that both approaches induce distinct any-order inference behaviors and improve downstream performance. We release our codebase at https://github.com/SeunggeunKimkr/genuine-any-order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散推理任务（如代码生成）中的非因果过程（称为任意顺序推理），指出自回归模型缺乏原生支持，而掩码扩散模型虽具有任意顺序预测接口，但存在接口-推理差距（位置不确定性）。提出两种互补方法：基于插入的掩码扩散（FlexMDM）通过插入操作放宽固定位置承诺，以及潜在空间掩码扩散（LatentMDM）将预测转移到粗粒度语义段以搜索潜在生成顺序。在Python编码（7B FlexMDM）和GSM8K（125M LatentMDM）上实验表明，两种方法都能诱导不同的任意顺序推理行为并提升下游性能。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型缺乏原生的任意顺序推理接口，而掩码扩散模型虽自然提供任意顺序预测接口，但其接口并不自动转化为任意顺序推理能力，该差距源于位置不确定性。
Method: 提出两种方法：1) 基于插入的掩码扩散（FlexMDM），通过插入操作放宽固定位置承诺，支持非连续区域的生成；2) 潜在空间掩码扩散（LatentMDM），将预测转移到粗粒度语义段，通过潜在生成顺序进行搜索。
Result: 在Python编码任务上训练7B FlexMDM，在GSM8K上训练125M LatentMDM，两者均展现出不同的任意顺序推理行为，并改善了下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 论文提出的两种方法均能有效诱导任意顺序推理行为并提升性能，并开源代码。

summary_sections.method: 提出两种方法：1) 基于插入的掩码扩散（FlexMDM），通过插入操作放宽固定位置承诺，支持非连续区域的生成；2) 潜在空间掩码扩散（LatentMDM），将预测转移到粗粒度语义段，通过潜在生成顺序进行搜索。
summary_sections.result: 在Python编码任务上训练7B FlexMDM，在GSM8K上训练125M LatentMDM，两者均展现出不同的任意顺序推理行为，并改善了下游任务性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文提出的两种方法均能有效诱导任意顺序推理行为并提升性能，并开源代码。

papers.title: HERMES: A Hybrid Ensemble for Head-and-Neck Tumor Segmentation, TN Staging, and Recurrence-Free Survival on PET/CT
papers.abstract_en: We present HERMES (Hybrid Ensemble for Radiotherapy-target segmentation, Malignancy staging, and Event-free Survival), a single containerized algorithm for the three HECKTOR 2026 subtasks: segmentation of the primary tumor (GTVp) and pathological lymph nodes (GTVn), radiological T/N staging, and recurrence-free survival (RFS), computed from a paired FDG-PET/CT scan and an electronic health record. A 10-fold ensemble of STU-Net Small networks produces the segmentation; the predicted mask then drives two downstream tasks. Rather than pass a generic radiomics vector to the staging models, we derive from the predicted masks a compact set of geometry features aligned with the size and number axes of AJCC/UICC 7th-edition radiological N/T staging. On internal cross-validation these features raise N-stage balanced accuracy from 0.691 to 0.720 (+0.030), our largest single design gain, at lower feature dimensionality. For prognosis we combine complementary deep and clinical risk experts in an equal-weight ensemble, and train one deep expert with a concordance-tracking survival loss of our own, whose value approximates the concordance index during training. Every component was selected on honest out-of-fold predictions under a regularization-oriented protocol, with no tuning on the public validation set, and deployed as two decorrelated submissions. On the HECKTOR 2026 validation leaderboard, HERMES achieved a weighted score of 0.6454 (Mean Dice 0.641, T balanced accuracy 0.580, N balanced accuracy 0.642, RFS C-index 0.679) and qualified for the testing phase. Team: AMC_HNC.

papers.title: From Conceptual Hydrologic Models to Conceptually Interpretable Neural Networks: A Snow-Water Mass-Conserving-Perceptron Framework for Discovering Catchment-Scale Precipitation-Storage-Runoff Representations
papers.abstract_en: The Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP) establishes a modeling paradigm in which conceptual hydrologic models can be reformulated as physically constrained, conceptually interpretable neural networks. Here, we develop a snow-water MCP network framework and evaluate it across 513 CAMELS-US basins. We first recast a coupled two-state SOIL-MCP and SNOWMCP conceptual model as a mass-conserving neural network and show that the hydrologic-model and neural-network formulations achieve comparable predictive performance. We then examine cross-node state-information sharing within two-state HYDROMCP architectures and evaluate broader single-layer networks constructed from three types of interpretable MCP units with one to five states. Across CONUS, the median KGEss increases from 0.82 for one-state networks to 0.89 for two-state networks and 0.90 for five-state networks, suggesting diminishing aggregate gains beyond two states. Basin-specific MCP and LSTM selection yields the same median KGEss of 0.90, while the selected MCP networks use fewer parameters on average. Complementary AIC- and KGE-based selection identifies compact, basin-specific directed-graph representations that balance predictive accuracy and model complexity. These analyses provide an empirical basis for identifying the numbers, types, and interactions of states needed for hydrologic representation. Future studies should test joint training against multiple hydrologic responses, such as streamflow, snow water equivalent, and groundwater storage.
papers.comment: 125 pages; Main text: 7 tables, 18 figures; Supplementary Materials: 3 texts, 10 tables, 32 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出雪水质量守恒感知机（Snow-Water MCP）框架，将概念水文模型重构为物理约束的可解释神经网络。在513个CAMELS-US流域上评估，发现两状态网络可达到与五状态网络相近的中位数KGEss（0.89 vs 0.90），而MCP网络与LSTM性能相当但参数更少。研究为确定水文表示中状态的数量、类型和相互作用提供了实证基础。
Motivation: 概念水文模型与神经网络的结合缺乏物理可解释性，且现有方法难以自动发现流域尺度的降水-存储-径流表示。本文旨在建立可解释且物理一致的神经网络框架。
Method: 基于质量守恒感知机（MCP）范式，将概念模型（如SOIL-MCP和SNOWMCP）重新表述为质量守恒的神经网络。设计了HYDROMCP架构，考察跨节点状态信息共享，构建包含1至5个状态的可解释MCP单元的网络。
Result: 在全美大陆（CONUS）上，中位数KGEss从一状态网络的0.82提高到两状态网络的0.89和五状态网络的0.90，表明两状态后聚合增益递减。MCP与LSTM的流域特定选择得到相同中位数KGEss（0.90），但MCP网络平均参数更少。AIC和KGE选择识别出紧凑的有向图表示。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些分析为识别水文表示所需状态的数量、类型和相互作用提供了实证基础，并指出未来应测试联合训练多个水文响应（如流量、雪水当量、地下水储量）。

papers.title: LLMET: Enabling Cross-Layer Evaluation of Emerging M3D Memories for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: The energy consumption of Large Language Model (LLM) serving is becoming a major system challenge as deployment scales, driven by hardware power and thermal constraints and rising electricity costs. A key contributor to chip energy dissipation is data movement between limited on-chip cache and off-chip High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). Meanwhile, emerging memory technologies such as monolithic 3D (M3D) integration of cache memories at the Back-End-Of-Line (BEOL) of logic chips enable larger and denser on-chip memories, creating new opportunities to reduce costly off-chip traffic. However, it remains unclear whether continuously scaling on-chip memory using emerging technologies can effectively improve the energy efficiency of LLM serving. To address this gap, we develop LLMET (LLM with Emerging Technology), a validated cross-layer simulation framework, and conduct a comprehensive study on the impact of large-capacity on-chip memory technologies across a broad range of models, applications and platforms. Utilizing M3D technology to expand the L2 cache from 40MB to 1GB yields a 44% reduction in chip energy during the Llama3.1-70B prefill phase with a 16K context window, based on LLMET simulation on a dual NVIDIA A100 GPU setup. On the 8x NVIDIA B200-like platform, extending the L2 cache from 128MB to 4GB saves the prefill energy by up to 24%. For the edge platform and workloads, the decode energy saving reaches 30% when increasing the 8MB cache size to 256MB. These results highlight the promise of ultra-large on-chip memories for energy-efficient LLM serving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLMET，一个跨层仿真框架，用于评估新兴M3D存储器技术对LLM服务能效的影响。通过在L2缓存中应用M3D技术，将缓存从40MB扩展到1GB，在Llama3.1-70B的prefill阶段可降低44%的芯片能耗；在8x NVIDIA B200平台上，L2缓存从128MB增至4GB可节省24%的prefill能耗。结果显示超大容量片上存储器对节能LLM服务有显著潜力。
Motivation: LLM服务的能耗随部署规模扩大而成为关键挑战，主要源于片上缓存与片外HBM之间的数据移动。新兴M3D存储器技术可在逻辑芯片后道工序集成更大容量的片上缓存，但尚不清楚持续扩展片上缓存是否能有效提升LLM服务的能效。
Method: 开发LLMET，一个经过验证的跨层仿真框架，用于评估不同容量（从40MB到4GB）的M3D L2缓存对多种模型、应用和平台（双NVIDIA A100、8x NVIDIA B200、边缘平台）的芯片能耗影响。
Result: 在双A100平台上，L2缓存从40MB增至1GB使Llama3.1-70B的prefill能耗降低44%；在8x B200平台上，128MB增至4GB节省24%；在边缘平台，8MB增至256MB使decode能耗降低30%。
Conclusion: 论文认为，超大容量片上存储器（如M3D技术）是提升LLM服务能效的有前景的途径。

papers.title: EvoPINN: Agentic Discovery of Executable Algorithms for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their performance heavily relies on the manual, trial-and-error engineering of neural representations, loss formulations, and optimization dynamics. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for automated design, unconstrained code generation often yields mathematically invalid or numerically unstable solutions under strict scientific computing constraints. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{EvoPINN}, an agentic framework that reformulates PINN development from labor-intensive manual design into a rigorous, execution-grounded algorithm discovery problem. EvoPINN navigates a modular search space by decoupling neural representations from training programs, utilizing an LLM agent to iteratively propose memory-conditioned programmatic modifications. To ensure scientific validity, all candidates undergo strict structural verification and budget-matched PDE evaluation. Extensive experiments across diverse PDE regimes (oscillatory, elliptic, dissipative, and nonlinear transport) demonstrate that EvoPINN discovers PDE-specialized learning algorithms that significantly reduce relative $L_{2}$ error compared to baselines. Crucially, EvoPINN autonomously invented SLRC-PINN, a novel architecture whose performance gains persist under rigorous parameter-matched comparisons, establishing the viability of execution-grounded agents for discovering genuinely new scientific computing mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoPINN 是一种代理框架，将物理信息神经网络（PINN）的开发转化为执行驱动的算法发现问题。它通过将神经表示与训练程序解耦，利用 LLM 代理迭代提出记忆条件化的程序修改，并经过严格的结构验证和预算匹配的 PDE 评估。在多种 PDE 上，EvoPINN 发现了专用学习算法，显著降低相对 L2 误差，并自主发明了 SLRC-PINN 架构。
Motivation: PINN 的性能高度依赖手动试错设计，而 LLM 生成的代码在科学计算约束下常出现数学无效或不稳定解。
Method: 提出 EvoPINN，将神经网络表示与训练程序解耦，利用 LLM 代理基于历史记忆迭代提出程序修改，并通过结构验证和预算匹配的 PDE 评估确保科学有效性。
Result: 在振荡、椭圆、耗散和非线性输运等 PDE 上，EvoPINN 发现的方法显著降低相对 L2 误差，并自主发明了 SLRC-PINN 架构，其性能在严格参数匹配比较中保持优势。
Conclusion: 验证了执行驱动代理发现全新科学计算机制的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parameterized Fair Resource Allocation under Diversity Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Resource allocation across multiple agent groups arises in many applications including e-commerce recommendation systems, housing assignment, and course allocation, and is commonly formulated as an optimization problem with diversity constraints to ensure group fairness. Existing approaches typically enforce these constraints as hard conditions, which overly restrict the feasible solution space and often lead to suboptimal allocations. In this paper, we propose PRA, a parameterized framework for fair resource allocation under diversity constraints. Inspired by the use of risk-aversion parameters in economic models, PRA introduces a set of controllable inequality-aversion parameters to softly regulate group-level diversity, thereby enabling flexible trade-offs between fairness and allocation efficiency. With appropriately calibrated parameters, PRA yields fairness-optimal assignments that comply with the specified diversity constraints. To accommodate additional application-specific constraints, we further extend the framework to an adaptive variant, APRA. We establish that the optimality of both PRA and APRA holds regardless of the chosen fairness metric and the nature of the additional constraints, underscoring the generality and robustness of our approach. Extensive experiments on three real-world applications demonstrate that our proposed framework consistently outperforms existing baselines in both effectiveness and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数化公平资源分配框架 PRA，通过在多样性约束中引入可控制的不平等厌恶参数，软调节群体多样性，实现公平性与分配效率的灵活权衡。PRA 在参数校准后可生成符合多样性约束的公平最优分配，并扩展为自适应变体 APRA，支持额外应用特定约束。理论证明最优性独立于公平性度量与附加约束类型，实验在三个真实应用中优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有方法将多样性约束视为硬条件，过度限制可行解空间，导致分配次优。
Method: 受经济模型中风险厌恶参数启发，提出 PRA 框架，引入一组可控制的不平等厌恶参数，软调节群体多样性约束。进一步扩展为自适应变体 APRA，以容纳额外应用特定约束。
Result: 在三个真实应用（包括推荐系统、住房分配和课程分配）上，PRA 和 APRA 在效果和鲁棒性上一致优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调其方法的最优性对公平性度量与额外约束类型均成立，具有通用性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 受经济模型中风险厌恶参数启发，提出 PRA 框架，引入一组可控制的不平等厌恶参数，软调节群体多样性约束。进一步扩展为自适应变体 APRA，以容纳额外应用特定约束。
summary_sections.result: 在三个真实应用（包括推荐系统、住房分配和课程分配）上，PRA 和 APRA 在效果和鲁棒性上一致优于现有基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调其方法的最优性对公平性度量与额外约束类型均成立，具有通用性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Conformal Changepoint Localization and Root Cause Analysis with Corrupted Observations
papers.abstract_en: Detecting when the statistical behavior of an engineered system changes, and identifying which component is responsible, are core problems in the monitoring of telecommunication networks, robotic platforms, security infrastructure, and multi-agent systems. In safety- and mission-critical deployments, such decisions must be accompanied by statistical reliability guarantees rather than by point estimates alone. Conformal changepoint localization (CONCH) and conformal root cause analysis (CROC) meet this need by returning confidence sets that contain the true changepoint, or the true root-cause stream, with a user-specified probability, without parametric assumptions on the data-generating process. In practice, however, observations are frequently corrupted, e.g., by outliers, sensor faults, or adversarial perturbations. While the finite-sample coverage of these procedures is preserved under contamination, the resulting confidence sets can become uninformatively large. Adopting a Huber-type contamination model, this paper proposes weighted CONCH (W-CONCH) and weighted CROC (W-CROC), which downweight observations that are likely to be corrupted with the goal of reducing confidence set size when data may be corrupted. The weighting mechanism, derived from a formal bound on the unknown corrupted data densities, leverages pre-existing second-order classifier-based uncertainty signals, such as those produced by evidential deep learning or Bayesian learning. W-CONCH and W-CROC are further generalized by introducing a meta-learning procedure for the weights that optimizes a differentiable surrogate of the confidence set size. Experiments on image-based and real-world changepoint and root-cause benchmarks show that uncertainty-based weighting substantially reduces confidence set size while maintaining the target coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对受污染观测下的变点定位和根因分析问题，提出加权共形变点定位（W-CONCH）和加权共形根因分析（W-CROC）方法。这些方法通过降权可能被污染的数据点来缩小置信集大小，同时保持用户指定的覆盖概率。加权机制基于二阶分类器不确定性信号，并进一步引入元学习优化权重。实验表明，该方法在保持目标覆盖率的同时显著减小了置信集大小。
Motivation: 现有共形变点定位（CONCH）和共形根因分析（CROC）方法在处理受污染的观测数据（如离群点、传感器故障或对抗扰动）时，虽然保有了有限样本覆盖率，但置信集可能会变得过大而信息量不足。
Method: 提出加权CONCH和加权CROC，采用Huber型污染模型，利用基于二阶分类器不确定性信号（如证据深度学习或贝叶斯学习）的加权机制降权疑似污染观测，并引入元学习过程优化权重以最小化置信集大小的可微替代。
Result: 在基于图像和真实世界的变点及根因基准上，基于不确定性的加权方法在维持目标覆盖率的同时，显著减小了置信集大小。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过加权机制可以有效处理受污染观测下的共形变点定位和根因分析问题，缩小置信集大小而不牺牲覆盖率保证。

papers.title: Learning Dynamic User Personas from Implicit Interaction Streams via Iterative Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) to individual users is essential for improving user experience, yet existing approaches typically rely on explicit preference supervision such as pairwise comparisons or demographic attributes, limiting their applicability in natural interaction settings. We propose IRIS, a framework that learns dynamic user personas directly from implicit interaction streams by extracting behavioral signals from everyday conversations and iteratively refining persona representations through a prediction-driven closed loop without requiring explicit feedback. We introduce an evaluation protocol based on behavior prediction, persona stability, and decision prediction. A proof-of-concept study on a synthetic interaction stream derived from public-domain autobiographical text shows that IRIS produces stable personas and distinguishes individual users while revealing limitations of memory-only approaches on recall-oriented metrics. We then validate IRIS on anonymized real-world Reddit r/AmItheAsshole (AITA) data, with personas built solely from each author's historical interactions. Across 100 authors, IRIS achieves the highest decision prediction accuracy among all evaluated methods (61.0%), outperforming static personas, memory-only retrieval, and no-personalization baselines. These results suggest that implicit behavioral modeling provides a scalable alternative to explicit preference learning for personalized LLMs and offers a practical foundation for adaptive conversational systems and embodied agents that require continuously evolving models of their users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IRIS 框架，从用户日常对话的隐式交互流中提取行为信号，通过预测驱动的闭环迭代精炼用户画像，无需显式偏好反馈。在基于公开自传文本的合成交互流上验证了画像稳定性和个体区分能力，并在 Reddit AITA 数据上对 100 位作者进行测试，决策预测准确率达 61.0%，优于静态画像、纯记忆检索和无个性化基线。
Motivation: 现有个性化大语言模型依赖显式偏好监督（如成对比较或人口属性），限制了其在自然交互场景中的应用。
Method: IRIS 框架通过从日常对话中提取行为信号，并利用预测驱动的闭环迭代精炼用户画像，无需显式反馈。
Result: 在 Reddit AITA 数据上，IRIS 对 100 位作者的决策预测准确率达到 61.0%，优于所有对比方法。
Conclusion: 隐式行为建模可为个性化大语言模型提供可扩展的替代方案，适用于需要持续演化用户模型的对话系统和具身智能体。

papers.title: Audio-Anchored Fusion of Multi-Ratio DiT Reconstruction Residuals for Cross-Domain Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Audio deepfake detectors often degrade when generators, corpora, or recording conditions change. We use a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), trained only on bona fide speech, as a frozen reconstruction probe. Reconstructions at masking ratios 0.5, 0.75, and 0.9 yield explicit multi-ratio residual maps. Because these residuals are domain sensitive, our audio-anchored detector passes the projected frozen-WavLM auditory representation into the fusion sum without gate-based attenuation and uses residuals only as a scalar-gated additive correction. The pre-specified seed-42 run obtains 6.5442% EER / 0.18456 min-DCF on ASVspoof 5 Eval and 13.8372% / 0.36921 on ITW Full; three-seed means are 6.8885 (0.3308)% and 15.3328 (2.0719)%. The latter is below a separately optimized WavLM-ResNet18 reference under both supervision settings. Auxiliary supervision raises dynamic competitive fusion from 18.4007% to 25.2968% mean ITW EER, worsening all three seeds. The results support reconstruction residuals as complementary evidence and motivate a non-competitive auditory path for ASVspoof 5-to-ITW transfer, without claiming a componentwise causal ablation of anchoring alone.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to speech security conference. This work proposes a cross-domain audio deepfake detection framework based on bona-fide trained DiT multi-ratio reconstruction residuals and audio-anchored additive fusion, evaluated on ASVspoof 5 and real-world ITW datasets
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨域音频深度伪造检测框架，使用仅在真实语音上训练的扩散变换器（DiT）作为冻结重建探针，在多个掩码比率（0.5、0.75、0.9）下生成残差图，并通过音频锚定融合（audio-anchored additive fusion）将投影的冻结WavLM听觉表示与残差结合，无需门控衰减。在ASVspoof 5和ITW数据集上评估，在单种子设置下分别达到6.5442%和13.8372%的等错误率（EER），支持残差作为补充证据，并表明非竞争性听觉路径有利于域迁移。
Motivation: 音频深度伪造检测器在面对生成器、语料或录音条件变化时性能下降，现有方法缺乏对域变化鲁棒的跨域检测能力。
Method: 使用仅在真实语音上训练的DiT作为冻结重建探针，在掩码比率0.5、0.75、0.9下重建，生成多比率残差图。提取WavLM听觉表示并投影，将残差作为标量门控加法校正，通过音频锚定融合（无门控衰减）与投影表示结合。
Result: 在ASVspoof 5 Eval上单种子EER为6.5442%，min-DCF为0.18456；在ITW Full上EER为13.8372%，min-DCF为0.36921。三种子平均EER分别为6.8885%和15.3328%。辅助监督反而使ITW EER从18.4007%上升至25.2968%。
Conclusion: 重建残差可作为互补证据，非竞争性听觉路径（无门控衰减）有利于从ASVspoof 5到ITW的域迁移，但未声称对锚定的因果消融。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Architecture Search for Traffic Prediction: A Survey of Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Traffic prediction is a core task in intelligent transportation systems, supporting applications such as adaptive signal control, route guidance, and ride-hailing dispatch. Deep learning models, including graph convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and Transformers, achieve strong results on standard benchmarks, but their architectures are designed by hand, requiring significant expert effort and producing models that often generalize poorly across cities and datasets. Neural Architecture Search (NAS) offers a systematic alternative to manual design. It automates the search over candidate architectures of deep learning models, finding designs that match the spatial-temporal structure of traffic data without manual trial and error. This survey reviews NAS methods applied to traffic prediction, organized by search strategy: gradient-based methods, evolutionary methods, and one-shot weight-sharing methods. For each category, we analyze how the search space is designed to cover spatial and temporal traffic operators, and how the search strategy balances cost against architecture quality. We also discuss open challenges, computational scalability to large road networks, manual search space design, cross-city generalization, dynamic graph structure, and the open question of NAS for spatial-temporal foundation models, and identify directions for future research.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 tables. Accepted at UrbCom 2026, the 8th International Workshop on Urban Computing, co-located with IEEE DCOSS-IoT 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文综述了面向交通预测的神经架构搜索（NAS）方法，按搜索策略（梯度方法、进化方法、单次权重共享方法）组织，分析搜索空间设计和搜索策略的权衡，并讨论了开放挑战与未来方向。
Motivation: 传统交通预测深度学习模型需手工设计架构，依赖专家经验且跨城市泛化差。NAS提供自动化搜索机制，但尚缺乏系统性综述。
Method: 按梯度方法、进化方法、单次权重共享三类策略组织综述，分析各方法中搜索空间如何覆盖时空算子以及搜索策略如何平衡计算成本与架构质量。
Result: 论文为分类综述，未提出新方法或呈现新实验结果，而是对现有工作的归纳与比较。
Conclusion: NAS在交通预测中有效但仍面临计算可扩展性、搜索空间手工设计、跨城市泛化、动态图结构等挑战，并指出未来方向包括面向时空基础模型的NAS。

papers.title: MultivationBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Sequential Motivation Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have sparked significant interest due to their potential for social intelligence; however, their ability to perform sequential motivation reasoning remains insufficiently studied. Existing evaluations predominantly examine static text or isolated visual snapshots, which do not reflect the cumulative nature of real-world behavioral drivers. To address this gap, we introduce MultivationBench, a benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate multimodal motivation reasoning within story-driven visual narratives. The benchmark builds upon established psychological frameworks - Maslow's hierarchy and Reiss's basic desires - and requires models to integrate accumulated multimodal context to infer evolving motivations. Results indicate that MultivationBench presents a significant challenge: all tested models struggle to maintain consistent motivation reasoning across sequential contexts, revealing a critical disconnect between static recognition capabilities and the dynamic reasoning essential for human-like social understanding.
papers.comment: 31 pages, including appendices; 6 figures and 22 tables. Code: https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/MultivationBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultivationBench是一个用于评估多模态大模型在故事驱动视觉叙事中进行顺序动机推理的基准。基于Maslow需求层次和Reiss基本欲望的心理学框架，要求模型整合累积的多模态上下文来推断不断变化的动机。测试结果显示所有模型都难以保持一致的动机推理，揭示了静态识别能力与动态推理之间的关键差距。
Motivation: 现有评估主要考察静态文本或孤立的视觉快照，无法反映现实世界行为驱动因素的累积特性，缺乏对多模态顺序动机推理的系统评估。
Method: 基于Maslow需求层次和Reiss基本欲望的心理学框架，构建故事驱动的视觉叙事数据集，要求模型整合随时间累积的多模态上下文来推理动机。
Result: 所有测试模型在MultivationBench上均表现不佳，难以在顺序上下文中保持一致的动机推理，表明静态识别与动态推理之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前多模态大模型在动态动机推理上的严重不足，是迈向类人社交理解的关键挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PUDA: An AI-Native Hardware Harness for Self-Driving Laboratories
papers.abstract_en: Physical Unified Device Architecture (PUDA) is an AI-native hardware harness for self-driving laboratories (SDLs). Rather than building a human-centered graphical user interface (GUI) orchestration layer, PUDA creates a command-line runtime environment that lets agents observe, orient, decide, and act over experiments while hardware execution remains deterministic, atomic, and auditable. Headless by design, devices appear through discoverable command-line interfaces, JSON protocols are routed through a distributed messaging system, and command responses, data products, and reports are preserved as structured records. PUDA organizes protocols, runs, samples, measurements, and command logs into an AI-native data structure linked by run identifiers and timestamps, preserving provenance from submitted protocol through hardware response to resulting data products. PUDA separates scientific orchestration from physical operation and data telemetry: agents choose experiments, while PUDA executes validated commands and captures provenance-linked state, responses, and data. The contribution is not another optimizer, orchestrator, or recipe language. It is a practical execution and data environment for agentic SDLs; the broader physical AI implication is that PUDA provides an AI-native hardware harness for AI systems to interact with physical tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PUDA 是一种面向自驱动实验室（SDL）的 AI 原生硬件框架。它摒弃了以人为中心的图形用户界面，创建了一个命令行运行时环境，使 AI 智能体能够以确定性、原子性和可审计的方式观察、定位、决策和执行实验。PUDA 通过可发现命令行接口暴露设备，通过分布式消息系统路由 JSON 协议，并将命令响应、数据产品和报告保存为结构化记录。其核心贡献在于为智能体 SDL 提供了一个实用的执行与数据环境，让 AI 系统能够直接与物理工具交互。
Motivation: 现有自驱动实验室通常依赖以人为中心的 GUI 编排层，导致 AI 智能体与物理硬件之间的交互效率低下且缺乏可审计性。PUDA 旨在提供一个 AI 原生的硬件框架，使智能体能够直接、可靠地与物理设备交互。

Conclusion: PUDA 不是一个新优化器、新编排器或新配方语言，而是一个实用的执行与数据环境，用于智能体自驱动实验室。其更广泛的物理 AI 意义在于为 AI 系统与物理工具交互提供了一个 AI 原生的硬件框架。

papers.title: Interpretable Image-Level Acne Severity Grading via EfficientNet-B0 Transfer Learning and Grad-CAM
papers.abstract_en: Acne vulgaris affects most adolescents and many adults. Accurate severity grading guides treatment, monitoring, and clinical trial endpoints, but manual assessment using the Investigator's Global Assessment or Hayashi criteria is limited by inter-rater variability and inconsistent imaging conditions. We developed a four-class acne severity classifier based on the Hayashi criteria using transfer learning with an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B0 model. The model was fine-tuned on the public ACNE04 dataset of 2,983 labeled images using AdamW optimization, geometric and photometric augmentation, and checkpoint selection based on validation macro-F1. On a held-out stratified 15 percent test set, the classifier achieved 93.5 percent accuracy and 94.4 percent macro-F1, with per-class F1 scores from 0.92 to 0.97. Eighty-three percent of errors occurred between adjacent grades. Quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa was 0.956, with a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.935 to 0.973. Bootstrap confidence intervals indicated stable performance. Grad-CAM visualizations from the final convolutional block focused on clinically relevant facial regions, including the forehead, cheeks, and chin. The complete pipeline is provided as functionally equivalent open-source implementations in Python using PyTorch and timm, and in MATLAB R2026a. The software includes a clinician-facing inference interface and a fallback backbone option that supports operation without specialized pretrained-weight packages. These results show that lightweight transfer learning can provide accurate, balanced, and interpretable acne severity grading while offering a reproducible cross-platform reference for future prospective and device-stratified clinical validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用ImageNet预训练的EfficientNet-B0模型，基于Hayashi标准对痤疮严重程度进行四分类分级。在ACNE04数据集上微调后，模型在15%测试集上达到93.5%准确率和94.4%宏F1分数，Grad-CAM可视化关注面部临床相关区域。
Motivation: 手动痤疮严重程度分级存在观察者间变异和成像条件不一致的问题，需要自动、可重复的分级方法。
Method: 采用迁移学习，使用ImageNet预训练的EfficientNet-B0模型，在ACNE04数据集上通过AdamW优化、几何和光度增强以及基于验证宏F1的检查点选择进行微调。
Result: 在15%测试集上，分类器达到93.5%准确率、94.4%宏F1分数，Cohen's kappa为0.956，83%的错误发生在相邻等级之间。
Conclusion: 轻量级迁移学习可以提供准确、平衡且可解释的痤疮严重程度分级，为未来临床验证提供可复现的跨平台参考。

papers.title: Chaos Is a LADDER: Domain Generalization Beyond Invariance via Reweighting
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) aims to learn from multiple source domains and generalize to unseen target domains. Most DG methods pursue invariance: they seek a causal representation whose prediction rule is invariant across domains. This principle is effective when the causal mechanism is stable, but becomes restrictive when the domain itself modulates how causal content maps to the response. In this case, directly feeding domain style into the predictor can create misleading shortcuts, since style does not by itself cause the response. Yet the apparent chaos of multiple styles can become a ladder: style can locate the unseen target domain among source domains and guide which domain-dependent prediction rules should be trusted. We propose \emph{Latent Adaptive Domain Disentanglement and Environment Reweighting} (LADDER), a fixed-model DG pipeline that learns causal/style representations, freezes the encoders, fits source-specific classifiers, and uses an unlabeled target-domain covariate set only at inference to compute weights over these fixed classifiers, with no target labels or model-state updates. We establish theoretical guarantees for source reweighting and validate LADDER on simulations, FMoW, and a location-grouped iWildCam protocol, with gains in overall and group-averaged accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LADDER，一种域泛化方法，通过解耦因果/风格表示、冻结编码器、拟合源域专用分类器，并在推理时利用无标注目标域协变量集计算权重来组合这些分类器，从而处理域调制因果内容的情形。理论分析和实验（模拟、FMoW、iWildCam）表明该方法提升了整体和组平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有域泛化方法主要追求不变性（invariance），但在域本身调制因果内容与响应之间映射时，不变性假设过于严格。直接使用域风格会导致误导性捷径，因为风格本身不直接引起响应。
Method: 提出Latent Adaptive Domain Disentanglement and Environment Reweighting (LADDER)流程：学习因果和风格表示，冻结编码器，训练源域专用分类器，在推理时仅用无标签目标域协变量集计算这些分类器的权重，无需目标标签或模型更新。
Result: 在模拟、FMoW和位置分组的iWildCam协议上，LADDER取得了整体和组平均准确率的提升。
Conclusion: LADDER通过源域重加权（reweighting）有效利用风格信息定位目标域，为域泛化提供了超越不变性假设的新思路。

papers.title: DHRCL:Training Code LLMs with Dense Hierarchical Rewards and Curriculum Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is a natural post-training paradigm for code-oriented large language models because generated programs can be evaluated through parsing, execution, unit tests, and structural analysis.However, existing methods often rely on sparse outcome rewards or statically combine heterogeneous dense signals, even though syntax validity, executability, functional correctness, and structural organization describe different and progressively dependent programming capabilities. We propose DHRCL, a reinforcement learning framework with Dense Hierarchical Rewards and Curriculum Learning. DHRCL decomposes feedback into syntax validation, execution success, unit-test pass rate, and AST-based structural similarity, and organizes these signals through a three-stage Syntax, Execution, Pass & Structural curriculum. Stage duration is determined automatically from recent validation trends rather than manually specified capability thresholds. We further introduce stage-aware probability-based token credit redistribution. The mechanism follows a consolidation-to-refinement principle: it emphasizes established token patterns during syntax-oriented optimization, applies uniform propagation for non-local execution feedback, and allocates more credit or blame to less-established token decisions during final functional optimization. Under a unified Qwen3-8B and KodCode protocol, the experiments compare DHRCL with binary, pass-rate, reward-model-based, and verifiable dense-reward baselines. We further evaluate DHRCL across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-14B backbones, showing that its advantage remains consistent as model capacity increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DHRCL，一种用于代码大语言模型后训练的强化学习框架，将反馈分解为语法验证、执行成功、单元测试通过率和 AST 结构相似性四个层级，并组织为语法、执行、通过&结构三阶段课程学习。阶段时长由验证趋势自动确定，并引入阶段感知的概率式 token 信用再分配机制。在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 上，该方法优于多种基线，且优势随模型规模增大保持一致。
Motivation: 现有代码 LLM 后训练方法常依赖稀疏结果奖励或静态组合异构密集信号，未能利用语法、可执行性、功能正确性和结构组织之间逐渐依赖的编程能力关系。
Method: 提出 DHRCL 框架：将代码反馈分解为四个层级，组织为三阶段课程学习（语法、执行、通过&结构），阶段时长由近期验证趋势自动确定；并采用阶段感知的概率式 token 信用再分配机制，遵循巩固-精炼原则。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 上，DHRCL 在统一协议下优于二进制、通过率、奖励模型和可验证密集奖励基线，且优势随模型容量增加保持一致。
Conclusion: DHRCL 通过分层奖励和课程学习有效利用代码的多级反馈信号，提升了代码 LLM 的强化学习训练效果。

papers.title: ForgetBench: Benchmarking Forgetting Dynamics of Long-Term Parametric Memory in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in knowledge acquisition and reasoning, yet their ability to retain previously acquired knowledge under repeated updates remains insufficiently understood. Existing evaluation paradigms primarily focus on single-step reasoning or static knowledge editing, which fail to capture the temporal dynamics of knowledge retention and degradation during continual model modification. In this work, we propose ForgetBench, a benchmark designed to systematically characterize forgetting behavior in LLMs under continual knowledge editing. ForgetBench introduces two complementary evaluation paradigms, namely concept-based QA and scenario-based QA, to disentangle isolated factual retention from structured relational knowledge preservation. Building upon a sequential editing framework, we construct temporally ordered knowledge streams and evaluate model behavior across multiple editing stages. To quantitatively analyze long-term retention dynamics, we further introduce a unified evaluation framework that models knowledge evolution over time, enabling the measurement of temporal decay, retention strength, and cross-instance stability. Extensive experiments across diverse models and editing methods demonstrate that existing approaches fail to strike a balance between long-term retention and generalization quality. Our findings highlight the need for more robust memory mechanisms that can effectively acquire, update, and preserve knowledge over time in future LLMs. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了ForgetBench，一个用于在持续知识编辑下系统刻画LLM遗忘行为的基准。它引入两种互补的评估范式：概念型QA和场景型QA，以解耦孤立事实保留与结构化关系知识保留。基于顺序编辑框架构建时序知识流，并引入统一评估框架建模知识随时间演化，测量时间衰减、保留强度和跨实例稳定性。实验表明现有方法无法在长期保留和泛化质量之间取得平衡。
Motivation: 现有评估主要关注单步推理或静态知识编辑，未能捕捉持续模型修改过程中知识保留和退化的时间动态。
Method: 构建ForgetBench基准，包括概念型QA和场景型QA两个评估范式，基于顺序编辑框架构建时序知识流，并引入统一评估框架建模知识演化。
Result: 大量实验表明现有方法无法在长期保留和泛化质量之间取得平衡。
Conclusion: 需要更稳健的记忆机制来有效获取、更新和随时间保留知识。
