papers.title: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models must learn the joint dynamics of states, actions, events, and observations, yet existing video, robotics, and simulation datasets usually capture only part of this structure. We introduce CG-World, a large-scale world-state dataset and protocol derived from industrial computer graphics production pipelines. CG-World explicitly records intermediate states, including multimodal semantics, spatial structure, skeletal and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters, physics caches, contact events, and multi-pass renderings. CG-World v1 contains approximately 850,000 temporally aligned segments of 1-5 seconds. It separates latent states, observations, relations, events, and branch metadata, and organizes them into unified spatiotemporal samples. To support intervention learning and counterfactual reasoning, CG-World defines a branch lineage covering factual trajectories, observation interventions, action interventions, mechanism interventions, and strict counterfactual branches, with intervention targets, invariants, and alternative outcomes explicitly recorded. We evaluate the dataset on geometry-conditioned video generation, action prediction, and closed-loop vision-language-action policy transfer. Results show that CG-World provides reusable structured supervision for controlled generation, action modeling, and embodied policy transfer. We plan to expand CG-World through continued data collection and community collaboration toward a shared data infrastructure for world models, Physical AI, and embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CG-World是一个从工业计算机图形（CG）生产管线导出的大规模世界状态数据集，显式记录了多模态语义、空间结构、骨骼与控制状态、运动曲线、相机与光照参数、物理缓存、接触事件以及多通道渲染等中间状态。数据集包含约85万个时间对齐片段，长度1-5秒，并定义了事实轨迹、观察干预、动作干预、机制干预及严格反事实分支的分支谱系，记录了干预目标、不变性与替代结果。实验表明该数据集可用于几何条件视频生成、动作预测和闭环视觉-语言-动作策略迁移。
Motivation: 现有视频、机器人与仿真数据集通常只捕捉状态、动作、事件和观测的局部结构，缺乏显式的、结构化的世界状态记录，限制了世界模型学习联合动力学的能力。
Method: 从工业CG生产管线提取中间状态，构建统一的时间-空间样本，包含分支谱系（事实轨迹、各类干预与反事实分支），并记录干预目标、不变性与替代结果。
Result: 在几何条件视频生成、动作预测和闭环视觉-语言-动作策略迁移任务上验证了数据集的有效性，表明其提供了可复用的结构化监督信号。
Conclusion: CG-World为世界模型、物理AI和具身智能提供了一种共享数据基础设施的初步方案，未来将通过持续数据收集与社区协作进行扩展。

summary_sections.tldr: CG-World是一个从工业计算机图形（CG）生产管线导出的大规模世界状态数据集，显式记录了多模态语义、空间结构、骨骼与控制状态、运动曲线、相机与光照参数、物理缓存、接触事件以及多通道渲染等中间状态。数据集包含约85万个时间对齐片段，长度1-5秒，并定义了事实轨迹、观察干预、动作干预、机制干预及严格反事实分支的分支谱系，记录了干预目标、不变性与替代结果。实验表明该数据集可用于几何条件视频生成、动作预测和闭环视觉-语言-动作策略迁移。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有视频、机器人与仿真数据集通常只捕捉状态、动作、事件和观测的局部结构，缺乏显式的、结构化的世界状态记录，限制了世界模型学习联合动力学的能力。
summary_sections.method: 从工业CG生产管线提取中间状态，构建统一的时间-空间样本，包含分支谱系（事实轨迹、各类干预与反事实分支），并记录干预目标、不变性与替代结果。
summary_sections.result: 在几何条件视频生成、动作预测和闭环视觉-语言-动作策略迁移任务上验证了数据集的有效性，表明其提供了可复用的结构化监督信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: CG-World为世界模型、物理AI和具身智能提供了一种共享数据基础设施的初步方案，未来将通过持续数据收集与社区协作进行扩展。

papers.title: Mergeable Model-Side Aggregation States for Long-Context Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A known limitation of long-context language models is their increasingly unreliable performance in non-additive, set-based aggregation as context length grows. Examples include cardinality estimation, set relationships, and grouped statistics, which widely exist in logs, program outputs, tables, and multi-turn conversations. To provide the aggregation state required by these tasks, we introduce a model-side aggregation interface that maintains compact Hash-based HyperLogLog (HLL) sketch states alongside a frozen language model. While the model processes the context, an extractor maps each relevant record to a canonical identity. The identity is then hashed and updates the HLL state. These states can be merged across context segments and/or read out directly for downstream reasoning, avoiding an additional generate-execute-return cycle. We validate the proposed approach by setting the HLL state size as 2 KiB (2,048 registers), which does not increase with context length or set cardinality. In a distinct-count experiment involving one million records, the mean relative error was 1.6%. In a separate merge test, states built from as many as 256 segments produced exactly the same readout as a single pass over the same stream. On 3,969 aggregate-then-reason tasks from 174 source windows, the fixed-budget interface reached 99.2% accuracy on Gemma 4 (31B, BF16), compared with 100.0% under exact aggregation; the paired gap was 0.8 percentage points (95% window-cluster CI: 0.5-1.3 points). On a matched set of 174 items, our method improved over direct full-context reasoning by 63.2 points on Qwen and 56.3 points on Gemma. The corresponding gains over chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning were 60.9 and 63.2 points, respectively. On a fixed 1,200-task Oolong-Synth subset, our method reached 91.1% on Qwen and 99.3% on Gemma. Code is available at https://github.com/songdc98/sketchops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文语言模型在非加性、基于集合的聚合任务（如基数估计、集合关系、分组统计）上随上下文长度增长性能下降的问题，提出一种模型侧聚合接口。该方法在冻结的语言模型旁维护基于哈希的HyperLogLog（HLL）草图状态，提取器将每条相关记录映射到规范标识并更新HLL状态，该状态可跨上下文段合并或直接读出用于下游推理。实验在100万条记录的不同计数任务上达到1.6%平均相对误差，在3969个聚合-推理任务上使用固定预算接口（2 KiB状态）在Gemma 4上达到99.2%准确率，相比直接全上下文推理和思维链推理均有显著提升。
Motivation: 长上下文语言模型在处理非加性、基于集合的聚合任务时，随上下文长度增加性能变得不可靠，这些任务广泛存在于日志、程序输出、表格和多轮对话中，现有模型缺乏高效准确的聚合状态接口。
Method: 提出模型侧聚合接口，维护紧凑的基于哈希的HyperLogLog草图状态，该状态不随上下文长度或集合基数增长。通过提取器将记录映射到规范标识并哈希更新HLL状态，状态可合并和直接读出，避免额外的生成-执行-返回循环。
Result: 在100万条记录的不同计数实验中，2 KiB状态大小下平均相对误差为1.6%；从256个段合并的状态与单次扫描结果一致。在3969个聚合-推理任务上达到99.2%准确率（Gemma 4），与精确聚合的100.0%相比差距0.8个百分点；在匹配的174项任务上，相比直接推理提升63.2（Qwen）和56.3（Gemma）个百分点，相比思维链提升60.9和63.2个百分点。在Oolong-Synth子集上达到91.1%（Qwen）和99.3%（Gemma）。
Conclusion: 固定预算的模型侧聚合接口能够高效准确地支持长上下文中的聚合任务，合并一致性良好，显著优于直接推理和思维链方法。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Cost-Constrained Quadrupedal Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Deploying learned control policies on low-cost robotic platforms introduces transport latencies and noisy motor feedback that systematically widens the sim-to-real gap. The chasm of simulation to deployment in hardware lies in the delay of the actuator reaching the commanded position. On platforms such as the Mini Pupper 2, a measured > $50 ms transport delay transforms the locomotion task from a standard Markov decision process into a partially observable one. In this paper, we take a biologically inspired approach of handling noisy and delayed feedback to close the sim-to-real gap, thereby expanding the capability of reinforcement learning on cost-constrained hardware. Using a low-cost quadrupedal hardware platform, we find that using a forward model of the average actuator delay, paired with a time-aware neural network results in robust locomotion. Additionally, our time-aware neural network learned a central pattern generator (CPG): a self-sustaining rhythmic gait that is robust to +320 ms latency perturbations, mirroring the CPGs found in the spinal cords of vertebrates. We posit that temporal self-organization may be a general strategy for cost-constrained locomotion.
papers.comment: Sim-to-real transfer, locomotion, reinforcement learning, central pattern generator
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低成本四足机器人硬件上的强化学习控制策略部署问题，发现超过50毫秒的传输延迟使标准马尔可夫决策过程变为部分可观测过程。采用生物启发的方法，利用平均执行器延迟的前向模型和时间感知神经网络，在Mini Pupper 2平台上实现了鲁棒的行走。时间感知神经网络自发学习了中央模式生成器（CPG），对超过320毫秒的延迟扰动具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 低成本机器人平台上的传输延迟和噪声电机反馈扩大了sim-to-real差距，使得强化学习策略难以在硬件上部署。
Method: 提出使用平均执行器延迟的前向模型和时间感知神经网络来处理部分可观测性，并学习自持的节律性步态。
Result: 在低成本四足平台Mini Pupper 2上实现了鲁棒行走，时间感知神经网络自发产生了对超过320毫秒延迟扰动鲁棒的中央模式生成器。
Conclusion: 时间自组织可能是成本受限运动的一般策略。

papers.title: FAS-R1: A Unified Multi-Task MLLM for Reasoning Face Anti-Spoofing
papers.abstract_en: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) is increasingly expected to provide not only bona fide/spoof decisions, but also attack semantics and image-grounded evidence for human inspection. Existing discriminative FAS models remain largely label-centric, while recent MLLM-based methods offer structured outputs but still rely mainly on supervised fine-tuning, often producing template-like rationales and weak optimization for difficult attacks. We propose FAS-R1, a two-stage reasoning-oriented MLLM framework for unified FAS prediction, covering authenticity classification, attack-type recognition and spoof-region localization. FAS-R1 first uses FAS-R1-23K, a high-quality long-CoT dataset, for cold-start supervised fine-tuning, and then performs FAS-specific GRPO post-training. Degradation-Simulated Augmentation (DSA) encourages stable spoof-cue reasoning across visual-quality shifts, while Difficulty-Aware GRPO (DA-GRPO) mitigates easy-sample dominance that may leave difficult task--attack groups under-optimized, especially for subtle or ambiguous attacks such as makeup and mask attacks. The main 3B FAS-R1 model achieves 98.75\% authenticity accuracy, 93.33\% attack-type accuracy, and 96.30/94.73\% AP@40/AP@50 in-domain. It also outperforms the compared systems in cross-domain authenticity generalization and answer-and-rationale quality. Experiments with different base models further show favorable scaling behavior. The code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FAS-R1，一个两阶段推理导向的多模态大语言模型框架，用于统一的面部反欺骗任务，包括真实性分类、攻击类型识别和欺骗区域定位。先使用高质量长推理链数据集FAS-R1-23K进行冷启动监督微调，再进行GRPO后训练。引入退化模拟增强和难度感知GRPO以提升对困难攻击的鲁棒性。3B模型在域内达到98.75%真实性准确率、93.33%攻击类型准确率、96.30/94.73% AP@40/AP@50，并展现出良好的跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有判别式FAS模型以标签为中心，缺乏可解释性；MLLM方法依赖监督微调，生成的推理模板化，对困难攻击优化不足。需要统一的推理式FAS框架以提供攻击语义和图像级证据。
Method: 提出两阶段训练：第一阶段使用FAS-R1-23K长思维链数据集进行冷启动监督微调；第二阶段进行FAS特定的GRPO后训练。包括退化模拟增强以稳定跨视觉质量推理，以及难度感知GRPO以缓解易样本主导问题，优化困难攻击（如化妆和口罩攻击）。
Result: 3B模型在域内达到98.75%真实性准确率、93.33%攻击类型准确率、96.30/94.73% AP@40/AP@50。在跨域真实性泛化和答案-推理链质量上优于对比系统，且实验展示了良好的扩展行为。
Conclusion: FAS-R1统一了多个FAS任务，通过推理增强可解释性和性能，代码将开源。

papers.title: Existence-Field Diffusion Model for Spatial Point Processes with Variable Cardinality
papers.abstract_en: We study generative modeling of spatial point processes (SPP), where both the number of points and their spatial configuration are governed by a joint distribution. While diffusion models have achieved strong performance in modeling complex distributions, extending them to variable-cardinality SPP remains challenging. Existing approaches either decouple the modeling of cardinality and spatial structure, or rely on discrete trans-dimensional operations to modify the number of points, resulting in inflexible and asymmetric generative dynamics. We propose the existence-field diffusion model (EFDM) for spatial point processes modeling, where each potential point is associated with an existence variable representing its degree of presence. This enables a unified diffusion process that jointly models both spatial locations and cardinality without requiring explicit discrete transitions. We demonstrate that our approach provides a flexible and general framework for generative modeling of spatial point processes, achieving improved modeling capability on datasets with varying cardinality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出存在场扩散模型（Existence-Field Diffusion Model, EFDM），用于对可变基数的空间点过程进行生成建模。模型为每个潜在点关联一个存在变量，通过统一的扩散过程同时建模点的位置和数量，避免了显式的离散转置操作。实验表明该方法在可变基数数据集上提升了建模能力。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在处理可变基数的空间点过程时，要么解耦基数与空间结构的建模，要么依赖离散转置操作来改变点数，导致生成动态不灵活且不对称。需要一种能联合建模位置和基数的统一框架。
Method: 提出EFDM，为每个潜在点赋予存在变量，表示其存在程度。通过扩散过程在连续空间中对位置和存在变量进行联合去噪，从而避免显式的基数改变操作。
Result: 在具有可变基数的空间点过程数据集上，EFDM实现了改进的建模能力（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: EFDM为空间点过程的生成建模提供了灵活且通用的框架，能够统一处理点位置和基数。其适用范围包括任何可变基数的点过程场景。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: SCOUT: Per-Context Reset Curricula for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-reward reinforcement learning often fails because rollouts from the unassisted evaluation start rarely reach later task stages. Reset curricula address this by starting some training rollouts from easier intermediate states, called scaffolds. Such a curriculum faces two decisions: scaffold access, obtaining informative starts, and scaffold allocation, deciding how quickly that assistance is removed. Most prior curricula pace removal on one shared schedule, which can fail when task instances, or contexts, learn at different rates. We introduce SCOUT, an online, learner-agnostic reset controller that gives every context its own curriculum. Using only binary rollout success, SCOUT removes assistance after sustained success, restores it after failure, and cautiously tests a harder start when progress stalls, without changing the reward, optimizer, or learner. A counting construction shows that synchronized global pacing can be insufficient when contexts need conflicting amounts of assisted practice. Across six navigation and manipulation settings, scaffold access improves learning and enables success in three where unassisted training fails within the reported budget. In a constructed pacing conflict, each tested global schedule leaves one group unsolved, while SCOUT solves both. Average success can conceal this failure, so we also report the least successful group. Group-level pacing works when learning differences follow known groups but can fail when they occur within one group. SCOUT needs no group labels and remains consistently strong in both cases. A reset curriculum should remove assistance at the scale where learning progress differs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOUT，一种针对稀疏奖励强化学习的在线、与学习器无关的重置课程控制器，它为每个上下文（context）独立管理辅助起始状态的移除和恢复，而非使用全局统一调度。通过实验证明，当不同任务实例学习速度不同时，全局调度可能失败，而SCOUT无需组标签即可适应。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励强化学习中，重置课程（reset curriculum）通常采用全局统一调度来移除辅助起始状态，但当不同任务实例（context）学习速度不同时，这种同步调度可能不足，导致部分实例始终无法成功。
Method: SCOUT是一个在线控制器，仅利用二进制轨迹成功信号，为每个上下文独立维护课程：在持续成功后移除辅助，失败后恢复辅助，并在进展停滞时谨慎尝试更难的起始状态。不改变奖励、优化器或学习器。
Result: 在六个导航和操作环境中，SCOUT提升了学习效果，并在三个原本在给定预算内无法成功训练的环境中实现了成功。在一个构造的调度冲突场景中，所有全局调度都遗留一组未解决，而SCOUT同时解决了两个组。
Conclusion: 重置课程应在学习进度差异发生的尺度上移除辅助，即按上下文而非全局调度。SCOUT无需组标签即可实现这一点，并在组内和组间差异场景中表现一致。

papers.title: Origins and mitigation of double descent in reduced order modeling
papers.abstract_en: Latent low-dimensional structure in datasets of natural and engineered systems enables their sparse sensing, or full-state reconstruction from historical data and very few carefully chosen localized measurements. Depending on the reconstruction algorithm, sensor locations, and measurement noise, the reconstruction risk curves demonstrate a diversity of patterns including a dramatic peak in error known as double descent in Machine Learning literature. Here we explore those scenarios under a unified Data-Noise Averaging theory. Qualitatively, we formulate sufficient criteria for double descent to emerge through a catastrophic amplification of a pathological signal in reconstruction. Quantitatively, we predict the detailed risk curves at a fraction of computational cost, trace reconstruction instability to individual sensors and their combinations, and provide regularization mechanisms to mitigate the instability. We demonstrate results for both static reconstruction of Sea Surface Temperature patterns and time integration of a reduced order model of a PDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究降阶建模（ROM）中双下降现象的起源与缓解。通过统一的数据-噪声平均理论，定性给出了双下降出现的充分条件，定量预测风险曲线并识别重建不稳定性来源，提出正则化机制。实验包括海表温度静态重建和PDE降阶模型的时间积分。
Motivation: 降阶建模中的重建风险曲线可能呈现双下降现象（误差急剧峰值），但其起源和缓解机制尚不明确。
Method: 提出数据-噪声平均理论，从定性和定量两个层面分析双下降的成因，并引入正则化方法抑制不稳定性。
Result: 理论预测的风险曲线与实验吻合，且正则化能有效缓解重建不稳定性。
Conclusion: 双下降源于病态信号放大，通过正则化可缓解；理论适用于静态和动态降阶模型。

papers.title: When Fish Look Alike: Tracking Identities with Dual-branch Elasticity
papers.abstract_en: Tracking dense, homogeneous targets like schooling fish remains a major challenge for multiple object tracking due to extreme inter-individual homogeneity, severe physical clustering, and rapid non-rigid deformations. While heavy-backbone separated detection and embedding trackers like SU-T push accuracy boundaries using complex Re-Identification networks, their computational overhead prohibits edge deployment. Furthermore, these modules often fail when appearance features degrade under severe occlusions. To overcome this, we propose Tracking Identities with Dual-branch Elasticity (TIDE). Bypassing expensive appearance cues, TIDE utilizes the Adaptive Geometric Correspondence IoU, an association mechanism leveraging spatial and structural consistency to robustly handle complex morphological variations. Crucially, TIDE introduces system-level deployment elasticity, decoupling the algorithmic pipeline from strict hardware constraints. Evaluations on the MFT-Edge benchmark demonstrate that our Lightweight L-branch achieves a competitive HOTA of 28.43 using merely 20.47G FLOPs. This represents a 38.7-fold computational reduction compared to upper bounds like SU-T, directly facilitating real-time edge deployment. Concurrently, our Scalable S-branch establishes a 29.98 HOTA, successfully bridging the gap between high-precision cloud analysis and efficient edge tracking. The dataset and codes are released at https://vranlee.github.io/TIDE/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对密集同质目标（如鱼群）的多目标跟踪问题，提出TIDE（Tracking Identities with Dual-branch Elasticity）方法。该方法通过自适应几何对应IoU（Adaptive Geometric Correspondence IoU）机制，利用空间和结构一致性来应对复杂形态变化，并引入系统级部署弹性，将算法流水线与硬件约束解耦。在MFT-Edge基准上，轻量级L分支以20.47G FLOPs实现28.43的HOTA，相比SU-T计算量降低38.7倍；可扩展S分支达到29.98 HOTA，弥合了高精度云分析与高效边缘跟踪之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有密集同质目标跟踪方法如SU-T依赖复杂重识别网络，计算开销大，无法边缘部署，且在严重遮挡下外观特征失效。
Method: 提出TIDE，使用自适应几何对应IoU进行关联，不依赖外观特征，并设计双分支弹性架构：Lightweight L分支用于边缘部署，Scalable S分支用于高精度云分析。
Result: 在MFT-Edge基准上，L分支以20.47G FLOPs实现28.43 HOTA，计算量较SU-T降低38.7倍；S分支实现29.98 HOTA。
Conclusion: TIDE通过几何一致性与部署弹性，在极低计算量下实现竞争性跟踪精度，适合边缘实时应用，并提供了高精度可扩展选项。

papers.title: Do Unified Multimodal Models Think in One Space? A Lens Through Cross-Branch Steering
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to integrate understanding and generation within a single architecture, yet it remains unclear whether these capabilities share a unified and transferable semantic space. This question is fundamentally challenging, as the two branches operate over heterogeneous representations (text tokens vs.\ visual latents) and distinct training objectives, making direct comparison difficult. To address this, we introduce \emph{cross-branch semantic steering}, an intervention-based framework that extracts semantic directions from one branch and applies them to the other. We show that steering vectors learned from the understanding branch can transfer to generation, enabling controllable image synthesis and improved semantic faithfulness. In contrast, the reverse direction consistently shows limited effectiveness. Our analysis suggests that this asymmetry may be related to a practical representational mismatch: understanding-derived vectors capture transferable, object-centric semantics, while generation-derived vectors primarily encode low-level appearance features. Our results reveal that architectural unification does not guarantee semantic alignment, and establish cross-branch steering as a practical tool for probing multimodal representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究统一多模态模型（UMMs）中理解与生成分支是否共享统一的语义空间。通过跨分支语义引导（cross-branch steering）框架，发现理解分支的引导向量可迁移至生成分支，实现可控图像生成和语义保真度提升，但反向引导效果有限，表明架构统一并不保证语义对齐。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型旨在单一架构中整合理解与生成能力，但两者是否共享可迁移的语义空间尚不清楚，这阻碍了对模型内部表征的理解和跨任务迁移。
Method: 提出跨分支语义引导框架，从一个分支提取语义方向向量并应用于另一分支，通过干预实验比较理解到生成与生成到理解的迁移效果。
Result: 理解分支的引导向量可有效控制生成分支的图像生成，提升语义保真度；但生成分支的引导向量对理解分支效果有限，仅编码低层外观特征。
Conclusion: 架构统一不一定带来语义对齐，跨分支语义引导可作为探测多模态表征的实用工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Voice Memory for Agentic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We present Voice Memory, a inference-only scheme for agentic speech recognition: at stream time, a frozen corrector reads a single per-domain memory.md and decides per utterance whether to act on the hypothesis or abstain and keep the 1-best. Asynchronously, a score-gated optimizer revises that file through bounded edits, accepting an edit only when it strictly improves a held-out score. Extended from classical ASR-LM framework, we refer this split the listener-thinker architecture; the two roles are coupled only through the memory, so no weights change and the learned skill stays auditable and portable. Restraint turns out to be the operative skill this loop discovers: unconstrained generative error correction (GER) over-corrects, breaking correct tokens on up to 64% of its edits on financial news, and Voice Memory, reduces this rate to 35%. Across ten HyPoradise domains with an open corrector, Voice Memory, lowers weighted word error rate from 8.36% to 7.52% (7.47% with three added in-context examples) without regressing any dataset below its 1-best baseline; gains concentrate where recoverable headroom is largest, including air-travel commands (8.40% to 3.40%) and noisy far-field speech (CHiME-4, 12.69% to 10.46%). The memory transfers across corrector families and adds zero parameters to the inference path. A demo and example code are provided for future studies.
papers.comment: Preprint. Technical report and open source: https://huggingface.co/huckiyang/voice-memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Voice Memory，一种仅推理阶段的智能体语音识别方案。它通过冻结的正确器读取单域记忆文件，决定是否纠正候选，同时异步优化器通过得分门控修改记忆文件，仅接受严格改进的编辑。在十个 HyPoradise 域上，加权词错误率从 8.36% 降至 7.52%，且不使任何数据集低于基线。
Motivation: 生成式错误纠正（GER）常过度纠正，破坏正确词元，例如在金融新闻上高达64%的编辑会破坏正确词元。需要一种可控的纠正机制，避免过度纠正并保持可审计性。
Method: 采用 listener-thinker 架构：正确器冻结，读取单域记忆文件（memory.md），对每个话语决定是否纠正或弃权保留1-best；异步优化器通过得分门控对记忆文件进行有界编辑，仅在严格改进保留集分数时接受编辑。权重保持不变，学习技能可审计可移植。
Result: 在十个HyPoradise域上，加权词错误率从8.36%降至7.52%（加入三个上下文示例后为7.47%），无数据集退化；金融新闻过度纠正率从64%降至35%；特殊域如航空指令错误率从8.40%降至3.40%，CHiME-4远场语音从12.69%降至10.46%。
Conclusion: Voice Memory 通过记忆文件实现可控纠正，零参数增加，记忆可跨不同正确器系列转移，为未来研究提供了演示和示例代码。

papers.title: Examining the Efficacy of Graph Neural Network Message-Passing in Regression Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNN) facilitate effective prediction on graph data such as molecules, media networks and neural network blueprints. GNNs facilitate prediction through message passing techniques which define how information flows from a node to its neighbors. Due to the ubiquity of the graph data type, the development of newer and better GNNs has garnered much interest in the machine learning community. However, GNN evaluation and benchmarking is primarily driven by classification tasks. Thus, prospective GNN message passing layers are evaluated on their ability to outperform prior work in classification contexts. In contrast, GNNs are equally capable of performing scalar regression prediction, yet this class of problem is often overlooked when proposing new GNNs while the best classification GNNs are utilized in an a priori or off-the-shelf manner for regression problems. In response, this paper studies the efficacy of GNN layers in a slew of regression contexts from rank ordering, error minimization and insight extraction. Results show that deep convolutional GNNs, particularly GEN, are more effective at these tasks than attention-based GNNs, while other classical, theoretically-inspired GNNs remain competitive and efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图神经网络（GNN）在回归任务中的有效性，对比了多种消息传递层在节点级和图级回归的性能。实验表明，深度卷积GNN（尤其是GEN）在回归任务中优于注意力机制GNN，而其他经典GNN也保持竞争力和效率。
Motivation: GNN的评估和基准测试主要基于分类任务，回归任务常被忽视，导致新GNN设计时未充分考虑回归性能。
Method: 系统比较多种GNN消息传递层（包括卷积、注意力等）在回归任务上的表现，涵盖排序、误差最小化和信息提取等场景。
Result: 深度卷积GNN（特别是GEN）在回归任务中优于注意力机制GNN，且经典GNN仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 回归任务应成为GNN评估的重要维度，卷积GNN在回归中表现突出。

papers.title: Flow Map Learning via Nongradient Vector Flow
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-based models benefit from simple regression losses, but inference incurs significant overhead because sampling requires integration. Consistency models address this by directly learning the flow maps along the ODE trajectory, opening a design space between one-step and many-step approaches. However, existing methods face computational challenges such as requiring model inverses or backpropagation through iterated model calls, and do not always prove that the desired ODE flow map is a solution to the loss. We introduce SGFlow, an approach for learning flow maps that bypasses explicit invertibility constraints and expensive differentiation through model iteration. SGFlow trains a model to compute both the ODE solutions and the implied velocity from scratch by following non-conservative dynamics with a stationary point at the desired flow map. On the CIFAR image benchmark, no single method attains the best FID at every step count: SGFlow attains the best FID at 10 sampling steps and remains competitive with flow matching, Meanflow, and Lagrangian map matching at other step counts, while being the only one with a proven stationary-point guarantee for its stopgrad-based dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SGFlow，一种学习扩散模型和流模型中 ODE 流映射的新方法。SGFlow 通过非保守动力学训练模型同时计算 ODE 解和隐含速度，避免了现有方法对显式可逆约束或迭代模型调用的反向传播的需求。在 CIFAR 图像基准上，SGFlow 在 10 步采样时取得最佳 FID，并在其他步数下与流匹配等方法竞争，且是唯一提供停梯度动力学不动点理论保证的方法。
Motivation: 扩散和流模型推理开销大，一致性模型虽可直接学习流映射，但面临需要模型逆或反向传播通过迭代模型调用的计算挑战，且缺乏损失解即为所需流映射的证明。
Method: SGFlow 通过引入非保守动力学，其不动点对应于所需流映射，从零开始训练模型同时输出 ODE 解和隐含速度，绕开了显式可逆约束和昂贵的迭代微分。
Result: 在 CIFAR 图像基准上，SGFlow 在 10 步采样时取得最佳 FID，并在其他步数下与流匹配、Meanflow、拉格朗日映射匹配等竞争，是唯一具有停梯度动力学不动点保证的方法。
Conclusion: SGFlow 提供了一种有理论保证的流映射学习方式，在生成质量和步数灵活性之间取得了竞争力，但其在图像之外领域的泛化性有待探索。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Knowledge before Reasoning: EC-Reason-Bench, a Training-Free Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM Enzyme Classification
papers.abstract_en: Enzyme function prediction is a hierarchical, knowledge-intensive form of protein function classification. Existing benchmarks expose an anomaly: general LLMs often get the coarse first level right, yet once asked for a complete EC number their accuracy at levels two through four drops to almost zero, while specialized models and tools stay usable. We propose EC-Reason-Bench, a training-free, diagnostic evaluation protocol built to answer two questions: why general LLMs score close to nothing on EC number prediction, and how much of that loss can be recovered without updating a single weight. We break enzyme classification ability into four orthogonal levers that can each be measured on their own: output structure, external knowledge, reasoning structure, and reasoning robustness. We test each lever with an inference-time method against a shared zero-shot baseline reproducing previously reported near-zero performance. Experiments with several strong reasoning LLMs yield four main findings. First, external knowledge is decisive and must precede reasoning: uniformly low closed-book performance rises sharply with open-book access, narrowing model gaps. Second, in closed-book settings, whether cascading and chain-of-thought help or hurt depends on a model's tendency to abstain. Third, once evidence is available the aggregate score of the best LLM setting is indistinguishable from simply voting the EC numbers of the nearest retrieved neighbors; that tie is an artifact of averaging, and it hides a large gain on adversarial evidence set against an equally large loss on multi-functional enzymes. Reasoning over evidence therefore acts as an arbiter of conflicting neighbors rather than as a source of knowledge, and no single-number leaderboard can see it. Fourth, accuracy obeys a law of homology availability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EC-Reason-Bench，一个无需训练的诊断基准，用于分析通用大语言模型 (LLM) 在酶分类 (EC 号码预测) 中表现极差的原因。通过将酶分类能力拆解为输出结构、外部知识、推理结构和推理鲁棒性四个正交杠杆，并分别用推理时方法测试，发现外部知识是关键且必须先于推理；开卷访问可大幅提升性能；链式思维的效果依赖于模型是否倾向于放弃；最佳 LLM 设置与简单投票最近邻 EC 号码结果平均相当，但该平均掩盖了不同场景下的显著差异。
Motivation: 现有基准显示通用 LLM 在 EC 号码的粗粒度第一级表现尚可，但完整预测时二至四级的准确率几乎为零，而专用模型仍保持可用。论文旨在探究为何通用 LLM 在 EC 号码预测上得分极低，以及在不更新权重的前提下能恢复多少损失。
Method: 提出 EC-Reason-Bench 协议，将酶分类能力分解为四个正交杠杆：输出结构、外部知识、推理结构和推理鲁棒性。每个杠杆用推理时方法测试，并与重现先前近零性能的零样本基线对比。
Result: 外部知识起决定性作用，闭卷性能低而开卷大幅提升；闭卷时链式思维的效果因模型而异；开卷下最佳 LLM 聚合得分与对最近邻 EC 号码进行投票统计无显著差异，但该平均掩盖了在对抗证据上大幅提升与在多功能酶上大幅下降的差异；准确率服从同源性可用性定律。
Conclusion: 论文强调推理应基于外部知识而非替代知识，且单一数字排行榜无法体现推理作为证据仲裁者的作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Registration-Grounded Spectral Fusion for Unregistered WLI/NBI Endoscopic Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: White-light imaging (WLI) and narrow-band imaging (NBI) provide complementary views of endoscopic lesions, but their paired observations are often spatially misaligned due to viewpoint changes, tissue deformation, and sequential handheld acquisition. This makes direct WLI/NBI fusion prone to mixing non-corresponding regions and may even degrade segmentation around lesion boundaries. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware complex-domain fusion framework for paired-but-unregistered WLI/NBI lesion segmentation. The framework first establishes topology-regularized feature correspondence and further estimates where the cross-modal correspondence is reliable. Guided by this reliability, the model selectively fuses WLI and NBI features in a learnable complex representation. In this representation, WLI-derived cues mainly provide appearance-related magnitude responses, while NBI-derived cues provide structure-sensitive phase responses. Unlike conventional real-valued or symmetric multimodal fusion, the proposed method explicitly models the different roles of WLI and NBI and suppresses unreliable cross-modal interaction in locally mismatched regions. Experiments on paired WLI/NBI endoscopic datasets show that the proposed reliability-aware registration grounding and complex-domain fusion consistently improve lesion segmentation performance. Role-reversal and module ablation studies further validate the necessity of both the modality-role design and reliability-guided cross-modal interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对白光成像（WLI）与窄带成像（NBI）内窥镜图像因空间未配准而难以直接融合的问题，提出一种基于拓扑正则化特征匹配的可靠性感知复杂域融合框架。该框架通过区分WLI提供强度信息、NBI提供结构信息的模态角色，利用可学习的复数表示选择性融合可靠区域，抑制不匹配区域的信息干扰。在配对的WLI/NBI内窥镜数据集上，该方法持续提升了病灶分割性能。
Motivation: WLI和NBI提供互补的内窥镜病灶视角，但手持采集导致空间未配准，直接融合会混合非对应区域，尤其恶化边界分割。
Method: 首先建立拓扑正则化的特征对应，并估计跨模态对应可靠性；然后基于可靠性指导，在可学习的复数表示中融合WLI（幅度）和NBI（相位）特征，显式建模不同模态的角色并抑制局部不匹配区域的交互。
Result: 在配对WLI/NBI内窥镜数据集上，所提方法持续提升病灶分割性能；角色互换与模块消融实验验证了模态角色设计和可靠性引导交互的必要性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过可靠性感知的配准引导和复数域融合有效处理未配准多模态内窥镜图像分割问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CaM-Wolf: Causal-Aware Multimodal Agents for Social Deduction Games
papers.abstract_en: Social deduction games (SDGs) such as Werewolf have become challenging testbeds for AI agents. These games require complex social skills such as reasoning, deception, and collaboration. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have driven significant progress in SDG agents, current approaches are predominantly text-based, overlooking the multimodal nature that is fundamental to human social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce CaM-Wolf, the first SDG agent that integrates multimodal perception and generation. CaM-Wolf processes video inputs from other players, employs a causal-aware Reasoner trained via reinforcement learning to establish logical chains between observable behaviors and hidden roles, and presents itself through an animated avatar. Our experiments and user study show that CaM-Wolf achieves superior agent gameplay performance and enhances the quality of human-AI interaction. This work represents a significant advancement towards creating more human-like AI agents capable of participating in nuanced social dynamics. Our code is available at https://3dagentworld.github.io/avatar_wolf.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CaM-Wolf是首个集成多模态感知与生成的社会推理游戏智能体，通过处理玩家视频输入、使用因果感知推理器（经强化学习训练）建立行为与隐藏角色之间的逻辑链，并以动画头像呈现。实验表明其在游戏表现和人机交互质量上均优于现有文本方法。
Motivation: 现有社会推理游戏智能体主要基于文本，忽略了人类社交互动中多模态信息的重要性。
Method: 提出CaM-Wolf智能体，整合多模态感知（视频输入）与生成，使用基于强化学习训练的因果感知推理器（causal-aware Reasoner）来关联可观察行为与隐藏角色。
Result: 通过实验和用户研究，CaM-Wolf在智能体游戏表现和人机交互质量上均取得更优结果。
Conclusion: 该工作推动了能参与复杂社交动态的类人AI智能体的发展，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Q-Steer: Action-Value Guidance for Molecular Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Oracle-limited molecular optimization gives reward only after a complete molecule is generated, while each rollout requires many local next-token decisions. This delayed-feedback interface makes molecular policy optimization myopic: an optimizer can learn that a molecule was good without knowing which intermediate actions made it good. We introduce Q-Steer, a rollout-time action-value steering primitive for molecular language models. Q-Steer uses an offline-trained and frozen prefix-action value scorer, PAVS-Q, that estimates the downstream reward of taking a candidate next token under a partial SMILES prefix, then adds a normalized value bonus to sampling logits. The optimizer update rule and online oracle budget are unchanged; the claim is fixed-online-oracle performance, not equal total compute. On PMO23 with a fixed 10,000-call online budget, complete factorial studies across two molecular language-model backbones and four optimizers show that Q-Steer improves mean valid-unique score in all eight backbone-optimizer cells, with positive macro mean-score gains between +0.033 and +0.049 and 18-20 task wins per cell. Mechanism controls show that action identity matters: prefix-broadcast values are nearly neutral, while shuffled action values harm performance. These results support Q-Steer as a reusable rollout-time action-value wrapper that improves average molecular optimization reward across optimizer families and policy backbones without changing the online oracle budget.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, and 25 tables. Includes supplementary experimental results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Q-Steer，一种用于分子策略优化的动作值引导方法。使用离线训练的前缀动作值评分器PAVS-Q，在SMILES生成过程中对每个候选token估计下游奖励，并添加归一化值奖励到采样logits中。在PMO23基准上，固定10,000次在线调用预算下，Q-Steer在两个分子语言模型骨干和四个优化器的全部八个组合中均提高了平均有效唯一得分，宏平均得分提升+0.033至+0.049，每个组合获得18-20个任务胜利。
Motivation: 分子策略优化面临延迟反馈问题：只有在完整分子生成后才获得奖励，而生成过程包含许多局部token决策，导致优化器难以知道哪些中间动作导致了好的结果。
Method: 提出Q-Steer，包含一个离线训练且冻结的前缀动作值评分器PAVS-Q，用于估计在当前部分SMILES前缀下选择某个候选token的未来奖励，然后将归一化值奖励添加到采样logits中。在线优化器的更新规则和在线oracle预算保持不变。
Result: 在PMO23基准上，固定10,000次在线oracle调用预算下，Q-Steer在两个分子语言模型骨干和四个优化器的所有八个组合中均提高了平均有效唯一得分，宏平均得分提升+0.033至+0.049，每个组合获得18-20个任务胜利。机制控制实验表明动作身份的重要性：前缀广播值接近中性，而打乱的动作值损害性能。
Conclusion: Q-Steer作为一种可重用的rollout时间动作值包装器，在不改变在线oracle预算的情况下，跨优化器家族和策略骨干提高了平均分子优化奖励。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Misalignment Has a Personality: A Big Five Account of Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a language model on data containing a narrow flaw, such as insecure code or incorrect mathematical answers, can cause broad misalignment through a mechanism that remains debated. We provide an interpretable account: in the models and corpora we study, misalignment behaves like a shift in personality. Prior work extracts activation directions for character traits from a single binary contrast, which can separate or steer behavior without establishing a calibrated scale. We instead extract personality vectors for the Big Five using a graded, three-level intervention and validate them on two open-weight models. The three levels are linearly ordered, with Cohen's d values of up to 6.2; the vectors transfer zero-shot and trait-specifically to an independent corpus; and their effects are strongest within a middle-layer band. Applied to training data, the vectors reveal that misaligned corpora across eight domains share a common Big Five signature: lower agreeableness and conscientiousness, together with higher extraversion and neuroticism. This signature is recovered by both models with a correlation of r = 0.94. Fine-tuning imprints the same profile, shifting the model's generations along the corresponding signature, with r = 0.83 using activation-based measurements and r = 0.90 using a text-based judge, while also shifting internal activations with r = 0.69. The same vectors characterize sycophancy as high extraversion and low conscientiousness rather than excess agreeableness, a distinction that a single direction cannot capture. Calibrated personality vectors transform an opaque safety phenomenon into a human-legible diagnostic profile.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型微调后出现的广泛失调（misalignment）现象，并提供一个可解释的视角：失调类似于人格特质的变化。作者通过三级干预提取大五人格（Big Five）向量，验证两个开源模型上的有效性。实验发现失调语料库在八个领域共享共同特征：低宜人性与尽责性、高外向性与神经质；微调会沿该特征方向改变模型输出和内部激活。该方法将安全现象转化为可读的诊断档案。
Motivation: 当前对微调导致模型广泛失调的机制存在争论，缺乏可解释的定量分析。本文试图用大五人格模型提供一种人类可理解的解释，帮助理解失调行为的根源。
Method: 采用三级线性干预（graded three-level intervention）提取大五人格向量，并独立验证于两个开源模型。向量在中间层效果最强，且能零样本迁移至独立语料库。
Result: 失调语料库在八个领域呈现显著的大五人格签名（r=0.94）；微调后模型内部激活和生成文本均沿该签名方向偏移（激活r=0.69，文本判决器r=0.90）。谄媚行为表现为高外向性和低尽责性，而非高宜人性。
Conclusion: 标定的人格向量能将模型安全现象转化为可量化、可解释的诊断特征，有助于理解失调机制并指导安全干预。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Collusion with Competitive Marginals: Price-Level Audits Are Blind by Construction
papers.abstract_en: Empirical work on algorithmic collusion asks one question of the data: are prices supracompetitive? We show this can be answered "no" by a conspiracy that is nonetheless profitable. Consider bidding agents that couple only through the joint distribution of their unexplained bid components, leaving every agent's own bid law exactly at the competitive law. Any test whose input is a single agent's price or bid history then has power exactly equal to its false-positive rate, for every coupling strength up to comonotonicity. The published detection methodology is therefore blind to this conduct by construction rather than underpowered, and no sample size repairs it. Three empirical results follow. First, the mechanism appears in real language-model agents: twenty models from nineteen independent developers, three deployment prompts each, show residual correlation of $+0.053$ between two deployments of one model against $+0.0001$ across models, with a 95% interval clustered by developer of $[0.030, 0.078]$, under an auditor that sees every order feature and is fitted out of sample. Second, the coupling falls monotonically as sampling temperature rises ($p=0.002$), turning a deployment parameter into a candidate mitigation. Third, on 24 days of Ethereum block-building auction data covering 77,684 bids from 39 bidders, the honest population of bidder pairs is itself so dependent that a screen held at a 5% false-positive rate must sit above a floor of $+0.50$ to $+0.81$, which is 20 to 32 times the family-wise sampling threshold and does not fall as the audit window grows. Since lawful multi-identity operation and conspiracy are behaviourally indistinguishable here, the tractable regulatory target is not detection but counting: resolving 40 bidding identities into 23 operators raises the Herfindahl index by 247.5%, and adding behavioural clusters from public bid streams reaches 324.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明在竞价代理中，通过仅耦合未解释的竞标成分联合分布而不改变每个代理的边际竞标分布，可以实现合谋且不引起价格水平的统计异常。任何基于单个代理价格历史的检测方法在此情形下功效等于假阳性率。作者在语言模型代理和Ethereum区块构建拍卖数据中观察到相关现象，并提出计数而非检测的监管思路。
Motivation: 现有算法合谋实证工作仅检验价格是否高于竞争水平，本文揭示一种即使价格水平不变仍能获利的合谋方式，使得当前检测方法失效。
Method: 构建理论框架：让竞价代理仅通过未解释竞标成分的联合分布耦合，保持每个代理边际竞标分布为竞争分布。分析检测方法的统计功效，并在真实数据（语言模型代理和以太坊拍卖）中验证。
Result: 20个语言模型代理的残差相关系数显示同一模型不同部署间为+0.053，不同模型间为+0.0001；随采样温度升高耦合下降（p=0.002）；以太坊拍卖数据中，诚实竞标者对间的依赖使得5%假阳性率检测阈值需高于+0.50至+0.81，且不随审计窗口增大而下降。
Conclusion: 由于合法多身份操作与合谋在行为上不可区分，可监管目标不是检测而是计数：将40个竞标身份解析为23个运营者使赫芬达尔指数上升247.5%，加入行为聚类后达324.5%。

papers.title: Zero-Fi: Zero-Shot Wi-Fi-Based Human Activity Recognition via Contrastive Signal-Language Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition has advanced substantially, but most existing methods assume a closed set of activities and require labeled Wi-Fi samples for every target class, limiting their ability to recognize unseen activities. We present Zero-Fi, a contrastive signal-language alignment framework for zero-shot Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition. Zero-Fi learns unified representations from complementary Wi-Fi signal features and aligns them with the semantic representations of natural-language activity descriptions in a shared embedding space. This cross-modal alignment enables Zero-Fi to recognize new activity classes without requiring labeled Wi-Fi samples or model adaptation for those classes. Experiments on large-scale public benchmark datasets demonstrate effective zero-shot recognition of held-out activity classes, highlighting the potential of signal-language alignment to extend Wi-Fi sensing beyond predefined activity classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Zero-Fi，一种基于对比信号-语言对齐的零样本Wi-Fi人体活动识别框架。它利用互补的Wi-Fi信号特征与自然语言活动描述的语义表示进行跨模态对齐，从而无需标注样本即可识别新活动类别。实验在大型公开数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有Wi-Fi人体活动识别方法通常假设活动类别固定，且需要每个目标类别的标注样本，无法识别未见过的活动。
Method: 提出对比信号-语言对齐框架，从互补Wi-Fi信号特征中学习统一表示，并与自然语言活动描述的语义表示对齐到共享嵌入空间。
Result: 在大型公开基准数据集上，对留出的活动类别实现了有效的零样本识别。
Conclusion: 信号-语言对齐有望将Wi-Fi感知扩展到预定义活动类别之外。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Adaptive Learning and Model Predictive Control for Tracking Unknown Dynamics with No Regret
papers.abstract_en: We propose a self-adaptive online learning for control method for tracking unknown target dynamics. The target dynamics can exhibit switching behavior, particularly, a mixture of structured, random, and/or adversarial motion. Such challenging target tracking scenarios arise in applications of dynamic mapping, traffic control, and pursuit evasion, where robots need to track, pursue, or avoid collision with moving landmarks, objects, humans, etc., whose dynamics are unknown. Our method simultaneously learns multiple predictors from scratch, via self-supervised, one-shot, and computationally efficient learning, and adaptively selects the best one to match the observed target behavior. The method enjoys finite-time near-optimality guarantees in expectation, characterized as a function of the learning error of the target dynamics and the frequency that the target dynamics switch. In the absence of both error and switching, the method asymptotically matches the optimal non-causal control policy that knows a priori the target dynamics, i.e., the method enjoys no regret in expectation. In the presence of learning errors and switching, the method degrades gracefully, \eg when there are errors and no switching, the average regret is proportional to the average learning error and switching times. To prove these guarantees, a novel technical approach is required compared to the existing works that employ RFF-based online learning. We validate our method in Crazyflie simulations and hardware experiments, across target trajectories that vary from structured to random to adversarial, in comparison to non-stochastic, kernel-based, and neural-network-based methods for online learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应的在线学习控制方法，用于跟踪未知的目标动力学，目标可能表现出结构化、随机或对抗性混合的切换行为。该方法通过自监督、一次性计算高效的方式同时学习多个预测器，并自适应选择最优者以匹配观测行为，具备期望意义下的有限时间近最优保证，在没有学习误差和切换时渐近达到最优非因果控制策略（无遗憾），在存在误差和切换时遗憾性能平滑退化。仿真和硬件实验在Crazyflie平台上验证了效果。
Motivation: 现有跟踪方法难以处理未知动态目标可能出现的结构化、随机或对抗性混合切换行为，而在动态建图、交通控制、追逃等机器人应用中这类场景普遍存在。
Method: 自适应的在线学习控制：同时学习多个预测器（自监督、一次性且计算高效），并在线自适应选择最佳预测器以匹配目标行为，结合模型预测控制实现跟踪。
Result: 方法具备期望意义下的有限时间近最优保证：无学习误差和切换时渐近达到最优非因果控制（无遗憾）；有误差和切换时平均遗憾与平均学习误差及切换次数成正比。在Crazyflie仿真与硬件实验中，与多种在线学习方法相比，在结构化、随机到对抗性目标轨迹上均表现更优。
Conclusion: 论文侧重理论保证与验证，未明确讨论局限性，但指出该方法适用于未知动态跟踪场景。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ClockRoPE: Random Fourier Rotations for Temporal Routine Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has been widely adopted in transformer-based large language models. However, its log-linear frequency schedule, originally designed to produce long-term attention decay, limits its adoption in domains with more complex distance-correlation patterns, such as temporal periodicity in sequential recommendation. We investigate the expressiveness of general query/key rotations and find that any normalized continuous positive-definite attention modulation function can be approximated by random rotations induced by its own Fourier transform, which we term Random Fourier Rotations. Building on this theory, we propose ClockRoPE for routine modeling in sequential recommendation, where rotation frequencies are derived from periodic attention modulation functions. In online A/B tests, ClockRoPE demonstrates consistent improvements in valued engagement metrics, and has been successfully deployed in production-scale generative retrieval system at a major video-sharing platform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ClockRoPE，一种基于随机傅立叶旋转的时序位置编码方法，用于序列推荐中的周期性建模。理论证明任何连续正定注意力调制函数均可由其傅立叶变换生成的随机旋转近似。在线A/B测试中，ClockRoPE在视频分享平台的生成式检索系统中提升了用户参与度指标。
Motivation: 标准RoPE的对数线性频率调度适用于长期注意力衰减，但在序列推荐等具有复杂时间周期性的场景中表达力不足。
Method: 提出随机傅立叶旋转（Random Fourier Rotations）框架，将周期注意力调制函数的傅立叶变换作为旋转频率，推导出ClockRoPE。
Result: 在线A/B测试表明，ClockRoPE在价值参与度指标上持续改进，并已成功部署于大型视频分享平台的生产级生成式检索系统。
Conclusion: 随机傅立叶旋转可有效建模时序周期性，ClockRoPE为序列推荐提供了一种实用的位置编码方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnosing Fine-Grained Inconsistency Classification in Financial Disclosure Text
papers.abstract_en: Financial disclosures contain numerical claims, temporal statements, entity references, policy commitments, and risk descriptions that may conflict in qualitatively different ways. Detecting a conflict is only the first step: review workflows may also need to determine its type, since numerical, temporal, referential, factual, and normative inconsistencies require different evidence and downstream checks. We study this problem as fine-grained inconsistency classification. Using a fixed 5,940-instance snapshot of SBID-FD, a synthetic financial-disclosure benchmark with 11 inconsistency labels and paired reference evidence spans, we compare frozen embedding classifiers, fine-tuned encoders, evidence-augmented classifiers, prompted large language models, and LoRA-adapted generative models under a shared evaluation protocol. A fine-tuned 300M encoder reaches 61.9% accuracy, compared with 61.5% for a LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-9B model and 61.3% for GPT-5.4. Because these systems differ in architecture, supervision, training objective, and input format, we interpret this as a practical efficiency result for compact supervised encoders rather than a controlled conclusion about model scale. Supplying gold evidence spans improves the fine-tuned encoder to 65.3%, whereas automatically predicted spans recover a meaningful but incomplete share of that gain, indicating that localization quality remains a bottleneck. Class-level analyses show that Referential inconsistencies are especially sensitive to localization quality, while Factual and Logical inconsistencies remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided. Together, the oracle, distractor, and per-class analyses separate localization errors from residual type-discrimination errors, indicating that progress requires both stronger evidence extraction and better reasoning over closely related inconsistency categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究金融披露文本中数值、时间、实体、事实和规范等细粒度不一致性的分类问题。使用合成基准SBID-FD的5940个实例，比较了多种分类方法，发现微调300M编码器达到61.9%准确率，与LoRA适配的Qwen3.5-9B（61.5%）和GPT-5.4（61.3%）性能相当。提供真实证据可提升至65.3%，但自动证据定位仍是瓶颈。
Motivation: 检测金融披露文本中的不一致性需要进一步分类其类型，因为不同类型（如数值、时间、引用等）需要不同的证据和验证流程，现有研究缺乏对细粒度不一致性分类的系统评估。
Method: 使用固定5,940实例的SBID-FD基准（含11种不一致性标签和配对证据），在统一评估协议下对比冻结嵌入分类器、微调编码器、证据增强分类器、提示大语言模型和LoRA适配生成模型。
Result: 微调300M编码器准确率61.9%，LoRA适配Qwen3.5-9B为61.5%，GPT-5.4为61.3%。提供真实证据提升至65.3%，自动预测证据仅部分恢复增益。类别分析显示引用不一致对定位敏感，事实和逻辑不一致即使提供证据仍困难。
Conclusion: 定位错误和类型区分错误是主要瓶颈，未来需要更强证据提取和对相似类别的不一致性推理能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究金融披露文本中数值、时间、实体、事实和规范等细粒度不一致性的分类问题。使用合成基准SBID-FD的5940个实例，比较了多种分类方法，发现微调300M编码器达到61.9%准确率，与LoRA适配的Qwen3.5-9B（61.5%）和GPT-5.4（61.3%）性能相当。提供真实证据可提升至65.3%，但自动证据定位仍是瓶颈。
summary_sections.motivation: 检测金融披露文本中的不一致性需要进一步分类其类型，因为不同类型（如数值、时间、引用等）需要不同的证据和验证流程，现有研究缺乏对细粒度不一致性分类的系统评估。
summary_sections.method: 使用固定5,940实例的SBID-FD基准（含11种不一致性标签和配对证据），在统一评估协议下对比冻结嵌入分类器、微调编码器、证据增强分类器、提示大语言模型和LoRA适配生成模型。
summary_sections.result: 微调300M编码器准确率61.9%，LoRA适配Qwen3.5-9B为61.5%，GPT-5.4为61.3%。提供真实证据提升至65.3%，自动预测证据仅部分恢复增益。类别分析显示引用不一致对定位敏感，事实和逻辑不一致即使提供证据仍困难。
summary_sections.conclusion: 定位错误和类型区分错误是主要瓶颈，未来需要更强证据提取和对相似类别的不一致性推理能力。

papers.title: Exploring Structures in Physics Problems: Can AI Agents Discover Statistical Mechanical Mappings?
papers.abstract_en: An important skill in theoretical physics is to recognize when a new problem can be transformed into a known model. We study this skill as an AI-agent task: can LLM-based agents discover statistical mechanical mappings from a raw partition function to a tractable representation? To probe this question, we introduce StatMechBench-v0, a benchmark of six Ising-type problems covering transfer-matrix methods, gauge-removable disorder, and planar/Pfaffian structure. We evaluate a simple propose-verify-revise agent across multiple LLMs and problem phrasings. The results show that numerical feedback often helps agents repair code and recover correct partition functions. However, agents can also pass the numerical checks while misidentifying the underlying tractable class or understating computational complexity. This both reveals limitations in current LLM reasoning and calls for a verification stack that goes beyond numerical agreement, incorporating, for example, symbolic checks and structural invariants. Our study provides an early evaluation and design directions for AI agents aimed at structural discovery in theoretical physics.
papers.comment: Accepted to the AID-Wild workshop at CAIS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理是否能在统计力学问题中发现结构映射，即从原始配分函数转化为可处理形式。作者引入StatMechBench-v0基准，包含六个Ising型问题，覆盖转移矩阵、规范可移除无序和平面/Pfaffian结构。实验表明数值反馈有助于代理修复代码，但代理可能通过数值检验却错误识别可处理类或低估计算复杂度，表明当前LLM推理的局限，需要超越数值一致性的验证栈。
Motivation: 理论物理中识别新问题能否转化为已知模型是一项重要技能，但当前AI代理在该任务上的能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 提出一个简单的“提出-验证-修正”（propose-verify-revise）代理框架，在多个LLM和问题表述上评估，并引入StatMechBench-v0基准。
Result: 数值反馈常帮助代理修复代码并恢复正确配分函数，但代理可能通过数值检验却错误识别可处理类或低估计算复杂性。
Conclusion: 研究表明当前LLM代理在结构发现上存在局限，需要结合符号检查和结构不变量的验证栈，为AI代理在理论物理中的应用提供早期评估和设计方向。

papers.title: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning is widely used in language model training to improve model performance on a target task while limiting drift from a reference policy. A standard way to balance this trade-off is via a KL-regularized RL objective, although this formulation does not by itself provide a principled way to set the regularization coefficient. In practice, the coefficient is typically chosen heuristically or via hyperparameter search, which can lead to unnecessary overhead in training cost or undesirable reward-retention trade-offs. We instead propose a game-theoretic framework that gives this trade-off an explicit statistical interpretation. Specifically, we study a sequential game in which an agent chooses a policy to maximize cumulative reward while a monitor observes policy outputs over time and tests for deviations from the reference policy. Although not originating from the same perspective, we show that the resulting equilibrium policy can nonetheless be expressed as the solution to a KL-regularized RL problem for an optimal regularization parameter that can be viewed as maximizing reward per unit of statistical distinguishability. Drawing on classical results from concave-convex fractional programming, we provide a principled method for learning this equilibrium coefficient via reduction to the KL-regularized RL objective, thus allowing for flexible integration into standard fine-tuning pipelines. In experiments with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.2-1B, we demonstrate that our methods result in competitive reward-retention trade-offs in a continual learning setting, and illustrate how our framework may be used to audit API providers serving open-source models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个博弈论框架来替代 KL-正则化强化学习中正则化系数的启发式选择。通过将问题建模为智能体与监控者之间的序贯博弈，证明平衡策略等价于一个具有最优正则化参数的 KL-正则化 RL 问题，该参数最大化每单位统计可区分性的奖励。基于凹凸分数规划的方法可学习该平衡系数，并集成到标准微调流程中。在 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 上的实验表明，该方法在持续学习设置下实现了有竞争力的奖励-保持权衡，并可用于审计 API 提供商。
Motivation: 当前 KL-正则化 RL 微调中正则化系数通常依靠启发式或超参数搜索选取，导致训练成本增加或奖励-保持权衡不佳，缺乏统计上的合理解释。
Method: 提出一个博弈论序贯博弈框架：智能体选择策略最大化累计奖励，监控者随时间观测策略输出并检验是否偏离参考策略。通过凹凸分数规划将平衡学习归约为 KL-正则化 RL 目标，从而得到最优正则化参数。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 上的实验显示，所提方法在持续学习设置中取得有竞争力的奖励-保持权衡，并可应用于审计 API 提供商。
Conclusion: 该博弈论框架为 KL-正则化 RL 中的正则化系数选择提供了统计基础，并能灵活融入现有微调流程，同时支持审计功能。

papers.title: High-Order Markov Blanket Discovery via a k-Order Relaxation of the Faithfulness Assumption
papers.abstract_en: The problem of learning the graphical Markov blanket (MB) of a variable from data has applications in many areas such as structure learning for Bayesian networks and Markov random fields, causal discovery, and feature selection. However, a common assumption most methods make is that the conditional independencies in the distribution imply the same separation in the graphical structure -- also known as the faithfulness assumption. Unfortunately, this assumption can be violated by higher-order dependencies such as XOR and parity-type relations, and -- on finite samples -- by empirical violations that, in extreme cases, even induce spurious dependencies absent from the true distribution. Therefore, in this paper we propose a "k-order" relaxation of the faithfulness assumption that captures parity type relationships between k+2 variables. We then propose a proof of concept algorithm called k-order Markov blanket (kOMB) that uses this relaxation for MB discovery. Finally, we empirically show how kOMB can recover the MB of a variable under both true and empirical violations of faithfulness. Code available at: https://github.com/lklee9/k-order-Markov-blanket
papers.comment: 17 pages (9 pages main text + supplementary material), 4 figures, 8 tables, 3 algorithms. Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/lklee9/k-order-Markov-blanket
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种k阶马尔可夫毯（kOMB）算法，通过放松faithfulness假设来发现变量在填充域中的高阶依赖关系，如XOR和parity型关系，并在模拟和真实数据上展示了其恢复马尔可夫毯的能力。
Motivation: 现有马尔可夫毯学习方法大多依赖faithfulness假设，但该假设在高阶依赖（如XOR、parity）或有限样本下容易被违反，导致错误的结构学习。
Method: 提出一种k阶faithfulness松弛，并基于此设计kOMB算法，通过条件独立性检验和k阶依赖检测来发现变量的马尔可夫毯。
Result: 实验表明kOMB能在faithfulness被违反的情况下（包括真实和模拟的高阶依赖）正确恢复马尔可夫毯。
Conclusion: k阶松弛方法扩展了马尔可夫毯发现的适用范围，为处理非线性、高阶依赖关系提供了新途径。

papers.title: SADe: Sparse-Atom Support Decontamination for Few-Shot Segmentation with Weak Support Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) commonly assumes clean pixel-level support masks, yet practical support supervision often uses boxes, scribbles, coarse masks, or pseudo-masks. These weak annotations may include texture-similar distractors and background context alongside the target, contaminating class prototypes or visual prompts before query prediction. We introduce SADe, a predictor-agnostic support decontamination layer that estimates the reliability of selected support patches without query information. Central to SADe is sparse autoencoder (SAE) atom evidence: dense similarity may respond to both target and texture-similar context, whereas contrasting atom activations inside and outside the weak-support region provides factor-level reliability cues. A lightweight router combines atom evidence with dense similarity and episode statistics to predict patch reliability and generate a cleaned support mask. Trained once on synthetic weak-support episodes from FSS-1000, the router is frozen for all target evaluations. The resulting mask supports standalone prediction or can be supplied to heterogeneous FSS models through native support interfaces without altering query-side inference. Under a matched weak-support protocol, SADe achieves the highest query mIoU in six of nine standalone prompt-shot combinations. With the same ProMi query head, it is within 0.03 mIoU of SAM3-derived masks under tight boxes and surpasses them by 11.17 and 19.49 points under box-r2 and box-r4, respectively. As a plug-in, SADe improves over raw support in 70 of 72 matched box-family comparisons across four frozen downstream models and two datasets. On point and scribble prompts, its average performance remains close to the corresponding raw-support baseline. Ablations and atom-removal controls show that atom evidence contributes reliability information beyond dense similarity.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures; includes a technical appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SADe，一种与预测器无关的支持去污染层，用于弱标注下的少样本分割。SADe利用稀疏自编码器的原子激活证据，结合密集相似性和片段统计，估计支持补丁的可靠性并生成清洁的支持掩码。在匹配的弱支持协议下，SADe在九种独立提示-镜头组合中的六种上取得了最高的查询mIoU。
Motivation: 实际少样本分割中，支持标注常为弱标注（如框、涂鸦、粗掩码），其中包含纹理相似干扰物和背景上下文，污染了类原型或视觉提示。现有方法未充分考虑如何无查询信息地估计支持补丁可靠性。
Method: 提出SADe去污染层，核心是稀疏自编码器原子证据：通过对比弱支持区域内外原子激活的差异，提供因子级可靠性线索。轻量路由器结合原子证据、密集相似性和片段统计，预测补丁可靠性并生成清洁支持掩码。路由器在FSS-1000合成弱支持片段上训练一次后冻结。
Result: 在匹配弱支持协议下，SADe在九种独立提示-镜头组合中六种达到最高查询mIoU。与ProMi查询头结合，紧框下与SAM3派生掩码差距在0.03 mIoU内，在box-r2和box-r4下分别超越11.17和19.49点。作为插件，在72个匹配框系列比较中改善70个。点/涂鸦提示下平均性能接近原始支持基线。
Conclusion: SADe作为无需查询信息的支持去污染层，能有效处理弱标注中的干扰，且可即插即用到多种FSS模型，不改变查询侧推理。消融实验验证了原子证据提供了超出密集相似性的可靠性信息。

papers.title: FilmBench: A Film-Grade Benchmark for Cinematic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Progress in video generation keeps narrowing the visual gap between AI-generated and professionally produced footage, yet most benchmarks still draw prompts from web sources or LLM templates and score them with untrained, generic multimodal models. More fundamentally, their evaluation taxonomies remain rudimentary (overall visual quality, coarse text alignment and temporal smoothness) rather than the professional Cinematic Language criteria by which films are actually made and judged, so they assess basic video plausibility rather than film-grade craft. We introduce FilmBench, a text-to-video (T2V) and reference-to-video (R2V) benchmark grounded in the professional Cinematic Language of the film- academy tradition and co-developed with directors and faculty from the Beijing Film Academy and the Hujing Digital Media & Entertainment Group film studio. It rests on three choices. First, prompts are reverse-engineered from clips of award-winning films spanning 20 cinematic genres and chosen by professional directors, so every prompt is anchored to a verified live-action reference; the prompts follow real shot lists, and most script multiple shots (1,056 of the 1,169 prompts are multi-shot), unlike prior single-clip benchmarks. Second, evaluation follows a three-level Cinematic taxonomy of 3 axes, 12 components and 35 (T2V) +3 (R2V-only) sub-metrics. Third, we develop an in-house expert-grade automatic evaluation agent and open-source its core suite of Cinematic Language operators (FilmOps). Benchmarking leading video generation models (9 for T2V, 7 for R2V), the evaluator reproduces the human model ranking at model-level Spearman \r{ho} = 0.95 (T2V) and 0.96 (R2V). Scores fall well below prior web-style benchmarks, with two consistent gaps in dynamic aesthetics and a marked single- to multi-shot performance drop that widens for weaker models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FilmBench，一个基于专业影视语言的电影级视频生成基准，由北京电影学院和影视公司联合开发。基准包含逆向工程自获奖电影片段的提示（多数为多镜头），三级电影分类体系（3轴12组件35+3子度量），并开源了自动评估核心算子FilmOps。在9个T2V和7个R2V模型上的测试表明，评估器与人类排序高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.95/0.96），但总体得分远低于现有网络风格基准，且存在动态美学和单多镜头性能下降的差距。
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准提示来源单一，评估分类简单，缺乏专业电影制作标准，无法衡量电影级工艺水平。
Method: 提出FilmBench，包含三类选择：提示来自20种电影类型的获奖影片片段并由专业导演选择，大多数为多镜头；评估采用三级电影分类体系（3轴12组件35+3子度量）；开发专家级自动评估代理并开源核心算子FilmOps。
Result: 在9个T2V和7个R2V模型上，评估器与人类模型排序的Spearman ρ分别为0.95和0.96。总体得分低于之前基准，存在动态美学和单多镜头性能下降的差距，且弱模型性能下降更明显。
Conclusion: 现有视频生成模型在电影级标准上仍有显著不足，尤其是动态美学和多镜头一致性，需要进一步提升。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出FilmBench，一个基于专业影视语言的电影级视频生成基准，由北京电影学院和影视公司联合开发。基准包含逆向工程自获奖电影片段的提示（多数为多镜头），三级电影分类体系（3轴12组件35+3子度量），并开源了自动评估核心算子FilmOps。在9个T2V和7个R2V模型上的测试表明，评估器与人类排序高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.95/0.96），但总体得分远低于现有网络风格基准，且存在动态美学和单多镜头性能下降的差距。

papers.title: Why does Greedy Search produce Optimal Clustering Outcomes? A Fixed-Core Assignment Theory
papers.abstract_en: Many existing clustering methods are designed based on a set-oriented definition---a cluster is a set of similar points---relying a point-to-point similarity function to find similar points. This works well for compact clusters, but clustering performance can deteriorate badly when cluster shapes are irregular, and densities or sizes vary between clusters. Recent `Cluster-as-Distribution' (CaD) clustering has been shown to discover these generic types of clusters in practice by treating each cluster as a set of independent and identically distributed points generated from some unknown distribution via a greedy search, achieving a clustering objective equivalent to that of Spectral Clustering, but with better clustering outcomes without eigen-decomposition. However, a theoretical analysis of this phenomenon is still lacking. Our analyses are from two angles. First, we analyze the approximation error between the true and empirical distribution embeddings. Second, we show that the greedy search employed to achieve the CaD clustering objective can be mapped to a partition matroid---yielding greedy optimality. These yield a near-optimality guarantee for the CaD clustering objective, with regret controlled by the approximation error. This is the first analysis that explains why CaD clustering via greedy search can discover clusters of arbitrary shapes, densities and sizes (where all set-oriented clustering methods have failed to discover) when the estimated cluster embeddings faithfully approximate the underlying cluster distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对'Cluster-as-Distribution' (CaD)聚类中贪心搜索为何能发现任意形状、密度和大小的簇这一现象，提供了理论分析。通过分析真实与经验分布嵌入的近似误差，并将贪心搜索映射到划分拟阵，证明了CaD聚类目标具有近最优性保证，遗憾受近似误差控制。这是首个从理论上解释贪心搜索在CaD聚类中有效性的工作。
Motivation: 现有聚类方法在簇形状不规则、密度或大小变化时性能下降，而CaD聚类通过贪心搜索在实践中表现优异但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 从两个角度分析：1）真实分布嵌入与经验分布嵌入之间的近似误差；2）将贪心搜索实现CaD聚类目标映射到划分拟阵，从而获得贪心最优性。由此推导出CaD聚类目标的近最优性保证，遗憾 bound 由近似误差控制。
Result: 给出了CaD聚类目标在估计的簇嵌入忠实近似底层分布条件下的近最优性保证，解释了为什么贪心搜索能发现任意形状、密度和大小的簇。
Conclusion: 本文是首个对CaD聚类通过贪心搜索实现的理论分析，证明了其在非紧凑簇上的有效性。

papers.title: LLM-based Source Code Compression via Thresholded Symbol Ranking
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of lossless compression of source code, motivated by the storage demands of large-scale software archives, such as Software Heritage (https://www.softwareheritage.org/). General-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2) offer a good trade-off between compression ratio and speed, but fail to exploit all special regularities inherent in source code. Recent approaches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) within Shannon's symbol-ranking framework, relying on a scheme in which the predicted rank can grow arbitrarily. While effective at reducing space, this setting incurs significant throughput degradation, and leaves open the question whether it is necessary to explicitly encode all ranks. In this work, we introduce LLM-based compressors deploying two novel symbol-ranking variants that bound predictions to the top-$T$ ranks ($T=1$ or $63$), with out-of-threshold symbols stored as exceptions and compressed jointly with the rank stream via general-purpose compressors. We conduct the first large-scale evaluation of LLM-based source code compression across 30 LLMs, including general-domain, code-specialized, and quantized models. Our $T$-bounded approach outperforms prior LLM-based compressors both in compression ratio (up to 37% relative improvement) and compression throughput (40% faster). Compared to general-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2), we obtain up to 82% relative compression gain but at a lower speed, thus offering a new trade-off point in the compression-speed spectrum. We also show that these gains are stronger on source code than on natural language, suggesting an interesting indication, namely that source code exposes regularities captured by LLMs but missed by general-purpose exact-match-based compressors. We conclude by commenting on open problems that offer theoretical and practical avenues of research.
papers.comment: This is the version of the paper submitted and then accepted for presentation at the 24th International Conference of the Italian Association for Artificial Intelligence (AIxIA 2026), Perugia, Italy, 6--9 October 2026. The paper will appear in the proceedings, published by Springer Verlag in the Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence (LNAI) series
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究源代码的无损压缩问题，利用大语言模型（LLM）在Shannon符号排名框架下提出两种阈值化排名变体（T=1或63），超出阈值的符号作为异常单独存储并与排名流一起用通用压缩器压缩。在30个LLM上的大规模评估显示，该方法相比先前基于LLM的压缩器在压缩比（最高提升37%）和吞吐量（快40%）上均有提升；相比通用压缩器（如zstd、bzip2）压缩比最高提升82%，但速度较慢。实验表明源代码比自然语言更易被LLM捕获规律。
Motivation: 现有通用压缩器无法充分利用源代码的特殊规律性，而基于LLM的符号排名方法虽能降低空间，但吞吐量低且需要编码所有排名。本文旨在解决这些问题，探索是否必须显式编码所有排名。
Method: 提出两种LLM驱动的阈值化符号排名变体：预测限制在top-T个排名内（T=1或63），超出阈值的符号作为异常存储，并与排名流一起通过通用压缩器进行联合压缩。
Result: 在30个LLM上的评估表明，相比先前LLM压缩器，压缩比提升最高37%，压缩吞吐量快40%；相比通用压缩器，压缩比提升最高82%，但速度较慢。
Conclusion: 阈值化排名方法在源代码压缩上优于先前LLM方法和通用压缩器，且源代码比自然语言展现出更多被LLM捕捉的规律性，但速度仍是瓶颈，未来需探索理论和实践问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Current Retrievers Cover All the Evidence? A Controlled Study of Conjunctive Cross-Page Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Finding a long document relevant to a multi-part request is not the same as establishing that it contains every requested piece of evidence. We study this gap for conjunctive document retrieval, where two or three explicit conditions must be supported on different pages of one document. We use n-Clue as a controlled measurement instrument: 1{,}000 queries over 2{,}021 documents pair all-condition golds with naturally occurring documents that satisfy only a subset, and a complete-first success requires a top-10 gold to precede every released subset qrel. Across 70 configurations, condition-wise decomposition improves two dense backbones by 6.8--7.3 points and lexical--visual fusion adds 8.7, while four generic rerankers all reduce Gold-NDCG; these directions replicate on a four-source stress set. Scaling one dense family from 0.6B to 8B changes complete-first success by 0.0 points. The strongest displayed hybrid illustrates the resulting gap: it finds a gold for 81.1\% of queries but succeeds complete-first on only 35.8\%, and the gap persists across condition count, target length, candidate density, query rendering, and the four-source stress set. Finally, page-aware visual systems surface stored support for every condition on only 5.1--5.3\% of queries. These results identify condition coverage, rather than gold discovery alone, as the central bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了复合跨页检索（conjunctive cross-page retrieval）中的证据覆盖问题，即查询需要多个条件分布在文档的不同页面上。作者使用n-Clue数据集进行控制实验，发现条件分解和词汇-视觉融合能提升性能，但通用重排序器反而降低效果。最强的混合系统在81.1%的查询中找到黄金文档，但只有35.8%的查询完全优先成功。页面感知视觉系统在仅5.1-5.3%的查询中覆盖所有条件。
Motivation: 现有检索系统主要关注找到相关文档，但忽略了文档是否包含查询中所有条件所需证据，尤其是当条件分布在文档不同页面时。
Method: 使用n-Clue数据集的1000个查询和2021个文档，通过条件分解和词汇-视觉融合等技术，评估不同配置下完全优先成功（complete-first success）等指标。
Result: 条件分解提升两个密集骨干网络6.8-7.3点，词汇-视觉融合提升8.7点，但四个通用重排序器都降低Gold-NDCG；缩放模型参数从0.6B到8B对完全优先成功无影响。最强调混合系统实现81.1%的查找但仅35.8%完全优先。
Conclusion: 条件覆盖率而非仅黄金文档发现是当前检索系统的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Towards simultaneous decoding of kinetic and kinematic movement parameters during grasp and lift task by noninvasive brain imaging
papers.abstract_en: Brain-machine interfaces (BMIs) can assist individuals with limited mobility, such as stroke survivors or amputees. One of the key challenges in developing BMIs is expanding their usability and control, which can be achieved by accurately decoding multiple kinematic and kinetic parameters. To address this, we propose three regression models: partial least squares regressor, multilayered perceptron, and attention based regressor, to decode multiple movement parameters from EEG signals. We evaluated these models on the WAY EEG GAL dataset, focusing on their performance under subject specific and subject independent conditions with two strategies: a single model for all parameters and a baseline with separate models for each parameter. Among all regressors, the attention based regressor achieved the best performance, with an $R^2$ of 0.8 and a latency of 29.2 milliseconds, demonstrating significant improvement in simultaneous multi parameter decoding. However, its performance dropped for single parameter decoding. The multi layered perceptron showed more consistent but lower accuracy across both decoding types ($R^2$ = 0.49). These findings highlight the potential of attention based models for real time multi command BMI systems and contribute to the development of more intuitive control devices.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, selected to be presented at Brain-Machine Interface (BMI) Systems Session, IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对脑机接口中同时解码多个运动学与动力学参数的需求，提出三种回归模型（偏最小二乘回归、多层感知器、基于注意力的回归器），并在WAY EEG GAL数据集上评估。结果表明，基于注意力的回归器在多参数同时解码中表现最佳（R²=0.8，延迟29.2毫秒），但单参数解码时性能下降；多层感知器精度较低但更稳定（R²=0.49）。
Motivation: 脑机接口需要同时解码多个运动参数以提升控制自然度，现有方法多关注单参数解码，缺乏对多参数同时解码的探索。
Method: 采用偏最小二乘回归、多层感知器和基于注意力的回归器三种模型，在受试者特定和受试者无关条件下评估，比较单模型解码所有参数与独立模型解码单个参数两种策略。
Result: 注意力回归器在多参数同时解码中R²达到0.8，延迟29.2毫秒，优于其他模型；单参数解码时性能下降，多层感知器精度较低但更稳定（R²=0.49）。
Conclusion: 注意力模型在实时多命令脑机接口中具有潜力，有助于开发更直观的控制设备。

papers.title: The Cost of Knowing: A Resource-Aware Protocol for Benchmarking Hallucination Beyond Static Leaderboards
papers.abstract_en: On standard factuality tasks, frontier models now cluster near the top of the scale. The question is therefore shifting from how factual a system is toward how much compute that factuality costs. Static leaderboards score factuality in isolation and treat compute as free, so they cannot tell a genuinely better system apart from one that simply spends more. Consider a ranking reversal. A brute-force Best-of-4 agent posts the higher raw factuality score (H-Score 0.9169 vs 0.9103) and would top a static leaderboard, but once cost is counted it is the worse system, losing on Q-Score (0.5169 vs 0.5217) at roughly four times the tokens and latency, under a reported cost weight whose sensitivity we sweep. So the system that tops a static leaderboard can be the worse one to deploy. To make this trade-off visible, we introduce MAS-HQ (Multi-Agent System Hallucination Quest), a resource-aware evaluation protocol. It wraps any factuality detector and normalizes for cost, and it pits systems against each other rather than scoring them in isolation. The Q-Score measures factuality minus normalized cost under a competitive match. Across summarization and open-domain QA, single-agent baselines drift into resource-heavy over-optimization, while competition elicits more resource-efficient policies. These gains are small but consistent, and stable across 100 trials. The axis stays discriminative for frontier systems (Gemini-2.5-Pro, and GPT-5) whose raw factuality scores are already bunched near the ceiling. MAS-HQ provides a reproducible way to measure how much a factual answer costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对静态排行榜仅关注事实性分数而忽略计算成本的问题，提出资源感知的评估协议MAS-HQ（Multi-Agent System Hallucination Quest）。该协议通过包装事实性检测器并归一化成本，以竞争性匹配的方式测量Q-Score（事实性减去归一化成本）。实验表明，在总结和开放域QA任务上，竞争机制能促使模型采用更资源高效的策略，且对于事实性分数已接近上限的前沿模型（如Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5）仍能保持区分度。
Motivation: 现有静态排行榜将事实性分数与计算成本割裂，无法区分真正高效的系统和仅靠大量计算堆砌分数的系统，导致部署时可能选择成本更高的模型。
Method: 提出MAS-HQ协议，该协议可包装任意事实性检测器，通过引入成本归一化和系统间竞争性匹配，计算Q-Score = 事实性分数 - 归一化成本，从而量化事实性的资源代价。
Result: 在总结和开放域QA任务中，单智能体基线倾向于资源过度优化，而MAS-HQ的竞争机制能够激发更资源高效的策略；收益虽小但一致，且在100次试验中保持稳定，对Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5等前沿模型仍具区分能力。
Conclusion: MAS-HQ提供了一种可复现的资源感知评估方法，使事实性成本显式化，弥补了静态排行榜的不足，有助于识别真正高效的系统。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对静态排行榜仅关注事实性分数而忽略计算成本的问题，提出资源感知的评估协议MAS-HQ（Multi-Agent System Hallucination Quest）。该协议通过包装事实性检测器并归一化成本，以竞争性匹配的方式测量Q-Score（事实性减去归一化成本）。实验表明，在总结和开放域QA任务上，竞争机制能促使模型采用更资源高效的策略，且对于事实性分数已接近上限的前沿模型（如Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5）仍能保持区分度。

summary_sections.method: 提出MAS-HQ协议，该协议可包装任意事实性检测器，通过引入成本归一化和系统间竞争性匹配，计算Q-Score = 事实性分数 - 归一化成本，从而量化事实性的资源代价。
summary_sections.result: 在总结和开放域QA任务中，单智能体基线倾向于资源过度优化，而MAS-HQ的竞争机制能够激发更资源高效的策略；收益虽小但一致，且在100次试验中保持稳定，对Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5等前沿模型仍具区分能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: MAS-HQ提供了一种可复现的资源感知评估方法，使事实性成本显式化，弥补了静态排行榜的不足，有助于识别真正高效的系统。

papers.title: AptAvatar: Fast and Vivid Long-Form Audio-Driven Video Generation for Production-Ready Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Production-ready audio-driven avatar generation requires efficient inference without sacrificing fidelity or motion expressiveness. However, existing acceleration methods often compromise quality through restrictive architectural choices, such as causal attention and short temporal horizons, or by reducing model capacity and resolution. Without such compromises, we propose AptAvatar, a 14B-parameter long-form audio-driven avatar generation framework that delivers fast and expressive inference. For efficiency in production-level applications, AptAvatar addresses the extreme two-step generation challenge. To bridge the gap between the multi-step teacher model and the two-step student model, we introduce Endpoint-Anchored Distribution Distillation. It augments vanilla distribution matching with a dedicated Anchor Score Estimator trained on the trajectory-endpoint distribution defined from a frozen pretrained 4-step bridge generator. This provides an attainable endpoint-level anchor for the evolving two-step student. To improve long-horizon consistency, we further introduce Self-Generated History Replay, which reuses cached outputs from earlier generator checkpoints as history conditions during chunk-wise training. This approximates inference-time conditioning on self-generated histories without costly online rollouts, mitigating quality degradation from accumulated history errors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AptAvatar generates vivid 720p long-form avatar videos with only 2 NFEs, achieving a 60x speedup while preserving visual fidelity and long-horizon identity. Code is available at https://github.com/TaoLiveAIGC/AptAvatar
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AptAvatar，一个140亿参数的长时音频驱动头像生成框架，通过端点锚定分布蒸馏和自生成历史回放技术，在仅2步推理下生成720p高清长视频，实现60倍加速，同时保持视觉保真度和长时身份一致性。
Motivation: 现有生产级音频驱动头像生成方法为加速推理常采用因果注意力、短时间窗口或降低模型容量，导致保真度和表现力下降。需要无需此类妥协的快速高质量方案。
Method: 提出两点创新：1）端点锚定分布蒸馏，利用预训练4步桥接生成器定义轨迹端点分布，训练一个锚点分数估计器，辅助2步学生模型匹配分布；2）自生成历史回放，在分块训练中复用早期生成器检查点的缓存输出作为历史条件，模拟推理时的自生成历史条件，避免累积误差。
Result: 在仅2步神经函数评估下生成720p长视频，实现60倍加速，且视觉保真度和长时身份一致性优于或持平现有方法。
Conclusion: AptAvatar通过端点锚定分布蒸馏和自生成历史回放，在极简推理步骤下实现了生产级音频驱动头像生成的效率与质量平衡。

papers.title: Harnessing X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy Data through Multimodal Mining of Battery Literature
papers.abstract_en: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is central to understanding the local electronic and atomic structure of materials, yet most published spectra remain inaccessible to data-driven analysis because they are embedded in figures and described through fragmented textual context in the literature. Here, we use multimodal (image and text) literature mining to transform this dispersed knowledge into an AI-ready experimental data resource. We developed a scalable spectroscopy data digitization pipeline that identifies XAS figures in full-text articles, digitizes spectral curves, and links each spectrum to accompanying metadata on the measured edge and material. Applying this pipeline to the battery literature produced an open dataset of 13,740 XAS spectra, spanning 66 absorbing elements and diverse battery chemistries, with expert validation confirming accurate extraction of spectral and metadata information. By converting literature-embedded spectra into structured numerical data, this dataset provides a foundation for large-scale XAS analysis, cross-laboratory comparison, high-throughput characterization, and autonomous discovery of advanced materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过多模态（图像与文本）文献挖掘，将电池文献中嵌入的X射线吸收光谱（XAS）数据数字化，构建了一个包含13,740条光谱的开放数据集，覆盖66种吸收元素和多种电池化学体系。该数据集为大规模XAS分析、跨实验室比较和高通量表征提供了基础。
Motivation: 大量已发表的XAS谱图以图像形式分散在文献中，缺乏可访问的结构化数据，阻碍了数据驱动的材料分析。
Method: 开发了一套可扩展的光谱数据数字化流程，包括从全文文章中识别XAS图像、数字化谱线、并将每条光谱与测量边和材料等元数据关联。
Result: 从电池文献中提取了13,740条XAS光谱，经专家验证，光谱和元数据提取准确。
Conclusion: 该数据集将文献中的谱图转化为结构化数值数据，为大规模XAS分析、跨实验室比较和高通量表征提供了基础。

papers.title: A Comparison of Data Augmentation Methods for Training Deep Neural Networks on Synthetic Aperture Sonar
papers.abstract_en: In this work we study Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) for Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS) data with a focus on deep neural networks (DNNs). The main challenge in training DNNs for SAS-ATR arises from the limited quantity of labeled target examples due to the significant costs and time required to collect real-world SAS data. One successful general strategy for mitigating the problem of limited training data is augmentation, which generates additional synthetic training data by introducing realistic variations to available data. Prior research has investigated a variety of augmentation strategies for SAS-ATR, including conventional image augmentations (e.g., contrast changes, cropping) as well as augmentations motivated the specific physics of SAS data. Building on prior work, we systematically compare many of these existing augmentation strategies for training DNNs for SAS-ATR. We also investigate the impact of augmentation when combined with modern DNN architectures such as transformers. The results indicate that augmentation can improve target recognition accuracy, although benefits vary, and not all augmentations are beneficial.
papers.comment: This paper was originally published in the proceedings of the International Conference on Underwater Acoustics 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了多种数据增强方法（包括传统图像增强和合成孔径声纳物理特性驱动的增强）用于训练深度神经网络进行自动目标识别。结果显示数据增强能提升识别准确率，但不同增强方法效果差异显著，且并非所有方法都有益。
Motivation: 合成孔径声纳数据标注成本高、数量有限，限制了深度神经网络的训练，而现有多种数据增强方法缺乏系统性比较。
Method: 系统比较了多种已有增强策略（传统图像增强如对比度变化、裁剪，以及基于SAS物理特性的增强），并考察了与现代架构如Transformer的结合效果。
Result: 数据增强能提升目标识别准确率，但收益随方法而异，部分增强甚至可能有害。
Conclusion: 数据增强在SAS-ATR中有效但需谨慎选择，未来需探索更高效、鲁棒的方法。

papers.title: LabRobFail: A Benchmark for Robotic Failure Analysis in Chemical Self-driving Laboratory
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of embodied agents in self-driving laboratories could accelerate scientific discovery, yet their reliability is constrained by the irreversible and safety-critical nature of chemical experiments. Progress is further hindered by scarce failure data and the lack of fine-grained evaluation protocols. To address these challenges, we introduce LabRobFail, a failure-centric framework for learning and evaluating robotic failure analysis in chemical laboratories. LabRobFail-Sim injects controllable failures at the control, physics, and semantic levels, enabling the construction of LabRobFail-Data, which contains over 20,000 trajectories across 70+ task scenarios, five failure categories, and 11 fine-grained failure types. LabRobFail-Bench evaluates six capabilities spanning task understanding, failure detection, temporal localization, severity assessment, failure classification, and actionable correction. We further develop LabRobFail-VLM, a domain-specialized vision-language model that generates structured failure diagnoses and recovery instructions. On seen environments, it achieves 90.83% failure-detection accuracy and 77.21% temporal-localization accuracy, substantially outperforming general-purpose VLMs. When integrated as a real-time supervisor, it improves downstream task success rates by 4-16 percentage points, demonstrating the value of fine-grained failure understanding for closed-loop recovery and reliable laboratory autonomy. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Su-ISE-2001/SciRobo
papers.comment: Under review. Haobo Wang and Baoli Sun contributed equally. Code and data: https://github.com/Su-ISE-2001/SciRobo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LabRobFail，一个用于化学自驱动实验室机器人故障分析的基准框架。包含故障注入模拟器LabRobFail-Sim（生成20000+轨迹，覆盖5类故障和11种细粒度类型）、六维度评测基准LabRobFail-Bench，以及专用视觉语言模型LabRobFail-VLM。VLM在已知环境上故障检测准确率达90.83%，时间定位准确率77.21%，作为实时监控可提升下游任务成功率4-16个百分点。
Motivation: 自主实验室中机器人可靠性受限于化学实验的不可逆性和安全关键性，但故障数据稀缺且缺乏细粒度评估协议。
Method: 构建LabRobFail框架，包含可控故障注入的模拟器、大规模故障轨迹数据集、六能力评测基准，以及基于VLM的故障诊断与恢复指令生成模型。
Result: LabRobFail-VLM在已知环境上故障检测准确率90.83%、时间定位准确率77.21%，远优于通用VLM；作为实时监控提升下游任务成功率4-16个百分点。
Conclusion: 细粒度故障理解对可靠实验室自主性至关重要，该框架为化工自驱动实验室提供了故障分析与闭环恢复的系统方案。
