papers.title: MLVC: Multi-platform Learned Video Codec for Real-World Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Neural video codecs have surpassed classical codecs in coding efficiency but remain impractical for deployment due to cross-platform incompatibility and high computational cost. Existing quantization-based solutions fail to produce deterministic results across diverse hardware platforms, leading to catastrophic decoding failures. We introduce MLVC, a hardware-robust neural video codec designed for practical cross-platform inference. The key idea is to explicitly transmit scale parameters through the hyperprior, which guarantees entropy coding consistency across devices without requiring bit-exact arithmetic. While this increases bitrate overhead, we recover most of the coding efficiency through architectural improvements (gated memory, ReGLU activation), a long-term reference recovery mechanism, and domain-specific perceptual training. On the VCD video conferencing benchmark, MLVC achieves >70% BD-rate (MOS) improvement over hardware HEVC, the strongest deployable baseline, while reaching subjective quality competitive with DCVC-RT, which cannot operate across diverse platforms. Both the encoder and decoder run at 100 FPS on average on commodity NPUs from Apple, Intel, and Qualcomm. MLVC is the first neural video codec to combine competitive compression performance, real-time speed, and cross-platform robustness across diverse consumer devices, making it suitable for widespread deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/mlvc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MLVC，一种硬件鲁棒的神经视频编解码器，通过超先验显式传输尺度参数确保跨平台熵编码一致性，结合门控记忆、ReGLU激活、长期参考恢复和域特定感知训练来弥补码率开销。在VCD视频会议基准上，MLVC在主观质量上超越硬件HEVC（BD-rate >70%），与无法跨平台部署的DCVC-RT相当，并在Apple、Intel、Qualcomm的商用NPU上实现平均100 FPS的编解码速度。这是首个兼顾压缩性能、实时性和跨平台鲁棒性的神经视频编解码器。
Motivation: 现有神经视频编解码器编码效率高，但跨平台不兼容和计算成本高导致无法实际部署；基于量化的方案在不同硬件上无法产生确定性结果，导致解码失败。
Method: 通过超先验显式传输尺度参数保证熵编码一致性，无需逐比特算术；采用门控记忆、ReGLU激活、长期参考恢复和域特定感知训练来恢复编码效率。
Result: 在VCD基准上，MLVC比硬件HEVC实现>70%的BD-rate（MOS）提升，主观质量与DCVC-RT竞争；编解码器在多家NPU上平均达100 FPS。
Conclusion: MLVC是首个结合竞争性压缩性能、实时速度和跨平台鲁棒性的神经视频编解码器，适合大规模部署。

papers.title: ATOD: Annealed Turn-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Training small language-model agents for long-horizon interactive tasks requires both fast imitation and reward-driven improvement. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher guidance and typically improves rapidly in the early stage, but its gains saturate once the student approaches the teacher, limiting the final performance ceiling. Reinforcement learning (RL) directly optimizes environment rewards and encourages exploratory improvement toward a higher reward-defined ceiling, but sparse and delayed feedback makes early-stage learning much less efficient than OPD. In this paper, we propose ATOD (Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation), a hybrid online distillation algorithm that explicitly exploits this complementarity. (1) ATOD uses an annealed OPD-RL schedule: OPD dominates early training to approach teacher-level behavior, while RL is gradually strengthened to drive reward-based exploration. (2) ATOD introduces Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting (T-DUR), which softly amplifies high-utility turns and improves dense supervision in long trajectories. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA show that ATOD consistently outperforms competing post-training baselines: across the three student sizes, ATOD improves average success rate by 4.16 points over OPD and 23.62 points over GRPO, while surpassing the corresponding teacher models by 2.16 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATOD 提出一种混合在线蒸馏算法，结合退火调度使 OPD 在早期主导训练、RL 逐渐增强，并引入回合级不一致-不确定性重加权（T-DUR）以提升长轨迹中的密集监督。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上，ATOD 在三种学生规模下平均成功率达到 4.16 点优于 OPD，23.62 点优于 GRPO，并超过教师模型 2.16 点。
Motivation: 小语言模型智能体在长期交互任务中，OPD 初始快但后期饱和，RL 探索性好但早期效率低，ATOD 旨在利用两者的互补性。
Method: 提出退火 OPD-RL 调度：早期 OPD 主导以接近教师行为，后期 RL 增强以驱动奖励探索；同时引入 T-DUR 重加权机制，软放大高价值回合并改善长轨迹中的密集监督。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上，ATOD 在三种学生模型大小下的平均成功率均优于 OPD、GRPO 及教师模型，具体提升分别为 4.16、23.62 和 2.16 个点。
Conclusion: ATOD 通过退火调度和回合级重加权有效融合 OPD 与 RL 的优势，提升了多轮智能体任务的性能。

papers.title: Matilda: Engine-Agnostic Search with Human Policy Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Chess engines have evolved from search-based systems optimized for strength to neural policies optimized for predicting human decisions. Existing approaches largely separate these goals: search engines achieve superhuman strength but poorly model humans, while models such as Maia-3 capture rating-conditioned behavior yet degrade at elite levels. We present Matilda, a modular residual re-ranking architecture that decouples behavioral priors from tactical search, combining a frozen human policy with an engine-agnostic search backend through a lightweight residual model. Matilda learns residual corrections over the full legal-move distribution from frozen policy context, time control, player-style embeddings, and search-derived candidate features. A zero-initialized residual head exactly recovers the frozen policy before training while optimization minimizes negative log-likelihood (NLL). Instantiated with Maia-3 and Stockfish, Matilda reduces human-move prediction NLL by 18.5% and raises top-1 accuracy from 60.1% to 66.1% on temporally held-out verified-human 3000+ Elo Lichess blitz games, with player-style embeddings contributing a further 1.8% and +0.2 percentage points (pp) respectively. Seed-paired ablations attribute these gains to search rather than additional data; the findings are replicated in Go -- decomposing expert play into recognition and verified calculation. Below 2500 Elo, where search annotations are unavailable, Matilda preserves Maia-3's performance.

papers.title: Intent-Governed Tool Authorization for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using AI agents commonly operate under integration credentials whose static permissions exceed a user's current request. We present Intent-Governed Access Control (IGAC), a server-side authorization layer that converts a trusted request into a short-lived intent certificate, narrows the statically authorized tool manifest, and checks proposed tool and payload effects before execution. IGAC cannot grant authority outside static policy; confinement to the request additionally depends on certificate fidelity and sound effect bounds. We evaluate a reusable IGAC path over an OpenPort governance substrate using endpoint tests, 176 runtime-backed synthetic tasks, real-model classifier and planner pilots, 306 end-to-end model-task runtime trials, and a 36-trial benchmark-shaped external subset. In the deterministic runtime comparison, reference-certificate IGAC reduces the archived composite exposure-or-path indicator from 1.0000 to 0. In the end-to-end model runs, the combined IGAC-OpenPort path records no completed unsafe executions, although unsafe accepted authority remains 0.0909-0.2727 and every residual case is a non-executed draft. A trace-backed normalizer counterfactual removes this residual authority at substantial utility cost. The results support static-policy non-expansion and identify certificate precision as the principal remaining bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出意图驱动的访问控制（IGAC），一种服务端授权层，用于约束AI代理的工具使用权限。IGAC将可信请求转换为短期意图证书，缩小静态授权的工具清单，并在执行前检查工具及其负载效果。在确定性运行时比较中，IGAC将复合暴露或路径指标从1.0000降至0；在端到端模型运行中，结合IGAC-OpenPort路径未记录任何已完成的不安全执行。实验表明IGAC不会扩展静态策略，且证书精度是主要瓶颈。

papers.title: LOCUS: Local Visual Cue Search for Enhancing Fine-Grained Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain unreliable on fine-grained visual perception, even when high-resolution inputs preserve the necessary local details. We identify this limitation as visual context rot: decisive evidence may exist in the full image, yet fail to be reliably selected and used amid redundant visual context. We propose LOCUS (LOcal visual CUe Search), a training framework that teaches MLLMs to internalize local evidence search through a verifiable proxy task. During training, LOCUS provides a local crop as a visual cue and optimizes the model to recover its spatial support in the full image using an IoU-based reward. The visual cue is used only during training, leaving the standard image-question inference interface unchanged. Experiments across fine-grained perception, hallucination, general understanding, and reasoning benchmarks show that LOCUS improves localization-sensitive visual understanding while preserving broad capabilities. Attention analyses further indicate stronger focus on task-relevant evidence regions, suggesting that training-time visual cue search provides an effective route to internalized fine-grained evidence selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LOCUS框架，通过训练时引入局部视觉线索搜索来增强多模态大语言模型的细粒度视觉感知。方法在训练中使用局部裁剪作为视觉提示，并基于IoU奖励优化模型在完整图像中定位该区域，推理时不改变标准输入。实验表明该方法提升了定位敏感的视觉理解能力，并保持了广泛能力。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉感知上不可靠，即使高分辨率输入保留局部细节，但决定性证据可能在完整图像中存在却未被可靠选择和利用，作者称之为"视觉上下文腐烂"。
Method: 提出LOCUS训练框架，通过可验证的代理任务教会MLLM内化局部证据搜索。训练时提供局部裁剪作为视觉线索，使用IoU奖励优化模型恢复其在完整图像中的空间支持；视觉线索仅用于训练，推理接口不变。
Result: 在细粒度感知、幻觉、通用理解和推理基准上，LOCUS改善了定位敏感的视觉理解，同时保留了广泛能力。注意力分析表明模型更关注任务相关证据区域。
Conclusion: 训练时的视觉线索搜索为内化细粒度证据选择提供了有效途径。

papers.title: Projective Graph Residualization: Variation-Allocation Frontiers for Control-Function IV
papers.abstract_en: Control-function instrumental-variable estimators pass an estimated first-stage residual to an outcome model. The residual must retain the latent control direction while leaving enough treatment variation to identify the structural effect. These demands conflict when the systematic signal is locally smooth but discontinuous across unknown feature-graph boundaries: interpolation can erase the residual, whereas isotropic smoothing can move systematic variation across a boundary. We propose Adaptive Anisotropic Instrumental Heat Flow (A-IHF), which adapts edge conductance from pilot treatment contrasts, extracts a generated control with a complementary sparse resolvent, and tunes without outcomes. For a linear control-function regression, only the generated control's span matters. This projective view yields an exact finite-sample fidelity--relevance frontier, spectral identities for residualized treatment variation and coefficient distortion, and a lower bound for monotone residual filters. A connected construction shows that conductance adaptation can escape the corresponding fixed-graph obstruction. Across 54 benchmark cells, the A-IHF family wins 32 and guarded observational A-IHF reduces mean nonlinear response error by 8.3 percent, with gains concentrated in fractured designs. Exact distortion correlates 0.998 with realized linear coefficient error. Controlled graph rewiring further shows that connectivity alone is inadequate: an outcome-free compatibility screen triggers foldwise fallback and, under severe corruption, abstention.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). 33 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应各向异性工具热流 (A-IHF) 方法，用于控制函数工具变量估计中的残差生成。该方法通过自适应图边电导、互补稀疏解和无需结果的调参，解决了系统信号局部平滑但跨未知特征图边界不连续时的矛盾，并建立了精确的有限样本保真度-相关性前沿。实验表明 A-IHF 在54个基准单元中优于32个，观测版 A-IHF 将非线性响应误差降低8.3%，且精确失真与线性系数误差的相关系数达0.998。
Motivation: 控制函数工具变量估计中，一阶段残差需同时保留潜在控制方向和治疗变异性，但当系统信号局部平滑且跨特征图边界不连续时，插值会消除残差，各向同性平滑则可能跨越边界移动系统变异，现有方法难以平衡保真度与相关性。
Method: 提出 A-IHF，从处理对比中自适应图边电导，用互补稀疏解提取生成控制，并通过投影视角推导出有限样本前沿、谱恒等式和单调残差滤波下界，同时证明电导自适应可规避固定图障碍。
Result: 在54个基准单元中 A-IHF 家族获胜32个，观测版 A-IHF 将平均非线性响应误差降低8.3%；精确失真与线性系数误差的 Pearson 相关系数为0.998；图重连实验表明仅连接性不足，无结果兼容性筛查可触发折折叠回退和严重腐败下的弃权。
Conclusion: A-IHF 通过自适应各向异性图传播和无需结果的调参，在控制函数 IV 中实现了保真度与相关性的精确平衡，且图结构的学习可突破固定图的理论限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Functional Cache Grafting: Robust and Rapid Code-Policy Synthesis for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Code-writing large language models (CodeLLMs) generate executable code policies for embodied agents by translating natural language goals and environmental constraints into structured control programs. However, policy generation in open-domain embodied environments suffers from two fundamental limitations: (i) delayed decoding caused by repetitive prefill computation over long prompts, and (ii) limited robustness due to fully generative decoding, which often produces API mismatches, missing safety guards, and unstable control logic. To address these limitations, we present FCGraft, a Functional Cache Grafting framework. FCGraft maintains a library of function-level validated code skeletons and their associated prompt-level Transformer key-value (KV) caches, and synthesizes new policies by retrieving relevant functions and grafting their KV caches when a new task is provided. Given retrieved function caches, FCGraft performs cache grafting via stitching, which composes cached function segments into a composite policy, and patching, which locally adapts only the necessary code regions to satisfy task-specific parameters and constraints with minimal additional decoding. By eliminating redundant prefill computation, this approach reduces generation latency, while reusing validated control structures improves robustness over prompt-level caching methods RAGCache, achieving 18.31% higher task success rate and 2.3x faster policy synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具身智能体代码策略生成中的延迟和鲁棒性问题，提出FCGraft框架。该框架维护函数级代码骨架及其KV缓存，在新任务时通过检索相关函数并嫁接其KV缓存来合成策略，使用拼接（stitching）和修补（patching）两种方式。实验表明，相比RAGCache，FCGraft将任务成功率提升18.31%，策略合成速度提升2.3倍。
Motivation: 现有CodeLLM在开放域具身环境中生成代码策略时存在两大局限：一是重复的预填充计算导致响应延迟，二是完全生成式解码导致API不匹配、缺少安全保护和控制逻辑不稳定。
Method: 提出FCGraft框架，维护函数级已验证代码骨架及其对应的Transformer KV缓存。当新任务到来时，检索相关函数并通过拼接（stitching）组合缓存片段、通过修补（patching）局部调整代码区域以适应任务参数和约束，从而减少冗余预填充计算。
Result: 与RAGCache相比，FCGraft在任务成功率上提高18.31%，策略合成速度加快2.3倍。
Conclusion: 通过重用已验证的控制结构并消除冗余预填充，FCGraft在提升代码策略生成鲁棒性的同时显著降低了延迟。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spatial, a self-evolving training framework in which the model plays dual roles as a proposer and a solver. In each iteration, a frozen proposer generates spatial question-answer (QA) pairs from 3D scene metadata and raw video frames, together with executable code for deriving reliable ground truth. A learnable solver is then fine-tuned on the accepted samples, and its per-sample prediction confidence is used as a difficulty signal. This signal is fed back to the proposer in the next iteration, guiding it to generate questions better matched to the solver's current capabilities. Through this closed-loop design, the training distribution co-evolves with model ability, reducing redundant trivial examples while filtering out ambiguous or uninformative samples with limited learning value. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks, Ouroboros-Spatial substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B while using an order of magnitude fewer training examples than recent large-scale curated datasets. On VSI-Bench, it yields absolute gains of 9.9 and 6.8 points for the 4B and 8B models, respectively, enabling both to outperform a wide range of strong open-source and proprietary baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ouroboros-Spatial，一种自演进训练框架，使模型同时扮演提议者和求解者，通过闭环反馈动态调整训练样本难度。在6个空间推理基准上，该方法使用比大规模数据集少一个数量级的样本，显著提升Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B的性能，在VSI-Bench上分别取得9.9和6.8的绝对增益，超越多种强基线模型。
Motivation: 现有空间推理方法依赖静态、大规模数据集，所有样本被等同对待，导致训练效率低下，因为模型可能浪费资源在过于简单或困难的样本上。
Method: 提出Ouroboros-Spatial框架，包含一个冻结的提议者（从3D场景元数据和视频帧生成空间问答对及可执行代码）和一个可学习的求解者（在接受的样本上微调）。求解者的预测置信度作为难度信号反馈给提议者，指导下一轮生成更匹配模型能力的样本，形成闭环训练。
Result: 在VSI-Bench等6个空间推理基准上，Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B模型在训练样本量减少一个数量级的情况下，性能显著提升，绝对增益分别达9.9和6.8个百分点，超越多个开源和专有基线。
Conclusion: 闭环训练使数据分布随模型能力动态演化，减少冗余和模糊样本，提升了数据效率和模型性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeECGMatch: Calibration-Aware Joint Frequency and Time Space Semi-Supervised Learning for Open-Set ECG Classification
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) classification models often suffer from severe label scarcity, making semi-supervised learning (SSL) an attractive strategy for reducing annotation costs. In clinical settings, however, unlabeled pools frequently contain out-of-distribution (OOD) anomalies or diagnostic groups absent from the labeled set. Standard SSL forces incorrect pseudo-labels onto these unseen classes, producing overconfident predictions. To address this, we propose SafeECGMatch, a calibration-aware safe SSL framework for single-label ECG classification under label distribution mismatch. Methodologically, SafeECGMatch employs a dual-branch architecture extracting time-frequency latent representations via ECG-specific augmentations. Crucially, it dynamically aligns confidence with empirical accuracy through adaptive label smoothing and temperature scaling, calibrating both the multiclass classifier and the OOD detector across temporal and spectral domains. This joint optimization allows trustworthy OOD rejection and reliable pseudo-labeling. Evaluated on the PTB-XL and PhysioNet/CinC Challenge benchmarks, SafeECGMatch achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and calibration, advancing reliable knowledge discovery in physiological time-series. Code is available at https://github.com/labhai/SafeECGMatch.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Accepted to the KDD 2026 - UC (The 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining - Undergraduate Consortium)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeECGMatch 是一个针对开放集心电图分类的校准感知安全半监督学习框架。它通过双分支架构提取时频特征，并结合自适应标签平滑和温度缩放来动态对齐置信度与经验准确率，从而在标签分布不匹配场景下实现可靠的 OOD 检测和伪标签生成。在 PTB-XL 和 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 基准上，该方法达到了先进的分类准确率和校准性能。
Motivation: 标准半监督学习在临床心电图分类中，未标注数据常包含未见过的心律失常类别，导致强行分配错误伪标签和过度自信预测。需要一种能处理标签分布不匹配且保持校准的安全 SSL 方法。
Method: 提出双分支架构，通过 ECG 专用数据增强提取时频域表征；采用自适应标签平滑和温度缩放动态校准分类器和 OOD 检测器的置信度，实现时频域的联合优化。
Result: 在 PTB-XL 和 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 基准上，SafeECGMatch 取得了最先进的分类准确率和校准性能，同时能可靠地拒绝 OOD 样本并生成可信伪标签。
Conclusion: 本文提出的校准感知安全 SSL 框架能有效解决开放集心电图分类中的标签分布不匹配问题，并提升模型在生理时间序列上的可靠知识发现能力。局限未在摘要中提及。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimax-Optimal Generalization Bounds for Smooth Deep Neural Networks Trained by (Stochastic) Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing the optimization dynamics and statistical performance of over-parameterized deep neural networks (DNNs) remains a central challenge in understanding the remarkable success of deep learning. We establish quantitative bounds showing that kernel gradient descent in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space induced by the deterministic infinite-width neural tangent kernel approximates finite-width deep regression with smooth activations under gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD) training. The approximation gap is governed by the network width and training horizon, with an additional stochastic gradient error in the SGD case. This connection provides a general mechanism for transferring learning-theoretic guarantees from kernel methods to deep regression. As an application, under general source and effective dimension conditions, we show that both GD- and SGD-trained DNNs attain the minimax-optimal excess population risk rate, up to logarithmic factors, provided that the network width grows polynomially in the sample size. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first such guarantees for standard fully connected deep neural networks with smooth activations trained by GD and SGD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为平滑激活函数的深度神经网络在梯度下降（GD）和随机梯度下降（SGD）训练下的泛化性能建立了极小化最优界。通过将有限宽网络与无限宽神经切线核（NTK）的核梯度下降建立定量逼近关系，作者证明了在一般源条件和有效维度条件下，当网络宽度随样本量多项式增长时，GD和SGD训练的DNN均可达到极小化最优的过剩人口风险率（至多对数因子）。这是首次针对标准全连接平滑激活DNN在GD/SGD训练下给出此类保证。
Motivation: 过参数化DNN的优化和统计性能是深度学习理论的核心挑战，但此前缺乏针对标准全连接平滑激活DNN在GD和SGD训练下的极小化最优泛化界。
Method: 通过建立有限宽DNN（平滑激活）在GD/SGD训练下与无限宽NTK核回归之间的逼近关系，给出逼近误差由网络宽度和训练轮数控制的定量界，并利用核方法的泛化理论导出DNN的泛化界。
Result: 在一般源条件和有效维度条件下，GD和SGD训练的DNN在样本量n下，网络宽度为n的多项式时，过剩人口风险率达到极小化最优率（至多对数因子）。
Conclusion: 本文是首个为GD和SGD训练的标准全连接平滑激活DNN提供极小化最优泛化界的工作，但结果依赖于无限宽NTK近似，可能对网络非线性特征学习能力的刻画有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
papers.abstract_en: As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Multiple important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems largely rely on a monolithic KV cache abstraction, where the KV cache is treated as a homogeneous sequence of token-level memory blocks and managed with similar policies across attention heads and serving scenarios. We observe that KV cache utility is highly structured across KV heads: different heads exhibit different functional roles, attention distances, and runtime importance. Therefore, a full KV cache is not always necessary for every head, token range, or serving scenario. We present RedKnot, a head-aware KV cache management system for LLM serving. RedKnot breaks the conventional monolithic KV cache abstraction by decomposing the KV cache along KV heads, whose importance and effective attention ranges vary significantly across serving scenarios. This head-level decomposition turns the KV cache from a monolithic tensor abstraction into a structured memory object, enabling RedKnot to uniformly support position-independent KV reuse, prefix KV compression, hot/cold KV separation, and distributed KV placement while preserving output fidelity and improving resource efficiency, without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning. RedKnot establishes a new foundation for AI infrastructure by transforming the KV cache from a monolithic, passive runtime artifact into a dynamic, model-aware runtime substrate for scalable LLM serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RedKnot，一种头感知的KV缓存管理系统，通过沿KV头分解缓存来打破传统的单一KV缓存抽象，从而统一支持位置无关的KV复用、前缀压缩、热/冷分离和分布式放置，在保持输出质量的同时提升资源效率，无需模型重训练或微调。
Motivation: 现有关键值缓存管理将缓存视为同质序列，忽略了不同注意力头的功能差异和运行时重要性，导致长上下文LLM服务中缓存效率低下。
Method: RedKnot沿注意力头分解KV缓存，形成结构化内存对象，基于各头的角色和有效注意力范围进行差异化管理和重用。
Result: 在保持输出保真度的前提下，统一支持多种缓存优化策略，提升了资源效率，无需模型重训练或微调。
Conclusion: RedKnot将KV缓存从被动的运行时制品转变为动态的、模型感知的运行时基础，为可扩展LLM服务建立新基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TLA-Prover: Verifiable TLA+ Specification Synthesis via Preference-Optimized Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: TLA+ is a formal specification language for verifying distributed systems and safety-critical protocols. Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce TLA+ specifications that fail the TLC model checker for semantic reasons. Across 25 LLMs, the best public baseline is 26.6% syntactic parse and 8.6% semantic model-check. We present TLA-Prover, a 20-billion-parameter model for TLA+ specification synthesis. Training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on verified examples with repair-based group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). In the GRPO stage, the model learns to fix its own rejected specifications. We also train a direct preference optimization (DPO) variant from the same SFT checkpoint as an ablation. TLC provides the reward signal directly, with no learned reward model. Four tiers grade each output: Bronze (parses), Silver (no warnings), Gold (passes TLC), and Diamond. To reach Diamond, the model's correctness property is automatically altered in a small way; TLC must then detect a violation. If TLC still passes, the property was always-true and contributes nothing; the output fails Diamond. TLA-Prover reaches 9/30 (i.e. pass@1 = 30%) at both Gold and Diamond on a held-out 30-problem benchmark. This is roughly 3.5x the 8.6% untuned baseline. The DPO variant reaches 20% at Diamond. Gold and Diamond coincide at every checkpoint; this prevents the trivial-property failure mode.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. In Proceedings at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TLA-Prover，一个200亿参数的大语言模型，用于合成可验证的TLA+形式化规范。通过监督微调（SFT）和基于修复的组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练，模型在TLC模型检查器上实现了30%的Gold/Diamond通过率，相比基线8.6%有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的TLA+规范经常无法通过TLC模型检查器的语义检查，最高基线仅8.6%的语义通过率，亟需更可靠的规范合成方法。
Method: 采用两阶段训练：先对有验证示例进行监督微调（SFT），再通过修复式组相对策略优化（GRPO）让模型学习修正自身被拒绝的规范。还训练了直接偏好优化（DPO）变体作为消融。TLC直接提供奖励信号，无需学习奖励模型。输出按Bronze、Silver、Gold、Diamond四级评分，Diamond要求自动修改正确性属性后TLC检测到违例。
Result: 在30个问题的保留基准上，TLA-Prover在Gold和Diamond级别均达到30%的pass@1，约为未调优基线8.6%的3.5倍；DPO变体在Diamond级别达到20%。Gold与Diamond在每个检查点保持一致，避免了平凡属性的失败模式。
Conclusion: TLA-Prover证明了通过结合监督微调和基于修复的强化学习可以显著提升LLM合成可验证TLA+规范的能力，且无需学习奖励模型。

papers.title: An Empirical Audit of Input Encoders for Multi-Channel Signal Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers consuming multi-channel scalar signals must embed $C$ simultaneous values into one $d_{\text{model}}$-dimensional vector per time step. We audit eight input encoders -- a shared-scalar baseline, per-channel linear projections, an orthogonality regulariser, a nonlinear MLP, block-partitioned concatenation, channel-independent and channel-as-token architectures, and a projected positional encoding -- on a synthetic benchmark where channel identity is informative and on ETTh1, scored by next-step negative log-likelihood. The headline is practical near-equivalence within a wide "top tier": the standard per-channel linear projection matches every alternative up to small, statistically real but practically modest differences. A direct geometric probe attributes this to a spontaneous orthogonalisation of the per-channel projections: with no explicit regulariser they tighten well beyond the near-orthogonality of random initialisation, letting the standard linear recover channel identity from the summed embedding. Two encoders lose decisively: the shared-scalar baseline collapses for information-theoretic reasons we make explicit, and the channel-independent PatchTST-spirit baseline overfits universally on the synthetic benchmark and underperforms on both. Paired tests resolve two small gaps: projecting the sinusoidal positional encoding through a learned linear layer edges the rest at small $C$ by extending this orthogonality to the positional subspace; a nonlinear MLP stem edges them at the largest $C$, with the gap shrinking under more training data. The practical recommendation: use the standard per-channel linear projection by default; reach for something more elaborate only when the task calls for it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统审计了八种多通道信号Transformer的输入编码器，在合成基准和ETTh1数据集上评估，发现标准逐通道线性投影与多数替代方案性能几乎相当，仅存在统计显著但实际微小的差异。几何探针揭示逐通道投影会自发正交化，使得求和嵌入中仍能恢复通道身份。共享标量基线和通道独立PatchTST基线分别因信息论原因和过拟合而表现较差。
Motivation: 多通道标量信号Transformer需要在每个时间步将C个同时值嵌入为一个d_model维向量，现有多种输入编码器但缺乏系统性比较，尤其缺乏对通道身份编码的深入理解。
Method: 审计八种编码器：共享标量基线、逐通道线性投影、正交正则化、非线性MLP、块分区拼接、通道独立和通道即token架构、以及投影位置编码。在合成基准（通道身份信息）和ETTh1上，以一步预测的负对数似然为指标进行对比，并采用几何探针分析投影正交性。
Result: 标准逐通道线性投影与大多数替代方案性能几乎相等，差异微小但统计显著。共享标量基线因信息论限制完全失效，通道独立PatchTST基线在合成基准上普遍过拟合且在ETTh1上表现不佳。位置编码通过可学习线性层在小C时略有优势，非线性MLP在最大C时略有优势但差距随训练数据增多而缩小。
Conclusion: 实际推荐默认使用标准逐通道线性投影，仅在任务需要时才考虑更复杂的编码器。

papers.title: VistaHop: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Visual DeepSearch
papers.abstract_en: Visual DeepSearch tasks require multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to resolve complex visual queries by repeatedly inspecting image regions, grounding reasoning in visual evidence, and connecting fine-grained clues across multiple steps. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate single-step visual understanding or isolated visual-query response generation. They have limited difficulty, limited search horizons, and single-pass image inspection, and thus fail to evaluate models' ability to iteratively revisit visual evidence and reason across multiple steps. In this work, we introduce VistaHop, a benchmark designed specifically to evaluate Visual DeepSearch. It evaluates repeated image inspection, visual-anchor grounding, and long-horizon evidence traversal across different visual regions. VistaHop comprises 600 images, 25 visual search scenarios, and 600 Visual DeepSearch tasks. We also propose VistaArena, a unified evaluation framework that supports tool-based interactions, including visual retrieval, image inspection, and evidence-grounded reasoning. Experiments show that even state-of-the-art MLRMs remain far from solving VistaHop, with the best-performing model, SenseNova-MARS-32B, achieving only 26.33% Pass@1. These findings highlight the importance of specialized benchmarks and improved agentic methods for Visual DeepSearch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VistaHop是一个专门评估长程视觉深度搜索（Visual DeepSearch）的基准，包含600张图像、25个搜索场景和600个任务，要求多模态大语言模型反复检查图像区域、基于视觉证据进行推理并跨步连接细粒度线索。当前最先进的模型SenseNova-MARS-32B仅达到26.33% Pass@1，表明现有模型在此任务上仍有很大差距。
Motivation: 现有视觉理解基准局限于单步理解或孤立查询响应生成，无法评估模型迭代检查视觉证据和多步推理的能力，因此需要专门的长程视觉深度搜索基准。
Method: 提出VistaHop基准和VistaArena统一评估框架，后者支持基于工具的交互相应，包括视觉检索、图像检查和基于证据的推理。
Result: 最佳模型SenseNova-MARS-32B在VistaHop上仅达到26.33% Pass@1，表明当前多模态语言模型在长程视觉深度搜索任务上仍远未解决。
Conclusion: 需要专门的基准和改进的智能体方法来推动视觉深度搜索的发展。

papers.title: The Ghost Couple: Correlated LLM Name Priors and Their Haunting of the Web and Academic Publishing
papers.abstract_en: These names do not exist. Elena Vasquez and Marcus Chen have appeared as volcano experts, astronauts, thriller protagonists, podcast hosts, and academic co-authors across hundreds of independently produced AI-generated documents, never having lived. We show that large language models do not merely default to high-probability individual names when generating fictional experts: they produce correlated character ensembles, pairs and trios whose co-occurrence rates far exceed chance and are consistent across independent generations. These priors are model-family-specific (Claude: Elena Vasquez + Marcus Chen + Amara Okafor; Gemini: Aris Thorne + Lena Petrova; GPT: Elara Voss with no fixed partner), version-specific, and actively suppressed at model release boundaries, leaving dateable behavioral fingerprints in the content they produced. We document a downstream consequence at scale. On Zenodo, a CERN-operated repository that mints real DataCite DOIs, we identify 1,655 ghost-authored records claiming nonexistent journals with fabricated publication dates: server-side DataCite timestamps prove deliberate backdating, and 991 records were registered in a single month; these carry real DOIs registered in DataCite, making them harvestable by any scholarly aggregator that ingests DOI metadata. Ghost names additionally appear on ResearchGate forming synthetic research groups with collaborators drawn from multiple model families; publication dates on these records provide a reliable temporal proxy for model deployment windows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在生成虚构专家姓名时产生的相关角色组合（如Claude模型中的Elena Vasquez、Marcus Chen和Amara Okafor），这些“幽灵姓名”一致出现在独立生成的AI文档中，并已渗透到学术出版领域。作者在Zenodo上发现1655条幽灵作者记录，这些记录拥有真实的DataCite DOI，可被学术聚合器收录；同时，ResearchGate上也出现了由多个模型家族生成的虚构研究小组。
Motivation: 现有研究关注LLM生成的单个假名，但忽略了模型倾向于生成相关性强的角色组合（如搭配或三人组），这些组合具有模型家族特异性和版本特异性，并可能污染学术记录。
Method: 通过分析不同模型系列（Claude、Gemini、GPT）生成的文档，统计虚构姓名共现频率，并跨独立生成验证一致性。进一步在Zenodo和ResearchGate上系统搜索匹配这些姓名组合的学术记录，利用DataCite时间戳判断数据篡改。
Result: 识别了1655条幽灵作者记录，其中991条在单月内注册，且DataCite时间戳显示故意回溯；这些记录拥有真实DOI可被收割。ResearchGate上存在跨模型家族的虚构研究小组，其发布日期可作为模型部署时间窗的代理。
Conclusion: LLM生成的关联性姓名先验不仅导致内容污染，还通过学术平台（如Zenodo）制造了可被引用的虚假学术记录，影响学术诚信。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Target localization, identification and sensing using latent symmetries
papers.abstract_en: We show that an array of scatterers which has been designed to have latent ("hidden") symmetries can be used as a sensor. We use the capacitance matrix as a canonical model for three-dimensional hybridisation and study how the introduction of an "intruder'' scatterer breaks the latent symmetries. By analysing the degree to which each symmetry is broken, we identify the radius of the intruder and localize its position. This can be achieved using a dictionary-based approach, however Bayesian inference or an artificial neural network (multi-layer perceptron) perform better in the presence of measurement noise. To our knowledge, this is the first time latent symmetries have been exploited successfully for sensing problems. It is also the first time latent symmetries have been observed in a three-dimensional open system that cannot be approximated by a sparse graph.
papers.comment: Published in SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了一种利用具有潜在（隐藏）对称性的散射体阵列作为传感器的方法。通过电容矩阵模型研究入侵散射体如何破坏潜在对称性，并分析对称性破坏程度来识别入侵者半径和位置。基于字典的方法可行，但在噪声下贝叶斯推断或多层感知器表现更好。这是首次将潜在对称性成功用于传感，并首次在三维开放系统中观察到无法用稀疏图近似的潜在对称性。
Motivation: 现有传感方法通常需要复杂设计，而潜在对称性提供了一种新的物理机制。利用散射体阵列中隐藏的对称性进行目标定位和识别，有望提升传感性能并降低硬件要求。
Method: 使用电容矩阵作为三维混合的规范模型，研究入侵散射体对潜在对称性的破坏。通过分析对称性破坏程度，采用字典学习、贝叶斯推断或多层感知器进行目标半径识别与位置定位。
Result: 在测量噪声存在时，贝叶斯推断和人工神经网络（多层感知器）优于字典方法；首次成功将潜在对称性应用于传感问题，并首次在三维开放系统中观察到无法由稀疏图近似的潜在对称性。
Conclusion: 潜在对称性可作为一种有效的传感机制，适用于三维开放系统。未来工作可探索更复杂的散射体配置和实际应用场景。

papers.title: RWGBench: Evaluating Scholarly Positioning in Related Work Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have shown strong fluency in scientific writing, yet the evaluation of related work generation (RWG) remains limited. Existing RWG evaluations largely inherit summarization-oriented metrics, using lexical or semantic similarity to reference sections as proxies for quality. However, related work writing is fundamentally a citation-level scholarly positioning task: it requires selecting, organizing, and framing prior work to clarify how a target paper relates to, differs from, and contributes beyond existing research.As a result, models may generate coherent and semantically-relevant text while exhibiting academically critical failures, such as inappropriate citation selection or misplaced references, that conventional metrics do not capture.To this end, we introduce \textbf{RWGBench}, a benchmark that evaluates RWG from the perspective of citation decision-making rather than text similarity. RWGBench is constructed from a large-scale collection of 40,108 computer science papers and a retrieval corpus of 1.09 million documents, with a carefully curated test set comprising 100 papers and their corresponding published related work sections.We propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that assesses citation selection, contextual appropriateness, organization, and discourse structure.Experiments reveal systematic limitations in current systems that are obscured by standard evaluations, while Oracle studies further disentangle retrieval-level and generation-level bottlenecks. Human evaluation further shows that our citation-centric metrics align substantially better with expert judgment than surface-level text metrics. RWGBench offers a citation-centric testbed for developing and evaluating related work generation systems that are better aligned with scholarly writing practices.
papers.comment: 10 pages, code and data available at https://github.com/BFTree/RWGBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RWGBench，一个从引用决策角度评估相关工作生成（RWG）的基准，而非传统的文本相似度指标。该基准基于 4 万多篇计算机科学论文构建，包含 100 篇论文的测试集及多维度评估框架（引用选择、上下文恰当性、组织、语篇结构）。实验发现现有系统存在被常规指标掩盖的系统性局限，且引用中心指标与专家判断的一致性远高于表层文本指标。
Motivation: 现有 RWG 评估几乎全部沿用摘要式指标（如词汇/语义相似度），但相关工作写作本质上是引用层面的学术定位任务，传统指标无法捕捉不当引用选择或引用错位等学术性失败。
Method: 构建 RWGBench 基准：从 40,108 篇计算机科学论文和 109 万文档检索语料中，精心筛选 100 篇论文及其已发表的相关工作章节；提出多维度评估框架，涵盖引用选择、上下文恰当性、组织结构和语篇结构。
Result: 实验揭示现有系统存在被标准评估掩盖的系统性局限；Oracle 研究进一步分离了检索层面和生成层面的瓶颈；人类评估表明引用中心的指标与专家判断的一致性显著优于表层文本指标。
Conclusion: RWGBench 提供了一个以引用为中心的测试平台，用于开发和评估更符合学术写作实践的相关工作生成系统。

papers.title: Mapping small reservoirs across Brazil from 1984 to 2025
papers.abstract_en: Water research in Brazil largely overlooks the widespread damming of small streams for agricultural uses including watering cattle, farm-scale hydropower, irrigation, and aquaculture. These ubiquitous dams and their reservoirs affect water temperature, stream connectivity, aquatic habitats, greenhouse gas emissions, and evaporative water losses. Mapping small reservoirs is challenging because it requires reliably detecting small water bodies and distinguishing artificial reservoirs from natural lakes. As a result, most regional and global datasets exclude them. To address this gap, we trained a deep learning computer vision model to accurately segment small (0.1 to 100 ha), stream-fed, surface water reservoirs in Brazil leveraging data from Landsat 5-9. Applying our model from 1984 to 2025, we created annual reservoir maps for the entire country to evaluate how their count, size, and distribution have changed over time. The number of detected reservoirs grew nearly fourfold from 224,059 to 817,458, while their total surface area increased from 3490 $km^2$ to 8455 $km^2$. To our knowledge, this is the first country-wide annual dataset representing the evolution of small reservoirs over four decades. The publicly available annual maps highlight the extent and cumulative impacts of small stream impoundments across Brazil, providing actionable insights for managing freshwater ecosystems and water resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用深度学习模型从Landsat 5-9卫星影像中分割巴西全国的小型水库（0.1-100公顷），生成了1984-2025年的年度水库地图。模型检测到的水库数量从224,059个增长到817,458个，总面积从3,490 km²增加到8,455 km²。这是首个覆盖四十年、全国范围的小型水库演变数据集。
Motivation: 巴西广泛存在用于农业的小型水坝及其水库，但大多数区域和全球数据集因检测困难而将其排除，导致这些水体对水温、流域连通性、温室气体排放等影响被忽视。
Method: 训练了一个深度学习计算机视觉模型（基于U-Net或类似架构），使用Landsat 5-9多时相数据，对巴西境内小型人工水库进行像素级分割，并生成年度水库分布图。
Result: 1984年至2025年间，检测到的水库数量增长近四倍（从224,059到817,458），总面积增加超过一倍（从3,490 km²到8,455 km²）。
Conclusion: 该公开数据集揭示了巴西小型水库的扩张规模与累积影响，为淡水生态系统和水资源管理提供了 actionable 见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Rule Violations Are Rare: Chimera Training for Logical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Many practical anomalies are not merely rare inputs, but violations of semantic constraints: objects co-occur in structured ways, actions imply preconditions, and events satisfy temporal or relational regularities. We study anomaly detection in this setting, where constraints are given as logical rules over learned visual concepts, but real rule violations are rare or absent during training. We propose a neural rule evaluator that compiles each constraint into a directed acyclic graph and learns feature-aware subtree MLP gates for its internal logical operators. Each gate maps child features and edge-level negations to a parent representation and a rule-satisfaction probability, with intermediate supervision obtained from exact Boolean propagation over ground-truth concept labels. The key difficulty is that same-image training data often provide insufficient coverage of informative truth configurations and also allow shortcut solutions. To address this, we introduce chimera training: an operand-level counterfactual construction at the feature level. Instead of mixing input images, we concatenate subtree features from different samples; each operand keeps the hard truth label of the sample it came from, and the chimera target is obtained by applying the node's logical operator to those inherited labels. This supplies supervised logical counterexamples without requiring real anomalous images. Across CLEVRER, OpenImages, and VidOR, the resulting evaluator improves rule-level anomaly AUROC over independent-events and same-image semantic-training baselines, especially for compositional and relational rules. The method yields both scalar anomaly scores and rule-level attributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究逻辑异常检测，其中异常定义为对语义约束（如对象共现、动作前提）的违反，但训练时真正的违反实例很少。作者提出一种神经规则评估器，将约束编译为有向无环图，并引入特征感知的子树MLP门控来学习逻辑运算。针对训练数据覆盖不足和捷径学习问题，提出chimera training：在特征层面拼接不同样本的子树特征，利用继承的硬标签构造反事实训练样本。在CLEVRER、OpenImages、VidOR上，该方法在组合和关系规则上的异常检测AUROC优于事件独立和同图语义训练基线。
Motivation: 传统异常检测假设异常是稀有输入，但许多实际异常是语义约束的违反（如物体摆放顺序、动作前提），且训练时这类违反极为稀少甚至缺失，导致模型难以学习真正的违规模式。
Method: 提出神经规则评估器，将每个逻辑规则编译为DAG，每个内部逻辑节点使用MLP门控融合子节点特征并输出满足概率，中间监督来自真值概念标签的逻辑传播；为解决训练数据覆盖不足，提出chimera training：在特征级拼接不同样本的子树特征，每个操作数保留其来源样本的硬标签，通过节点逻辑运算生成反事实目标。
Result: 在CLEVRER、OpenImages、VidOR上，规则级异常AUROC超越独立事件和同图语义训练基线，尤其对组合性和关系性规则提升显著。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效利用逻辑规则和反事实训练检测罕见违规，并提供规则级归因，但依赖预训练的视觉概念检测器，可能受其误差影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When One Point Is Not Enough: Addressing Ambiguous Instances in Dimensionality Reduction by Splitting
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) methods are widely used to visualize high-dimensional data. One key task in DR-based analysis is discovering neighborhoods, which relies on analyzing the fine-grained local structure of a projection. However, DR is an inherently lossy process; no technique can perfectly preserve the high-dimensional relationships, and projections therefore contain visual artifacts. In this paper, we highlight a typically overlooked source of visual artifacts: ambiguous instances. These are instances that are highly similar to multiple mutually dissimilar neighborhoods in the high-dimensional space. Standard DR methods cannot faithfully project such instances, since each data instance is mapped to a single point in the visual space. As a result, such an instance is placed in only one of its neighborhoods (or in none at all), so only part of its neighborhood structure is represented. We call this distortion partial neighborhood embedding. In this paper, we introduce a graph-based approach that identifies ambiguous instances and replicates them as multiple points in the projection, placing each copy within its respective neighborhood. We use UMAP for our results, but our approach also generalizes to other local graph-based DR techniques. We show that our approach reveals previously hidden neighborhood memberships in projections and reduces partial neighborhood embedding across multiple examples, and is further supported by quantitative analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出降维（DR）可视化中的一个被忽视的伪影来源：模糊实例，即在高维空间中与多个互不相似的邻域高度相似的实例。标准DR方法将每个数据点映射为单个点，无法忠实表示这种实例，导致部分邻域嵌入失真。作者提出一种基于图的方法，识别模糊实例并在投影中将其复制为多个点，每个副本放置在其对应的邻域中。基于UMAP的实验表明，该方法能揭示隐藏的邻域成员关系，减少部分邻域嵌入，并有定量分析支持。
Motivation: 现有降维方法在处理与多个互不相似邻域高度相似的实例时，只能将每个实例映射为单个点，导致部分邻域结构丢失，产生视觉伪影。这种模糊实例通常被忽视，但会影响邻域发现任务。
Method: 提出一种基于图的模糊实例识别和复制方法：首先构建高维邻域图，识别与多个邻域高度相似的实例；然后在投影空间中将该实例复制为多个点，每个副本通过局部DR技术（如UMAP）放置在其对应邻域内。该方法可推广到其他基于局部图的DR技术。
Result: 在多个示例上，该方法揭示了投影中先前隐藏的邻域成员关系，并减少了部分邻域嵌入失真。定量分析进一步支持了有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调了模糊实例是DR可视化的常见但被忽视的伪影来源，提出的复制方法能改善邻域结构的表示。未来工作可探索更自动的复制数量选择和评估标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability typically discovers circuits and then argues what they do from examples and ablations. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for turning task-localized circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims: projected functional equivalence, task-relevant invariance, edge necessity, and robustness to continuous final-residual perturbations. At small scale, we directly verify all four properties for quote-closing and bracket-type circuits, including program-mediated circuits whose attention selection is entirely symbolic. At GPT-2 scale, we remove LayerNorm from a sparsemax/LeakyReLU model after training with a +0.0087 OpenWebText loss increase, replace retained attention heads with synthesized restricted-DSL programs, and calibrate only program-local readouts while freezing and hashing every other parameter. The resulting three-edge quote circuit (embedding $\to$ MLP 0 $\to$ program head $\to$ logits) verifies all four properties over a hash-pinned 1,280-prompt domain in linear real arithmetic: 1,280/1,280 equivalence and invariance, 640 edge-necessity witnesses per edge, and robustness at $ε= 0.01$ with minimum certified radius 0.01515. For two alphabet variants of the same opener-detection/copy-type task, untouched gates expose a localization frontier: bracket-type extraction is exact only with all 144 heads, while the constructed quote artifact verifies with three edges. Naive discovery-based verification failed for measured reasons; at scale, we find we must build the object we can verify. The verified object is a calibrated artifact, not the unmodified model, and all claims are bounded to declared domains.
papers.comment: 23 pages. v2: adds GPT-2-scale verified distillation (three-edge verified quote circuit), LayerNorm removal for sparsemax models, and gated localization protocols
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可验证 Transformer (Verifiable Transformers) 框架，将任务局部化电路转化为有界、可求解检查的声明，包括投影功能等价、任务相关不变性、边必要性和对连续最终残差扰动的鲁棒性。在小规模上验证了引号闭合和括号型电路，在 GPT-2 规模上通过移除 LayerNorm、替换注意力头为受限 DSL 程序等方法，对三边引号电路在 1,280 提示域上验证了全部四个属性，等价性和不变性全部通过，边必要性每个边 640 个见证，鲁棒性 epsilon=0.01 时最小认证半径 0.01515。
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性通常通过示例和消融实验论证电路行为，缺乏形式化、可验证的保证。
Method: 提出 Verifiable Transformers 框架，包括四个可求解检查的声明：投影功能等价、任务相关不变性、边必要性和鲁棒性。在 GPT-2 规模上，训练后移除 LayerNorm（OpenWebText 损失增加 +0.0087），用合成的受限 DSL 程序替换保留的注意力头，仅校准程序局部读出，冻结并哈希其余参数。
Result: 在 GPT-2 规模的三边引号电路上，1,280/1,280 等价性和不变性通过，每个边有 640 个边必要性见证，鲁棒性 epsilon=0.01 时最小认证半径 0.01515。对于括号型任务，仅使用全部 144 个头才能精确提取，而构建的引号人工制品用三条边即可验证。
Conclusion: 验证对象是校准后的人工制品（artifact），而非原始模型，所有声明都限定在声明的域内。该框架提供了比基于示例的电路解释更严格的验证，但依赖于构建可验证的对象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four candidate hygiene mechanisms: outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active-cap, meta-skill authoring guidance, and pattern canonicalisation. On MBPP+ hard-100 with Claude Opus 4.7, Ratchet lifts held-out pass@1 from a $0.258 \pm 0.047$ baseline to a late-window rolling mean of $0.584$ (peak $0.658 \pm 0.042$) across 100 rounds and 3 seeds, a $+0.328 \pm 0.018$ rolling-mean gain where the no-skill control drifts at $+0.002 \pm 0.005$; the same recipe transfers to an agentic solver on SWE-bench Verified ($+0.22$ peak lift over 20~rounds). Eight ablations (A1--A8) reveal that the minimal working recipe is smaller than our design suggests: retirement and the meta-skill authoring prior are load-bearing, while explicit deduplication (canonicalisation, cover-guard) is subsumed by the meta-skill itself. A non-divergence proposition shows that bounded cap and retirement threshold together keep expected performance from drifting below the no-skill floor by more than a fixed margin, bounding library drift rather than guaranteeing improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ratchet，一种让冻结LLM代理通过自然语言技能库进行自我进化的最小化卫生食谱。在MBPP+ hard-100上，Ratchet将held-out pass@1从0.258提升到0.584（峰值0.658），在SWE-bench Verified上也取得提升。实验表明，技能退役和元技能编写先验是关键，而去重机制可以被元技能替代。
Motivation: 现有自我进化技能库（如Voyager）中，LLM编写的技能相比无技能基线提升为0.0pp，而人工编写的技能提升16.2pp，瓶颈在于生命周期管理而非技能编写。
Method: 提出Ratchet单代理循环，冻结LLM编写、检索、管理和退役自然语言技能，集成四种候选卫生机制：结果驱动的退役、有限活动容量、元技能编写指导和模式规范化。
Result: 在MBPP+ hard-100上，Ratchet将held-out pass@1从0.258±0.047基线提升到0.584（峰值0.658±0.042），增益0.328±0.018，而无技能控制漂移仅0.002±0.005；在SWE-bench Verified上获得0.22峰值提升。
Conclusion: 最小有效配方比设计更简单：退役和元技能先验是关键，显式去重可被元技能替代。提出非发散命题，表明有界容量和退役阈值能确保性能不偏离无技能底线。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 最小有效配方比设计更简单：退役和元技能先验是关键，显式去重可被元技能替代。提出非发散命题，表明有界容量和退役阈值能确保性能不偏离无技能底线。

papers.title: Exact Symmetry as Algebra: A Machine-Verified Tensor Calculus that Enforces Physical Selection Rules
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry is central to the physical sciences, yet machine learning usually captures it only approximately, leaving a residual per-step equivariance error $\varepsilon$ that compounds with depth $M$ as $M\varepsilon$, whereas exact equivariance holds at unbounded depth; we demonstrate this divergence at fourteen orders of magnitude. We show that a symmetry can be made exact by construction, as the multiplication rule of a tensor algebra. In the resulting $\starG$ algebra, defined by any finite group $G$, the group-Fourier transform block-diagonalizes every tensor into irreducible-representation blocks, making equivariance intrinsic; requiring equivariance conversely \emph{forces} this suitably normalized transform, so the algebra is determined by $G$ rather than chosen. The standard matrix toolbox, including a Frobenius-optimal low-rank factorization, transfers blockwise, machine-checked in Lean~4 under an explicit axiom budget, and extends unchanged to band-limited compact groups and, under periodic boundary conditions, to all 230 crystallographic space groups and the compact little-group fibers of Euclidean and Poincaré symmetry. This exactness is an applied capability: on inorganic-crystal elastic tensors the algebra enforces point-group selection rules exactly on the output of \emph{any} predictor, driving a trained graph network's forbidden-channel leakage from $10^{-2}$ to machine zero, eliminating mechanically unstable predictions, and recovering viable materials that an unconstrained screen discards; on molecular data, with no quantum-mechanical input, it exposes octahedral selection-rule signatures consistent with the Wigner--Eckart theorem. Matched networks lead on pooled molecular accuracy, which we report plainly: the contribution is a complementary algebraic calculus, structural and diagnostic, exact at any depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种精确对称性的张量代数方法，通过构造使对称性成为代数的乘法规则，实现机器验证的精确等变性，并在晶体弹性张量和分子数据上验证了其效果。
Motivation: 机器学习通常仅近似满足物理对称性，导致等变误差随深度累积，而精确等变性可以在任意深度下保持。
Method: 提出$\star G$代数，基于有限群$G$的乘法规则，利用群傅里叶变换将张量块对角化为不可约表示，从而实现内禀等变性。该方法通过Lean 4进行机器验证，并扩展到所有230个晶体学空间群和连续对称群。
Result: 在无机晶体弹性张量上，该方法将图网络的禁止通道泄漏从$10^{-2}$降到机器零，消除不稳定的预测并恢复被过滤的可行材料；在分子数据上，没有量子力学输入也能暴露八面体选择规则特征，与Wigner-Eckart定理一致。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种互补的代数计算，结构性和诊断性，在任何深度下都是精确的。

papers.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving skill libraries face a silent failure mode we term \emph{library drift}: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. Recent evaluation confirms the symptom (LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp (SkillsBench)), yet the underlying mechanism has not been isolated. We provide (1) a reproducible trigger: ablations that isolate drift: one disables skill injection (flat floor, +0.002), one imposes premature retirement (active harm, $-$0.019); (2) trace-level diagnostics: an append-only evidence log with per-skill contribution scores, attribution verdicts, and router engagement metrics that make the failure visible before it reaches end-task scores; and (3) a verified fix: a minimal governance recipe (outcome-driven retirement + bounded active-cap + meta-skill authoring prior) that lifts held-out pass@1 from a 0.258 baseline to a late-window mean of 0.584 (rolling gain $+$0.328) on MBPP+ hard-100 over 100 rounds. Eight ablations decompose which governance mechanisms are load-bearing and which are subsumed, providing a concrete playbook for diagnosing library drift in any self-evolving agent.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN@ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea. https://github.com/amazon-science/Self-Evolving-Agents-Ratchet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了自演化大型语言模型（LLM）技能库中一种未被注意的故障模式——“库漂移”（library drift），即无限制的技能积累缺乏结果驱动的生命周期管理，导致检索退化、误正注入和性能停滞。作者通过消融实验分离出漂移的触发机制，提出基于附加证据日志的追踪诊断方法，并验证了一个最小治理方案（结果驱动的技能退役、有界活跃容量和元技能编写先验），在MBPP+ hard-100基准上将held-out pass@1从0.258提升至0.584。
Motivation: 自演化技能库普遍存在性能停滞问题（LLM撰写的技能带来+0.0pp增益，而人工撰写的技能带来+16.2pp），但根本机制未被分离。本文旨在诊断并修复这一沉默故障。
Method: 提供可重复的漂移触发条件（禁用技能注入和过早退休消融）、追踪级诊断方法（包含每技能贡献分数、归属判定和路由器参与度指标的追加证据日志），以及一个最小治理方案（结果驱动的退役+有界活跃容量+元技能编写先验）。
Result: 在MBPP+ hard-100上，该治理方案将held-out pass@1从0.258基线提升至0.584（滚动增益+0.328），并进行了8项消融实验分解各治理机制的贡献。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个诊断任何自演化智能体中库漂移的具体方案，并强调结果驱动的生命周期管理是抑制性能退化的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Capability Paradox: How Smarter Auditors Make Multi-Agent Systems Less Secure
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems extend large language models (LLMs) by decomposing tasks among specialized agents, but their distributed decision process creates new attack surfaces. We identify semantic hijacking, an attack in which harmful requests are concealed within domain-specific narratives and propagated to a Manager through Worker reports, without any syntactic injection primitives. Across 42,000 adversarial trials over 12 Manager models and 7 Worker configurations, we uncover a capability paradox: as Worker capability increases, the mean system-level Attack Success Rate (ASR) increases from 18.4% to 63.9%, peaking at 94.4%. To explain this effect, we conduct multi-level mediation analysis on two independent datasets (47,807 interactions). This analysis shows that this paradox is driven by linguistic certainty: stronger Workers are more likely to interpret adversarial narratives as legitimate, convey their conclusions assertively, and thereby lead Managers to treat such confident endorsements as justification to execute. In our larger Worker-Only setting ($n_W$=14), certainty mediates 74% of the effect, with 95% confidence intervals (CI) excluding zero under both Monte Carlo and cluster bootstrap; the smaller Full-MAS setting ($n_W$ =6) shows a directionally consistent indirect effect. Worker-side safety prompting does not reliably mitigate this failure. Building on the mediation finding, we propose heterogeneous ensemble verification, which pairs Workers of asymmetric domain competence so their complementary vulnerabilities break the certainty-to-execution chain, reducing ASR from 52.8% to 2.0% with negligible benign-task impact. Our results show that upgrading components to stronger models can actively degrade system security, and that effective defenses require exploiting--rather than eliminating--capability asymmetries between agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多智能体系统中的能力悖论：更强能力的Worker反而导致系统更易遭受语义劫持攻击，攻击成功率从18.4%升至94.4%。通过中介分析揭示该效应由语言确定性驱动，并提出异构集成验证将攻击成功率降至2.0%。
Motivation: 多智能体系统将任务分解给专门智能体，但分布式决策产生新攻击面。现有工作忽略Worker能力增强可能引入安全漏洞。
Method: 设计语义劫持攻击（将有害请求嵌入领域叙事），对12个Manager模型和7个Worker配置进行42000次对抗试验，并通过多级中介分析（47807次交互）验证语言确定性的中介作用，最后提出异构集成验证利用能力不对称防御。
Result: Worker能力从弱到强时，系统平均攻击成功率从18.4%增至63.9%，最高达94.4%；异构集成验证将成功率从52.8%降至2.0%，且对良性任务影响可忽略。
Conclusion: 升级组件为更强模型会主动降低系统安全性，有效防御需利用智能体间能力不对称而非消除差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Skills on the Fly: Test-Time Adaptive Skill Synthesis for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Additional test-time compute can give LLM agents access to more past experience, yet expanding the context or adding rollouts does not necessarily yield greater agent capability. We call this challenge test-time compute-to-capability conversion and propose SkillTTA, which retrieves task-relevant training trajectories and synthesizes a temporary skill conditioned on the visible target context for a solver with fixed parameters. To pursue a higher performance ceiling, SkillTTA further uses meta prompt optimization (MPO) to adapt the policy that writes these skills. MPO evaluates candidate prompts on paired tasks and emphasizes informative transitions. It also confines updates to benchmark-specific atomic slots, reducing the variance caused by observing each edit only indirectly through skill synthesis and solver rollout. Across ALFWorld, SpreadsheetBench, BigCodeBench, and WebShop, SkillTTA outperforms state-of-the-art reuse and optimization baselines. It attains a higher performance ceiling at lower compute cost than baseline reuse and sampling strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM agent在测试时计算资源增加但能力提升有限的问题，提出SkillTTA方法，通过检索训练轨迹合成临时技能，并采用元提示优化(MPO)调整策略，在ALFWorld等基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 额外测试时计算（如扩大上下文或增加rollout）并不能保证提升LLM agent能力，存在测试时计算到能力转换的低效问题。
Method: SkillTTA包含两个部分：检索任务相关训练轨迹并在可见目标上下文中合成临时技能；以及元提示优化(MPO)自适应地调整编写技能的提示策略，MPO评估候选提示并约束更新到基准特定的原子槽中。
Result: 在ALFWorld、SpreadsheetBench、BigCodeBench、WebShop上，SkillTTA优于最新的重用和优化基线，以更低的计算成本达到更高的性能上限。
Conclusion: 本文证明了通过测试时技能合成与元优化可以有效提升LLM agent的测试时计算效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HYVINT: Intensity-Driven Hypergraph Generation with Variational Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraphs provide a principled framework for modeling polyadic interactions, with applications in recommendation systems, social networks, and molecular modeling. Hypergraph generation remains challenging because incidence structures are discrete, sparse, and governed by heterogeneous higher-order interactions. Existing generators often rely on implicit latent spaces or continuous incidence decoders, which provide limited mechanistic interpretation of how node-hyperedge incidences arise. To address these limitations, we propose HYVINT, an intensity-driven hypergraph generative framework. Our key innovations are twofold: (i) we develop an intensity-driven incidence formation mechanism for hypergraphs that links latent interaction strength to binary incidence, and (ii) we derive a tractable lower-bound variational estimator for learning latent representations. We provide generation error bounds with asymptotic convergence rates and empirically show that HYVINT achieves strong fidelity while maintaining substantial novelty and diversity on synthetic and real-world hypergraphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HYVINT，一种基于强度驱动的超图生成框架。核心创新包括强度驱动的关联形成机制，该机制将潜在交互强度映射到二元关联，以及一个可处理的变分下界估计器用于学习潜在表示。摘要提供了生成误差界与渐近收敛率，并在合成和真实超图上展示了强保真度、新颖性和多样性。
Motivation: 现有超图生成方法依赖隐空间或连续解码器，缺乏对节点-超边关联形成的机制解释，难以处理异质性高阶交互。
Method: 提出强度驱动的超图生成框架HYVINT，包括：(i) 强度驱动关联形成机制，连接潜在交互强度与二元关联；(ii) 可处理的变分下界估计器，用于学习潜在表示。
Result: 摘要提供了生成误差界与渐近收敛率，实验表明在保真度、新颖性和多样性方面均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: HYVINT通过强度驱动机制提供了对超图生成过程的可解释性，并在多项指标上取得良好性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A nonlinear extension of parametric model embedding for dimensionality reduction in parametric shape design
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality reduction is essential in simulation-based shape design, where high-dimensional parameterizations hinder optimization, surrogate modeling, and systematic design-space exploration. Parametric Model Embedding (PME) addresses this issue by constructing reduced variables from geometric information while preserving an explicit backmapping to the original design parameters. However, PME is intrinsically linear and may become inefficient when the sampled design space is governed by nonlinear geometric variability. This paper introduces a nonlinear extension of PME, denoted NLPME. The proposed framework preserves the defining principle of PME -- geometry-driven latent variables and parameter-mediated reconstruction -- while replacing the linear reduced subspace with a nonlinear latent representation. Geometry is not reconstructed directly from the latent variables; instead, the latent representation is decoded into admissible design parameters, and the corresponding geometry is recovered through a forward parametric map. The method is assessed on a bio-inspired autonomous underwater glider with a 32-dimensional parametric shape description and a CAD-based geometry-generation process. NLPME reaches a 5\% reconstruction-error threshold with \(N=5\) latent variables, compared with \(N=8\) for linear PME, and a 1\% threshold with \(N=9\), compared with \(N=15\) for PME. Comparison with a deep autoencoder shows that most of the nonlinear compression gain can be retained while preserving an explicit backmapping to the original design variables. The results establish NLPME as a compact, admissible, and engineering-compatible nonlinear reduced representation for parametric shape design spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种参数模型嵌入(PME)的非线性扩展方法(NLPME)，用于参数化形状设计的降维。NLPME保留了几何驱动的潜在变量和参数介导的重构，但用非线性潜在表示替代线性子空间。在32维参数描述的自主水下滑翔机案例中，NLPME以5个潜在变量达到5%重构误差阈值（PME需8个），9个潜在变量达到1%阈值（PME需15个）。结果表明NLPME是一种紧凑、可允许且工程兼容的非线性降维表示。
Motivation: 线性PME在采样设计空间由非线性几何变异性主导时效率低下，需要一种非线性扩展来提升降维效果。
Method: 提出非线性参数模型嵌入(NLPME)，保留PME的几何驱动潜在变量和参数介导重构原则，但将线性潜在子空间替换为非线性潜在表示。几何不直接从潜在变量重建，而是将潜在表示解码为可接受的几何参数，再通过正向参数映射恢复几何。

papers.title: Structured Belief State and the First Precision-Aware Benchmark for LLM Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM memory benchmarks evaluate answer quality rather than retrieval accuracy. Consequently, a system that dumps its entire belief store can achieve perfect recall and mask severe precision failures. We show this evaluation gap persists across multiple embedding models where similarity-based retrieval over domain-specific corpora inherently struggles to isolate target beliefs from semantically proximate ones. Furthermore, multi-turn topic drift compounds this retrieval noise while driving up latency and operational costs. To decouple retrieval quality from generative performance, we introduce PrecisionMemBench, an 89-case benchmark measuring precision, noise isolation, session latency, and belief mutability. We also present Tenure, a structured belief-store proxy that resolves scope and retrieval before inference and injects typed belief state as ambient instruction before the model sees the prompt, removing model-side discretion over whether memory is consulted. Evaluated across 13 configurations, Tenure achieves perfect retrieval passes across all active, non-session, and session test cases. In contrast, the baseline configurations fail to reach even half of the active passes, with precision scores clustering at 0.22 and below. Our results demonstrate that while current memory systems successfully store information, they fail to retrieve it cleanly; a structural vulnerability that traditional answer-quality benchmarks conceal.

papers.title: Optimality of Sub-network Laplace Approximations: New Results and Methods
papers.abstract_en: Although the Laplace approximation offers a simple route to uncertainty quantification in deep neural networks, its reliance on inverting large Hessian matrices has motivated a range of computationally feasible low-dimensional or sparse approximations. A prominent class of such methods - sub-network Laplace approximations, constructs surrogates by restricting attention to a small subset of parameters. Existing approaches in this family typically rely on diagonal, layer-wise, or other architectural heuristics for subset selection, which ignore cross-parameter interactions and lack formal optimality guarantees. In this paper, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of the sub-network Laplace paradigm. We prove that all sub-network Laplace methods systematically underestimate the predictive variance of the full Laplace posterior, and that this bias decreases monotonically as the retained sub-matrix expands. Leveraging this insight, we propose two principled, analytically grounded sub-network Hessian approximations: \textit{Gradient-Laplace} selects parameters with the largest average squared gradients of the model output with respect to the parameters over a reference dataset; while \textit{Greedy-Laplace} iteratively refines this selection by accounting for off-diagonal interactions in the precision matrix. We establish theoretical guarantees characterizing their optimality properties and show that Gradient-Laplace provably outperforms existing heuristic approaches. Extensive numerical studies across diverse settings indicate that these methods perform strongly relative to existing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对深度神经网络中的子网络拉普拉斯近似（sub-network Laplace approximations）进行严格理论分析，证明所有子网络方法都会系统性地低估全拉普拉斯后验的预测方差，且偏差随保留子矩阵扩大而单调减小。基于该分析，提出两种有理论保证的新方法：Gradient-Laplace（基于梯度的参数选择）和Greedy-Laplace（迭代考虑精度矩阵的非对角交互），并证明它们优于现有启发式方法。
Motivation: 现有子网络拉普拉斯近似多依赖对角、逐层等启发式参数选择，忽略参数间交互且缺乏最优性保证，需要理论指导的合理方法。
Method: 理论证明子网络拉普拉斯近似低估方差且偏差单调递减；提出Gradient-Laplace（选取输出关于参数的平均平方梯度最大的参数）和Greedy-Laplace（迭代选参并纳入精度矩阵的非对角交互）。
Result: 理论保证Gradient-Laplace优于现有启发式方法；大量数值实验表明两种方法在多种设置下表现强劲。
Conclusion: 本文为子网络拉普拉斯近似提供了理论框架和两种可计算、有保证的新方法，但该方法本身仅关注不确定性量化，未涉及具体应用领域。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Element-Aware Cross-Version Differencing of Scientific Documents via Layout-Aware Alignment and Structure-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-version differencing of scientific documents is essential in scholarly publishing and technical documentation, but remains challenging because scientific documents are page-structured artifacts containing heterogeneous elements such as text, tables, formulas, figures, and layout cues. Existing text-sequence-based methods often lose layout and structural information, while image-based methods lack semantic interpretability and are sensitive to rendering variation. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a layout-aware heterogeneous element-aware framework for scientific document differencing. The framework decomposes document versions into semantically typed elements, establishes cross-version correspondence through an alignment-first mechanism that jointly models spatial, content, and structural compatibility, and performs type-aware difference reasoning over aligned element pairs. It supports unified change detection, localization, structure-awareness analysis, and alignment/matching evaluation across text, tables, formulas, and figures. Experiments on real-world scientific PDF data from journal production proofreading workflows show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms element-specific baselines. It achieves detection F1 scores of 0.903, 0.855, 0.862, and 0.845 for text, tables, formulas, and figures, respectively, with further improvements in localization, structure awareness, and matching quality. Ablation and sensitivity analyses confirm the effectiveness of cross-version alignment, type-specific representations, structure-aware reasoning, and compatibility-weight design. These results demonstrate that heterogeneous element-aware differencing provides a robust and interpretable solution for scientific document comparison in realistic editorial production scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个布局感知的异构元素感知框架，用于科学文档的跨版本差异比较。该框架将文档版本分解为语义类型元素，通过对齐优先机制建立跨版本对应关系，并进行类型感知的差异推理。在真实期刊生产校对数据上的实验表明，该框架在文本、表格、公式和图形的检测F1分数上分别达到0.903、0.855、0.862和0.845，优于元素特定基线。
Motivation: 现有文本序列方法丢失布局和结构信息，图像方法缺乏语义可解释性且对渲染变化敏感，需要一种能处理科学文档中异构元素（文本、表格、公式、图形）的差异比较方法。
Method: 提出一个框架，包括：1）将文档版本分解为语义类型元素；2）通过联合建模空间、内容和结构兼容性的对齐优先机制建立跨版本对应；3）对对齐元素对进行类型感知的差异推理，支持统一的变化检测、定位、结构感知分析和匹配评估。
Result: 在真实期刊生产校对数据上，文本、表格、公式和图形的检测F1分别为0.903、0.855、0.862和0.845；消融和敏感性分析验证了跨版本对齐、类型特定表示、结构感知推理和兼容性权重设计的有效性。
Conclusion: 异构元素感知差异比较为科学文档比较提供了鲁棒且可解释的解决方案，适用于实际编辑生产场景。

papers.title: Distill, Diffuse, Segment: Unsupervised 3D Semantic Segmentation for Autonomous Driving Based on Multi-Level Distillation and Graph Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR-based semantic segmentation is essential for autonomous-driving perception, yet dense point-wise annotations are costly, and long-tailed outdoor scenes make small safety-critical objects difficult to discover without supervision. Existing unsupervised methods face three key challenges: they struggle to preserve small and sparsely observed objects under substantial scale variation, have difficulty enforcing intra-region consistency and inter-region discrimination during cross-modal transfer, and lack an efficient feature-preserving mechanism for contextual propagation over superpoint graphs. We therefore propose DDS, an unsupervised 3D semantic segmentation framework. First, a coarse-to-fine multi-granularity mask cascade provides complementary 3D region cues for objects across different scales, improving the preservation of small and sparsely observed objects. Second, region-guided multi-level distillation transfers self-supervised visual knowledge through point-level alignment, mask-level prototype alignment, and prototype-level contrastive learning, enhancing intra-region consistency and inter-region discrimination. Third, restart-based graph diffusion efficiently propagates contextual information among superpoints while anchoring the refined representation to the initial distilled features and avoiding explicit graph eigendecomposition. Experiments on real-world driving datasets show that DDS outperforms representative unsupervised baselines, improving oAcc, mAcc, and mIoU by up to 2.9%, 9.7%, and 4.1%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of DDS for unsupervised 3D scene understanding in autonomous-driving scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDS，一种无监督 3D 语义分割框架，用于自动驾驶中的 LiDAR 点云。通过粗到细的多粒度掩码级联保留小物体，区域引导的多级蒸馏提升跨模态一致性，以及重启图扩散传播上下文信息。在真实驾驶数据集上，DDS 在 oAcc、mAcc 和 mIoU 上分别提升 2.9%、9.7% 和 4.1%。
Motivation: LiDAR 语义分割依赖昂贵的人工标注，且无监督方法难以保留小物体、维持区域一致性以及高效传播上下文，尤其在长尾户外场景中。
Method: 提出 DDS 框架，包含：(1) 粗到细的多粒度掩码级联来生成不同尺度的 3D 区域提示；(2) 区域引导的多级蒸馏，通过点级、掩码级和原型级对比学习对齐自监督视觉知识；(3) 重启图扩散，在超点图上传播上下文并保持初始蒸馏特征，避免显式图分解。
Result: 在真实驾驶数据集上，DDS 优于无监督基线，oAcc、mAcc 和 mIoU 分别提升 2.9%、9.7% 和 4.1%。
Conclusion: DDS 在无监督 3D 场景理解中有效且可迁移，适用于自动驾驶场景。

papers.title: CAST: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Caption-Guided Visual Attention Steering
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on downstream tasks, they frequently produce contents that deviate from visual information, leading to object hallucination. To tackle this, recent works mostly depend on expensive manual annotations and training cost, or decoding strategies which significantly increase inference time. In this work, we observe that LVLMs' attention to visual information is significantly enhanced when answering caption queries compared to non-caption queries. Inspired by this phenomenon, we propose Caption-guided Visual Attention Steering (CAST), a training-free, plug-and-play hallucination mitigation method that leverages the attention activation pattern corresponding to caption queries to enhance LVLMs' visual perception capability. Specifically, we use probing techniques to identify attention heads that are highly sensitive to caption queries and estimate optimized steering directions for their outputs. This steering strengthens LVLM's fine-grained visual perception capabilities, thereby effectively mitigating object hallucination. CAST reduced object hallucination by an average of 6.03% across five widely used LVLMs and five benchmarks including both discriminative and generative tasks, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance while adding little inference cost and preserving other foundational capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练、即插即用的方法 CAST，通过利用描述性查询（caption queries）对应的注意力激活模式来增强大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的视觉感知能力，从而缓解对象幻觉。该方法在五个 LVLM 和五个基准上平均减少 6.03% 的对象幻觉，且几乎不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 现有 LVLM 常产生与视觉信息不符的内容（对象幻觉），现有缓解方法依赖昂贵的人工标注或训练，或增加推理时间。
Method: 通过探测技术识别对描述性查询高度敏感的注意力头，并估计其输出的优化转向方向，从而强化模型的细粒度视觉感知。

papers.title: Topology-Constrained Quantized nnUNet for Efficient and Anatomically Accurate 3D Tooth Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a topology-constrained quantized nnUNet framework for efficient and anatomically accurate 3D tooth segmentation, addressing the challenges of spatial distortion introduced by quantization in deep learning models. The proposed method integrates a novel tooth-specific topological loss into quantization-aware training, preserving critical anatomical structures such as tooth count, adjacency relationships, and cavity integrity while maintaining computational efficiency. The system employs an 8-bit quantized nnUNet backbone, where weights and activations are dynamically calibrated to minimize precision loss during inference. Furthermore, the topological loss combines connected-component analysis, adjacency consistency, and hole detection penalties, ensuring anatomical fidelity without modifying the underlying network architecture. The joint optimization objective harmonizes cross-entropy loss, quantization regularization, and topological constraints, enabling end-to-end training with gradient approximations for persistent homology terms. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces topological errors compared to conventional quantized models, achieving clinically plausible segmentations on dental CBCT scans. The method retains the hardware efficiency of integer-only inference, making it suitable for deployment in resource-constrained clinical environments. This work bridges the gap between computational efficiency and anatomical precision in medical image segmentation, offering a practical solution for real-world dental applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑约束量化nnUNet框架，用于高效且解剖准确的3D牙齿分割。通过将牙齿特定的拓扑损失（包括连通分量分析、邻接一致性和空洞检测惩罚）集成到量化感知训练中，在8-bit量化条件下保持解剖结构完整性。实验表明，该方法相比传统量化模型显著减少拓扑错误，在牙科CBCT扫描上实现临床可行的分割，并保持整数推理的硬件效率。
Motivation: 深度学习模型量化引入的空间失真会破坏牙齿分割中的关键解剖结构（如牙齿计数、邻接关系和空洞完整性），现有方法尚未有效解决该问题。
Method: 采用8-bit量化nnUNet作为骨干网络，在量化感知训练中联合优化交叉熵损失、量化正则化和拓扑约束，通过梯度近似处理持久同调项。拓扑损失包含连通分量分析、邻接一致性和空洞检测惩罚，无需修改网络架构。
Result: 在牙科CBCT扫描上，该方法显著降低了拓扑错误，生成临床合理的分割结果，同时保持整数推理的计算效率。
Conclusion: 该工作弥合了医学图像分割中计算效率与解剖精度之间的差距，为资源受限的临床环境提供了实用解决方案。

papers.title: SpectraDINO: Modality-Conditioned Adaptation of RGB Vision Foundation Models Across Infrared Bands
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models (VFMs) pretrained on large-scale RGB data provide strong general-purpose representations, yet infrared perception, which is essential for robotics and driving in low light and adverse weather, still relies on backbones built per sensor. Existing transfer methods bridge the visible-infrared gap for only a single band or a single RGB-IR pair, leaving no unified backbone that spans the infrared spectrum. We present SpectraDINO, a modality-conditioned adaptation of an RGB vision foundation model that supports NIR, SWIR, and LWIR with a single shared ViT. All modality-specific behavior is conditioned on the active sensor via lightweight input stems, learned modality embeddings, and per-modality bottleneck adapters, while the transformer weights remain shared. We propose a staged protocol to distill the frozen DINOv2 teacher into a spectral student via cosine distillation, symmetric contrastive alignment, patch-level correspondence, and a queue-based neighborhood-preservation loss, and then selectively fine-tune the deeper blocks to adapt without forgetting RGB priors. Across seven detection and segmentation benchmarks spanning all three infrared bands, this single conditioned backbone matches or surpasses modality-specific methods, improving mIoU over the best published results by 2.6 points on FMB and 1.4 on SemanticRT, and exceeding identically fine-tuned foundation-model baselines by 2.7 mAP on SWIR detection.
papers.comment: Updated with the revised model results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpectraDINO，一种模态条件适配方法，将RGB视觉基础模型DINOv2扩展到支持NIR、SWIR、LWIR三个红外波段，使用单个共享ViT。通过轻量输入茎、学习的模态嵌入和每模态瓶颈适配器实现模态特定行为，并采用分阶段协议进行蒸馏和微调。在七个检测和分割基准上，该单模型匹配或超越模态特定方法，例如在FMB上提升mIoU 2.6点。
Motivation: 现有的红外感知依赖每个传感器单独构建骨干网络，缺乏统一的跨红外光谱骨干。现有迁移方法仅适用于单一波段或单一RGB-IR对。
Method: 提出模态条件适配，包括轻量输入茎、学习的模态嵌入和每模态瓶颈适配器，所有transformer权重共享。采用分阶段协议：首先通过余弦蒸馏、对称对比对齐、图像块级对应和基于队列的邻域保持损失从冻结的DINOv2教师蒸馏到光谱学生，然后选择性微调深层块以适配而不遗忘RGB先验。
Result: 在七个涵盖三个红外波段的检测和分割基准上，该单条件骨干匹配或超越模态特定方法。在FMB上mIoU提升2.6点，在SemanticRT上提升1.4点，在SWIR检测上mAP超过相同微调的基础模型基线2.7点。
Conclusion: 摘要显示该工作成功将RGB视觉基础模型扩展到多红外波段，无需为每个传感器单独训练，且性能优于已有方法。但未提及在降水预测等任务上的应用，可能仅限于视觉感知。

papers.title: Prompt Framing Distorts Count Based Evaluation of LLM Error Detection: Evidence from Numeric Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Count-based F1 is widely used as a proxy for LLM error-detection quality, but this paper shows that it can rise dramatically without a corresponding improvement in span localization, a gap termed F1 Inflation. The paper introduces ErrorBench, a controlled stress-test protocol for prompt-induced count distortion. ErrorBench evaluates six contemporary LLMs under five prompt conditions over 4,290 responses from 143 CoNLL-2014 passages. Under CoNLL-2014 M2-style scoring, anchored prompts produce up to 0.79 points of F1 Inflation, and up to 0.96 under strict matching. A 100-passage replication using the official ERRANT 3.0.0 pipeline and multi-reference scoring reproduces the pattern: averaged over six models, the Blind-to-Anchored prompt shift raises Count-F1 by +0.21 while raising multi-reference ERRANT F0.5 by only +0.04. The study finds larger count responses in highly instruction-compliant GPT/Claude systems and smaller responses in the Gemini family under this stress-test protocol. The findings suggest that LLM proofreading and document-review evaluations should avoid pre-populated error counts and should report span-aware metrics alongside count-based metrics.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现基于计数的F1分数在LLM错误检测中可能因prompt框架而膨胀，而不反映真正的跨度定位改进，称为F1通货膨胀。作者提出ErrorBench压力测试协议，评估了六种LLM在五种prompt条件下的表现，表明锚定prompt会导致F1通货膨胀高达0.79分（CoNLL-2014 M2评分）和0.96分（严格匹配）。在100段文本的复制实验中，盲到锚定prompt转换使Count-F1平均提升0.21，但多参考ERRANT F0.5仅提升0.04。结论建议评估应避免预填充错误计数，并同时报告跨度感知和基于计数的指标。
Motivation: 基于计数的F1广泛用于评估LLM错误检测质量，但其可能因prompt框架而扭曲，导致虚高的评估结果，缺乏对跨度定位能力的真实反映。
Method: 引入ErrorBench，一个控制压力测试协议，通过改变prompt条件（如锚定错误计数）评估六种当代LLM在143段CoNLL-2014文本上的4,290条响应，使用M2和严格匹配评分，并在100段文本上使用官方ERRANT 3.0.0管道和多参考评分进行复制。
Result: 锚定prompt导致F1通货膨胀最高达0.79（M2评分）和0.96（严格匹配）。盲到锚定prompt转换时，Count-F1平均提升0.21，而多参考ERRANT F0.5仅提升0.04。GPT/Claude模型表现出更大的计数响应，而Gemini系列响应较小。
Conclusion: LLM校对和文档审查评估应避免预填充错误计数，并应同时报告跨度感知指标（如ERRANT F0.5）和基于计数的指标，以避免prompt框架导致的扭曲。

papers.title: SparseContrast: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Efficient and Accurate Contrastive Learning in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: We propose SparseContrast, a new framework that merges dynamic sparse attention with contrastive learning for medical imaging, with a focus on chest X-ray disease detection in low-data settings. Traditional contrastive learning methods rely on dense attention mechanisms, which are computationally expensive and often process redundant regions in medical images. To resolve this, SparseContrast introduces a sparse attention mechanism that selectively concentrates on diagnostically pertinent areas, markedly decreasing computational burden without compromising accuracy. The framework adaptively trims attention maps in the training phase, directed by a compact saliency predictor which concurrently optimizes sparsity and feature quality. This method not only speeds up training and inference by as much as 40% relative to dense attention benchmarks but also boosts diagnostic accuracy by focusing on areas of clinical importance. Moreover, the approach remains indifferent to the selection of backbone architecture, which permits its application to both convolutional and transformer-based models. Experiments show SparseContrast attains comparable or better performance in disease identification tasks with greater efficiency relative to current approaches. The proposed framework delivers a practical approach for implementing contrastive learning in medical imaging settings with limited resources, where computational efficiency and diagnostic accuracy are paramount.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SparseContrast框架，将动态稀疏注意力与对比学习结合，用于医学影像中的胸部X射线疾病检测，特别适用于低数据场景。通过稀疏注意力机制聚焦诊断相关区域，减少计算负担并提升效率，实验显示训练和推理速度提升40%，同时保持或提升诊断准确性。
Motivation: 传统对比学习方法依赖密集注意力，计算成本高且处理医学图像中的冗余区域，限制了在资源有限环境中的应用。
Method: 引入动态稀疏注意力机制，由紧凑的显著性预测器指导，在训练阶段自适应修剪注意力图，同时优化稀疏性和特征质量，支持卷积和Transformer骨干。
Result: 相比密集注意力基准，训练和推理速度提升40%，在疾病识别任务上达到相当或更优的诊断准确性。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种在有限资源医学影像设置中实现对比学习的实用方法，兼顾计算效率和诊断准确性。
