papers.title: How does downsampling affect needle electromyography signals? A generalisable workflow for understanding downsampling effects on high-frequency time series
papers.abstract_en: Automated analysis of needle electromyography (nEMG) signals is emerging as a tool to support the detection of neuromuscular diseases (NMDs), yet the signals' high and heterogeneous sampling rates pose substantial computational challenges for feature-based machine-learning models, particularly for near real-time analysis. Downsampling offers a potential solution, but its impact on diagnostic signal content and classification performance remains insufficiently understood. This study presents a workflow for systematically evaluating information loss caused by downsampling in high-frequency time series. The workflow combines shape-based distortion metrics with classification outcomes from available feature-based machine learning models and feature space analysis to quantify how different downsampling algorithms and factors affect both waveform integrity and predictive performance. We use a three-class NMD classification task to experimentally evaluate the workflow. We demonstrate how the workflow identifies downsampling configurations that preserve diagnostic information while substantially reducing computational load. Analysis of shape-based distortion metrics showed that shape-aware downsampling algorithms outperform standard decimation, as they better preserve peak structure and overall signal morphology. The results provide practical guidance for selecting downsampling configurations that enable near real-time nEMG analysis and highlight a generalisable workflow that can be used to balance data reduction with model performance in other high-frequency time-series applications as well.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用工作流，系统评估降采样对高频时间序列（如针肌电图信号）的信息损失影响，结合形状失真度量和机器学习分类性能，以在数据压缩和诊断准确率之间取得平衡。在神经肌肉疾病三分类任务上验证，显示形状感知降采样算法优于标准抽取，能为近实时分析提供实用指导。
Motivation: 高频异质采样率的nEMG信号分析计算量大，降采样可降低负载，但对其诊断内容的影响缺乏系统性理解。
Method: 提出结合形状失真度量、现有基于特征的机器学习模型分类结果和特征空间分析的工作流，量化不同降采样算法和因子的影响。
Result: 在神经肌肉疾病三分类任务上，形状感知降采样算法比标准抽取更好保留峰值结构和信号形态，能在降低计算负荷的同时保持诊断信息。
Conclusion: 工作流可推广到其他高频时间序列应用，为平衡数据缩减与模型性能提供实用指导。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Singular-Value Learning for Cross-Covariances Forecasting in Financial Markets
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in nonlinear shrinkage yield asymptotically optimal cleaners for large covariance matrices and have been extended to empirical cross-covariances via singular-value shrinkage. However, these approaches rely on stationarity and bounded-spectrum assumptions that are violated by real equity returns, which exhibit dependence drift and macroscopic common modes. We propose a physics-informed neural estimator that parameterizes the cleaned cross-covariance matrix in the empirical singular-vector basis and learns a nonlinear map from empirical singular values and marginal projections to cleaned singular values, recovering the cleaning performances of the analytical solution as a limiting case. On U.S. equity data, the learned correction not only improves out-of-sample cross-covariance prediction but also translates these statistical gains into better tracking-error minimization for portfolio replication. Furthermore, it remains stable in regimes where the analytical cross-covariance estimation deteriorates with universe size, suggesting an interpolation between sample-size denoising and a learned forecast correction under non-stationary dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融收益数据中非平稳性和宏观共同模式违反传统非线性收缩假设的问题，提出一种物理信息神经网络估计器。该方法在经验奇异向量基中参数化清洁的互协方差矩阵，学习从经验奇异值和边际投影到清洁奇异值的非线性映射，解析解作为极限情况。在美国股票数据上，该估计改善了样本外互协方差预测，并提升了投资组合复制中的跟踪误差最小化，且在解析估计随市值规模恶化的体制下保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有非线性收缩方法依赖平稳性和有界谱假设，而实际股票收益表现出依赖漂移和宏观共同模式，违反这些假设，导致协方差估计不准确。
Method: 提出物理信息神经网络估计器，在经验奇异向量基中参数化清洁互协方差矩阵，学习从经验奇异值和边际投影到清洁奇异值的非线性映射，以解析解作为极限情况。
Result: 在美国股票数据上，该方法改善了样本外互协方差预测，并转化为更好的投资组合复制跟踪误差最小化；在解析估计随市值规模恶化的体制下保持稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法介于样本量去噪和非平稳依赖下的学习预测校正之间，展示了在非平稳金融数据上的稳定性和预测改进。

summary_sections.method: 提出物理信息神经网络估计器，在经验奇异向量基中参数化清洁互协方差矩阵，学习从经验奇异值和边际投影到清洁奇异值的非线性映射，以解析解作为极限情况。
summary_sections.result: 在美国股票数据上，该方法改善了样本外互协方差预测，并转化为更好的投资组合复制跟踪误差最小化；在解析估计随市值规模恶化的体制下保持稳定。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该方法介于样本量去噪和非平稳依赖下的学习预测校正之间，展示了在非平稳金融数据上的稳定性和预测改进。

papers.title: How Context Shapes Truth: Geometric Transformations of Statement-level Truth Representations in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often encode whether a statement is true as a vector in their residual stream activations. These vectors, also known as truth vectors, have been studied in prior work, however how they change when context is introduced remains unexplored. We study this question by measuring (1) the directional change ($θ$) between the truth vectors with and without context and (2) the relative magnitude of the truth vectors upon adding context. Across four LLMs and four datasets, we find that (1) truth vectors are roughly orthogonal in early layers, converge in middle layers, and may stabilize or continue increasing in later layers; (2) adding context generally increases the truth vector magnitude, i.e., the separation between true and false representations in the activation space is amplified; (3) larger models distinguish relevant from irrelevant context mainly through directional change ($θ$), while smaller models show this distinction through magnitude differences. We also find that context conflicting with parametric knowledge produces larger geometric changes than parametrically aligned context. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that provides a geometric characterization of how context transforms the truth vector in the activation space of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLMs）中陈述级真值表示（truth vectors）在上下文影响下的几何变换。通过测量有无上下文时真值向量的方向变化（θ）和相对幅度，发现早期层向量几乎正交，中层收敛，后期稳定或继续增加；添加上下文通常增加向量幅度；大模型主要通过方向变化区分相关与不相关上下文，小模型则通过幅度差异。
Motivation: 已有工作研究了LLMs中编码陈述真值的向量（truth vectors），但上下文如何改变这些向量的几何特性尚不清楚。
Method: 测量两种几何量：有无上下文时truth vectors的方向变化（θ）和添加上下文后向量的相对幅度。在4个LLM和4个数据集上进行实验。
Result: 1) 早期层truth vectors近似正交，中层收敛，后期可能稳定或继续增加；2) 添加上下文通常增大truth vector幅度，即真假表示在激活空间的分离被放大；3) 大模型主要通过方向变化区分相关与无关上下文，小模型通过幅度差异；4) 与参数知识冲突的上下文导致比对齐的上下文更大的几何变化。
Conclusion: 该工作是首次对上下文如何变换LLM激活空间中truth vectors提供几何表征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $\texttt{AMEND++}$: Benchmarking Eligibility Criteria Amendments in Clinical Trials
papers.abstract_en: Clinical trial amendments frequently introduce delays, increased costs, and administrative burden, with eligibility criteria being the most commonly amended component. We introduce \textit{eligibility criteria amendment prediction}, a novel NLP task that aims to forecast whether the eligibility criteria of an initial trial protocol will undergo future amendments. To support this task, we release $\texttt{AMEND++}$, a benchmark suite comprising two datasets: $\texttt{AMEND}$, which captures eligibility-criteria version histories and amendment labels from public clinical trials, and $\verb|AMEND_LLM|$, a refined subset curated using an LLM-based denoising pipeline to isolate substantive changes. We further propose $\textit{Change-Aware Masked Language Modeling}$ (CAMLM), a revision-aware pretraining strategy that leverages historical edits to learn amendment-sensitive representations. Experiments across diverse baselines show that CAMLM consistently improves amendment prediction, enabling more robust and cost-effective clinical trial design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出临床试验资格标准修订预测这一新NLP任务，并发布AMEND++基准套件，包含AMEND和AMEND_LLM两个数据集。作者进一步提出Change-Aware Masked Language Modeling (CAMLM)预训练策略，利用历史编辑学习修订敏感表示。实验表明CAMLM持续提升预测性能。
Motivation: 临床试验修正常导致延迟、成本增加和管理负担，而资格标准是最常修改的部分；预测修改有助于更稳健和经济的试验设计。
Method: 定义资格标准修订预测任务；构建AMEND数据集（公共试验版本历史及修订标签）和AMEND_LLM子集（LLM去噪后仅含实质变更）；提出CAMLM预训练方法，通过掩码语言建模学习修订感知表示。
Result: 在多种基线模型上的实验显示，CAMLM在修订预测任务上持续取得改进。
Conclusion: 论文强调该任务和基准的实用性，以及CAMLM在提升预测鲁棒性方面的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LiDARDraft: Generating LiDAR Point Cloud from Versatile Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic and diverse LiDAR point clouds is crucial for autonomous driving simulation. Although previous methods achieve LiDAR point cloud generation from user inputs, they struggle to attain high-quality results while enabling versatile controllability, due to the imbalance between the complex distribution of LiDAR point clouds and the simple control signals. To address the limitation, we propose LiDARDraft, which utilizes the 3D layout to build a bridge between versatile conditional signals and LiDAR point clouds. The 3D layout can be trivially generated from various user inputs such as textual descriptions and images. Specifically, we represent text, images, and point clouds as unified 3D layouts, which are further transformed into semantic and depth control signals. Then, we employ a rangemap-based ControlNet to guide LiDAR point cloud generation. This pixel-level alignment approach demonstrates excellent performance in controllable LiDAR point clouds generation, enabling "simulation from scratch", allowing self-driving environments to be created from arbitrary textual descriptions, images and sketches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LiDARDraft，通过3D布局桥接多模态条件信号与LiDAR点云生成，利用rangemap-based ControlNet实现像素级对齐，支持从文本、图像、草图等输入生成高质量LiDAR点云，用于自动驾驶仿真。
Motivation: 现有方法在生成LiDAR点云时难以兼顾高质量与多样控制，因为点云分布复杂而控制信号简单。
Method: 将文本、图像等输入统一表示为3D布局，转化为语义和深度控制信号，再通过rangemap-based ControlNet引导点云生成。
Result: 摘要定性描述该方法在可控LiDAR点云生成中表现出色，生成的点云逼真多样，支持从任意描述、图像或草图中创建仿真环境。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了像素级对齐的可控点云生成，使自动驾驶环境可从零构建，提升了仿真灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kinetic Mining in Context: Few-Shot Action Synthesis via Text-to-Motion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: The acquisition cost for large, annotated motion datasets remains a critical bottleneck for skeletal-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR). Although Text-to-Motion (T2M) generative models offer a compelling, scalable source of synthetic data, their training objectives, which emphasize general artistic motion, and dataset structures fundamentally differ from HAR's requirements for kinematically precise, class-discriminative actions. This disparity creates a significant domain gap, making generalist T2M models ill-equipped for generating motions suitable for HAR classifiers. To address this challenge, we propose KineMIC (Kinetic Mining In Context), a transfer learning framework for few-shot action synthesis. KineMIC adapts a T2M diffusion model to an HAR domain by hypothesizing that semantic correspondences in the text encoding space can provide soft supervision for kinematic distillation. We operationalize this via a kinetic mining strategy that leverages CLIP text embeddings to establish correspondences between sparse HAR labels and T2M source data. This process guides fine-tuning, transforming the generalist T2M backbone into a specialized few-shot Action-to-Motion generator. We validate KineMIC using HumanML3D as the source T2M dataset and a subset of NTU RGB+D 120 as the target HAR domain, randomly selecting just 10 samples per action class. Our approach generates significantly more coherent motions, providing a robust data augmentation source that delivers a +23.1% accuracy points improvement. Animated illustrations and supplementary materials are available at https://lucazzola.github.io/kinemic-page/.
papers.comment: To appear in the proceedings of 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026). For references, please cite the official proceedings version. Paper website: https://lucazzola.github.io/kinemic-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KineMIC 框架，利用 CLIP 文本嵌入建立稀疏 HAR 标签与 T2M 源数据之间的语义对应，指导微调 T2M 扩散模型成为少样本动作生成器，在 NTU RGB+D 120 子集（每类 10 样本）上生成更连贯的运动，作为数据增强带来 +23.1% 准确率提升。
Motivation: 标注大规模动作数据集成本高昂，而现有 T2M 生成模型注重艺术运动，与 HAR 所需的运动学精确、类别判别性动作存在领域差距。
Method: 提出 KineMIC 迁移学习框架，假设文本编码空间中的语义对应可为运动学蒸馏提供软监督，通过 CLIP 文本嵌入匹配稀疏 HAR 标签与 T2M 源数据，指导 T2M 扩散模型微调为少样本 Action-to-Motion 生成器。
Result: 以 HumanML3D 为源、NTU RGB+D 120 子集为目标，每类仅 10 个样本，生成的运动更连贯，作为数据增强使分类准确率提升 23.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 KineMIC 通过运动学蒸馏和语义对应有效弥合 T2M 与 HAR 的领域差距，为少样本动作合成提供可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Context-measure: Contextualizing Metric for Camouflage
papers.abstract_en: Camouflage relies heavily on context, but current metrics used in camouflaged object segmentation ignore contextual cues. We identify two major drawbacks of these metrics: first, the Dimension Flaw - a predicted foreground map usually contains both pixel labels and probability scores, whereas ground truth provides only one-dimensional binary labels; second, the Range Flaw - these metrics struggle to capture full-range pixel dependencies. Thus, we propose Context-measure, a novel context-aware evaluation paradigm built on a probabilistic pixel correlation framework. It augments the ground truth with pixel-level contextual affinity and builds a perception cycle, achieving greater consistency with human perception. Extensive experiments using four meta-measures show that our Context-measure comprehensively outperforms all widely adopted metrics for camouflaged object segmentation. To our knowledge, this is the first metric designed for camouflaged scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/pursuitxi/Context-measure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对伪装物体分割（camouflaged object segmentation）现有评估指标的缺陷，提出一种新的上下文感知评估范式 Context-measure。该方法基于概率像素相关框架，通过增强 ground truth 的像素级上下文亲和性并构建感知循环，解决了现有指标存在的维度缺陷（Dimension Flaw）和范围缺陷（Range Flaw）。实验表明，Context-measure 在四个元度量上全面优于现有广泛采用的指标，是首个专为伪装场景设计的评估指标。
Motivation: 现有伪装物体分割评估指标缺乏上下文感知能力，存在两个主要缺陷：预测图包含多维信息而真值只有一维二进制标签（维度缺陷），以及无法捕获全范围像素依赖（范围缺陷）。
Method: 提出一个基于概率像素相关框架的上下文感知评估范式 Context-measure，通过增强真值图的像素级上下文亲和性并构建感知循环，实现与人类感知更一致的评估。
Result: 在四个元度量上，Context-measure 全面优于所有广泛采用的伪装物体分割指标。
Conclusion: Context-measure 是首个专为伪装场景设计的评估指标，弥补了现有指标忽略上下文线索的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LISA-3D: Lifting Language-Image Segmentation to 3D via Multi-View Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven 3D reconstruction requires masks that understand free-form instructions and remain stable under viewpoint changes. We present LISA-3D, a two-stage framework that adapts the instruction-following segmenter LISA with geometry-aware Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) layers while keeping the SAM-3D reconstructor frozen. During training, paired RGB-D frames and camera poses define a differentiable reprojection loss that enforces cross-view agreement without additional 3D-text annotations. At deployment, the adapted segmenter can produce an RGBA prompt for SAM-3D from one RGB image; when registered RGB-D views are available, optional logit fusion further improves the prompt. On ScanRefer and Nr3D, geometry-aware tuning improves both 2D masks and lifted 3D reconstructions while updating only 11.6M parameters. Our results separate geometry-aware training gains from optional multi-view inference gains, providing a modular route from language grounding to object-centric 3D reconstruction.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at The 9th Chinese Conference on Pattern Recognition and Computer Vision (PRCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LISA-3D，一个两阶段框架，将指令跟随分割器 LISA 与几何感知的低秩适配（LoRA）层结合，同时保持 SAM-3D 重建器冻结。通过可微分重投影损失强制多视图一致性，无需额外的 3D-文本标注。在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 上，仅更新 11.6M 参数即可提升 2D 掩码和 3D 重建质量。
Motivation: 文本驱动的 3D 重建需要能够理解自由形式指令并在视角变化下保持稳定的掩码，现有方法缺乏跨视图一致性且需要大量 3D 文本标注。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用几何感知 LoRA 微调 LISA，结合可微分重投影损失实现多视图一致性；第二阶段用微调后的 LISA 生成 RGBA 提示，输入 SAM-3D 进行 3D 重建，并可选的 logit 融合进一步改进提示。
Result: 在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 数据集上，几何感知调优仅更新 11.6M 参数，同时提升了 2D 掩码和 3D 重建质量。实验分离了几何感知训练和多视图推理的增益，展示了模块化路径。
Conclusion: 工作提供了一种从语言理解到以物体为中心的 3D 重建的模块化方法，强调几何感知训练和多视图一致性带来的收益，无需额外的 3D 文本标注。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用几何感知 LoRA 微调 LISA，结合可微分重投影损失实现多视图一致性；第二阶段用微调后的 LISA 生成 RGBA 提示，输入 SAM-3D 进行 3D 重建，并可选的 logit 融合进一步改进提示。
summary_sections.result: 在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 数据集上，几何感知调优仅更新 11.6M 参数，同时提升了 2D 掩码和 3D 重建质量。实验分离了几何感知训练和多视图推理的增益，展示了模块化路径。
summary_sections.conclusion: 工作提供了一种从语言理解到以物体为中心的 3D 重建的模块化方法，强调几何感知训练和多视图一致性带来的收益，无需额外的 3D 文本标注。

papers.title: BioPro: Towards Difference-Aware Gender Fairness for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) inherit significant social biases from their training data, notably in gender representation. Current fairness interventions often adopt a difference-unaware perspective that enforces uniform treatment across demographic groups. These approaches, however, fail to distinguish between contexts where neutrality is required and those where group-specific attributes are legitimate and must be preserved. Building upon recent advances in difference-aware fairness for text-only models, we extend this concept to the multimodal domain and formalize the problem of difference-aware gender fairness for image captioning and text-to-image generation. We advocate for selective debiasing, which aims to mitigate unwanted bias in neutral contexts while preserving valid distinctions in explicit ones. To achieve this, we propose BioPro (Bias Orthogonal Projection), an entirely training-free framework. BioPro identifies a low-dimensional gender-variation subspace through counterfactual embeddings and applies projection to selectively neutralize gender-related information. Experiments show that BioPro effectively reduces gender bias in neutral cases while maintaining gender faithfulness in explicit ones, thus providing a promising direction toward achieving selective fairness in VLMs. Beyond gender bias, we further demonstrate that BioPro can effectively generalize to continuous bias variables, such as scene brightness, highlighting its broader applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中的性别偏见问题，提出了一种名为BioPro（Bias Orthogonal Projection）的无训练框架。BioPro通过反事实嵌入识别低维性别变化子空间，并应用投影选择性中性和制性别相关信息，在保持显式上下文中性别属性准确性的同时，减少中性语境下的性别偏见。实验表明该方法在图像描述和文本到图像生成任务上有效，并能推广到连续偏见变量（如场景亮度）。
Motivation: 现有公平性干预方法通常采用差异无感知（difference-unaware）视角，强制对人口统计群体进行统一处理，未能区分需要中性的语境和需要保留群体特定属性的语境。
Method: 提出BioPro（Bias Orthogonal Projection）框架，通过反事实嵌入构建低维性别变化子空间，并利用投影操作选择性地中性和制性别相关信息，无需模型训练。
Result: 实验显示BioPro在减少中性语境下的性别偏见的同时，保持了显式语境中的性别忠实性，并且该方法能有效推广到连续偏见变量（如场景亮度）。
Conclusion: BioPro为实现VLM中的选择性公平性提供了有前景的方向，且具有扩展到其他连续偏见变量的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Balancing Centralized Learning and Distributed Self-Organization: A Hybrid Model for Embodied Morphogenesis
papers.abstract_en: Background: both embodied intelligence and developmental morphogenesis depend on a division of labour between centralized guidance and distributed material dynamics, but the amount of top-down control needed to steer self-organization remains unclear. Methods: we coupled a compact full-resolution convolutional controller to a differentiable Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion (RD) substrate. The controller observes two fields, U and V, and applies smooth gain-scheduled modulations of the feed and kill parameters (Delta F and Delta K). We compared pure RD, neural network (NN)-dominant and hybrid regimes and evaluated spectral selectivity, convergence and control cost. Results: the hybrid regime achieved 100% strict convergence at approximately 165 steps, whereas pure RD and the NN-dominant baseline did not converge within the same horizon. It matched the substrate's spectral selectivity while using approximately 15 times less L1 effort and over 200 times less L2 power than the NN-dominant controller. Moderate amplitudes (A approximately 0.03-0.045) formed a Goldilocks zone with 100% quasi-convergence in 94-96 steps. Conclusions: effective control is best framed as seed then cede: brief, smooth parameter-level nudges place the system in a favourable basin of attraction, after which reaction-diffusion dynamics complete and stabilize the pattern. This provides a quantitative model of morphological computation for controlled self-organization.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对体形态发生中集中式学习与分布式自组织的分工问题，提出一种混合模型：将紧凑的全分辨率卷积控制器与可微Gray-Scott反应-扩散基底耦合。控制器通过增益调制的参数扰动（ΔF和ΔK）引导系统，实验对比了纯RD、神经网络主导和混合三种模式。结果显示混合模式约165步实现100%严格收敛，匹配基底频谱选择性，且控制代价（L1约1/15，L2约1/200）远低于神经网络主导模式。作者将有效控制概括为“先播种后放弃”（seed then cede）。
Motivation: 体形态发生依赖集中式指导与分布式材料动力学之间的分工，但自上而下控制所需程度尚不明确，现有方法在平衡引导与自组织方面缺乏定量模型。
Method: 将全分辨率卷积神经网络控制器与可微Gray-Scott反应-扩散基底耦合，控制器观测U和V场的空间分布，对feed和kill参数施加平滑增益调制的扰动（ΔF和ΔK）。
Result: 混合模式约165步达到100%严格收敛，而纯RD和NN主导基线在相同步数内未收敛；混合模式匹配基底的频谱选择性，但L1控制代价约为NN主导模式的1/15，L2功率约为1/200；中等振幅（约0.03-0.045）形成黄金区间，94-96步实现100%准收敛。
Conclusion: 有效控制的最佳方式是“先播种后放弃”：短暂、平滑的参数级扰动将系统推入有利吸引子，随后反应-扩散动力学完成并稳定模式，该框架为受控自组织的形态计算提供定量模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Breaking the Stealth-Potency Trade-off in Clean-Image Backdoors with Generative Trigger Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Clean-image backdoor attacks, which use only label manipulation in training datasets to compromise deep neural networks, pose a significant threat to security-critical applications. A critical flaw in existing methods is that the poison rate required for a successful attack induces a proportional, and thus noticeable, drop in Clean Accuracy (CA), undermining their stealthiness. This paper presents a new paradigm for clean-image attacks that minimizes this accuracy degradation by optimizing the trigger itself. We introduce Generative Clean-Image Backdoors (GCB), a framework that uses a conditional InfoGAN to identify naturally occurring image features that can serve as potent and stealthy triggers. By ensuring these triggers are easily separable from benign task-related features, GCB enables a victim model to learn the backdoor from an extremely small set of poisoned examples, resulting in a CA drop of less than 1%. Our experiments demonstrate GCB's remarkable versatility, successfully adapting to six datasets, five architectures, and four tasks, including the first demonstration of clean-image backdoors in regression and segmentation. GCB also exhibits resilience against most of the existing backdoor defenses.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 22 figures, 15 tables. To appear in AAAI '26 (Oral). This paper extends the AAAI-2026 version by including the Appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式干净图像后门（GCB）框架，通过条件InfoGAN优化触发器本身，在保持后门攻击有效性的同时将干净准确率下降控制在1%以内，突破了干净图像后门攻击中隐蔽性与有效性之间的权衡。实验表明GCB在六个数据集、五种架构和四个任务（包括回归和分割）上均有效，且能抵御多数现有后门防御。
Motivation: 现有干净图像后门攻击需要较高的投毒率，导致干净准确率显著下降，从而暴露攻击行为。
Method: 提出GCB框架，使用条件InfoGAN从训练数据中自动发现可作为触发器的自然图像特征，确保这些特征与良性任务特征易于分离，从而仅需极少投毒样本即可植入后门。
Result: GCB在多个数据集和任务上将干净准确率下降控制在1%以内，并首次展示了在回归和分割任务上的干净图像后门攻击。
Conclusion: GCB通过优化触发器本身，有效解决了干净图像后门攻击中隐蔽性与有效性的权衡问题，但可能对某些防御机制（如基于特征分布的检测）仍存在局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measure what Matters: Psychometric Evaluation of AI with Situational Judgment Tests
papers.abstract_en: Persona conditioning is widely used to steer large language model (LLM) behavior, but it is unclear whether it induces stable behavioral structure or superficial variation. We propose a framework to measure consistent behavioral tendencies using situational judgment tests (SJTs), multidimensional item response theory (MIRT), and structured synthetic personas, treating responses as observations of latent behavioral variables. Across large-scale SJT and persona datasets, we find that persona-conditioned behaviors are stable across runs, latent trait scores predict external benchmarks (e.g., TruthfulQA, EmoBench), and MIRT reveals consistent latent structure. We validate these results through human annotation, benchmark evaluation, and internal consistency analyses. We interpret these traits not as human personality, but as stable behavioral tendencies expressed across contexts. Our results show that scenario-based psychometric evaluation provides a more reliable alternative to classical self-report approaches for assessing LLM behavior, and we release datasets to support further study.
papers.comment: 100 pages. Code, and link to datasets here: https://github.com/amir-abdullah-thoughtworks/psychometrics_for_LLMs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用情景判断测试（SJT）、多维项目反应理论（MIRT）和结构化合成人格来分析大语言模型（LLM）的行为一致性。摘要表明，人格条件化行为在不同运行中稳定，潜在特质分数能预测外部基准，MIRT揭示一致潜在结构。作者认为基于场景的心理测量评估比经典自我报告方法更可靠。
Motivation: 现有的人格条件化技术虽广泛用于引导LLM行为，但不确定其是否产生稳定行为结构或仅是表面变化。需要更可靠的测量方法。
Method: 使用情景判断测试（SJT）、多维项目反应理论（MIRT）和结构化合成人格，将LLM响应视为潜在行为变量的观测，通过大规模SJT和人格数据集分析。
Result: 人格条件化行为在不同运行中稳定；潜在特质分数可预测TruthfulQA、EmoBench等外部基准；MIRT揭示一致潜在结构；通过人工标注和内部一致性分析验证。
Conclusion: 基于场景的心理测量评估是评估LLM行为的更可靠替代方案，数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARC-Encoder: learning compressed text representations for large language models
papers.abstract_en: Recent techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation or chain-of-thought reasoning have led to longer contexts and increased inference costs. Context compression techniques can reduce these costs, but the most effective approaches require fine-tuning the target model or even modifying its architecture. This can degrade its general abilities when not used for this specific purpose. Here we explore an alternative approach: an encoder that compresses the context into continuous representations which replace token embeddings in decoder LLMs. First, we perform a systematic study of training strategies and architecture choices for the encoder. Our findings led to the design of an Adaptable text Representations Compressor, named ARC-Encoder, which outputs $x$-times fewer continuous representations (typically $x\!\in\!\{4,8\}$) than text tokens. We evaluate ARC-Encoder across a variety of LLM usage scenarios, ranging from in-context learning to context window extension, on both instruct and base decoders. Results show that ARC-Encoder achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks while improving computational efficiency at inference. Finally, we demonstrate that our models can be adapted to multiple decoders simultaneously, allowing a single encoder to generalize across different decoder LLMs. This makes ARC-Encoder a flexible and efficient solution for portable encoders that work seamlessly with multiple LLMs. We release a training code at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/ARC-Encoder , fine-tuning dataset and pretrained models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/kyutai/arc-encoders-68ee18787301407d60a57047 .
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research 2026 (https://openreview.net/forum?id=lU1P9dsqfn)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARC-Encoder，一种可适应文本表示压缩器，将上下文压缩为连续表示替换token嵌入，无需微调目标模型。系统研究了训练策略和架构，实现4-8倍压缩，在多场景下达到SOTA并提高推理效率，且可同时适配多个解码器。
Motivation: 长上下文导致推理成本增加，现有压缩方法需微调模型或修改架构，可能损害通用能力。本文探索一种替代方案：用编码器压缩上下文为连续表示，直接替换token嵌入。
Method: 系统研究训练策略和架构选择，设计ARC-Encoder，输出比文本token少x倍（x∈{4,8}）的连续表示，用于替换解码器LLM中的token嵌入。
Result: 在上下文学习、上下文窗口扩展等多种LLM使用场景中，ARC-Encoder在多个基准上达到SOTA，同时提高推理计算效率，且单个编码器可同时适配多个解码器。
Conclusion: ARC-Encoder提供了一种灵活高效的便携式编码器解决方案，可与多个LLM无缝协作，无需微调目标模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On-Device Inference versus Wireless Streaming: Energy-Efficient Multi-Modal Deep Learning for Wearable Cardiovascular Patches
papers.abstract_en: Wearable cardiovascular sensor patches promise continuous, unobtrusive monitoring, but their tight energy, memory, and compute budgets make it unclear whether physiological signals should be analyzed on the device or streamed to the cloud for processing. We study this inference-versus-transmission trade-off for a resource-constrained patch that records synchronized electrocardiogram (ECG) and phonocardiogram (PCG) signals. We propose an end-to-end, multi-modal convolutional neural network (CNN) with early fusion that classifies the two modalities directly on the device, without hand-crafted features. Trained and validated on the PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2016 dataset, the floating-point model attains an accuracy of 0.975, which is competitive with the best reported results. At the same time, it reduces the parameter count and computational cost by approximately three orders of magnitude. We deploy an 8-bit integer version of the model on a microcontroller with an integrated neural processing unit (NPU) and measure its inference energy. We also benchmark the energy required for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication on a representative evaluation kit across a range of payload sizes. NPU inference consumes approximately one-seventh of the energy required for CPU inference. For realistic per-second payloads, local inference is also several times more energy efficient than continuous raw-data streaming. These results show that on-device intelligence, rather than constant transmission, is the more energy-efficient basis for always-on wearable cardiovascular monitoring at the edge.

papers.title: On the Rademacher Complexity of Graph Neural Networks: Unifying Expressivity and Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the interplay between generalization, expressivity, and the geometry of the input space is a central challenge in graph learning. The expressivity of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) is typically characterized through their correspondence with graph invariants, such as those from the Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) hierarchy. While more expressive GNNs can distinguish a richer set of graphs, they are also associated with weaker generalization guarantees. Previous works have addressed this trade-off using the VC dimension, a purely combinatorial measure, independent of the training data. In this work, we adopt a data-dependent measure of generalization, the empirical Rademacher complexity, and derive tight generalization bounds that jointly consider the expressive power of GNNs and the geometry of the underlying input space. Specifically, any graph invariant that upper-bounds a GNN's expressive power partitions the input space into equivalence classes, and we show that the empirical Rademacher complexity is controlled by the distribution of training samples across these classes. Moving beyond discrete partitions, we incorporate the geometry of the input space and derive covering-number bounds under Lipschitz continuity, showing that the complexity cost can be mitigated when the hypothesis class remains smooth over the data geometry. In addition, we prove that the empirical Rademacher complexity is Lipschitz continuous with respect to the Wasserstein distance between empirical measures supported on different datasets. This yields robustness and generalization guarantees under sampling variability. Importantly, our framework is not restricted to message-passing GNNs or WL, but extends to arbitrary GNN architectures and their associated invariants, providing a step toward a unified theory of GNN generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数据相关的经验Rademacher复杂度出发，推导了图神经网络（GNN）的泛化界，统一考虑了表达能力和输入空间的几何性质。通过将输入空间按图不变量划分为等价类，证明复杂度由训练样本在各类上的分布控制；进一步利用Lipschitz连续性导出覆盖数界，并证明复杂度关于Wasserstein距离的连续性，从而在采样变异性下提供鲁棒性保证。该框架不限于消息传递GNN或Weisfeiler-Leman层次，可推广至任意GNN架构。
Motivation: 现有工作用VC维（组合度量）刻画GNN表达性与泛化的权衡，但VC维与数据无关。本文希望采用数据依赖的Rademacher复杂度，从而同时考虑表达能力与输入空间几何对泛化的影响。
Method: 定义GNN的假设类，并利用图不变量对输入空间划分等价类，导出经验Rademacher复杂度的上界；引入Lipschitz连续性得到覆盖数界；证明复杂度关于Wasserstein距离的Lipschitz性，用于分析采样变异性下的泛化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但提出理论框架：Rademacher复杂度由训练样本在等价类上的分布控制，且复杂度代价可被假设类在数据几何上的光滑性缓解。
Conclusion: 该框架为GNN的泛化理论提供了统一视角，可扩展至任意GNN架构和其对应的图不变量，但未给出实验验证。

papers.title: VideoNorms: Benchmarking Cultural Awareness of Video Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) are deployed globally, it is important to assess their ability to reason across cultural contexts. To advance cultural norm awareness evaluation in VideoLLMs, we introduce VideoNorms, a dataset of cultural norm annotations from popular US and Chinese TV shows annotated with adherence or violation labels and (non-)verbal evidence. Through a human-AI collaboration framework, each item was first annotated by a large VideoLLM, and then reviewed by at least three trained monocultural annotators with significant lived experience in the target culture, resulting in a dataset of over 3,000 human judgments. Human verification showed disparity in US and Chinese norm extraction performance, cautioning against fully automatic approaches cultures under-represented in training data. Hierarchical linear modeling analysis of $7$ open-weight VideoLLMs' performance revealed that: 1) models perform worse in Chinese compared to US, particularly for norm adherence prediction; 2) models have more difficulty in providing non-verbal evidence compared to verbal evidence for norm adherence/violation predictions. Ablation studies confirm video modality is indeed necessary for accurate performance, and scaling model size does not yield classification score improvements. Our findings and data contribute to culturally grounded video model training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VideoNorms数据集，用于评估视频大语言模型在不同文化背景下的规范推理能力。该数据集包含来自中美电视剧的文化规范标注，通过人机协作框架由大模型初步标注后经多位文化背景人工审核。实验表明，模型在中国文化规范预测上表现较差，且提供非语言证据比语言证据更困难；视频模态对准确预测必不可少，而模型规模扩大并未提升分类性能。
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型在全球部署时缺乏文化感知评估，尤其是对非美国文化（如中国）的规范理解不足，需要基准数据集和评测方法。
Method: 构建VideoNorms数据集，采用人机协作：先由大VideoLLM标注规范遵守/违反及（非）语言证据，再由至少三位有该文化生活经验的人工审核，最终获得3000余条人工判断。使用层次线性模型分析7个开源VideoLLMs的性能。
Result: 模型在中国文化情境下表现较差，尤其规范遵守预测；非语言证据预测比语言证据更困难；消融实验显示视频模态必要，模型规模增大不提升分类分数。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了视频大模型的文化偏见，强调在非代表性文化中不能依赖全自动方法，数据集和发现有助于文化敏感的模型训练与评估。

papers.title: GBPP: Grasp-Aware Base Placement Prediction for Robots via Two-Stage Learning
papers.abstract_en: GBPP is a fast learning based scorer that selects a robot base pose for grasping from a single RGB-D snapshot. The method uses a two stage curriculum: (1) a simple distance-visibility rule auto-labels a large dataset at low cost; and (2) a smaller set of high fidelity simulation trials refines the model to match true grasp outcomes. A PointNet++ style point cloud encoder with an MLP scores dense grids of candidate poses, enabling rapid online selection without full task-and-motion optimization. In simulation and on a real mobile manipulator, GBPP outperforms proximity and geometry only baselines, choosing safer and more reachable stances and degrading gracefully when wrong. The results offer a practical recipe for data efficient, geometry aware base placement: use inexpensive heuristics for coverage, then calibrate with targeted simulation.
papers.comment: Jizhuo Chen, Diwen Liu are equal contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GBPP是一种基于学习的快速评分器，用于从单个RGB-D快照中为机器人选择抓取基座姿态。该方法采用两阶段课程学习：先通过简单的距离-可见性规则自动标注大规模低成本数据集，再使用少量高保真仿真试验校准模型以匹配真实抓取结果。使用PointNet++风格的点云编码器和MLP对密集候选姿态网格评分，支持快速在线选择。在仿真和真实移动操作手上，GBPP优于基于接近度和几何的基线方法，选择更安全、更可达到的站位，并在出错时优雅退化。
Motivation: 机器人抓取中基座放置（base placement）通常依赖任务和运动规划，速度慢且难以泛化；现有几何启发式方法缺乏对抓取可行性的感知，导致站位不安全或不可达。
Method: 提出两阶段课程学习：第一阶段使用距离-可见性规则自动生成大量低成本标签；第二阶段利用少量高保真仿真试验调整模型。架构采用PointNet++点云编码器结合MLP，对候选基座姿态的密集网格进行评分。
Result: 在仿真和真实移动操作手实验中，GBPP在安全性和可达性上优于基于接近度和几何的基线方法，且错误时性能衰减平滑。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种数据高效、几何感知的基座放置实用方案：先用廉价启发式覆盖，再用目标仿真校准。

papers.title: HealthSLM-Bench: Benchmarking Small Language Models for Mobile and Wearable Healthcare Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Mobile and wearable healthcare monitoring play a vital role in facilitating timely interventions, managing chronic health conditions, and ultimately improving individuals' quality of life. Previous studies on large language models (LLMs) have highlighted their impressive generalization abilities and effectiveness in healthcare prediction tasks. However, most LLM-based healthcare solutions are cloud-based, which raises significant privacy concerns and results in increased memory usage and latency. To address these challenges, there is growing interest in compact models, Small Language Models (SLMs), which are lightweight and designed to run locally and efficiently on mobile and wearable devices. Nevertheless, how well these models perform in healthcare prediction remains largely unexplored. We systematically evaluated SLMs on health prediction tasks using zero-shot, few-shot, and instruction fine-tuning approaches, and deployed the best performing fine-tuned SLMs on mobile devices to evaluate their real-world efficiency and predictive performance in practical healthcare scenarios. Our results show that SLMs can achieve performance comparable to LLMs while offering substantial gains in efficiency and privacy. However, challenges remain, particularly in handling class imbalance and few-shot scenarios. These findings highlight SLMs, though imperfect in their current form, as a promising solution for next-generation, privacy-preserving healthcare monitoring.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 tables, 6 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on GenAI4Health
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HealthSLM-Bench，系统评估小语言模型（SLMs）在移动和可穿戴医疗健康监测任务上的性能。通过零样本、少样本和指令微调方法，在真实医疗数据上对比SLMs与LLMs，并将最佳模型部署到移动设备测试实际效率。结果表明SLMs能达到与LLMs相当的预测性能，同时在隐私和效率上具有显著优势，但仍面临类别不平衡和少样本挑战。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的医疗健康解决方案多依赖云端，存在隐私泄露和高延迟问题；而轻量级SLM虽适合本地部署，但在医疗预测任务上的系统评估尚属空白。
Method: 采用零样本、少样本和指令微调三种方式系统评估多个开源SLM在医疗健康预测任务上的表现，并将最优微调模型部署到真实移动设备上进行端侧性能对比。
Result: SLM在多项医疗预测任务上取得与LLM相当的准确率，同时推理速度提升、内存占用减少，且数据无需上传云端；但在少数类别样本不足和少样本设置下性能下降明显。
Conclusion: SLM作为隐私保护的本地化健康监测方案具有潜力，但当前在类别不均衡和少样本泛化方面仍需改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Advantage of Fine-Grained Training
papers.abstract_en: In classification problems, models are trained to predict a class label based on the input data features. However, class labels are organized hierarchically in many datasets. While a classification task is often defined at a specific level of this hierarchy, training can utilize a finer granularity of labels. Empirical evidence suggests that such fine-grained training can enhance performance. In this work, we investigate the generality of this observation and explore its underlying causes using both real and synthetic datasets. We show that training on fine-grained labels does not universally improve classification accuracy. Instead, the effectiveness of this strategy depends on the geometric structure of the data and its relations with the label hierarchy. Specifically, we show that the advantage of fine-grained training crucially depends on the degree of alignment between the decision boundaries required for the fine- and coarse-grained tasks, a property that we term boundary redundancy. Additionally, factors such as dataset size and model capacity significantly influence whether fine-grained labels provide a performance benefit. Indeed, we identify a transition, whose location is largely controlled by the degree of overparameterization, separating regimes where fine-grained training improves performance from those where direct coarse-grained training is preferable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在分类问题中使用细粒度标签训练是否能提升性能。作者利用真实和合成数据集证明，细粒度训练并非普遍有益，其效果取决于数据几何结构和标签层次之间的对齐程度，即边界冗余（boundary redundancy）。此外，数据集大小和模型容量也影响性能，存在一个由过参数化程度控制的转变点，区分细粒度训练更好还是直接粗粒度训练更好。
Motivation: 许多数据集具有层次化标签结构，通常仅定义某一层级的分类任务，但已有经验表明使用更细粒度标签训练可能提升性能。本文旨在探究这一现象的普遍性及其潜在机制。
Method: 作者使用真实和合成数据集进行实验，分析细粒度标签训练效果与数据几何结构、标签层次关系（边界冗余）以及数据集大小、模型容量等因素的关系。
Result: 细粒度训练并非普遍优于粗粒度训练，其优势高度依赖于边界冗余——即细粒度和粗粒度任务所需决策边界的对齐程度。同时，存在一个由过参数化程度控制的转变，决定哪种训练更优。
Conclusion: 细粒度训练的优势有条件限制，主要取决于边界冗余和模型过参数化程度。这提醒研究者不能盲目采用细粒度标签，需根据数据特性进行选择。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap in Ophthalmic AI: MM-Retinal-Reason Dataset and OphthaReason Model toward Dynamic Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable reasoning abilities with reinforcement learning paradigm. Although several multimodal reasoning models have been explored in the medical domain, most of them focus exclusively on basic reasoning, which refers to shallow inference based on visual feature matching. However, real-world clinical diagnosis extends beyond basic reasoning, demanding reasoning processes that integrate heterogeneous clinical information (such as chief complaints and medical history) with multimodal medical imaging data. To bridge this gap, we introduce MM-Retinal-Reason, the first ophthalmic multimodal dataset with the full spectrum of perception and reasoning. It encompasses both basic reasoning tasks and complex reasoning tasks, aiming to enhance visual-centric fundamental reasoning capabilities and emulate realistic clinical thinking patterns. Building upon MM-Retinal-Reason, we propose OphthaReason, the first ophthalmology-specific multimodal reasoning model with step-by-step reasoning traces. To enable flexible adaptation to both basic and complex reasoning tasks, we specifically design a novel method called Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Thinking (UADT), which estimates sample-level uncertainty via entropy and dynamically modulates the model's exploration depth using a shaped advantage mechanism. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on both basic and complex reasoning tasks, outperforming general-purpose MLLMs, medical MLLMs, RL-based medical MLLMs, and ophthalmic MLLMs by at least 24.92\%, 15.00\%, 21.20\%, and 17.66\%. Project Page: \href{https://github.com/lxirich/OphthaReason}{link}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对眼科临床诊断中需要融合异质临床信息与多模态影像数据的高级推理需求，构建了首个涵盖基础推理与复杂推理的全谱眼科多模态数据集MM-Retinal-Reason，并提出了首个眼科专用多模态推理模型OphthaReason。模型采用不确定性感知动态思考（UADT）方法，通过熵估计样本级不确定性并利用成形优势机制动态调节探索深度。实验表明，该模型在基础与复杂推理任务上均达到最先进性能，超越通用MLLM、医学MLLM及基于强化学习的医学MLLM等基线模型至少15%以上。
Motivation: 现有医学多模态大模型主要关注基于视觉特征匹配的基础推理，无法满足真实临床诊断中整合主诉、病史等多源信息与影像数据的高级推理需求，缺乏专门针对眼科的复杂推理数据集与模型。
Method: 构建MM-Retinal-Reason数据集，包含基础与复杂推理两类任务；提出OphthaReason模型，并设计不确定性感知动态思考（UADT）方法，利用熵估计样本级不确定性，通过成形优势机制动态调整模型推理深度。
Result: 在基础与复杂推理任务上，OphthaReason相比通用MLLM、医学MLLM、基于强化学习的医学MLLM及眼科MLLM，性能分别提升至少24.92%、15.00%、21.20%和17.66%。
Conclusion: 本文首次针对眼科临床推理需求构建了全谱数据集与专用模型，验证了动态深度推理在眼科多模态任务中的有效性，但仅涉及视网膜领域，未拓展至其他眼科亚专科。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FPEdit: Robust LLM Fingerprinting through Localized Parameter Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models represent significant investments in computation, data, and engineering expertise, making them extraordinarily valuable intellectual assets. Nevertheless, these AI assets remain vulnerable to unauthorized redistribution and commercial exploitation through fine-tuning or black-box deployment. Current fingerprinting approaches face a fundamental trade-off: intrinsic methods require full parameter access, while backdoor-based techniques employ statistically anomalous triggers easily detected and filtered by adversaries. To address these limitations, we introduce FPEdit, a novel framework that leverages knowledge editing to inject semantically coherent natural language fingerprints through sparse, targeted modifications to model weights. Our approach introduces Promote-Suppress Value Vector Optimization, which simultaneously enhances target token likelihood while suppressing competing tokens, ensuring robust fingerprint integration without degrading core model functionality. Extensive experiments show that FPEdit achieves 94-100% fingerprint retention under both full-parameter fine-tuning and parameter-efficient adaptation, while preserving performance on downstream benchmarks. Moreover, FPEdit remains robust under quantization, pruning, and stochastic decoding, and can embed 10 fingerprint pairs into LLaMA2-7B in under 2 minutes using less than 30 GB of GPU memory, which represents a substantial reduction in resource requirements. These advances establish FPEdit as the first fingerprinting approach to simultaneously achieve robustness against adaptation, resistance to detection, and preservation of model utility, thereby providing a minimally invasive solution for reliable provenance verification of large language models in adversarial deployment scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FPEdit，一种通过知识编辑注入自然语言指纹的方法，利用 Promote-Suppress Value Vector Optimization 在少量参数修改中同时增强目标 token 概率并抑制竞争 token，实现指纹保留且不损害模型性能。实验表明在完整微调和参数高效微调下指纹保留率达 94-100%，对量化、剪枝、随机解码具有鲁棒性，且能在 2 分钟内为 LLaMA2-7B 嵌入 10 个指纹对，GPU 内存小于 30 GB。
Motivation: 当前指纹方法面临内在方法需要全参数访问或后门方法使用统计异常触发器易被检测过滤的权衡，缺乏一种同时具备鲁棒性、抗检测性和模型效用保留的方法。
Method: 提出 FPEdit 框架，利用知识编辑通过稀疏有针对性修改模型权重注入语义连贯的自然语言指纹；具体使用 Promote-Suppress Value Vector Optimization，同时提升目标 token 似然并抑制竞争 token。
Result: 在全参数微调和参数高效微调下实现 94-100% 指纹保留，保持下游基准性能，且对量化、剪枝、随机解码鲁棒，能在 2 分钟内嵌入 10 个指纹对，GPU 内存低于 30 GB。
Conclusion: 本文首次同时实现对抗适应性、抗检测性和模型效用保留的指纹方法，为对抗部署场景中的大语言模型来源验证提供了微创解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReDiSC: A Reparameterized Masked Diffusion Model for Scalable Node Classification with Structured Predictions
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, graph neural networks (GNN) have achieved unprecedented successes in node classification tasks. Although GNNs inherently encode specific inductive biases (e.g., acting as low-pass or high-pass filters), most existing methods implicitly assume conditional independence among node labels in their optimization objectives. While this assumption is suitable for traditional classification tasks such as image recognition, it contradicts the intuitive observation that node labels in graphs remain correlated, even after conditioning on the graph structure. To make structured predictions for node labels, we propose ReDiSC, namely, Reparameterized masked Diffusion model for Structured node Classification. ReDiSC estimates the joint distribution of node labels using a reparameterized masked diffusion model, which is learned through the variational expectation-maximization (EM) framework. Our theoretical analysis shows the efficiency advantage of ReDiSC in the E-step compared to DPM-SNC, a state-of-the-art model that relies on a manifold-constrained diffusion model in continuous domain. Meanwhile, we explicitly link ReDiSC's M-step objective to popular GNN and label propagation hybrid approaches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReDiSC achieves superior or highly competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art GNN, label propagation, and diffusion-based baselines across both homophilic and heterophilic graphs of varying sizes. Notably, ReDiSC scales effectively to large-scale datasets on which previous structured diffusion methods fail due to computational constraints, highlighting its significant practical advantage in structured node classification tasks.
papers.comment: The article has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS), with the DOI: {10.1007/s11704-026-60545-6}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReDiSC，一种重参数化掩码扩散模型，用于图节点分类中的结构化预测。该方法通过变分期望最大化框架学习节点标签的联合分布，理论分析表明其在E步比现有连续域扩散模型更高效，M步目标与GNN和标签传播方法关联。实验在多种同质和异质图上取得优异性能，并能扩展到大规模数据集。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络（GNN）隐式假设节点标签条件独立，但这与图结构下标签仍存在关联的直觉相矛盾，导致无法进行结构化预测。
Method: 提出重参数化掩码扩散模型ReDiSC，通过变分期望最大化（EM）框架学习节点标签的联合分布。E步利用重参数化提高效率，M步目标与GNN和标签传播方法建立联系。
Result: 在多种同质和异质图上，ReDiSC在节点分类任务上达到优于或极具竞争力的性能，并能扩展到之前结构化扩散方法因计算限制无法处理的大规模数据集。
Conclusion: ReDiSC通过结构化预测克服了GNN中条件独立假设的局限，并在大规模图上展示了实际优势，但摘要未提及其在非结构化数据或动态图上的适用性。

papers.title: MemAgent: Reshaping Long-Context LLM with Multi-Conv RL-based Memory Agent
papers.abstract_en: Despite improvements by length extrapolation, efficient attention and memory modules, handling infinitely long documents with linear complexity without performance degradation during extrapolation remains the ultimate challenge in long-text processing. We directly optimize for long-text tasks in an end-to-end fashion and introduce a novel agent workflow, MemAgent, which reads text in segments and updates the memory using an overwrite strategy. We extend the DAPO algorithm to facilitate training via independent-context multi-conversation generation. MemAgent has demonstrated superb long-context capabilities, being able to extrapolate from an 8K context trained on 32K text to a 3.5M QA task with performance loss < 5% and achieves 95%+ in 512K RULER test.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026 as an Oral presentation. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=k5nIOvYGCL Project page: https://memagent-sialab.github.io/
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemAgent 是一种基于强化学习的记忆代理工作流，通过分段读取和覆盖策略更新记忆，旨在解决超长文本的端到端处理问题。该方法扩展了 DAPO 算法，利用独立上下文多会话生成进行训练。实验表明，MemAgent 能在 8K 上下文训练后外推至 3.5M 长度的 QA 任务，性能损失小于 5%，并在 512K RULER 测试中达到 95% 以上准确率。
Motivation: 现有长文本处理方法（如长度外推、高效注意力或记忆模块）在无限长文本上仍存在性能下降的问题，缺乏直接针对长文本任务进行端到端优化的方案。
Method: 提出 MemAgent 代理工作流，按分段读取文本，并采用覆盖策略更新记忆；同时扩展 DAPO 算法，引入独立上下文多会话生成来支持训练。
Result: 从 8K 训练上下文外推至 3.5M 长度的 QA 任务，性能损失小于 5%；在 512K RULER 测试中准确率超过 95%。
Conclusion: MemAgent 展示了强大的长上下文外推能力，为超长文本处理提供了有效的端到端解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ultra-Short rPPG Estimation via Periodicity Guidance and Signal Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Many remote Heart Rate (HR) measurement methods focus on estimating remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals from video clips lasting around 10 seconds but often overlook the need for HR estimation from ultra-short video clips. In this paper, we aim to accurately measure HR from ultra-short 2-second video clips by specifically addressing two key challenges. First, to overcome the limited number of heartbeat cycles in ultra-short video clips, we propose an effective periodicity-guided rPPG estimation method that enforces consistent periodicity between rPPG signals estimated from ultra-short clips and their much longer ground truth signals. Next, to mitigate estimation inaccuracies due to spectral leakage, we propose including a generator to reconstruct longer rPPG signals from ultra-short ones while preserving their periodic consistency to enable more accurate HR measurement. Extensive experiments on four rPPG estimation benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method not only accurately measures HR from ultra-short video clips but also outperform previous rPPG estimation techniques to achieve state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超短视频（2秒）中的远程心率（HR）测量问题，提出一种周期引导的rPPG估计方法。通过强制超短视频估计的rPPG信号与长时真实信号保持周期一致性，并利用生成器从超短信号重建更长rPPG信号以减轻频谱泄漏，在四个基准数据集上取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有rPPG方法多针对10秒左右视频，忽略了对超短视频（如2秒）的心率估计需求。超短视频中心跳周期数量有限且频谱泄漏导致估计不准确。
Method: 提出周期引导的rPPG估计方法，强制超短视频估计的rPPG与长时真实信号周期一致；同时引入生成器从超短信号重建更长rPPG信号，保持周期一致性以提升心率测量精度。
Result: 在四个rPPG基准数据集上，该方法不仅从超短视频中准确测量心率，且超越了此前rPPG技术，达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 本文证明周期一致性和信号重建策略可有效克服超短视频中心率估计的挑战，为短时远程心率测量提供可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ASCD: Attention-Steerable Contrastive Decoding for Reducing Hallucination in MLLM
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently hallucinate by over-committing to spurious visual cues. Prior remedies-Visual and Instruction Contrastive Decoding (VCD, ICD)-mitigate this issue, yet the mechanism remains opaque. We first empirically show that their improvements systematically coincide with redistributions of cross-modal attention. Building on this insight, we propose Attention-Steerable Contrastive Decoding (ASCD), which directly steers the attention scores during decoding. ASCD combines (i) positive steering, which amplifies automatically mined text-centric heads-stable within a model and robust across domains-with (ii) negative steering, which dampens on-the-fly identified critical visual tokens. The method incurs negligible runtime and memory overhead and requires no additional training. Across five MLLM backbones and three decoding schemes, ASCD reduces hallucination on POPE, CHAIR, and MMHal-Bench by up to 38.2 percent while improving accuracy on standard VQA benchmarks, including MMMU, MM-VET, ScienceQA, TextVQA, and GQA. These results position attention steering as a simple, model-agnostic, and principled route to safer, more faithful multimodal generation.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 40(12): 10306-10314, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Attention-Steerable Contrastive Decoding (ASCD)，通过直接操纵交叉注意力分数来减少多模态大语言模型的幻觉。ASCD结合正引导（放大文本中心注意力头）和负引导（抑制关键视觉token），无需额外训练，在多个模型和基准上降低幻觉高达38.2%，同时提升VQA准确率。
Motivation: 现有对比解码方法（VCD, ICD）虽缓解幻觉，但机制不透明；作者发现其改进与跨模态注意力重分布相关，因此提出直接引导注意力的方法。
Method: 提出ASCD，包含正引导（自动挖掘的文本中心注意力头，跨领域鲁棒）和负引导（动态抑制关键视觉token），无需训练，运行时开销小。
Result: 在POPE、CHAIR、MMHal-Bench上幻觉降低高达38.2%，在MMMU、MM-VET、ScienceQA、TextVQA、GQA等VQA基准上提升准确率。在五个MLLM骨干和三种解码方案上验证。
Conclusion: 注意力引导是一种简单、模型无关、有原则的路径，用于更安全、更忠实的多模态生成。

papers.title: Improving Knowledge Distillation Under Unknown Covariate Shift Through Confidence-Guided Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Large foundation models trained on extensive datasets demonstrate strong zero-shot capabilities in various domains. Knowledge distillation has become an established tool for transferring knowledge from foundation models to small student networks when data and model size are constrained. However, the efficacy of distillation is often hampered by limited training data coverage. This can result in a covariate shift between training and test data which in turn can lead the student to exploit spurious features or even shortcut learning. We address this problem by introducing a novel diffusion-based data augmentation strategy that generates images by maximizing the disagreement between the teacher and the student, effectively creating challenging samples that the student struggles with, thus mitigating the problem of covariate shift. Experiments demonstrate that, compared to state-of-the-art diffusion-based data augmentation baselines, our approach is best or second-best in sample mean accuracy and improves the worst group and mean group accuracy on CelebA-HQ, SpuCo Birds and BAR as well as the spurious score on Spurious ImageNet under covariate shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识蒸馏中训练数据覆盖不足导致的协变量偏移问题，提出基于扩散模型的数据增强策略，通过最大化教师与学生之间的分歧生成困难样本，从而缓解协变量偏移。实验表明，该方法在CelebA-HQ、SpuCo Birds、BAR和Spurious ImageNet等数据集上，在协变量偏移下改善了最差组和平均组准确率及虚假相关性分数。
Motivation: 训练数据覆盖率有限会导致训练与测试数据之间的协变量偏移，使学生网络利用虚假特征或捷径学习，影响蒸馏效果。
Method: 提出一种基于扩散模型的数据增强方法，通过最大化教师与学生之间的不一致性来生成图像，创建学生难以处理的挑战性样本，从而缓解协变量偏移问题。
Result: 与最先进的基于扩散模型的数据增强基线相比，该方法在样本平均准确率上达到最佳或次佳，并在CelebA-HQ、SpuCo Birds、BAR上提升了最差组和平均组准确率，在Spurious ImageNet上提升了虚假相关性分数。
Conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了知识蒸馏中协变量偏移导致的问题，通过生成困难样本增强了学生的泛化能力。

papers.title: OmniAD: Detect and Understand Industrial Anomaly via Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While anomaly detection has made significant progress, generating detailed analyses that incorporate industrial knowledge remains a challenge. To address this gap, we introduce OmniAD, a novel framework that unifies anomaly detection and understanding for fine-grained analysis. OmniAD is a multimodal reasoner that combines visual and textual reasoning processes. The visual reasoning provides detailed inspection by leveraging Text-as-Mask Encoding to perform anomaly detection through text generation without manually selected thresholds. Following this, Visual Guided Textual Reasoning conducts comprehensive analysis by integrating visual perception. To enhance few-shot generalization, we employ an integrated training strategy that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (GRPO), incorporating three sophisticated reward functions. Experimental results demonstrate that OmniAD achieves a performance of 79.1 on the MMAD benchmark, surpassing models such as Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GPT-4o. It also shows strong results across multiple anomaly detection benchmarks. These results highlight the importance of enhancing visual perception for effective reasoning in anomaly understanding. All codes and models will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniAD框架，统一工业异常检测与细粒度分析，通过多模态推理（视觉+文本）实现无需手动阈值的选择。视觉推理使用Text-as-Mask Encoding通过文本生成检测异常，视觉引导文本推理进行综合分析。采用SFT+GRPO联合训练和三种奖励函数。在MMAD基准上达到79.1，超过Qwen2.5-VL-7B和GPT-4o。
Motivation: 现有异常检测缺乏融入工业知识的细粒度分析。
Method: 提出OmniAD，包括Text-as-Mask Encoding的视觉推理和视觉引导文本推理，以及SFT+GRPO联合训练。
Result: MMAD基准79.1，超过Qwen2.5-VL-7B和GPT-4o。
Conclusion: 增强视觉感知对于异常理解中的有效推理很重要。

papers.title: Equivariant Eikonal Neural Networks: Grid-Free, Scalable Travel-Time Prediction on Homogeneous Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Equivariant Neural Eikonal Solvers, a novel framework that integrates Equivariant Neural Fields (ENFs) with Neural Eikonal Solvers. Our approach employs a single neural field where a unified shared backbone is conditioned on signal-specific latent variables - represented as point clouds in a Lie group - to model diverse Eikonal solutions. The ENF integration ensures equivariant mapping from these latent representations to the solution field, delivering three key benefits: enhanced representation efficiency through weight-sharing, robust geometric grounding, and solution steerability. This steerability allows transformations applied to the latent point cloud to induce predictable, geometrically meaningful modifications in the resulting Eikonal solution. By coupling these steerable representations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), our framework accurately models Eikonal travel-time solutions while generalizing to arbitrary Riemannian manifolds with regular group actions. This includes homogeneous spaces such as Euclidean, position-orientation, spherical, and hyperbolic manifolds. We validate our approach through applications in seismic travel-time modeling of 2D, 3D, and spherical benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate superior performance, scalability, adaptability, and user controllability compared to existing Neural Operator-based Eikonal solver methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出等变神经Eikonal求解器（Equivariant Neural Eikonal Solvers），通过将等变神经场（ENF）与物理信息神经网络（PINN）结合，实现无网格、可扩展的旅行时间预测。该方法使用单一共享主干网络，通过李群点云作为潜变量条件化，确保解场对潜变量变换的等变映射，从而支持任意黎曼流形（欧几里得、位置-方向、球面、双曲等齐性空间）上的Eikonal方程求解。在地震旅行时间建模的2D、3D和球面基准数据集上，该方法优于现有基于神经算子的Eikonal求解器，展现出更好的性能、可扩展性和可控性。
Motivation: 传统Eikonal求解器依赖网格离散化，可扩展性差且难以处理复杂几何。现有神经算子方法在表示效率和几何鲁棒性上存在不足，且缺乏对解场几何变换的明确控制。
Method: 将等变神经场（ENF）集成到神经Eikonal求解器中：用一个共享主干网络，以李群中的点云作为信号特定潜变量，通过等变映射生成对应Eikonal解场。潜变量变换可诱导解场的可预测几何变化（可操控性），并结合PINN损失训练，适用于任意具有规则群作用的黎曼流形。
Result: 在2D、3D和球面地震旅行时间基准上，该方法在精度和可扩展性上优于现有神经算子Eikonal求解器，并展示了用户可控的解场修改能力。
Conclusion: 该框架为齐性空间上的Eikonal方程提供了一种无网格、等变且可扩展的求解范式，其可操控性允许通过几何变换灵活调整解场。

papers.title: AI LEGO: Scaffolding Cross-Functional Collaboration in Industrial Responsible AI Practices during Early Design Stages
papers.abstract_en: Responsible AI (RAI) efforts increasingly emphasize the importance of addressing potential harms early in the AI development lifecycle through social-technical lenses. However, in cross-functional industry teams, this work is often stalled by a persistent coordination challenge: how technical roles hand off technical intent, how teams establish shared structures for collaboration, and how non-technical roles are supported in systematically evaluating harms. Through literature review and a semi-structured interview study with 8 practitioners, we unpack how this challenge manifests---technical design choices are rarely handed off in ways that support meaningful engagement by non-technical roles; collaborative workflows lack shared, visual structures to support mutual understanding; and non-technical practitioners are left without scaffolds for systematic harm evaluation. Existing tools like JIRA or Google Docs, while useful for product tracking, are ill-suited for supporting joint harm identification across roles, often requiring significant extra effort to align understanding. To address this, we developed AI LEGO, a web-based prototype that operationalizes the boundary object theory to support cross-functional AI practitioners in effectively facilitating knowledge handoff and identifying harmful design choices in the early design stages. Technical roles use interactive blocks to draft development plans, while non-technical roles engage with those blocks through stage-specific checklists and LLM-driven persona simulations to surface potential harms. In a study with 18 cross-functional practitioners, AI LEGO increased the volume and likelihood of harms identified compared to baseline worksheets. Participants found that its modular structure and persona prompts made harm identification more accessible, fostering clearer and more collaborative RAI practices in early design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过文献综述和8位从业者的半结构化访谈，揭示了工业界跨功能团队在负责任AI早期设计阶段面临的协作挑战：技术意图难以有效传递、缺乏共享的视觉结构、非技术角色缺少系统化危害评估支撑。为此，作者基于边界对象理论开发了AI LEGO原型，允许技术角色通过交互模块起草开发计划，非技术角色通过阶段化清单和LLM驱动的角色模拟识别潜在危害。18位跨功能参与者的实验表明，AI LEGO相比基线表格提高了危害识别的数量和可能性。
Motivation: 早期设计阶段的负责任AI实践常因跨功能协作障碍而停滞，现有工具（如JIRA、Google Docs）不支持角色间的联合危害识别，需要额外努力对齐理解。
Method: 基于边界对象理论，开发AI LEGO网页原型，技术角色使用交互模块（interactive blocks）起草开发计划，非技术角色通过阶段化检查清单和LLM驱动的角色模拟来识别危害。
Result: 与基线工作表相比，AI LEGO增加了危害识别的数量和可能性，参与者认为其模块化结构和角色提示使危害识别更易访问。
Conclusion: AI LEGO促进了早期设计中更清晰、更协作的负责任AI实践，但研究局限于工业场景和原型阶段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Challenges and proposed solutions in modeling multimodal medical data: A systematic review
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal data modeling has emerged as a powerful approach in clinical research, enabling the integration of diverse data types such as imaging, genomics, wearable sensors, and electronic health records. Despite its potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and support personalized care, modeling such heterogeneous data presents significant technical challenges. This systematic review synthesizes findings from 69 studies to identify common obstacles, including missing modalities, limited sample sizes, dimensionality imbalance, interpretability issues, and finding the optimal fusion techniques. We highlight recent methodological advances, such as transfer learning, generative models, attention mechanisms, and neural architecture search that offer promising solutions. By mapping current trends and innovations, this review provides a comprehensive overview of the field and offers practical insights to guide future research and development in multimodal modeling for medical applications.

Method: 对69项研究进行系统性综述，归纳共性挑战并映射近年方法论进展，如迁移学习、生成模型、注意力机制和神经架构搜索。

papers.title: Low-Precision Training of Large Language Models: Methods, Challenges, and Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance across various domains. However, the substantial hardware resources required for their training present a significant barrier to efficiency and scalability. To mitigate this challenge, low-precision training techniques have been widely adopted, leading to notable advancements in training efficiency. Despite these gains, low-precision training involves several components, such as weights, activations, and gradients, each of which can be represented in different numerical formats. The resulting diversity has created a fragmented landscape in low-precision training research, making it difficult for researchers to gain a unified overview of the field. This survey provides a comprehensive review of existing low-precision training methods. To systematically organize these approaches, we categorize them into three primary groups based on their underlying numerical formats, which is a key factor influencing hardware compatibility, computational efficiency, and ease of reference for readers. The categories are (1) fixed-point and integer-based methods, (2) floating-point-based methods, and (3) customized format-based methods. Additionally, we discuss quantization-aware training approaches, which share key similarities with low-precision training during forward propagation. Beyond efficiency, we examine robustness and deployment reliability under low precision. Finally, we highlight several promising research directions to advance this field. A collection of papers discussed in this survey is provided in https://github.com/Hao840/Awesome-Low-Precision-Training.

papers.title: When Should AI Follow? Task Structure and Joint Adaptation by Human and AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: How should organizations divide and sequence decision tasks between human and artificial agents? We develop a computational model of joint sequential adaptation in which two agents differ in a single, precisely specified way: the memory regime governing how past decisions shape subsequent ones. A recency-weighted regime, motivated by behavioral evidence on human adaptation, privileges recent outcomes; a uniform-memory regime, motivated by the scale-free consistency of algorithmic updating, weights a window of past outcomes equally. Situated in the lineage of NK/NKC models but developed on its own terms as a sequential-adaptation model, the framework varies task scope (N), within-task coupling (K), and cross-agent coupling (C) across modular and sequenced task structures. Three mechanisms organize the results. First, threshold dynamics create absorbing high- and low-payoff regimes, so adaptation compounds whatever it inherits. Second, uniform memory amplifies inherited trajectories, for good and for ill, whereas recency weighting corrects locally but is volatile at scale. Third, memoryless stochastic adaptation, though inferior on average, functions as an escape mechanism when inherited trajectories are poor. Consequently, joint performance is maximized not by the prevalent "AI-first" design, but when scale-free adaptation follows a high-performing human; broad stochastic search instead rescues sequences initiated by low-performing humans. The model and its experimental validation (a separate study) offer organization designers a task-structural contingency logic for human-AI collaboration and caution against universal prescriptions for AI-first deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人类与AI智能体在决策任务中的联合序列适应问题，提出一个计算模型，区分两种记忆机制（近期权重记忆与均匀记忆）。模型揭示了阈值动力学、记忆放大效应和随机逃离机制，并发现联合绩效最优时并非AI优先，而是当规模无关的AI跟随高绩效人类时最佳。实验验证支持这一观点。
Motivation: 现有组织设计中普遍推崇“AI优先”的部署方式，但缺乏理论依据。论文旨在理解任务结构和智能体记忆特性如何影响人机协作的序列适应绩效。
Method: 构建一个基于NK/NKC模型的序列适应框架，两个智能体仅记忆机制不同（近期权重 vs 均匀记忆），通过改变任务范围(N)、任务内耦合(K)和跨智能体耦合(C)来模拟模块化与序列化任务结构。
Result: 发现联合绩效最大化并非AI优先，而是当均匀记忆的AI跟随高绩效人类时；若人类绩效低，随机搜索能挽救序列。均匀记忆放大继承轨迹，近期权重局部纠正但全局波动。
Conclusion: 人机协作的序列化决策应依据任务结构和人类绩效灵活设计，而非采用统一的AI优先策略。

papers.title: AI Alignment in Medical Imaging: Unveiling Hidden Biases Through Counterfactual Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) systems for medical imaging have demonstrated remarkable diagnostic capabilities, but their susceptibility to biases poses significant risks, since biases may negatively impact generalization performance. In this paper, we introduce a novel statistical framework to evaluate the dependency of medical imaging ML models on sensitive attributes, such as demographics. Our method leverages the concept of counterfactual invariance, measuring the extent to which a model's predictions remain unchanged under hypothetical changes to sensitive attributes. We present a practical algorithm that combines conditional latent diffusion models with statistical hypothesis testing to identify and quantify such biases without requiring direct access to counterfactual data. Through experiments on synthetic datasets and large-scale real-world medical imaging datasets, including \textsc{cheXpert} and MIMIC-CXR, we demonstrate that our approach aligns closely with counterfactual fairness principles and outperforms standard baselines. This work provides a robust tool to ensure that ML diagnostic systems generalize well, e.g., across demographic groups, offering a critical step towards AI safety in healthcare. Code: https://github.com/Neferpitou3871/AI-Alignment-Medical-Imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学影像机器学习系统对敏感属性（如人口统计学特征）的依赖偏差问题，提出一种基于反事实不变性（counterfactual invariance）的统计框架。该方法结合条件潜扩散模型（conditional latent diffusion models）与统计假设检验，无需反事实数据即可量化预测对敏感属性变化的不敏感性。在合成数据集及真实医学影像数据集（cheXpert、MIMIC-CXR）上的实验表明，该方法与反事实公平原则高度一致，且优于标准基线。
Motivation: 医学影像ML系统虽诊断能力强，但易受数据中与敏感属性相关的偏差影响，导致泛化性能下降。现有偏差检测方法往往需要反事实数据或对数据分布有强假设。
Method: 提出一个融合条件潜扩散模型和统计假设检验的算法，通过测量模型预测在反事实扰动下的变化程度来评估对敏感属性的依赖，无需显式生成反事实样本。
Result: 在cheXpert和MIMIC-CXR等数据集上，该方法与反事实公平性指标吻合，并显著优于标准偏差检测基线。
Conclusion: 该工作为医疗AI系统提供了跨人口统计组的鲁棒性验证工具，有助于提升AI在医疗中的安全性与公平性。

papers.title: Decision-oriented joint optimization of evidence fusion based on event-conditioned credibility
papers.abstract_en: In decision-level fusion tasks involving heterogeneous sources with unequal precision and potential anomalies, evidence deviating from the majority may be either critical evidence supporting the correct decision or anomalous evidence supporting an incorrect event. Existing credible evidence fusion methods primarily assess credibility through inter-evidence comparisons and may consequently underestimate critical evidence. This paper proposes event-conditioned credibility to characterize the relative credibility of evidence under different candidate-event hypotheses. A decision-oriented joint optimization model then couples credibility calculation, evidence fusion, and event decision through candidate-event probabilities. The model is expressed as a continuous self-mapping on the probability simplex. A direct fixed-point iteration provides the default fast solver, while a Kuhn simplicial search supplies a mesh-dependent approximate fixed point if the direct iteration forms a periodic orbit. A plausibility--belief arithmetic--geometric divergence is further proposed to calculate event-conditioned credibility. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method gives credibility rankings that better reflect the contribution of evidence to the ground truth and provides greater support for the correct event than representative credible evidence fusion methods. Monte Carlo tests additionally demonstrate a high empirical fixed-point attainment rate over the tested settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异构源决策级融合任务中，偏离多数的证据可能为关键证据或异常证据的问题，提出事件条件可信度（event-conditioned credibility）来表征不同候选事件假设下证据的相对可信度，并建立决策导向的联合优化模型，将可信度计算、证据融合和事件决策通过候选事件概率耦合。模型表示为概率单纯形上的连续自映射，采用直接不动点迭代作为默认快速求解器，若形成周期轨道则使用Kuhn单纯形搜索提供网格依赖的近似不动点。进一步提出似然-信念算术-几何散度（plausibility–belief arithmetic–geometric divergence）来计算事件条件可信度。数值实验表明，该方法给出的可信度排名能更好反映证据对真实事件的贡献，且比代表性可信证据融合方法更支持正确事件。
Motivation: 现有可信证据融合方法主要通过证据间比较评估可信度，可能低估偏离多数的关键证据，导致融合决策偏差。
Method: 提出事件条件可信度概念，构建决策导向联合优化模型，将可信度计算、证据融合与决策用候选事件概率耦合为概率单纯形上的连续自映射；采用直接不动点迭代或Kuhn单纯形搜索求解；引入似然-信念算术-几何散度计算可信度。
Result: 数值实验表明该方法给出的可信度排名更好反映证据对真实事件的贡献，对正确事件的支持大于代表性可信证据融合方法；蒙特卡洛测试显示在所设设置下具有高的经验不动点到达率。
Conclusion: 该方法通过事件条件可信度避免了低估关键证据，提升了决策级融合的可靠性。

papers.title: The Reliability of LLMs for Medical Diagnosis: An Examination of Consistency, Manipulation, and Contextual Awareness
papers.abstract_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic reliability of two Large Language Models (LLMs), Google Gemini 2.0 Flash and OpenAI ChatGPT-4o, across three dimensions: consistency under rephrased inputs, susceptibility to irrelevant prompt content, and responsiveness to added clinical context. We designed 52 clinical scenarios and modified each under controlled conditions. For consistency, scenarios were rephrased with demographic, wording, and examination changes that preserved the diagnostic core. And the susceptibility was evaluated through embedding irrelevant but plausible narrative details while keeping the clinical evidence unchanged. For contextual awareness, patient history, lifestyle data, or diagnostic findings were added to shift the expected diagnosis. Physician reviewers then judged whether context-driven changes were clinically appropriate. Both models returned identical diagnoses across all equivalent variants and repeated queries (100% consistency). When irrelevant details were added, Gemini changed its diagnosis in 40.0% of cases and ChatGPT in 30.0%. ChatGPT responded to context more often than Gemini (77.8% vs. 55.6%), but a larger share of its changes were clinically inappropriate (33.3% vs. 22.2%). Gemini's context-driven changes were more often judged appropriate (66.7% vs. 55.6%). Consistency under controlled inputs did not protect either model from irrelevant manipulation or unjustified diagnostic shifts when context changed. Before LLMs can separate relevant from irrelevant input and flag insufficient evidence, their diagnostic use requires clinician oversight and structured safeguards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了Google Gemini 2.0 Flash和OpenAI ChatGPT-4o在52个临床场景中的诊断可靠性。结果表明，模型在重述输入下100%一致，但添加无关细节时分别有40%和30%的诊断变化；上下文驱动变化中，ChatGPT响应更多但临床不适当比例更高，Gemini的变化更合适。作者强调，在LLM能够区分相关与无关输入之前，临床监督是必要的。
Motivation: 现有LLM在医疗诊断中的应用缺乏系统评估其可靠性和对输入变化（如重述、无关细节、临床背景）的鲁棒性。
Method: 设计52个临床场景，分别通过重述、添加无关细节、添加临床背景进行修改，并由医生评审判断诊断变化是否临床合理。
Result: 重述下100%一致性；无关细节导致Gemini诊断改变40.0%，ChatGPT 30.0%；ChatGPT上下文响应率更高（77.8%），但临床不合适比例也更高（33.3%）；Gemini上下文驱动变化更常被判断为合适（66.7%）。
Conclusion: 一致性不能保证免受无关操纵或不合理的诊断变化；LLM在医疗诊断中使用需要临床监督和结构化保障。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文评估了Google Gemini 2.0 Flash和OpenAI ChatGPT-4o在52个临床场景中的诊断可靠性。结果表明，模型在重述输入下100%一致，但添加无关细节时分别有40%和30%的诊断变化；上下文驱动变化中，ChatGPT响应更多但临床不适当比例更高，Gemini的变化更合适。作者强调，在LLM能够区分相关与无关输入之前，临床监督是必要的。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM在医疗诊断中的应用缺乏系统评估其可靠性和对输入变化（如重述、无关细节、临床背景）的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.method: 设计52个临床场景，分别通过重述、添加无关细节、添加临床背景进行修改，并由医生评审判断诊断变化是否临床合理。
summary_sections.result: 重述下100%一致性；无关细节导致Gemini诊断改变40.0%，ChatGPT 30.0%；ChatGPT上下文响应率更高（77.8%），但临床不合适比例也更高（33.3%）；Gemini上下文驱动变化更常被判断为合适（66.7%）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 一致性不能保证免受无关操纵或不合理的诊断变化；LLM在医疗诊断中使用需要临床监督和结构化保障。

papers.title: Optimal Causal Annotations: An Application to Casenotes in Social Services
papers.abstract_en: Problem definition: Estimating causal effects of interventions is central to policy and operations, but outcome data are often missing or costly to obtain. LLMs can provide text annotation at scale but may be subject to unknown bias. When ground-truth outcomes require expensive expert labeling or follow-up, budget limits typically allow only a fraction of the data to be labeled. Motivated by collaboration with a nonprofit conducting street outreach in homelessness services, whose most interesting outcomes are in unstructured casenotes, we ask: which observations should be selected for labeling under a fixed budget? Methodology/results: Our method optimizes annotation probabilities to minimize the variance of average treatment effect estimation. We derive a closed-form solution and establish that a feasible two-batch estimator achieves the best possible asymptotic variance. On simulated and real-world datasets, our method achieves lower MSE than random sampling and 43%-91% reductions in labels and costs for the same interval widths. In a case study classifying progress towards housing applications from casenotes with LLMs, we find out-of-the-box LLMs under-recognize client progress, highlighting the importance of grounding LLM judgment. Our estimates indicate that 8.6% of clients improve 2-year housing outcomes due to more street outreach in the first six months, and increasing outreach from the first to third quartile increases maximum progress towards a housing application by an estimated half-step. Managerial implications: LLM-as-a-judge may threaten estimation validity; our method enables valid causal estimation with a limited annotation budget. Evaluating causal impacts on intermediate nonprofit outcomes can inform operations: returns to outreach appear concave, so expanding the extensive margin of who receives outreach may be resource-efficient.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对社会服务案例记录中因果效应估计的标注预算有限问题，提出一种优化标注概率的方法，以最小化平均处理效应估计的方差。通过闭式解和两批估计器实现最优渐近方差，在模拟和真实数据上相比随机采样降低43%-91%的标注成本。案例研究显示，未经微调的LLM在从案例记录中识别客户进展时存在低估偏差，并估计增加街头外展服务可提升8.6%的客户住房结果。
Motivation: 结果数据常缺失或昂贵获取，LLM标注虽可规模化但存在未知偏差。在非营利组织街头外展服务合作中，预算限制仅允许标注部分数据，需选择哪些观测值进行标记以有效估计因果效应。
Method: 提出优化标注概率的方法，最小化平均处理效应估计的方差。推导出闭式解，并证明两批估计器可实现最优渐近方差。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，该方法比随机抽样实现更低的均方误差，相同区间宽度下标签和成本减少43%-91%。案例研究中，未微调LLM低估客户进展，估计前六个月增加街头外展使8.6%的客户改善两年住房结果，外展从第一四分位数增至第三四分位数使住房申请最大进展提升约半个步长。
Conclusion: LLM作为评判者可能威胁估计有效性，该方法可在有限标注预算下实现有效的因果估计。评估非营利组织中间结果的因果影响可指导运营：外展回报呈凹性，扩展外展的广泛边际可能资源高效。

papers.title: Neural Radiance Fields for the Real World: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have remodeled 3D scene representation since release. NeRFs can effectively reconstruct complex 3D scenes from 2D images, advancing different fields and applications such as scene understanding, 3D content generation, and robotics. Despite significant research progress, a thorough review of recent innovations, applications, and challenges is lacking. This survey compiles key theoretical advancements and alternative scene representations and investigates emerging challenges. It further explores applications on reconstruction, highlights NeRFs' impact on computer vision and robotics, and reviews essential datasets and toolkits. By identifying gaps in the literature, this survey discusses open challenges and offers directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于神经辐射场（NeRF）在现实世界应用的综述，涵盖了理论进展、替代场景表示、新兴挑战以及计算机视觉和机器人领域的应用，并讨论了开放问题和未来研究方向。
Motivation: 尽管NeRF自提出以来已取得显著进展，但缺乏对近期创新、应用和挑战的全面综述。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过系统梳理关键理论进展、替代场景表示、应用场景（如重建、计算机视觉、机器人）以及常用数据集和工具包，对NeRF领域进行综合调查。
Result: 总结了NeRF在多个领域的应用现状，指出了当前文献中的空白，并提出了未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 本文作为NeRF领域的综述，为研究者提供了全面的技术概览和未来研究建议。

papers.title: Learning Controlled Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning controlled stochastic differential equations (SDEs) \[ dX_t = b(t,X_t,u_t)\,dt + σ(t,X_t,u_t)\,dW_t, \] whose drift and diffusion depend nonlinearly on time, state, and control values. From trajectory data, we aim to estimate coefficients whose induced density flows reproduce those of the observed dynamics. The data consist of several controls sampled from a finite-dimensional family and, for each control, multiple independent trajectories observed at discrete times over a fixed horizon. The controls are observed inputs, not learner-selected decisions. We propose a kernel method for multidimensional nonlinear controlled SDEs. The method estimates the density flow for each sampled control, then fits the drift $b$ and diffusion matrix $a=σσ^\top$ by matching the estimated flows through the Fokker-Planck equation. Under Sobolev regularity assumptions, we prove finite-sample bounds on the error between the density flows of the learned and true SDEs, measured in $L^2$ over controls, time, and state. The bounds quantify how the error decreases with the number $K$ of sampled controls, with rates determined by the state and control-parametrization dimensions and Sobolev regularity. We further derive uniform-in-control guarantees and CVaR-type bounds for tail-sensitive quantities. Numerical experiments illustrate the method, and an open-source Python implementation is provided.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种核方法，从轨迹数据中学习非线性受控随机微分方程（SDE）的漂移和扩散系数，通过匹配Fokker-Planck方程估计的密度流来拟合系数，并提供了有限样本误差界。
Motivation: 现有方法难以从离散观测的轨迹中学习非线性受控SDE的系数，尤其是当控制来自有限维族且系数依赖于时间、状态和控制时。
Method: 提出核方法：先为每个采样控制估计密度流，然后通过Fokker-Planck方程匹配估计的密度流来拟合漂移b和扩散矩阵a=σσ^T。
Result: 在Sobolev正则性假设下，证明了学习SDE与真实SDE密度流之间L^2误差的有限样本界，误差随控制采样数K增加而减小，速率取决于状态和控制参数化维度及Sobolev正则性。还推导了控制一致保证和CVaR型界。数值实验验证了方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为从轨迹数据学习非线性受控SDE提供了理论保证，但仅适用于控制来自有限维族的情形。
Relevance: 10
