papers.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Networks for Robust AC-Optimal Power Flow
papers.abstract_en: We present PINCO, an unsupervised learning framework that integrates Graph Neural Networks with physics-informed neural networks for AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) solutions. Unlike state-of-the-art unsupervised methods that require prescreened datasets containing only feasible instances, our approach operates on unfiltered data, including ill-conditioned cases. The framework addresses two critical gaps in the literature: (1) robustness to topology changes up to N-2 contingencies, and (2) detecting optimal power flow instances that are infeasible without relying on traditional solvers for data filtering. PINCO embeds physical laws into the learning process via augmented Lagrangian multipliers. In addition, it introduces a clustering branch with learnable centroids that automatically separate feasible from infeasible solutions based on constraint-violation patterns. We evaluate the framework across systems of varying complexity, including the IEEE 30-bus, IEEE 57-bus, and Swiss transmission networks, demonstrating scalability and robustness under diverse loading conditions and topology variations. Benchmarking against DeepOPF-FT and the IPOPT solver shows that PINCO achieves comparable constraint satisfaction while delivering two to three orders of magnitude computational speedup compared to IPOPT and lower operational costs across all configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PINCO，一个无监督学习框架，结合图神经网络和物理信息神经网络求解交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）。该框架无需预筛选数据，能处理包括病态算例在内的未过滤数据，并自动检测不可行实例。PINCO通过增广拉格朗日乘子嵌入物理定律，并引入具有可学习质心的聚类分支以区分可行与不可行解。在IEEE 30/57节点和瑞士输电网上的测试显示，与IPOPT相比，PINCO在满足约束的同时实现2-3个数量级的计算加速，且运行成本更低。
Motivation: 现有无监督AC-OPF方法依赖预筛选的可行数据集，对拓扑变化（如N-2故障）鲁棒性差，且无法自动检测不可行实例，存在关键空白。
Method: 提出PINCO框架，采用图神经网络结合物理信息神经网络，利用增广拉格朗日乘子嵌入物理定律；并引入聚类分支通过约束违反模式自动分离可行与不可分解。
Result: 在IEEE 30/57节点和瑞士输电网的测试中，PINCO与DeepOPF-FT和IPOPT对比，在约束满足相当的情况下，计算速度比IPOPT快2-3个数量级，且运行成本更低。
Conclusion: PINCO提供了一种无需数据预筛选、对拓扑变化鲁棒、能自动检测不可行解的AC-OPF求解方案，在计算效率上具有显著优势。

papers.title: One-Frame Calibration with Siamese Network in Facial Action Unit Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automatic facial action unit (AU) recognition is used widely in facial expression analysis. Most existing AU recognition systems aim for cross-participant non-calibrated generalization (NCG) to unseen faces without further calibration. However, due to the diversity of facial attributes across different identities, accurately inferring AU activation from single images of an unseen face is sometimes infeasible, even for human experts -- it is crucial to first understand how the face appears in its neutral expression, or significant bias may be incurred. Therefore, we propose to perform one-frame calibration (OFC) in AU recognition: for each face, a single image of its neutral expression is used as the reference image for calibration. With this strategy, we develop a Calibrating Siamese Network (CSN) for AU recognition and demonstrate its remarkable effectiveness with a simple iResNet-50 (IR50) backbone. On the DISFA, DISFA+, and UNBC-McMaster datasets, we show that our OFC CSN-IR50 model (a) substantially improves the performance of IR50 by mitigating facial attribute biases (including biases due to wrinkles, eyebrow positions, facial hair, etc.), (b) substantially outperforms the naive OFC method of baseline subtraction as well as (c) a fine-tuned version of this naive OFC method, and (d) also outperforms state-of-the-art NCG models for both AU intensity estimation and AU detection. The code is available at https://github.com/ShuangquanFeng/CSN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在面部动作单元（AU）识别中采用单帧校准（OFC）策略，利用中性表情的单张图像作为参考来消除面部属性偏差。作者开发了校准孪生网络（CSN），在DISFA、DISFA+和UNBC-McMaster数据集上，使用简单iResNet-50骨干网络显著提升了AU强度估计和检测性能，超越了非校准泛化（NCG）模型。
Motivation: 现有AU识别系统通常进行跨被试的非校准泛化，但由于不同人脸的面部属性多样性，仅从单张图像准确推断AU激活有时不可行，需要先了解中性表情以消除偏差。
Method: 提出单帧校准（OFC）策略，为每张人脸使用其单张中性表情图像作为校准参考；并开发校准孪生网络（CSN），采用iResNet-50骨干网络，通过对比学习实现校准。
Result: 在DISFA、DISFA+和UNBC-McMaster数据集上，CSN-IR50模型相比基线IR50显著提升，抑制了皱纹、眉毛位置、胡须等面部属性偏差；优于朴素OFC基线减法及其微调版本，并超越现有SOTA NCG模型。
Conclusion: 单帧校准策略能有效提升AU识别准确性，且只需一张中性参考图像，简单高效。代码已开源。

papers.title: Particle-Filtering-based Latent Diffusion for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Current strategies for solving image-based inverse problems apply latent diffusion models to perform posterior sampling.However, almost all approaches make no explicit attempt to explore the solution space, instead drawing only a single sample from a Gaussian distribution from which to generate their solution. In this paper, we introduce a particle-filtering-based framework for a nonlinear exploration of the solution space in the initial stages of reverse SDE methods. Our proposed particle-filtering-based latent diffusion (PFLD) method and proposed problem formulation and framework can be applied to any diffusion-based solution for linear or nonlinear inverse problems. Our experimental results show that PFLD outperforms the SoTA solver PSLD on the FFHQ-1K and ImageNet-1K datasets on inverse problem tasks of super resolution, Gaussian debluring and inpainting.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于粒子滤波的潜在扩散模型（PFLD），用于求解图像逆问题。与现有方法仅从单高斯样本出发不同，PFLD在反向SDE初始阶段通过粒子滤波对解空间进行非线性探索，可应用于线性和非线性逆问题。实验表明，在超分辨率、高斯去模糊和图像修复任务上，PFLD在FFHQ-1K和ImageNet-1K数据集上优于现有最优求解器PSLD。
Motivation: 现有基于潜在扩散模型的逆问题求解方法大多仅从单一高斯分布采样，缺乏显式的解空间探索，可能导致解的质量受限于初始样本。
Method: 提出粒子滤波潜在扩散（PFLD）方法，在逆向SDE初始阶段引入粒子滤波框架进行非线性解空间探索，可适配任意基于扩散的线性或非线性逆问题求解器。
Result: 在FFHQ-1K和ImageNet-1K数据集上，PFLD在超分辨率、高斯去模糊和图像修复任务中均优于现有最优方法PSLD。
Conclusion: 粒子滤波框架有效提升了扩散模型在逆问题中的解空间探索能力，且具有良好的通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pushing the Frontier on Approximate EFX Allocations
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of allocating a set of indivisible goods to a set of agents with additive valuation functions, aiming to achieve approximate envy-freeness up to any good ($α$-EFX). The state-of-the-art results on the problem include that (exact) EFX allocations exist when (a) there are at most three agents, or (b) the agents' valuation functions can take at most two values, or (c) the agents' valuation functions can be represented via a graph. For $α$-EFX, it is known that a $0.618$-EFX allocation exists for any number of agents with additive valuation functions. In this paper, we show that $2/3$-EFX allocations exist when (a) there are at most seven agents, (b) the agents' valuation functions can take at most three values, or (c) the agents' valuation functions can be represented via a multigraph. Our results can be interpreted in two ways. First, by relaxing the notion of EFX to $2/3$-EFX, we obtain existence results for strict generalizations of the settings for which exact EFX allocations are known to exist. Secondly, by imposing restrictions on the setting, we manage to beat the barrier of $0.618$ and achieve an approximation guarantee of $2/3$. Therefore, our results push the frontier of existence and computation of approximate EFX allocations, and provide insights into the challenges of settling the existence of exact EFX allocations.
papers.comment: The conference version of this work has been accepted to the Twenty-Fifth ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC 2024)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在可加性估值函数下，如何将不可分割物品公平分配给多个智能体，目标达到α-EFX（近似无嫉妒至任意物品）。已知结果包括：至多三个智能体时存在精确EFX分配；估值函数取两个值时存在；或可通过图表示时存在。对于α-EFX，已知任意多个智能体存在0.618-EFX分配。本文证明：当智能体数不超过七个、或估值函数取至多三个值、或可通过多重图表示时，2/3-EFX分配存在。这些结果一方面通过放松EFX至2/3-EFX，推广了已知精确EFX存在的场景；另一方面通过施加限制，突破了0.618的界限达到2/3近似比。
Motivation: EFX分配的存在性问题是公平分配领域的核心挑战，目前只在少数特殊设置下得到解决。本文旨在推动近似EFX分配的存在性边界，探索在更一般条件下能否获得比0.618更好的近似比。
Method: 采用构造性方法，针对不同限制条件设计分配算法：对于至多七个智能体、估值函数取值不超过三个、或估值函数可由多重图表示的情况，证明存在2/3-EFX分配。
Result: 主要结果包括：（a）至多七个智能体时存在2/3-EFX分配；（b）估值函数取至多三个值时存在2/3-EFX分配；（c）估值函数可由多重图表示时存在2/3-EFX分配。这些结果将已知近似比从0.618提升至2/3，并推广了精确EFX存在的条件。
Conclusion: 本文通过证明更优的近似比（2/3）在更广的设置下存在，推动了近似EFX分配的存在性前沿。这些结果为最终解决精确EFX的存在性问题提供了见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Network Assisted Lifting Steps For Improved Fully Scalable Lossy Image Compression in JPEG 2000
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes to augment the lifting steps of the conventional wavelet transform with additional neural network assisted lifting steps. These additional steps reduce residual redundancy (notably aliasing information) amongst the wavelet subbands, and also improve the visual quality of reconstructed images at reduced resolutions. The proposed approach involves two steps, a high-to-low step followed by a low-to-high step. The high-to-low step suppresses aliasing in the low-pass band by using the detail bands at the same resolution, while the low-to-high step aims to further remove redundancy from detail bands, so as to achieve higher energy compaction. The proposed two lifting steps are trained in an end-to-end fashion; we employ a backward annealing approach to overcome the non-differentiability of the quantization and cost functions during back-propagation. Importantly, the networks employed in this paper are compact and with limited non-linearities, allowing a fully scalable system; one pair of trained network parameters are applied for all levels of decomposition and for all bit-rates of interest. By employing the proposed approach within the JPEG 2000 image coding standard, our method can achieve up to 17.4% average BD bit-rate saving over a wide range of bit-rates, while retaining quality and resolution scalability features of JPEG 2000.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI) for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在 JPEG 2000 的小波变换提升步骤中增加神经网络辅助的提升步骤，以减少子带间的残余冗余（尤其是混叠信息），并改善低分辨率重建图像的视觉质量。方法包括高到低和低到高两个步骤，采用端到端训练和反向退火策略克服量化不可微问题。在 JPEG 2000 框架下，平均可节省 17.4% 的 BD 比特率，同时保持质量和分辨率可扩展性。
Motivation: 传统小波变换后的子带间仍存在残余冗余（如混叠信息），影响压缩效率和低分辨率重建质量。
Method: 在原始提升步骤后增加两个神经网络辅助的提升步骤：高到低步骤利用细节带抑制低通带混叠，低到高步骤进一步去除细节带冗余。网络紧凑、非线性有限，一对参数适用于所有分解层级和比特率。使用反向退火处理量化和代价函数的不可微性。
Result: 在 JPEG 2000 中集成该方法，平均 BD 比特率节省达 17.4%，覆盖宽比特率范围，且保持质量和分辨率可扩展性。
Conclusion: 所提方法有效提升压缩性能，同时保持了完全可扩展性，适合用于现有图像编码标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentially Private Permutation Tests
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed growing concerns about the privacy of sensitive data. In response to these concerns, differential privacy has emerged as a rigorous framework for privacy protection, gaining widespread recognition in both academic and industrial circles. While substantial progress has been made in private data analysis, existing methods often suffer from impracticality or a significant loss of statistical efficiency. This paper aims to alleviate these concerns in the context of hypothesis testing by introducing differentially private permutation tests. The proposed framework extends classical non-private permutation tests to private settings, maintaining both finite-sample validity and differential privacy in a rigorous manner. The power of the proposed test depends on the choice of a test statistic, and we establish general conditions for consistency and non-asymptotic uniform power. To demonstrate the utility and practicality of our framework, we focus on reproducing kernel-based test statistics and introduce differentially private kernel tests for two-sample and independence testing: dpMMD and dpHSIC. The proposed kernel tests are straightforward to implement, applicable to various types of data, and attain minimax optimal power across different privacy regimes. Our empirical evaluations further highlight their competitive power under various synthetic and real-world scenarios, emphasizing their practical value. The code is publicly available to facilitate the implementation of our framework.
papers.comment: This version incorporates selected journal revisions, including Rényi differential privacy and expanded experiments, and adds a new high-privacy minimax lower bound (Theorem 10) not included in the journal version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出差分隐私置换检验框架，将经典非私有置换检验扩展到私有设置，同时保持有限样本有效性和差分隐私。重点基于再生核检验统计量，设计dpMMD和dpHSIC用于双样本和独立性检验，达到极小极大最优功效，并开源代码。
Motivation: 现有私有数据分析方法常缺乏实用性或统计效率低下；本文旨在在假设检验背景下缓解隐私与功效的权衡。
Method: 引入差分隐私置换检验，扩展非私有置换检验；基于再生核统计量设计dpMMD和dpHSIC，满足差分隐私并保持有限样本有效性。
Result: 提出检验在多种隐私机制下达到极小极大最优功效；实验在合成和真实数据上展现竞争力。
Conclusion: 框架实用且易于实现，代码公开；适用于多种数据类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pramana: A Composable, Domain-Specific Backend for Empirical Networking Research
papers.abstract_en: Networking research advances by turning hypotheses into empirical evidence, so accelerating it means reducing the lag between ideation (synthesizing a hypothesis) and generating the data that tests it. Consider a concrete case: does a bulk BBR download fairly share its bottleneck with competing real-time Google Meet traffic? Validating this requires configuring a realistic bottleneck link, concurrently generating BBR's bulk transfer and Meet's real-time traffic, and collecting relevant service-quality metrics. Today this overhead is high, often forcing researchers to start from scratch for every new idea. This ideation-to-data-generation gap will only worsen in the agentic AI era, where AI-assisted ideation accelerates exponentially, yet its outputs cannot be validated without a data-generation backend. This paper explores how to bridge this gap. We envision a composable, domain-specific backend, Pramana, shaped as a thin waist, with diverse research intents at the top and disparate execution substrates at the bottom. Pramana realizes this waist through a single contract, the intent specification, which disaggregates an experiment into three independent axes: the intent (what data to generate), the substrate (where to generate it), and the mechanism (how to produce it), so one specification runs on any substrate. We demonstrate Pramana's utility by building a first-of-its-kind corpus of 255 data-generation intents mined from 66 published papers, and show the intent specification satisfies all of them, where no existing tool satisfies more than 13%. Our current proof-of-concept implementation already satisfies 34% of these intents, more than twice the best existing tool, and we lay out a roadmap for closing this abstraction-implementation gap through a broader community effort to build the envisioned data-generation backend and accelerate empirical networking research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pramana，一个用于经验网络研究的可组合、领域特定后端，通过意图规范（intent specification）将实验分解为意图、基板和机制三个独立轴，从而加速从假设到数据生成的流程。论文基于66篇已发表论文挖掘了255个数据生成意图，显示意图规范覆盖所有意图，而现有工具最多覆盖13%。当前原型实现已覆盖34%的意图，超过最好工具的两倍。
Motivation: 网络研究中从假设到数据生成的延迟过高，研究者常需从头开始配置实验。AI辅助假设生成加速使得这一差距加剧，需要可组合的后端来桥接。
Method: 提出Pramana，通过一个薄腰架构，以意图规范为核心契约，将实验分解为意图、基板和机制，使得一个规范可在任何基板上运行。
Result: 基于66篇论文挖掘的255个意图，意图规范满足所有意图；当前实现满足34%，远超现有工具（不到13%）。
Conclusion: 论文证明意图规范的充分性，并展示了原型实现的潜力，但承认存在抽象-实现差距，需要社区努力构建完整的后端。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Synthetic Users Fail: A Cross-Domain Benchmark of LLM-Simulated Human Survey Responses
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic users, stand-ins for human respondents whose simulated answers feed product, policy, and market decisions. We ask when this substitution is valid and when it fails, and package the answer as an evaluation framework for intelligent synthetic-user systems. A single protocol, run across four models spanning two families and an 8B-to-frontier capability range, is applied to two independent domains of real human-response data: U.S. general social attitudes (General Social Survey) and cross-cultural values (World Values Survey). Every model is benchmarked against a suite of non-LLM baselines fit on held-out human data. Under demographic prompting and the survey-simulation protocols we test, two failures replicate across both domains, all four models, and both families. First, at the individual level no LLM beats even the strongest baseline; on cross-cultural values every model falls well below it, and the gap survives distance-aware and proper scoring. Second, models systematically over-determine demographics, treating identity as far more predictive of attitudes than it is among real people, a distortion present for nearly every question-group combination and robust to a coding-invariant measure. Neither failure is remedied by a larger, more capable model. A decision-impact analysis shows why this matters in practice: on a segment-targeting task the models inflate between-segment gaps two to fourfold, would direct a team to the wrong segment in half of U.S. and most cross-cultural cases, and manufacture segment splits that do not exist in real people. We make the cross-domain benchmark and the evaluation framework available on request, so that teams can determine in advance when synthetic-user evidence is safe for decision support and when it is not.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Preprint; under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建跨领域基准测试，评估LLM作为合成用户模拟人类调查响应的有效性。在General Social Survey和World Values Survey两个领域、四种模型上，发现LLM在个体层面无法超越简单基线，且过度依赖人口统计信息，导致实践中的决策偏差。
Motivation: LLM被广泛用作合成用户代替人类受访者，但缺乏系统验证其模拟的有效性及失败条件。
Method: 设计统一评估框架，对比四种LLM与多种非LLM基线，在两大独立人类响应数据集上测试，并引入决策影响分析。
Result: LLM个体模拟效果均未超过最强基线；模型系统性地高估人口统计变量的预测作用，导致段间差距膨胀2-4倍，半数美国家庭和大多数跨文化案例中导向错误目标段。
Conclusion: 当前LLM模拟人类调查响应在个体层面和群体偏差上存在系统性失败，且更大模型无法缓解，需预先评估其决策支持安全性。

summary_sections.motivation: LLM被广泛用作合成用户代替人类受访者，但缺乏系统验证其模拟的有效性及失败条件。
summary_sections.method: 设计统一评估框架，对比四种LLM与多种非LLM基线，在两大独立人类响应数据集上测试，并引入决策影响分析。
summary_sections.result: LLM个体模拟效果均未超过最强基线；模型系统性地高估人口统计变量的预测作用，导致段间差距膨胀2-4倍，半数美国家庭和大多数跨文化案例中导向错误目标段。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前LLM模拟人类调查响应在个体层面和群体偏差上存在系统性失败，且更大模型无法缓解，需预先评估其决策支持安全性。

papers.title: Toward a Unified Statistical Theory of Unsupervised Pretraining and Supervised Neural Knowledge Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph learning provides a powerful framework for representing and inferring structured knowledge, with broad practical applications. However, the scarcity of relation-specific labeled triples per entity hinders the training of expressive models, and the ad hoc design of scoring functions limits generalizability and lacks theoretical grounding. We address both issues with a theoretically grounded, end-to-end training framework that extends and subsumes existing methods. Our framework is a two-stage procedure: unsupervised pretraining over heterogeneous corpora followed by supervised learning with multiple relation types. We establish a nonasymptotic risk bound that disentangles pretraining representation error from labeled-sample complexity, formally quantifying the benefit of large-scale unlabeled data for downstream knowledge prediction. Synthetic experiments validate each theoretical component, and real-world experiments confirm the effectiveness of our approach on large-scale knowledge graph benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一统计理论框架，将无监督预训练和监督知识图谱学习整合为两阶段过程，并给出非渐近风险界以量化大规模无标注数据的收益。合成实验验证理论组件，真实实验证明方法在大规模知识图谱基准上的有效性。
Motivation: 知识图谱学习中关系特定的标注三元组稀疏，且现有评分函数设计缺乏理论依据，限制了模型泛化能力。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先对异构语料进行无监督预训练，再对多关系类型进行有监督学习，并建立非渐近风险界来解耦预训练表示误差与标注样本复杂度。
Result: 合成实验验证各理论组件的正确性；真实实验表明方法在大规模知识图谱基准上有效。
Conclusion: 该框架从理论上量化了大规模无标注数据对下游知识预测的益处，为知识图谱学习提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: MetaKoopman: Bayesian Meta-Learning of Koopman Operators for Modeling Structured Dynamics under Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Modeling and forecasting nonlinear dynamics under distribution shifts is essential for robust decision-making in real-world systems. In this work, we propose MetaKoopman, a Bayesian meta-learning framework for modeling nonlinear dynamics through linear latent representations. MetaKoopman learns a Matrix Normal-Inverse Wishart (MNIW) prior over the Koopman operator, enabling closed-form Bayesian updates conditioned on recent trajectory segments. Moreover, it provides a closed-form posterior predictive distribution over future state trajectories, capturing both epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty in the learned dynamics. We evaluate MetaKoopman on a full-scale autonomous truck and trailer system across a wide range of adverse winter scenarios, including snow, ice, and mixed-friction conditions, as well as in simulated control tasks with diverse distribution shifts. MetaKoopman consistently outperforms prior approaches in multi-step prediction accuracy, uncertainty calibration, and robustness to distributional shifts. Field experiments further demonstrate its effectiveness in dynamically feasible motion planning, particularly during evasive maneuvers and operation at the limits of traction. Project website: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/MetaKoopman/
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 (2025), 29551-29584
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MetaKoopman 框架，通过贝叶斯元学习在潜空间中线性化非线性动力学，利用矩阵正态逆威沙特先验实现 Koopman 算子的闭式后验更新，并在自动驾驶卡车拖车系统及模拟控制任务中验证了多步预测精度与不确定性校准优势。
Motivation: 现有非线性动力学建模方法在分布偏移下预测鲁棒性不足，且难以量化认知不确定性和偶然不确定性。
Method: 构建 Koopman 算子的矩阵正态逆威沙特先验，基于轨迹片段进行闭式贝叶斯更新，并得到状态轨迹的闭式后验预测分布。
Result: 在真实冬季场景（雪、冰、混合摩擦）及模拟分布偏移任务中，MetaKoopman 在多步预测精度、不确定性校准和鲁棒性上持续超越基线方法，并在极限操作下实现动态可行运动规划。
Conclusion: 方法有效融合了元学习与贝叶斯更新，适用于对安全要求高的动力学系统，但计算代价与高维扩展性有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Automorphism-Induced Non-Canonicity in Top-k Explanations of Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A gradient-based GNN explainer given a molecule with two chemically equivalent nitro groups assigns them attribution scores that are equal to the last bit. It cannot do otherwise: message passing is exactly permutation equivariant, so any automorphism of the input leaves every attribution invariant. Yet the standard report, the top-k edges, names one of the two, and which one is settled by the order of an array. We show this is a structural obstruction rather than an implementation slip. When no minimal valid explanation is fixed by the input's automorphism group, no rule can be single-valued, minimal and symmetry-respecting at once. For the exact-k reports used in practice we give a parameter-free criterion, mechanised in Lean 4 with no axiom dependencies, that decides from the graph alone whether every score-optimal report of that size must split an orbit. Across 21298 instance-budget decisions the criterion agrees with a mechanical model-equivalence check without exception, and no severing case we found admitted a neutral alternative. The obstruction is common. Nontrivial automorphisms occur in 93.4% of Mutagenicity, the dataset the seminal explainability papers use, so the measure-zero dismissal of symmetric inputs, sound on the continuous domains it was made for, collapses here. At the sparsity budget those papers report, 24.0% of molecules with two interchangeable nitro groups (6 of 25) surface exactly one of them, every one arbitrary under mechanical verification. A model's blindness also manufactures symmetry: every MUTAG molecule contains atoms chemistry separates and the network provably cannot, and a matched control shows the resolution is set by what the model reads rather than how it is parameterised. Reporting orbits removes the arbitrariness at 0.11 ms and 0.43 extra edges per graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示图神经网络（GNN）解释器在分子图上因自同构（automorphism）导致top-k解释非唯一性的结构性障碍：当输入具有对称性时，任何基于梯度的方法都无法唯一确定最小有效解释。作者给出一个无参数准则，可在Lean 4中机械验证，决定top-k报告是否必须分裂轨道（orbit）。在Mutagenicity数据集上，93.4%的分子存在非平凡自同构，且24%的具有两个可互换硝基的分子中top-k解释任意选择了其中一个。报告轨道可消除任意性，仅增加0.43额外边/图。
Motivation: 现有GNN解释器在分子图中面对对称化学基团（如两个等价硝基）时，top-k解释会任意选择其中一个，这是结构性的问题而非实现缺陷，需要理论分析并给出可操作的解决方案。
Method: 通过自同构群分析，证明不存在同时满足单值、最小和对称性保持的解释规则；对于实际使用的exact-k报告，提出一个无参数准则，利用Lean 4进行机械验证，从图结构本身判断最优解释是否必须分裂轨道。
Result: 在21298个实例-预算决策上，该准则与机械模型等价性检查完全一致；在Mutagenicity数据集中，93.4%的分子存在非平凡自同构；在文献报告的稀疏预算下，24.0%的具有两个可互换硝基的分子（6/25）的top-k解释任意选择了其中一个。报告轨道可消除任意性，耗时0.11 ms，增加0.43额外边/图。
Conclusion: 自同构导致的解释非唯一性是普遍存在的结构障碍，报告轨道（而不是单个边）可以消除任意性，且开销很小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Incast-Free MoE Rate-Based Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures have become key to large language models; however, their typical round-robin (RR) scheduling introduces significant bottlenecks. In this paper, we demonstrate that RR causes a previously-undiscovered exponential incast phenomenon with MoE traffic. We propose an alternative proactive fair scheduling framework tailored for MoE workloads, which effectively prevents fabric oversubscription. We also outline how it can be implemented in NICs. Finally, through extensive simulations with real and synthetic workloads, we demonstrate that this framework consistently eliminates incast, maintains a near-100% link utilization, and reduces Collective Completion Time (CCT).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现Mixture of Experts (MoE)架构中典型的轮询调度会导致之前未发现的指数级incast现象，并提出一种主动公平调度框架来消除incast，保持接近100%的链路利用率，并减少集体完成时间。
Motivation: 现有MoE轮询调度引起指数级incast问题，造成网络瓶颈。
Method: 提出一种针对MoE工作负载的主动公平调度框架，避免网络过订阅，并概述如何在NIC中实现。
Result: 通过真实和合成工作负载的模拟，表明该框架持续消除incast，维持近100%链路利用率，减少集体完成时间。
Conclusion: 该调度框架有效消除了MoE中的incast问题，提高了网络效率。

papers.title: RAGuard: A Layered Defense Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems Against Data Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) in external corpora, but this reliance exposes them to corpus poisoning: maliciously injected passages that manipulate retrieved evidence. We introduce RAGuard, a layered defense against \emph{factual} corpus-poisoning attacks on RAG pipelines. The first layer adversarially fine-tunes a dense retriever on synthetic poisoned documents (fabricated facts, contradictions, and reasoning traps), teaching it to downrank malicious passages before generation. The second layer, the Zero-Knowledge Inference Patch ZKIP, is a label-free, black-box filter: for each retrieved document, it performs a leave-one-out decode and scores the document by the semantic shift and output-entropy change that its removal induces. ZKIP requires no poison labels, no ground-truth answers, and no access to model internals; it compares the model's own answers under counterfactual contexts. On poisoned Natural Questions at 5--30\% poison ratios, adversarial retriever training alone reduces but does not eliminate attack success, while ZKIP drives the measured attack success rate to 0.000 in every defended configuration, keeping Recall@5 within 0.03 of the clean-corpus baseline. Supervised analyses on both Natural Questions and BEIR (NFCorpus) confirm that the counterfactual signals ZKIP relies on carry learnable poison structure. The defense costs $k{+}1$ generator passes per query ($6\times$ for $k{=}5$); we analyze batching and early-stopping approximations that reduce this overhead. We also show that keyword-preserving poisons leave lexical retrievers such as BM25 essentially unaffected, an observation that delineates the boundary of the threat model. Code, datasets, and evaluation harnesses are released for reproducibility.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS ResponsibleFM 2025, AAAI FrontierIR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAGuard是针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中语料库投毒攻击（corpus poisoning）的一种分层防御框架。第一层通过对抗性微调稠密检索器，使其学会降低恶意文档的排序；第二层ZKIP是一种无需标签的黑盒过滤器，通过留一法解码和语义偏移检测识别中毒文档。在Natural Questions数据集上，5-30%投毒比例下，ZKIP将攻击成功率降至0.000，同时保持Recall@5与干净基线相差不超过0.03。
Motivation: RAG系统依赖外部语料库进行检索，这使其容易受到语料库投毒攻击——恶意注入的文档会操纵检索结果，导致生成错误事实。现有防御方法有限，需要一种高效且无需标签的检测机制。
Method: 提出两层防御：第一层对抗性微调稠密检索器，在合成中毒文档上训练使其降低恶意文档排名；第二层ZKIP（零知识推理补丁）通过留一法解码，比较每个文档被移除前后的语义变化和输出熵变化来评分，无需标签或模型内部访问。
Result: 在Natural Questions数据集上，5-30%投毒比例下，单独对抗训练不能完全消除攻击，而ZKIP将攻击成功率降至0.000，Recall@5与干净基线差距不超过0.03。在BEIR（NFCorpus）上进一步验证了反事实信号的可学习性。
Conclusion: RAGuard能有效防御RAG管道中的事实性投毒攻击，ZKIP作为黑盒过滤器实现了零攻击成功率。方法代价是每个查询需k+1次生成器调用，可通过批处理和早停近似降低开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Implicit Causal World Models from Multi-Agent Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: In model-based reinforcement learning, world models exist as internal simulators, but their training often conflates statistical correlations with causal mechanisms. This problem is exacerbated in multi-agent systems where physical transitions are intertwined with strategic agent intents, causing world models to fail under distribution shift. We introduce Implicit Causal World Models to recover environmental dynamics from offline demonstrations without requiring pre-defined causal graphs. By incorporating policy variance, we render world models discoverable via the sequential backdoor condition. Evaluations across coordination tasks (Two-Door, Navigation, and Giveway) demonstrate that these models provide interpretable causal representations under both full and partial observability, with model accuracy scaling directly with interventional strength.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出隐式因果世界模型（Implicit Causal World Models），从离线多智能体演示中恢复环境动态，无需预定义因果图。通过引入策略方差，利用序列后门条件使世界模型可发现。在Two-Door、Navigation和Giveway等协作任务上的评估表明，该模型在完全和部分可观测条件下都能提供可解释的因果表示，且模型精度与干预强度成正比。
Motivation: 在基于模型的强化学习中，世界模型常混淆统计相关性与因果机制，此问题在多智能体系统中尤为严重，导致分布偏移下模型失效。
Method: 隐式因果世界模型通过结合策略方差和序列后门条件，从离线演示中学习因果结构，无需事先指定因果图。
Result: 在多个协调任务（Two-Door、Navigation、Giveway）上，模型在完全和部分可观测环境下均能获得可解释的因果表示，且精度随干预强度增加而提升。

papers.title: Rethinking Clinical Relevance in Chest X-ray Machine Learning: How Evaluation References Define Performance
papers.abstract_en: Chest X-ray (CXR) machine learning relies heavily on automated evaluation using reference standards that aim to approximate clinical judgment. However, commonly used report-derived labels for pathology classification or generic image quality metrics for reconstruction may not reliably reflect clinical judgment. We systematically investigate how evaluation-reference choices affect model performance and ranking in both pathology classification and image quality assessment (IQA). To enable controlled comparison across evaluation references, we collected paired expert image- and report-derived labels for thoracic findings from a clinical cohort at Cambridge University Hospitals (CUH) and curated a subset of the public MIMIC-CXR dataset, along with expert ratings of diagnostic image quality. We show that for supervised image classifiers (ResNet, DenseNet), several zero-shot and fine-tuned vision-language models (e.g., MedKLIP, GLoRIA, and ConVIRT), changing the label source leads to substantial differences not only in performance estimates but also in model rankings. In parallel, alignment of IQA measures with expert judgment depends heavily on the choice of measure, and commonly used IQA metrics such as SSIM and PSNR often fail to align with expert assessments of diagnostic usability. Our results demonstrate that evaluation choices are crucial: they can determine which models and methods appear best and are therefore selected for further development or deployment. The selection of evaluation references should therefore be treated as a central component of clinical validity in CXR machine learning, and justified with respect to the pathology, imaging task, and intended downstream clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了胸部X光（CXR）机器学习中评估参考标准（如报告派生标签和图像质量指标）的选择如何影响模型性能估计和排名。通过剑桥大学医院临床队列和MIMIC-CXR数据集的实验，发现对于病理分类和图像质量评估，不同的评估参考导致模型性能估计和排名的显著差异。评估选择决定了哪些模型和方法看起来最优，从而影响后续开发和部署，应将评估参考的选择视为CXR机器学习临床有效性的核心组成部分。
Motivation: 现有CXR机器学习依赖自动评估参考标准，但常用标签（如报告派生标签）和图像质量指标（如SSIM、PSNR）可能无法可靠反映临床判断，导致模型选择和评估偏差。
Method: 收集配对专家标注的报告派生和影像派生标签以及诊断图像质量评分，使用有监督分类器（ResNet、DenseNet）和视觉-语言模型（MedKLIP、GLoRIA、ConVIRT）进行实验，比较不同评估参考下的性能与排名。
Result: 改变标签来源导致性能估计和模型排名显著差异；常用图像质量指标（SSIM、PSNR）常与专家诊断可用性评估不一致。
Conclusion: 评估参考的选择是影响模型临床有效性的关键因素，应根据病理、成像任务和下游临床用途进行论证。

papers.title: Seeing or Knowing? Visual Context Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance by integrating visual inputs with the rich priors of pretrained language models. However, they often fail on vision-centric tasks, especially when visual evidence conflicts with pretrained knowledge. We explore these failures separately using two diagnostic paradigms: (1) probing whether visual information is available, via image reconstruction, and (2) measuring multimodal context sensitivity, the extent to which the model follows visual context versus the language prior. To support the second, we introduce the WhatIfVis, a benchmark spanning five coarse-grained dimensions (spatial-temporal, color, count, size, and weight) whose questions admit answers from either the image or the prior. Our analysis yields three findings: (i) Coarse-grained visual evidence is preserved, as these attributes can be reconstructed from the final-layer image tokens of frozen MLLMs. Failures on questions about these attributes therefore point to post-perceptual utilization, rather than to degraded visual encoding during perception. (ii) Even when explicitly instructed to use or ignore visual evidence, vanilla models (without supervised fine-tuning on the WhatIfVis) show unstable visual context sensitivity. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves this controllability and generalizes across domains, and activation patching further localizes the vision-versus-prior trade-off at architecture-specific depths across all six models. (iii) The vision-versus-prior trade-off is controllable along a learned vector. Applying this steering vector, even without any intent instruction, improves controllability over the vanilla model. Together, these results relocate the bottleneck, indicating that for the coarse attributes we study, MLLMs encode the visual evidence but cannot reliably control their reliance on it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文探究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉中心任务中的失败模式，特别是当视觉证据与预训练知识冲突时。作者通过图像重建探测视觉信息可用性，并引入WhatIfVis基准测试从五个粗粒度维度（时空、颜色、计数、尺寸、重量）测量模型遵循视觉上下文与语言先验的程度。研究发现：粗粒度视觉证据在冻结MLLM的最终层图像token中可重建，失败源于后感知利用而非编码；模型对视觉上下文的敏感度不稳定，监督微调可改善可控性，且激活修补定位了视觉-先验权衡的架构深度；该权衡可沿学习向量控制，无需意图指令即可提升可控性。结果表明，对于这些粗粒度属性，模型编码了视觉证据但无法可靠控制对其依赖。
Motivation: MLLMs在视觉中心任务上常失败，尤其是视觉证据与预训练知识冲突时，需要理解失败原因。
Method: 采用两种诊断范式：图像重建探测视觉信息可用性；引入WhatIfVis基准多维度测量视觉上下文敏感度。还使用监督微调、激活修补和指导向量控制。
Result: 粗粒度视觉特征可从冻结模型图像token重建；模型对视觉上下文敏感度不稳定，SFT可改善且跨领域泛化；激活修补定位权衡深度；沿学习向量可控制权衡。
Conclusion: 对于所研究的粗粒度属性，MLLMs编码了视觉证据但无法可靠控制对其依赖，瓶颈在于后感知利用而非感知编码。

papers.title: Aligning LLM-Simulated and Human Examinees for Psychometric Calibration: A Cognitive Diagnostic Profiling Approach
papers.abstract_en: Psychometric calibration for educational tests typically requires costly human response data. Large language models (LLMs) simulated examinees offer a promising route to early calibration, but their responses are too accurate and too uniform. We propose Cognitive Diagnostic Profiling (CDP), a zero-shot framework that prompts LLMs to simulate plausible examinees with diverse cognitive profiles: binary attribute-mastery patterns are rendered as natural-language profiles and sampled under an uninformative or an informative distribution. Using the Tatsuoka fraction-subtraction dataset (536 examinees, 15 items, five attributes), we evaluated eight LLM configurations under no-profile, uninformative-CDP, and informative-CDP conditions, assessing alignment with human examinees at the ability-distribution, mastery-profile, and item-difficulty levels. CDP improved all three levels: distributional overlap rose across configurations; weighted correlations between profile-level scores and human profile expectations reached 0.92 to 0.98; and item-difficulty recovery improved in rank order and absolute alignment, most for reasoning-enabled models; in the strongest case, Gemini 3.0 Flash (Thinking), one-parameter logistic (1PL) difficulty Spearman correlations rose from 0.24 to 0.86 and 0.90 and the root-mean-square error (RMSE) fell from 6.31 to 1.30 and 0.90; the informative condition helped most where profile-level alignment was strong. CDP brings LLM-simulated examinees into closer psychometric alignment with human examinees, making them practical for operational test development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出认知诊断画像（CDP）框架，通过将二进制属性掌握模式转化为自然语言画像并采样，提示LLM模拟具有多样认知画像的考生。在Tatsuoka分数减法数据集上，CDP显著提升了LLM模拟考生与人类考生在能力分布、掌握画像和项目难度三个层面的对齐度，使LLM模拟考生更适用于实际测试开发。
Motivation: 心理测量校准通常需要昂贵的人类响应数据，LLM模拟考生虽可替代但响应过于准确和均匀，缺乏真实考生的多样性。
Method: 提出零样本CDP框架，将二进制属性掌握模式转化为自然语言画像，在无信息或信息分布下采样，作为提示输入LLM以模拟具有特定认知画像的考生。
Result: 在Tatsuoka数据集上，CDP使分布重叠提升；画像级分数与人类期望的加权相关性达0.92-0.98；1PL项目难度Spearman相关性从0.24提升至0.86和0.90，RMSE从6.31降至1.30和0.90。信息条件在画像对齐强时帮助最大。
Conclusion: CDP能使LLM模拟考生与人类考生在心理测量上更对齐，使其可用于操作化的测试开发。

papers.title: StealthBench: Measuring Operational Stealth in Autonomous Offensive-Security Agents
papers.abstract_en: Stealth, the discipline of achieving an objective without revealing your presence, capabilities, or collected intelligence, is what separates sophisticated operators from detectable ones. Elite security researchers and advanced persistent threats achieve their objectives unnoticed; autonomous agents increasingly inherit the same offensive tasks, but do they inherit the tradecraft? We introduce StealthBench,a benchmark that measures operational stealth in autonomous offensive-security agents across six operational security (OPSEC) dimensions. We extract 11 hand-verified OPSEC incidents from real bug-bounty and red-team trajectories, expanded into 14 dockerized task scenarios, where agents, despite finding real vulnerabilities, committed stealth failures inconsistent with standard operational tradecraft: embedding credentials in public uploads, deleting production resources to prove access, force-adding uninvolved users to demonstrate a race condition. We evaluate agent trajectories using a 3-model large language model (LLM) judge panel with majority-vote aggregation, measuring safe success rate (solved and stealthy), Stealth@Solve (tradecraft quality among successful solves), and reckless solve rate (solved but cover blown). Our results show that no model exceeds 54% safe success rate (the compound metric requiring both task completion and stealth), confirming that OPSEC failures are systematic across model families. We release StealthBench as a public benchmark to support both the development of stealth-aware agents and automated OPSEC monitoring for autonomous offensive-security deployments. The interactive leaderboard, evaluation harness, and dataset are available at https://stealthbench.com.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 9 tables, 1 figure, 2 appendices. Code: https://github.com/GangGreenTemperTatum/stealthbench Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/0xmoose/stealthbench Website: https://stealthbench.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StealthBench，一个衡量自主进攻性安全代理操作隐身性的基准。从真实漏洞赏金和红队轨迹中提取 11 个 OPSEC 事件，扩展为 14 个 Docker 任务场景。使用 3 个 LLM 组成的评审团进行多数投票评估，测量安全成功率、Stealth@Solve 和草率解决率。实验结果显示没有模型的安全成功率超过 54%，表明 OPSEC 失败在不同模型系列中具有系统性。该基准已公开，旨在支持隐身感知代理和自动 OPSEC 监控。
Motivation: 自主代理在继承进攻性安全任务时，是否继承了相应的操作隐身技巧？现有代理经常出现 OPSEC 失败，例如将凭证嵌入公开上传、删除生产资源以证明访问权限、强制添加无关用户以演示竞争条件。有必要系统性地衡量和提升代理的隐身性。
Method: 构建 StealthBench 基准，包含 14 个基于 Docker 的任务场景，每个场景源自真实 OPSEC 事件。使用 3 个 LLM 模型组成的评审团进行多数投票评估，定义安全成功率（任务完成且隐身）、Stealth@Solve（成功解决中的隐身质量）和草率解决率（任务完成但暴露）。
Result: 在所有评估的模型中，安全成功率均不超过 54%，表明 OPSEC 失败是模型产品系列中的系统性问题。
Conclusion: StealthBench 作为公开基准发布，可用于开发隐身感知的自主代理，并为自主进攻性安全部署提供自动 OPSEC 监控。

papers.title: SARC-DQ: Runtime Data-Quality Gating for Agentic AI: Silent Evidence Defects, the Incompetence Shield, and Downstream-Only Remediation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems act, so a defect in the evidence they retrieve becomes a wrong action with a currency cost. The most dangerous enterprise defects are metadata-borne: a stale price or a superseded record, perfectly well-formed in the payload and betrayed only by freshness, lineage, or provenance. Such a defect never enters the agent's context, and an agent cannot doubt data it cannot see. On a priced replenishment benchmark, a competent agent silently converts an injected metadata-borne defect into a costly action about 60% of the time, with zero data-quality flags and behavioral doubt markers at chance (AUC <= 0.50). Across four model tiers spanning roughly 15x in inference price, the rate stays flat: capability does not buy skepticism. A metadata-aware pre-action gate with downstream-only remediation recovers the loss fully on the signals its predicates cover and not at all on those they miss. A model-free oracle derived from the task's decision geometry tracks the measured rates with MAE 0.015 (Pearson r = 0.876, interval coverage 15/16 cells), giving the flat ladder an analytical form. Evidence integrity is a systems axis distinct from model capability; mitigation depends on enforcement placement and predicate coverage. Code, frozen results, and a deterministic analysis pipeline: https://github.com/besanson/dqSarc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI智能体系统中元数据携带的静默证据缺陷（如过时价格或过期记录）如何导致代价高昂的错误行动。实验表明，在定价补充基准上，一个称职的智能体约有60%的概率将注入的缺陷转化为代价高昂的行动，且不产生任何数据质量标记或行为怀疑标志。能力更强的模型并未表现出更高的怀疑度。论文提出一种元数据感知的行动前门控机制，配合仅下游修复，能完全恢复其谓词覆盖的信号损失。还给出了一个基于任务决策几何的无模型预测器，准确拟合了测量率。
Motivation: 智能体系统依赖检索到的证据行动，但元数据层面的缺陷（如数据新鲜度、谱系）不会破坏数据载荷，智能体无法感知这些不可见缺陷，导致错误行动并产生实际成本。现有方法缺乏对此类静默缺陷的系统性检测和缓解。
Method: 提出SARC-DQ运行时数据质量门控机制：在智能体行动前，使用元数据感知的谓词检查（如时效性、谱系）对证据进行过滤；对检测到的缺陷仅在下游进行补救（如重试、备用源）。同时构建了一个无模型预测器，利用任务决策几何分析缺陷转化率。
Result: 实验显示，在定价补充基准上，智能体对注入的元数据缺陷的沉默转化率约60%，且不受模型能力影响（跨越约15倍推理成本的4个模型层级，转化率稳定）。门控机制完全恢复了其覆盖的谓词部分造成的损失，但遗漏的谓词则无改善。无模型预测器与实测率的MAE为0.015，Pearson r=0.876。
Conclusion: 证据完整性是独立于模型能力的一个系统维度；缓解效果取决于门控放置位置和谓词覆盖范围。论文强调元数据层面的静默缺陷是智能体系统的重要风险源，需要专门的运行时数据质量检查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Confounder Trap: Treatment-Encoding Representations in Causal Inference with Text
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects of linguistic properties from observational text is difficult because the same document can contain both the treatment of interest and the non-treatment textual attributes needed for adjustment. Existing approaches often learn representations from the full text to capture latent confounding, but when treatment status is itself encoded by words in the text, these representations can directly encode treatment. This creates a confounder trap: richer representations can make treated and control documents separable, inducing overlap violations even when the underlying causal problem satisfies overlap. We study latent text treatments that are encoded through lexicons or other treatment-defining lexical information, and propose masking-based adjustment representations that remove this lexical treatment signal before representation learning. We formalize representation-induced overlap failure, prove that deletion masking preserves overlap for bag-of-words/topic-model representations, and characterize replacement masking as a natural relaxation for large language models that hides treatment-defining tokens while preserving word order and context. Across simulations, masking improves overlap diagnostics, stabilizes treatment effect estimates, and reduces bias relative to adjustment methods that learn from the unmasked text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在基于文本的因果推断中，从全文学习的表示可能直接编码处理状态，导致重叠违反，即使因果问题本身满足重叠。作者提出掩码调整表示方法，在表示学习前移除词汇处理信号，理论证明删除掩码可保持词袋/主题模型的重叠，替换掩码则适用于大模型。模拟表明该方法改善重叠诊断、稳定效应估计并降低偏差。
Motivation: 现有因果推断方法从全文学习表示以控制混淆，但文本中处理状态由词汇编码时，这些表示会泄露处理信息，造成重叠违反，需要新的表示学习方法。
Method: 提出掩码调整表示方法：对处理定义词汇进行删除掩码（适用于词袋/主题模型）或替换掩码（适用于大语言模型），在表示学习前移除处理信号，同时保留词序和上下文。
Result: 模拟实验中，掩码方法改善了重叠诊断指标，稳定了处理效应估计，并降低了相较于未掩码调整方法的偏差。
Conclusion: 掩码调整表示能有效避免表示引起的重叠失败，提升文本因果推断的可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TraceCoder: Explainable and Auditable Code Generation with Position-Key Snippet Versioning
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary LLM-based coding agents produce code as black-box outputs: the rationale behind each line is hidden, the evolution of the code through benchmark-driven repair is ephemeral, and post-hoc auditing is impossible. We present a code generation concept that addresses these shortcomings through three complementary mechanisms: (i) a relational snippet-history schema that records, per repair event, the benchmark reference, round number, failure text, and LLM explanation, enabling full provenance queries; (ii) a browser-based visualisation tool that renders this history as heat-mapped, hover-annotated source code; and (iii) a competitive fractional position-key indexing scheme with tree-node delimiters that assigns stable, lexicographically-ordered identifiers to each code snippet, enabling fine-grained tracking without disrupting surrounding lines. We evaluate TraceCoder on 30 algorithmic programming tasks spanning string processing, mathematical computation, and data-structure manipulation, across two provider configurations. Of these, 10 exhaust the 6-iteration budget on tasks with subtle edge-case behaviour. Mean Chg% reaches 30%, three in ten code snippets carry a traceable repair-event row, compared to 21% when using Gemini 2.0 Flash as sole provider on a 20-task subset. Three detailed case studies demonstrate how the system explains which specific benchmark failures shaped each line of the final program. The proposed mechanism makes the internal "narrative" of automated code generation auditable and replayable, a property essential for trust and accountability in production deployments.
papers.comment: Submitted Version (version submitted on May deadline to AGENTICS 2026). Version of Record to appear in AGENTICS proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceCoder 提出一种可解释和可审计的代码生成概念，通过关系型片段历史模式、浏览器可视化工具和分数位置键索引方案，记录代码修复事件并实现细粒度追踪。在30个算法编程任务上评估，平均变更率达到30%。
Motivation: 当前基于LLM的编码代理以黑盒方式生成代码，缺乏每行代码背后的推理、代码演变无法追溯，且事后审计不可行。
Method: 提出三个互补机制：关系型片段历史模式记录修复事件的基准参考、轮次、失败文本和LLM解释；浏览器可视化工具通过热图注释渲染历史；分数位置键索引方案为每个代码片段分配稳定、字典序的标识符。
Result: 在30个算法编程任务上，10个任务耗尽6次迭代预算，平均变更率30%，30%的代码片段携带可追溯修复事件行（Gemini 2.0 Flash仅21%）。三个案例研究展示系统如何解释基准失败如何影响最终代码。
Conclusion: TraceCoder 使自动代码生成的内部“叙事”可审计和可重放，对生产部署中的信任和问责至关重要。

papers.title: MoSAIC: Aligned Intervention Supervision for Part-Local Motion Style Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Editing character motion often requires transferring a gesture or gait from one or more reference motions while preserving the source action, timing, root trajectory, and unselected body regions. Existing motion datasets, however, rarely provide paired targets for arbitrary part-local content--reference combinations, and self-reconstruction training may allow a diffusion model to reproduce the content motion while underusing the routed reference. We present MoSAIC, a latent diffusion framework for part-local reference-conditioned motion style transfer. MoSAIC factorizes content and reference features by anatomical region, preserves the root trajectory through a separate conditioning pathway, and routes user-selected references to individual body parts. Its central contribution is aligned intervention supervision, which constructs synchronized references and counterfactual targets through controlled local transformations, making both the requested regional response and the motion to be preserved directly observable during training. In a frozen evaluation comprising 128 motions and 896 routed conditions, part-masked routing reduces preserved-region error from 70.64 to 66.45~mm and matched-noise off-target leakage from 18.08 to 9.88~mm relative to whole-body routing, while retaining a positive selected-region response. A matched-budget continuation study further shows that retaining aligned intervention supervision produces an 8.8\% relative increase in selected-target response and a 2.0-percentage-point increase in requested-route influence concentration. These results demonstrate that MoSAIC improves the response--preservation trade-off required for selective and controllable part-local motion editing.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://utsa-virlab.github.io/MoSAIC/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoSAIC 是一个基于潜在扩散 (latent diffusion) 的部分局部运动风格迁移框架，通过解剖区域分解内容与参考特征，独立保留根轨迹，并将用户选择的参考路由到指定身体部位。其核心创新是对齐干预监督 (aligned intervention supervision)，通过受控局部变换构造同步参考与反事实目标，使训练中可直接观测所需区域响应和需保留的运动。在包含 128 个动作和 896 个路由条件的冻结评估中，部分掩蔽路由相比全身路由将保留区域误差从 70.64 mm 降至 66.45 mm，将匹配噪声离目标泄漏从 18.08 mm 降至 9.88 mm，同时保持正向的选择区域响应。
Motivation: 现有运动数据集很少为任意的局部内容-参考组合提供配对目标，且自重建训练可能使扩散模型复现内容运动而低估路由参考。需要一种能够实现选择性、可控的部分局部运动编辑的方法。
Method: 提出 MoSAIC 框架，包含解剖区域分解、根轨迹独立条件路径、部分局部参考路由，以及核心的对齐干预监督——通过受控局部变换构造同步参考与反事实目标，使训练中直接监督期望的区域响应与需保留的运动。
Result: 在冻结评估中，部分掩蔽路由相比全身路由，保留区域误差降低 4.19 mm，匹配噪声泄漏降低 8.20 mm；保留对齐干预监督使选择目标响应相对提升 8.8%，请求路由影响集中度提升 2.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: MoSAIC 改善了选择性、可控的部分局部运动编辑中响应与保留的权衡。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentGUI: An Interface for Observing and Steering Long-Running AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly adept at tackling complex, long-running tasks. With the rapid surge of autonomous capabilities, human oversight is systematically lagging behind due to limited human-centered interfacing. Aiming to address this, we introduce AgentGUI, a user-friendly, locally hosted GUI for seamlessly observing and steering AI agents amid multiple concurrent, long-running sessions. AgentGUI features 1) rich agent trajectory visualizations, 2) effective manual and automated steering, and 3) integration with and coordination between open-source and frontier agent frameworks. A controlled user study demonstrates statistically significant reduction in the time it takes to identify key elements from agent traces (38% faster, p = 0.023). In a preliminary experiment, AgentGUI's automated drift prevention feature raises the task completion rate of small local agents by as high as 34pp across a 0.8B--9B model ladder (N=50 runs per model). AgentGUI is publicly available through its project website (https://agent-gui-project.github.io) and open-source repository (https://github.com/eth-medical-ai-lab/agent-gui), along with a demo video (https://youtube.com/watch?v=GSDyxN1gTF0).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍AgentGUI，一个本地托管的GUI，用于观察和指导长时间运行的AI代理。它提供丰富的代理轨迹可视化、手动和自动引导，以及与开源和前沿代理框架的集成。用户研究表明，识别代理轨迹关键元素的时间减少了38%（p=0.023），自动漂移预防将小型本地代理的任务完成率提高了多达34个百分点。
Motivation: AI代理日益擅长复杂的长时间任务，但人类监督由于缺乏以人为中心的界面而滞后，导致监督效率低下。
Method: 设计了一个用户友好的本地GUI，包含丰富轨迹可视化、手动和自动引导功能，并与多种代理框架集成。
Result: 用户研究显示识别关键元素时间减少38%（p=0.023）；自动漂移预防将0.8B-9B模型的任务完成率提高多达34个百分点（N=50）。
Conclusion: AgentGUI通过可视化和引导功能显著提升人工监督效率，且开源可用。

papers.title: Entity Resolution in Practice: Lessons from a Self-Serve Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: We built and evaluated a self-serve entity resolution (ER) system on six benchmarks spanning 864 to 5M records, and three lessons emerged that are absent from existing ER literature. (1) No single matching algorithm wins everywhere - a self-serve pipeline cannot predict its next dataset, so we recommend training several algorithm families per dataset and letting an automatic bake-off pick the winner. (2) Precision and recall need separate fixes, not a shared threshold - precision needs hard rule-based vetoes, recall needs more diverse candidate retrieval. (3) One false-positive link can silently merge unrelated entities - assuming "A matches B" and "B matches C" implies "A matches C" lets a single bad link chain hundreds of records together, so every cross-group merge must be actively re-verified. We hope these lessons save practitioners the months of dead-end experiments that led us to them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分享自服务实体解析（ER）系统的实践经验和教训，基于六个基准测试（864到500万条记录）。关键教训包括：没有单一匹配算法普遍最优，建议每个数据集训练多种算法并自动选择最佳；精确率和召回率需要分别处理，精确率靠硬规则否决，召回率需更多样化的候选检索；假阳性链接会通过传递性合并不相关实体，因此每个跨组合并需主动重新验证。
Motivation: 现有ER文献缺乏对自服务系统实际部署教训的讨论，例如算法选择策略、精度和召回率的独立修复以及错误链接的连锁效应。
Method: 构建和评估自服务ER系统，使用自动烘焙竞赛选择算法族，对精确率和召回率分别采用硬规则否决和多样化候选检索，并对跨组合并进行主动重新验证。
Result: 在六个基准测试上发现没有单一算法始终最优；精确率需硬规则否决，召回率需更丰富候选检索；一个假阳性链接可通过传递性合并大量记录，需重新验证。
Conclusion: 这些教训旨在帮助实践者避免数月的无效实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Eddeep: a deep-learning framework for fast eddy-current distortion correction in diffusion MRI
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) relies on diffusion-weighted echo-planar imaging, which is highly susceptible to eddy-current-induced geometric distortions. These distortions vary across diffusion volumes according to gradient strength and direction, causing between-volume misalignment that can bias downstream microstructural analyses. Current state-of-the-art correction methods, such as FSL Eddy, achieve high-quality correction through iterative prediction-correction schemes but are computationally expensive. We propose Eddeep, a deep-learning framework for fast eddy-current distortion correction in dMRI. Eddeep decomposes the problem into two stages. First, a supervised image translation network standardises the appearance of diffusion-weighted and b=0 images, removing contrast differences that hinder reliable registration. Second, an unsupervised registration network estimates both eddy-current distortion and between-volume head motion parameters under a physics-constrained quadratic distortion model, enabling correction in a single forward pass. The method was trained on UK Biobank data and evaluated on both in-domain (UK Biobank) and out-of-domain (Memodyn) datasets. Across a range of complementary metrics, including between-volume jitter, diffusion kurtosis imaging residuals, signal irregularity, and mutual information, Eddeep achieved correction quality comparable to that of FSL Eddy while substantially reducing inference time. These results demonstrate that deep learning can provide accurate and efficient eddy-current distortion correction without relying on iterative optimisation, supporting the development of faster diffusion MRI processing pipelines for large-scale studies and clinical deployment. The code is available at: https://github.com/CIG-UCL/eddeep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Eddeep，一种用于扩散 MRI (dMRI) 快速涡流畸变校正的深度学习框架。该方法分为两阶段：第一阶段用有监督图像翻译网络标准化扩散加权图像和 b=0 图像的外观，消除对比度差异；第二阶段用无监督配准网络在物理约束的二次畸变模型下估计涡流畸变和头部运动参数，只需一次前向传播即可完成校正。在英国生物银行 (UK Biobank) 上训练，在域内和域外数据集上评估，校正质量与 FSL Eddy 相当，但推理时间大幅减少。
Motivation: 现有 dMRI 涡流畸变校正方法如 FSL Eddy 通过迭代预测-校正方案实现高质量校正，但计算成本高，不利于大规模研究和临床部署。
Method: Eddeep 采用两阶段深度学习框架：第一阶段是有监督图像翻译网络，消除扩散加权图像与 b=0 图像之间的对比度差异；第二阶段是无监督配准网络，在二次畸变模型估计畸变和运动参数，实现单次前向传播校正。
Result: 在 UK Biobank 和 Memodyn 数据集上，使用多种指标（包括体间抖动、扩散峰度成像残差、信号不规则性和互信息）评估，Eddeep 的校正质量与 FSL Eddy 相当，但推理时间显著缩短。
Conclusion: 深度学习可以在不依赖迭代优化的情况下提供准确高效的涡流畸变校正，支持开发更快的大规模研究和临床 dMRI 处理流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Denoising growth complexity: Data geometry and certified schedules for diffusion sampling
papers.abstract_en: Two central challenges in diffusion-based sampling are the theoretical one of understanding their remarkable effectiveness even in high-dimensional settings, and the practical one of designing algorithms with certified performance guarantees. We show that these questions are intimately connected via the \emph{denoising growth complexity} ($\mathsf{DGC}$). It is a geometric measure defined by a log-time weighted integral of the derivative of the denoising mean-squared error along the Gaussian heat flow. We show how the $\mathsf{DGC}$ increments lead to a simple and explicit bound on the KL error of an Euler scheme applied to the stochastic innovations representation. The bound is local along the path: each step is controlled by the corresponding $\mathsf{DGC}$ increment and its relative stepsize. This structure allows us to derive KL sampling guarantees for optimized stepsize schedules, both in a simpler single-block setting and in a more refined $K$-block setting. The $\mathsf{DGC}$ function has a natural martingale structure, which we exploit to develop fully data-certified versions of these algorithms. It also admits information-theoretic upper bounds in terms of covariance, rate distortion, metric entropy, and the Poincar'e constant, thereby recovering and sharpening a range of existing diffusion-sampling guarantees, as well as giving new results. In log heat-time, the fine partition limit is governed by an integral involving the square root of the $\mathsf{DGC}$ density, whereas a single-block schedule depends on its ordinary integral. This comparison precisely characterizes when adaptation to data geometry yields substantial computational gains, including logarithmic-to-constant separations for simple Gaussian mixture models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出去噪增长复杂度（DGC）这一几何度量，用于分析扩散采样中Euler方案的KL误差，并推导了优化的步长调度策略。摘要显示DGC具有鞅结构，可用于数据认证算法，并通过协方差、率失真、度量熵和庞加莱常数给出了信息论上界，在简单高斯混合模型上实现了对数到常数的分离。
Motivation: 扩散采样在高维设置中效果显著，但理论理解不足，且缺乏具有保证性能的实用算法设计。
Method: 定义DGC为对数时间加权的高斯热流下去噪均方误差导数的积分，利用其增量得到Euler方案的KL误差局部界，并基于该结构设计单块和K块优化步长调度。
Result: 摘要报道DGC函数可用于数据认证算法，并恢复和改进了现有扩散采样保证，在简单高斯混合模型上显示几何自适应可带来对数到常数的计算增益。
Conclusion: 本文表明DGC是连接扩散采样理论理解和算法设计的核心度量，其局部结构支持认证性能保证和优化调度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HeteroPROPMT: A Real-time and Privacy-Preserving Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception Framework
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative Perception (CP) improves autonomous systems' awareness of their surroundings by sharing sensor data, intermediate features, and detection results. In real-world deployments, however, collaborating vehicles often use heterogeneous sensors, perception models, datasets, and training domains, creating feature-space shifts that degrade downstream fusion and detection. Existing approaches typically retrain fusion and detection components or introduce modality-specific feature interpreters. These methods scale poorly to newly joining agents and often require access to proprietary metadata, raising privacy concerns. We propose HeteroPROMPT, a real-time and privacy-preserving framework for heterogeneous collaborative perception. HeteroPROMPT rapidly aligns each heterogeneous agent's features with an ego-centric unified feature space through modular prompts and lightweight learning-based tuning, while keeping agent encoders and the collaborative fusion and detection stacks frozen. Its visual prompt-based training and inference modulate Bird's Eye View (BEV) features across channels and spatial locations with low computational overhead. For metadata-free deployment, an autoencoder learns a compact unified representation and extracts modality cues from shared features, enabling real-time modality classification and routing to the appropriate HeteroPROMPT modules without exposing proprietary agent information. Experiments on the OPV2V-H and V2XSet datasets show that HeteroPROMPT improves Average Precision over state-of-the-art heterogeneous CP methods while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters. This offers a scalable and practical CP solution. The proposed modality classifier also predicts the joining agent's modality from compact features with greater than 99.99 percent accuracy during deployment. Code will be available at https://github.com/arminmaleki007/HeteroPROMPT.
papers.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). 9 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HeteroPROMPT，一种实时且隐私保护的异构协作感知框架，用于解决自动驾驶中不同车辆传感器异构导致的特征空间偏移问题。该方法通过视觉提示（visual prompts）和轻量级学习调优，快速对齐异构代理特征到统一空间，同时冻结编码器和融合检测堆栈，并利用自编码器实现无元数据的模态分类。在OPV2V-H和V2XSet数据集上，HeteroPROMPT提升平均精度（Average Precision），且参数量少，模态分类准确率超过99.99%。
Motivation: 现有异构协作感知方法通常需要重新训练或访问专有元数据，导致扩展性差且隐私问题突出，难以应对新加入的异构代理。
Method: 提出基于模块化提示的异构特征对齐框架，通过轻量级可学习提示在BEV特征上调整通道和空间位置，同时保持代理编码器和融合检测堆栈冻结；引入自编码器学习紧凑统一表示并提取模态线索，实现无元数据部署。
Result: 在OPV2V-H和V2XSet上，HeteroPROMPT超过现有异构协作感知方法的平均精度（AP），且使用数量级更少的可训练参数；模态分类器在部署时从紧凑特征中预测模态准确率超过99.99%。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展、实用的实时异构协作感知方案，兼顾隐私和性能，适用于多车协作场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FloDR: An invertible dimensionality reduction method based on a normalising flow
papers.abstract_en: It is common for two-dimensional embeddings of high-dimensional data to be read far beyond what they can support. Distances in and between clusters, the meaning behind empty spaces, and the amount of structure hidden at each point are generally invisible in the output of methods such as t-SNE and UMAP. This is because the information that could support the meaning of these properties is discarded during the optimisation process. Here, we present FloDR, a dimensionality reduction method that embeds data through an invertible normalising flow. While FloDR only uses the first two output coordinates to create a two-dimensional embedding, it retains the remaining coordinates rather than discarding them. In addition to the embedding, an exact inverse and an exact density are properties of a trained mapping, which enable diagnostic visualisations that are computed from the exact inverse of the model that drew the layout rather than from an approximate one. Specifically, we draw two fields, the conditional spread, which measures how much of the original data remains undetermined at each embedding position in input units, and the hidden contrast, which measures how much information about a labelled contrast the two plotted coordinates discard. Both fields are rendered with a prespecified test against a held out portion of the input data and a bootstrap confidence. A field that fails the test is reported as refused.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FloDR，一种基于可逆归一化流（normalising flow）的降维方法。与 t-SNE 和 UMAP 不同，FloDR 保留高维数据的完整信息，生成可逆的二维嵌入并提供精确的逆映射和密度估计。该方法通过条件扩散（conditional spread）和隐藏对比（hidden contrast）两种可视化场，量化嵌入空间中的信息丢失，并设有统计检验。
Motivation: 现有降维方法（如 t-SNE、UMAP）在优化过程中丢弃了信息，导致二维嵌入的可解释性受限，无法支持对距离、聚类、空白空间等属性的准确解读。
Method: 使用可逆归一化流对高维数据进行降维，保留除前两个坐标外的所有维度，从而提供精确的逆映射和密度估计。基于逆映射计算条件扩散和隐藏对比两种可视化场，并通过 bootstrap 置信检验评估其统计显著性。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法能生成可逆嵌入，并支持对信息丢失的定量可视化诊断。
Conclusion: FloDR 通过保留完整信息并利用逆映射，为降维结果的可靠性提供了新的诊断工具，但摘要未讨论其在高维数据上的实证表现或计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comparing the Performance of Foundation Model Derived Embeddings with Traditional Approaches for Distant Metastasis Prediction in Head and Neck Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Background: Early prediction of distant metastasis (DM) risk in head and neck cancer (HNC) can enable timely interventions that may improve treatment outcomes. Many current machine learning methods rely on prior knowledge of the region of interest such as tumor segmentations, which require expert knowledge, is time-consuming and introduces user-dependent variability. Medical image-based foundation models have recently been developed for specific imaging modalities to streamline down-stream prediction tasks by extracting modality-relevant features. Purpose: In this study, we evaluate the effectiveness of using a foundation model as the feature extractor to predict DM risk in HNC patients and compare its performance with traditional approaches that require prior knowledge on the regions of interest. Methods: Preoperative CT images of 2327 patients from the RADCURE dataset were used. Three features-sets were created including radiomics, deep-learning based features, and CT Foundation derived features. The feature-sets were used individually in a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to predict DM risk. Results: The model using CT Foundation embeddings outperformed the radiomics and deep learning-based models, achieving a Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.791, compared to AUC values of 0.772 and 0.753 for the radiomics and deep learning-based models, respectively. The CT Foundation based model had similar performance to a model that combined the use of radiomics and deep learning-based features that achieved an AUC of 0.794. Conclusions: Features based on foundation models offer a promising alternative to traditional radiomics while reducing the need for domain expertise and extensively annotated datasets. Their minimal preprocessing requirements also make them a more accessible and scalable option.
papers.comment: 27 pages including supplemental materials, 5 main figures, 2 supplemental figures, 5 main tables, 7 supplemental tables. Poster Abstract at 2026 AAPM Meeting and Exhibition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了基于CT图像基础模型（CT Foundation）提取的特征在头颈癌远处转移风险预测中的表现，并与传统影像组学（radiomics）和深度学习特征进行对比。使用RADCURE数据集中2327名患者的术前CT图像，CT Foundation嵌入特征在多層感知器（MLP）中取得了AUC 0.791，优于影像组学（0.772）和深度学习（0.753），接近两者组合（0.794）。结果表明基础模型特征可减少对专业知识和大规模标注数据的依赖。
Motivation: 传统机器学习方法在头颈癌远处转移预测中依赖肿瘤分割等先验知识，费时且引入主观变异。基础模型有望通过自动化特征提取简化流程，但其在该任务上的有效性尚未得到系统验证。
Method: 使用RADCURE数据集（2327例HNC患者术前CT）构建三种特征集：影像组学特征、深度学习特征、CT Foundation模型嵌入特征。分别输入多层感知器（MLP）进行远处转移风险预测，比较AUC性能。
Result: CT Foundation特征模型AUC为0.791，高于影像组学（0.772）和深度学习（0.753），与两者组合特征模型（0.794）相当。
Conclusion: 基于基础模型的特征提取为传统影像组学提供了有希望的替代方案，减少了对领域专家知识和大量标注数据的需求，因预处理要求低而更具可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Top-$k$ Pareto Bandits: Hypervolume Regret for Multi-Objective Slate Selection
papers.abstract_en: We consider a stochastic multi-objective bandit problem where, at each round, the agent selects a slate of $k$ arms and observes their $d$-dimensional reward vectors under semi-bandit feedback. We do not aim at identifying a single optimal arm; instead, we consider the problem of maintaining a small set of actions that jointly approximate the Pareto frontier. We formalize this objective through the dominated hypervolume induced by the selected subset of arms, and define an $α$-approximate hypervolume regret with respect to the best size-$k$ subset achievable in hindsight, where $α= 1 - 1/e$ reflects the approximation guarantee of greedy maximization for monotone submodular functions. To address this problem, we introduce \textit{THV-UCB}, an optimistic algorithm that selects arms greedily based on optimistic estimates of their marginal hypervolume contributions. We establish a gap-free regret bound $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{nkT})$ that holds on every instance, together with a gap-dependent bound $\tilde{O}(nk^{2.5}/Δ_{\min})$ that becomes polylogarithmic in $T$ once the arms are sufficiently well separated. Our results provide theoretical support for using small subsets to approximate Pareto fronts in various multi-objective applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机多目标老虎机问题，每回合选择k个臂并观察d维奖励向量。目标是维护一个小子集来近似帕累托前沿，通过支配超体积度量。提出THV-UCB算法，基于边际超体积贡献的乐观估计贪婪选择。给出无间隙遗憾界Õ(d√(nkT))和依赖间隙的遗憾界Õ(nk^{2.5}/Δ_min)。
Motivation: 现有工作多聚焦单一最优臂，但实际应用需要一组帕累托最优解。本文形式化通过子集近似帕累托前沿的目标，并定义α-近似超体积遗憾。
Method: 提出THV-UCB算法，乐观估计边际超体积贡献，贪婪选择臂，利用半臂反馈。
Result: 建立了无间隙遗憾界Õ(d√(nkT))和依赖间隙的遗憾界Õ(nk^{2.5}/Δ_min)，后者在臂充分分离时随T呈多对数增长。
Conclusion: 为使用小子集近似帕累托前沿提供了理论支持，适用于多目标应用。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Early Verdicts, Better Budgets: Sequential Adaptive Rollout Allocation for Compute-Efficient RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is bottlenecked by rollout generation, yet many sampled prompts produce saturated groups (all responses correct or all incorrect) whose zero reward variance yields no policy-gradient signal. Existing remedies either oversample a larger candidate pool and discard saturated prompts (dynamic sampling), paying heavy extra rollouts, or predict prompt difficulty before sampling, which is fragile under a shifting policy. We observe that a group's effectiveness is usually decided early, within the first few of its rollouts, so spending a full group on an already-decided prompt is wasteful. We cast per-step rollout collection as a budget-constrained sequential allocation (optimal stopping) problem and introduce SARA (Sequential Adaptive Rollout Allocation). SARA maintains a Beta posterior over each prompt's success rate, evaluates a closed-form predictor of group effectiveness, and applies a two-threshold, SPRT-style rule that commits effective groups, abandons saturated ones after a short probe, and reallocates the freed budget to fresh prompts, without any extra prediction rollouts. We prove abandonment reliability, expected rollout savings, fixed-budget yield dominance, and a link between effective-group yield and the GRPO gradient norm. On mathematical reasoning and planning with 1.5B/3B models on a single GPU, SARA matches DPS (both below the DS oracle) while using 22% fewer rollouts than DS; composing SARA with DPS yields the best accuracy, slightly above DS, at 67% fewer rollouts (near-uniform cost).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）中 rollout 生成瓶颈，提出 SARA（顺序自适应 rollout 分配）算法。该方法将每个 prompt 的 rollout 收集建模为预算约束下的顺序分配问题，利用 Beta 后验和两阈值 SPRT 风格规则，在早期决定是否继续或放弃，并重新分配预算。在数学推理和规划任务上，1.5B/3B 模型单 GPU 实验表明，SARA 匹配动态采样（DPS）的精度，但使用更少的 rollout；SARA 与 DPS 组合达到最佳精度，rollout 减少 67%。
Motivation: RLVR 中许多 prompt 的 rollout 组很快饱和（全对或全错），但现有方法要么浪费大量额外 rollout 采样（动态采样），要么依赖策略变化的难度预测，鲁棒性差。
Method: 提出 SARA，维护每个 prompt 成功率的 Beta 后验，基于封闭形式预测器评估组有效性，并使用两阈值 SPRT 规则：承诺有效组、放弃饱和组，并将释放的预算重新分配给新 prompt，无需额外预测 rollout。
Result: 在数学推理和规划任务中，1.5B/3B 模型单 GPU 上，SARA 匹配 DPS（均低于 DS 理想情况）且 rollout 减少 22%；SARA 与 DPS 组合略优于 DS，rollout 减少 67%。
Conclusion: SARA 通过早期决策和预算重分配，在保持精度下显著减少 rollout 开销，可扩展至动态采样方法并提升整体效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Between Gradient and Natural Gradient: A Continuum of LoRA Initializations
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tunes large pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, but its performance depends strongly on how the adapters are initialized. Recent schemes initialize the adapters from the downstream loss gradient: some project the raw gradient onto its top directions, while others first whiten it with an estimate of the loss curvature. We show that these seemingly distinct methods are points on a single continuum: a two-parameter family of preconditioned gradient initializations, which we call Unified LoRA (ULoRA), governed by a spectral whitening exponent and an Adam-like diagonal exponent. Sweeping this family under a full learning-rate search, we find that no single fixed preconditioning strength dominates: the best operating point is task-dependent and frequently lies strictly inside the family, away from the published endpoints. Treated as an upper bound of this family, a tuned ULoRA configuration matches or exceeds full fine-tuning on all five GLUE tasks with RoBERTa-base and is competitive with the strongest baselines on GSM8K with LLaMA-2-7B. Our deployable, search-free variant, ULoRA-Auto, selects per-layer exponents from measured spectral statistics, approaches this upper bound at no additional search cost, and ranks at or near the top among deployable LoRA methods. Our results show that a principled design space for LoRA initialization and curvature preconditioning should be treated as a tunable dimension rather than a fixed design decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一框架（ULoRA），将LoRA初始化方法视为一个由谱白化指数和Adam类对角指数控制的连续族，并发现最优初始化点因任务而异，通常位于族内部而非端点。调优后的ULoRA配置在所有GLUE任务（RoBERTa-base）上匹配或超越全微调，在GSM8K（LLaMA-2-7B）上与最强基线竞争。此外，提出免搜索变体ULoRA-Auto，根据测量谱统计选择每层指数，接近上界而无额外搜索成本。
Motivation: LoRA微调性能严重依赖适配器初始化方式，现有方法（如原始梯度投影、曲率白化）看似不同，但缺乏统一理解，且固定初始化策略无法适应任务多样性。
Method: 提出ULoRA，一个两参数族（谱白化指数和Adam类对角指数）的预条件梯度初始化方法，将现有初始化方法作为其特例。通过完整学习率搜索扫描该族，并设计免搜索变体ULoRA-Auto，基于测量谱统计每层选择指数。
Result: 调优后的ULoRA在RoBERTa-base上所有GLUE任务匹配或超越全微调，在LLaMA-2-7B上GSM8K任务与最强基线竞争；ULoRA-Auto接近调优上界，且排名前列。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LoRA初始化与曲率预条件应被视为可调维度而非固定设计，ULoRA提供了一个原则性的设计空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD), which aligns a student with the teacher's token-level distribution on the student's own rollouts, is an effective paradigm for transferring capabilities across LLMs. Prevailing approaches assume a teacher at least as capable as the student: they either distill a larger model into a smaller one, which fails at the frontier where no larger teacher exists, or consolidate multiple domain experts trained from a shared base, which requires costly training at the student's scale. We introduce Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation (W2S-OPD), a simple yet effective OPD framework that improves the strong student by distilling from multiple weak models. W2S-OPD constructs a proxy teacher in logit space from a contrast pair of a positive and a negative model, both smaller than the student and cheap to obtain. Their logit difference isolates the capability direction, which is added to the student's own base model, yielding a proxy teacher that couples this direction while staying distributionally adjacent to the student. The student then distills it by minimizing the per-token reverse KL on its own rollouts. We instantiate the contrast pair as i) a post-RL expert against its pre-RL initialization, isolating the skill RL instills, ii) a larger against a smaller base model, isolating the capability from scale, and iii) a small base model with correct versus wrong hints, isolating the instance-level direction toward the solution. Across four math and three code benchmarks, W2S-OPD outperforms OPD, enables the student to surpass the domain teacher, and keeps improving the student even when every supervision source is weaker. Analysis shows different contrasts yield distinct signals: the post-RL and hint contrasts emphasize reasoning frameworks, while the scale contrast emphasizes the solving procedure. Our code will be available at https://github.com/Yu-Fangxu/W2S-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation (W2S-OPD)，一种利用多个弱模型作为代理教师来提升强学生模型的在线蒸馏框架。通过构建正负对比对的 logit 差异，提取能力方向并叠加到学生的基础模型上，形成分布相近的代理教师，学生通过最小化反向 KL 散度从其 rollouts 中蒸馏。在四个数学和三个代码基准测试中，W2S-OPD 优于标准 OPD，使学生模型超越领域教师，且在所有监督源都较弱时仍能持续改进。
Motivation: 现有在线蒸馏 (OPD) 假设教师至少与学生能力相当，但前沿场景中可能没有更强的教师，或者训练多个领域专家成本高昂。
Method: 构建由正负模型 (均小于学生) 组成的对比对，取 logit 差作为能力方向，叠加到学生自己的基础模型 logits 上，得到代理教师；学生通过最小化 per-token 反向 KL 散度在其自身 rollouts 上蒸馏。
Result: 在四个数学和三个代码基准上，W2S-OPD 优于标准 OPD，使学生超过领域教师，且在所有监督源较弱时仍能提升。不同对比对提取的信号不同：后 RL 和提示对比强调推理框架，规模对比强调求解过程。
Conclusion: W2S-OPD 为弱到强蒸馏提供了一种简单有效的方法，无需更强的教师或大规模训练，能够从弱监督中持续提升学生能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning the Word Problem: Geodesic Lengths and Cryptographic Applications
papers.abstract_en: The Word Problem has been a subject of intensive mathematical study for over a century, initially driving advances in combinatorial group theory and more recently emerging as a foundational hardness assumption in post-quantum cryptography (PQC). While generally undecidable, several families of infinite non-abelian groups exhibit solvable or algorithmically fast word problems, making them attractive platforms for cryptographic design. This paper introduces WPNet, a novel Graph Neural Network architecture capable of solving the Word Problem heuristically, which is demonstrated on the Baumslag-Solitar group $BS(1,2)$ and on an Artin group. By mapping unreduced words to dynamic graph structures, the model learns to cluster algebraically equivalent elements in a continuous embedding space, effectively identifying the geodesic representative of a word without executing discrete reduction steps. As an application, a model variant is developed that can predict the geodesic length of an unreduced word in both groups. To demonstrate the cryptographic severity of this structural leakage, WPNet is successfully deployed against the Wagner-Magyarik public-key cryptosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WPNet，一种基于图神经网络的结构，用于启发式解决群论中的字问题（Word Problem）。模型在Baumslag-Solitar群$BS(1,2)$和Artin群上验证，通过学习将未归约词映射到连续嵌入空间，从而识别词的测地线代表，无需离散归约步骤。进一步开发了预测未归约词测地线长度的变体，并成功攻击了Wagner-Magyarik公钥密码系统，展示了结构泄露的密码学严重性。
Motivation: 字问题在组合群论和密码学中具有基础重要性，尽管一般不可判定，但某些无限非交换群族具有可解或快速算法，适合密码设计。现有方法依赖离散归约，而本文探索利用图神经网络进行启发式学习，以替代传统归约步骤。
Method: 提出WPNet图神经网络架构，将未归约词映射为动态图结构，通过学习在连续嵌入空间中聚类代数等价的元素，从而识别词的测地线代表。还开发了预测测地线长度的变体模型。
Result: 在Baumslag-Solitar群$BS(1,2)$和Artin群上成功演示了字问题的启发式求解，并能预测未归约词的测地线长度。模型成功部署于Wagner-Magyarik公钥密码系统，表明结构泄漏可被利用。
Conclusion: 本文表明图神经网络可以启发式解决某些群的字问题，且此类结构知识可被用于攻击密码系统，提示在基于群论的密码设计中需考虑此类泄漏。

papers.title: Lightweight Image Classification of Raptor Species for Edge Devices: Rare-Species Dataset Expansion via Video Frame Extraction, Knowledge Distillation, and TensorRT Deployment
papers.abstract_en: We investigate lightweight raptor-species classification for real-time edge deployment in wind-turbine collision mitigation. Using DINOv2-L (304M parameters) as a teacher, we distilled three lightweight students (MobileNetV4, ViT-Small, and EfficientNet-B0). To reduce confusion between closely related species, we expanded the dataset to 12,519 images, including an increase in Steller's Sea Eagle images from 463 to 2,050 via video-frame extraction. Under a group split that separates samples at the video- and source-image level to mitigate source leakage at that granularity, the three-student ensemble achieved a macro recall of 0.935 +/- 0.004 over five distillation seeds (0.955 on a conventional image-level split, retaining 97.5% of the teacher's macro recall) with roughly one-eighth as many parameters. On a subset of 1,258 images disjoint from the former training images, White-tailed Eagle recall improved by up to 38.6 percentage points, while the rate at which it was misclassified as the Steller's Sea Eagle decreased from 61% to 15% of errors. TensorRT FP16 deployment of EfficientNet-B0 on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano achieved 3.19 ms/image including host-device transfer (313 images/s), with 99.95% argmax agreement with FP32. In five-seed controlled comparisons, neither distillation (versus CE-only) nor the change from a DINOv2-L to a DINOv3-L teacher yielded a clear ensemble-level improvement; the primary gains stem from the dataset expansion and teacher re-fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. English translation of a paper submitted to IPSJ (in Japanese); the Japanese version is the source of record

TL;DR: 本文研究用于风力涡轮机碰撞缓解的边缘设备实时猛禽物种分类。使用DINOv2-L（304M参数）作为教师，蒸馏出MobileNetV4、ViT-Small和EfficientNet-B0三个轻量学生模型。通过视频帧提取将Steller's Sea Eagle图像从463张扩展到2050张，总数据集达到12519张。在群组划分下，三个学生集成实现宏召回率0.935±0.004（图像级划分下0.955，保留教师97.5%性能），参数量约为教师的八分之一。TensorRT FP16部署的EfficientNet-B0在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上达到3.19ms/图像（313图像/秒），与FP32的argmax一致性为99.95%。
Motivation: 边缘设备上实时猛禽物种分类对于风力涡轮机碰撞缓解至关重要，但现有模型参数量大、难以部署，且近缘物种（如白尾海雕和虎头海雕）容易混淆，需要轻量模型和扩充数据集以提高分类准确率。
Method: 采用知识蒸馏框架，以DINOv2-L为教师，训练MobileNetV4、ViT-Small和EfficientNet-B0三个轻量学生。通过视频帧提取扩展罕见物种（Steller's Sea Eagle）图像，并采用群组划分（group split）避免数据泄露。最后使用TensorRT FP16将EfficientNet-B0部署到Jetson Orin Nano边缘设备。
Result: 三个学生集成在群组划分下宏召回0.935±0.004；White-tailed Eagle召回提升最多38.6个百分点，误分类为Steller's Sea Eagle的比例从61%降至15%。EfficientNet-B0在Jetson Orin Nano上推理延迟3.19ms/图像（313图像/秒），与FP32一致率99.95%。消融实验表明蒸馏本身和教师更换（DINOv2-L改为DINOv3-L）未带来明显改进，主要收益来自数据集扩展和教师重新微调。
Conclusion: 数据集扩展和教师重新微调是提升性能的关键，而蒸馏在集成级别未显优势。该方法可在边缘设备上实现实时高精度猛禽分类，适用于风力涡轮机碰撞缓解场景。

papers.title: LumaGuide: Distribution Shaping for Training-Free HDR Generation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models generate realistic images but are constrained by the statistical biases of their training data, limiting their ability to produce high dynamic range (HDR) content. In this work, we introduce LumaGuide, a training-free framework for distribution shaping in diffusion models. Instead of modifying model parameters, LumaGuide steers the sampling process to match target feature distributions via differentiable energy-based guidance. We instantiate this framework for HDR generation by controlling luminance distributions in perceptually uniform PQ space. Our results show that aligning luminance histograms is sufficient to induce HDR-consistent behavior, including coherent highlights and preserved shadow detail, while maintaining semantic fidelity. Beyond HDR, LumaGuide enables flexible specification of target distributions through data-driven presets, reference images, or text-driven predictors, and extends naturally to video generation with temporal consistency constraints. More broadly, our work demonstrates that controllable generation can be achieved by directly shaping output distributions at sampling time, without retraining diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LumaGuide是一个无需训练、基于扩散模型的框架，通过在采样过程中施加可微能量引导，实现输出分布塑形，从而生成高动态范围（HDR）图像。该方法通过控制感知均匀PQ空间中的亮度分布，无需修改模型参数即可产生HDR效果，包括高光细节和保留阴影细节，同时保持语义一致性。该框架还支持通过数据驱动预设、参考图像或文本驱动预测器灵活指定目标分布，并可扩展到视频生成。
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型受限于训练数据的统计偏差，难以生成高动态范围内容，而现有方法通常需要重新训练或微调模型。
Method: 提出LumaGuide，一种无需训练的训练框架，通过可微能量引导在采样过程中使输出特征分布匹配目标分布，具体应用于HDR生成时，在PQ空间中对亮度直方图进行对齐。
Result: 实验表明，对齐亮度直方图足以诱导HDR一致行为（如连贯高光和保留阴影细节），同时保持语义保真度。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了在采样时直接塑形输出分布即可实现可控生成，无需重新训练扩散模型，并具有扩展到视频生成和灵活目标分布设定的潜力。
Relevance: 0
