papers.title: SimpleWikiSearch: A Clean Offline Wikipedia Environment for Agentic Search
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agentic search systems are often evaluated as if the underlying LLM were the only component that matters, yet their measured performance also depends on the surrounding search environment: the Wikipedia snapshot, preprocessing pipeline, chunking policy, retrieval backend, tool schema, observation format, and answer submission rule. These details are frequently under-specified, making it difficult to compare results or reproduce reported baselines. We present SimpleWikiSearch, whose corpus construction, retrieval stack, tool contract, and evaluation protocol are explicit and runnable. The environment starts from a full English Wikipedia dump, cleans and chunks the corpus, builds keyword and dense retrieval indexes, and exposes a minimal tool interface consisting of \texttt{search}, \texttt{open\_url}, and \texttt{submit\_answer}. We report baseline results on six QA datasets using open-source LLMs and provide a random-300 subset for comparisons with closed-source commercial models. SimpleWikiSearch provides a domain-specific agent harness and a controlled offline environment for reproducible agentic-search evaluation. Its contribution is this specified reference setup, rather than a new agent algorithm. Code and data will be available at: https://github.com/JimXiongGM/simple_wiki_search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能搜索系统中环境细节（如Wikipedia快照、预处理管道、分块策略、检索后端等）常被忽略导致难以比较和复现的问题，提出了SimpleWikiSearch——一个明确且可运行的离线搜索环境。它从完整的英文Wikipedia转储开始，进行清洗、分块、构建关键词和稠密检索索引，并暴露三个工具接口（search, open_url, submit_answer）。在六个QA数据集上使用开源LLM报告了基线结果，并提供了随机300子集用于与闭源商业模型比较。该工作的贡献在于提供了一个可复现的参考设置，而非新的智能体算法。
Motivation: 当前基于LLM的智能搜索系统评估常将LLM视为唯一关键因素，但实际性能受搜索环境（Wikipedia快照、预处理、分块策略、检索后端、工具模式、观察格式、答案提交规则等）影响，这些细节常未明确说明，导致结果难以比较和基线复现。
Method: SimpleWikiSearch构建流程：从完整英文Wikipedia转储开始，进行清洗和分块，构建关键词和稠密检索索引，暴露最小工具接口（search, open_url, submit_answer），并提供领域特定的智能体框架和受控离线环境。
Result: 在六个QA数据集上使用开源LLM报告了基线结果，并提供了一个随机300子集用于与闭源商业模型比较。
Conclusion: SimpleWikiSearch贡献在于提供了一个明确、可运行且可复现的参考设置，而非新的智能体算法，旨在促进智能搜索评估的标准化和可复现性。

papers.title: AI Security Priorities: A Field-Wide Agenda
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems are rapidly integrated into critical economic, governmental, and national security functions, the gap between AI adoption and AI security readiness continues to widen. This paper presents a prioritized agenda for advancing AI security, informed by structured interviews with leaders across industry, government, and civil society, and refined through a multi-sector expert workshop. Participants identified and ranked the highest-importance and most cost-effective areas where progress could strengthen AI security - from protecting frontier AI systems and their underlying infrastructure to improving cybersecurity practices as AI reshapes the threat landscape. The resulting priorities are organized across four themes: establishing strategic foundations and policy frameworks; advancing public-private coordination and institutional infrastructure; advancing technical security engineering and assurance; and governing agentic AI under adversarial pressure. For each priority area, expert authors provide detailed analyses that define the problem, assess the current landscape, and identify actionable projects that stakeholders across sectors can pursue. The paper aims to serve as an initial practical foundation for coordinated investment and action across the AI security field. It is designed to serve both current practitioners and individuals and organizations looking to enter the field by identifying concrete, high-impact contributions suited to a range of strengths and capacities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过结构化访谈和多部门专家研讨会，识别并排序了AI安全领域的高优先级和成本高效领域，提出了涵盖战略基础、公私协调、技术工程和代理AI治理四个主题的行动议程，旨在为跨部门协调投资提供实用基础。
Motivation: AI系统快速融入关键经济、政府和国家安全功能，但安全准备不足，需要制定优先行动计划以缩小差距。
Method: 采用结构化访谈和多部门专家研讨会，收集行业、政府、民间社会领袖意见，识别并排序高重要性、高成本效益的AI安全领域。

Conclusion: 论文旨在为AI安全领域的协调投资和行动提供初始实用基础，服务于当前从业者和新进入者。

papers.title: The Human Utility Factor: A Computable Welfare Metric That Reframes AI Governance as a Constrained Optimisation Problem
papers.abstract_en: Existing AI governance frameworks, including the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, address safety, transparency, and accountability but do not operationalize quantitative constraints on macro-socioeconomic stability. As a result, AI systems may satisfy regulatory requirements while contributing to labor displacement, rising inequality, and reduced economic resilience. We introduce the Human Utility Factor (HUF), a differentiable welfare metric that models the interaction between Agency, Wellbeing, and Economic Stability as functions of three actionable policy levers: automation depth, redistribution intensity, and employment coverage. HUF yields a closed-form optimal automation level and a minimum redistribution threshold below which no level of automation is welfare-positive, transforming high-level governance objectives into computable constraints. We evaluate HUF using a three-agent multi-agent reinforcement learning framework across U.S., Canadian, and Nordic policy regimes. Both analytical and PPO-based agents identify welfare-optimal operating regions and reveal a critical failure mode: welfare metrics that do not explicitly constrain redistribution can converge to high-automation equilibria that satisfy the metric while undermining its intended societal objectives. Our results suggest that AI governance is fundamentally a constrained optimization problem rather than a compliance exercise. HUF provides a quantitative framework for evaluating automation policies, identifying socioeconomic stability boundaries, and supporting governance decisions under accelerating AI deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出人类效用因子（Human Utility Factor, HUF），一个可微的福利度量指标，将AI治理建模为有约束的优化问题。HUF将代理、福祉和经济稳定性作为自动化深度、再分配强度和就业覆盖三个政策杠杆的函数，导出封闭形式的最优自动化水平和最小再分配阈值。通过美、加、北欧政策体制下的多智能体强化学习评估，发现未约束再分配的福利度量会导致高自动化均衡而破坏社会目标。
Motivation: 现有AI治理框架（如EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF）缺乏对宏观社会经济稳定性的量化约束，导致合规的AI系统仍可能造成劳动力替代、不平等加剧和经济韧性下降。
Method: 定义HUF为代理、福祉和经济稳定性的可微函数，依赖于三个政策杠杆；通过解析求解最优自动化水平和最小再分配阈值，并使用多智能体强化学习（PPO）在三种政策体制下仿真验证。
Result: 解析和基于PPO的智能体均识别出福利最优运行区域，并揭示关键失效模式：未明确约束再分配的福利度量会收敛到高自动化均衡，反而破坏其预期社会目标。
Conclusion: AI治理本质上是约束优化问题而非合规练习；HUF提供了评估自动化政策、识别社会经济稳定性边界和支持治理决策的量化框架。

papers.title: The Easy Trap: Why LLMs Underestimate Misconception-Driven Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for estimating item difficulty in educational assessment. However, it remains unclear whether such estimates reflect how learners actually experience difficulty. This study investigates the alignment between LLM-generated difficulty ratings and empirical student performance on basic mathematics tasks. Four widely used LLM-based systems generated difficulty ratings on a 1-100 scale for 32 arithmetic items across multiple runs (N = 640 ratings). These were compared with empirical difficulty derived from responses of 770 Indonesian undergraduates using Classical Test Theory (CTT) and Item Response Theory (2PL). Results show moderate rank correlations (Spearman's rho = 0.52-0.70), indicating that LLMs capture coarse ordering of item difficulty. However, substantial and systematic misalignment emerges in fraction items. Several items consistently rated as easy by LLMs were among the most difficult for students, such as an item with only 34.16% correct for 100 : 1/2. We argue that LLMs approximate curricular difficulty, or what should be easy based on instructional sequencing, rather than cognitive difficulty driven by learner misconceptions. This leads to systematic underestimation of misconception-driven items, a phenomenon we term the Easy Trap. These findings highlight a critical limitation of LLM-based difficulty estimation and suggest that relying on such estimates without empirical grounding may introduce bias in assessment design and adaptive systems.
papers.comment: This paper poster presented on 19th Educational Data Mining Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在教育评估中估计题目难度的能力，发现LLMs能粗略排序项目难度（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.52-0.70），但在分数运算等由误解驱动的题目上系统性地低估难度，即“Easy Trap”现象。
Motivation: 现有LLMs被用于评估题目难度，但其估计是否反映学生的真实认知困难尚不明确，可能导致评估偏差。
Method: 使用四种LLM系统对32道算术题进行1-100评分（N=640评分），与770名印度尼西亚大学生的实证表现基于经典测试理论（CTT）和项目反应理论（2PL）获得的难度进行比较。
Result: LLM评分与实证难度的秩相关中等（斯皮尔曼rho=0.52-0.70），但分数题目显著低估难度，如100:1/2题正确率仅34.16%，却被LLM评为简单。
Conclusion: LLMs近似课程难度（基于教学顺序的应有难度）而非认知难度，导致对误解驱动题目的系统性低估，突显了LLM难度估计的关键局限性。

papers.title: Do Methods Support the Claims? Intra-Paper Verification for Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: The growing volume of scientific submissions has motivated interest in using large language models (LLMs) to assist peer review. Existing automated novelty assessment approaches typically compare a paper's claimed contributions against prior literature, implicitly assuming that these contributions are accurately realized in the work itself. Human reviewers, however, frequently challenge novelty claims not because similar ideas already exist, but because the methodological evidence presented in the paper does not adequately support them. This internal mismatch between claimed contributions and methodological realization is rarely examined by current LLM-based review systems. To address this gap, we introduce intra-paper claim verification, a framework that evaluates whether novelty claims articulated in a paper are substantiated by the methods used to realize them. The framework employs an LLM to extract novelty claims from the introduction, retrieve claim-relevant methodological evidence, and assess whether the methods substantiate the stated contributions. Assessment is guided by reviewer-inspired evaluation criteria derived inductively from human peer reviews collected from 182 ICLR 2025 papers. These criteria capture recurring reviewer concerns related to novelty, methodology, clarity, and other issues and are used to generate structured reviewer-style assessments of claim substantiation. We evaluate the framework by comparing LLM-generated review comments against human reviewer concerns on a balanced subset of accepted and rejected papers. Human evaluation demonstrates significant alignment between framework-generated assessments and human reviewer concerns, particularly for novelty-related issues. BERTScore further distinguishes corresponding human-LLM review pairs from mismatched controls, indicating that the framework captures concerns consistent with human reviewer observations.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Source code, prompts, evaluation materials, and supporting data available at https://github.com/Ranjitha2493/intra-paper-claim-method-verification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向同行评审的论文内部声明验证框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）从引言中提取新颖性声明，检索方法学证据，并评估方法是否支持声明。评估基于从182篇ICLR 2025论文的人类评审中归纳的评审标准，生成结构化评审意见。人类评估显示框架生成的意见与人类评审关注点显著一致，尤其在新颖性问题上。
Motivation: 现有LLM辅助审稿系统通常仅将论文声明与已有文献对比，忽略了声明与论文内部方法证据之间的不匹配，而人类评审常因方法证据不足而质疑新颖性声明。
Method: 框架包含三步：用LLM从引言提取新颖性声明；检索与声明相关的方法学证据；基于从人类评审中归纳的评估标准（涵盖新颖性、方法论、清晰度等），生成结构化的声明验证评审意见。
Result: 在收录与拒稿论文平衡子集上，人类评估显示框架生成的评审意见与人类评审关注点显著对齐（尤其新颖性相关）；BERTScore能区分对应的人机评审对与错配对照。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了利用LLM进行论文内部声明-方法一致性验证的可行性，但局限性可能包括依赖LLM的提取和评估能力、评估标准覆盖范围等。

papers.title: When Kernel Ridge Regression Meets the Hölder-Zygmund Class: Minimax Optimality and Failure of Properness
papers.abstract_en: We study kernel ridge regression for nonparametric regression over the Hölder-Zygmund class. Using an RKHS equivalent to a Sobolev space of smoothness s+d/2, we prove that misspecified KRR attains the minimax L2 rate n^{-2s/(2s+d)}. We also show that properness fails in the Hölder-Zygmund norm: even for the zero regression function with Gaussian noise, the expected squared Hölder-Zygmund norm of the KRR noise component grows as log n.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究核岭回归在Hölder-Zygmund类上的非参数回归，证明当核的平滑度与真实函数类不匹配时，KRR仍能达到极小极大L2收敛速率n^{-2s/(2s+d)}。同时指出，在Hölder-Zygmund范数下，即使回归函数为零且噪声为高斯，KRR的噪声分量期望平方范数以log n增长，表明properness失效。
Motivation: 分析核岭回归在Hölder-Zygmund类上的最优性，并探讨其properness性质是否成立。
Method: 使用与Sobolev空间等价的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS），推导misspecified KRR的收敛速率和噪声分量行为。
Result: KRR达到极小极大L2速率n^{-2s/(2s+d)}；在Hölder-Zygmund范数下，期望平方范数增长为log n。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，即便模型指定错误，KRR仍是最优的，但在Hölder-Zygmund范数下，properness不成立，这揭示了该范数下估计的困难。

papers.title: The Age of AI Agents Demands A New Scientific Paradigm To Sustain Trustworthy Science
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are becoming autonomous research agents that generate hypotheses, design experiments, and produce discoveries at scales beyond human oversight. As seen by increased submissions to ML venues, the verification gap between scientific output and our ability to check it is already widening, and autonomous agents make it worse by magnitudes given human-agent asymmetry. We argue that science must evolve its verification infrastructure, as it has before with peer review. However, while historical adaptations assumed human contributors who could be questioned and sanctioned, AI agents break this assumption. We propose criteria for an adapted verification infrastructure that emphasizes observable-by-default workflows, scalable verification, and clear attribution. We argue that without adaptation, ML and any scientific domain using agents face dangerous failures: experimental results that no person can verify, optimization for metrics over understanding, and accountability vacuums that erode scientific trust.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026, Position Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出随着AI系统成为自主研究代理，科学验证面临巨大鸿沟，因为人类无法有效核实AI产生的实验结果。作者提出科学界需调整验证基础设施，强调可观测、可扩展和清晰归因的标准，以维持可信的科学。
Motivation: AI代理在科研中的自主性日益增强，导致实验结果超出人类验证能力，传统基于可问责人类的验证机制失效，可能引发科学信任危机。
Method: 通过分析AI代理的特征（规模、不可观测性、不可问责性），提出适应性的验证基础设施应具备三个标准：默认可观测的工作流、可扩展的验证、以及清晰的归责机制。
Result: 论文不包含实证结果，而是提出一个分析框架和标准，指出若不改造验证流程，ML及依赖代理的科学领域将面临实验结果不可验证、指标优化取代理解、责任真空等危险。
Conclusion: 结论强调科学界必须主动调整验证基础设施以应对AI代理的挑战，否则将严重侵蚀科学信任。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Archetypes or ability? Clustering for modelling student mathematical competence
papers.abstract_en: Personalised learning systems often assume that mathematical ability is combined of discrete abilities, acquired sequentially and dependent upon first acquiring foundational abilities, and students often report different strengths. In this work, we explore the validity of these assumptions by applying clustering methods to a large dataset of 119,034 students, spanning 13 national-level exams sat in the United Kingdom and collected by the platform. Classifying question results as pass or fail, we use a Bernoulli Mixture Model to search for latent populations which would be indicative of discrete skill-sets. We find that few distinct clusters are present in the data and that the dominant factor is overall student ability, which is further supported by the high degree of linear correlation between the probability distributions of the resulting clusters. Our best performing model achieves an accuracy of 78 percent, competitive with more complicated models in the literature whilst being more explainable. Comparing this models performance with logistic regression baselines and with k-nearest neighbours, we find a small improvement when using performance on each individual question as features. This suggests that whilst overall ability level is the dominant factor for predicting performance, small further personalisation improvements can be made by tailoring to a students exact strengths, but that students do not appear to develop strongly differing ability across topics. Our work offers a national scale test of machine learning in education and offers a new benchmark for the field, demonstrating how explainable models can reach competitive performance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用伯努利混合模型对119,034名英国学生的13次国家考试数据进行分析，发现学生数学能力的主要因素是总体能力水平，而非离散的技能集。模型准确率达到78%，与更复杂模型竞争力相当且更具可解释性。
Motivation: 个性化学习系统常假设数学能力由离散技能组成且顺序获取，但学生报告不同优势。本文旨在验证这些假设的合理性。
Method: 将题目结果二值化为通过/未通过，应用伯努利混合模型聚类，搜索表示离散技能集的潜在群体。比较了逻辑回归、k近邻等基线。
Result: 数据中只发现少数不同簇，主要因素是总体能力；聚类概率分布高度线性相关。最佳模型准确率78%，使用每道题表现作为特征时性能小幅提升。
Conclusion: 总体能力水平是预测表现的主导因素，但根据学生具体优势进行小幅个性化改进可行；学生各主题能力差异不大。该工作提供了教育机器学习的全国规模测试和新基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identifying Implicit Bias in LLM-based Chat AI Toward People with Intellectual Disabilities
papers.abstract_en: Background: This work investigates the presence of implicit bias in Large Language Model (LLM)-based chat AI models directed toward people with intellectual disabilities (ID). Objective: The study aims to identify and measure representational differences related to people with ID and examine them to identify implicit biases inherent in AI chat generation technologies. Methods: Utilizing the GPT-4-Turbo model, we requested story-generation based on 10 prompt stems with and without descriptors for ID. This process was repeated using four other LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4o, Meta Llama-3-3-70B-Instruct, Anthropic Claude-3-5-Sonnet, and Mistral-Large-2411). The resulting 25,000 computer-generated stories were analyzed using a separate GPT-4-Turbo model instance to detect differences in how people are represented related to themes of bias described in previous literature. Results: Our findings reveal differences in how people are represented between story datasets with and without ID descriptors. These differences go beyond established characteristics of ID and imply the presence of mostly negative implicit biases. Identified differences related to considering people with ID as younger, with themes of paternalism and infantilization; depicting them as more inspirational and symbolic; as needing help more often, being dependent, and being saved; and having a negative perception of them and more hesitation to include them. Conclusions: These implicit biases are considered within the context of past discrimination towards people with ID and highlight the need for diligence against implicit bias towards people with ID in AI development. This research underscores the importance of assessing and mitigating implicit bias in decision-making technologies to prevent future societal harm.
papers.journal_ref: Karly V. Coffey, Gloria L. Krahn, John P. Hanley, Jacob E. Neely, Identifying implicit bias in LLM-based chat AI toward people with intellectual disabilities, Disability and Health Journal, 2026, 102086, ISSN 1936-6574
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用GPT-4-Turbo等五个LLM生成25,000个故事，对比带有与不带“智力障碍”描述词的文本，发现模型对智力障碍人群表现出负面隐式偏见，包括将其描绘得更年轻、更依赖他人、更被英雄化等。
Motivation: 现有研究较少关注LLM对智力障碍人群的隐式偏见，而这类偏见可能强化社会歧视。
Method: 向GPT-4-Turbo等五个LLM提供10组提示词（每组有/无智力障碍描述），生成故事后使用另一个GPT-4-Turbo实例分析表征差异。
Result: 发现故事中智力障碍群体被表现为更年轻、被家长化、被英雄化、更依赖帮助、更被排斥，且存在负面感知与犹豫态度。
Conclusion: LLM中存在针对智力障碍者的隐式偏见，反映了历史歧视，需要在AI开发中加强检测与缓解。

papers.title: Sim2Win: A Team-Agnostic, Event-Based Pre-Match Outcome Prediction and Tactical Profiling System for Football
papers.abstract_en: Pre-match tactical decision-making in professional football relies heavily on subjective expert analysis and identity-based scouting systems that cannot generalize to unseen teams. This paper presents Sim2Win, a team-agnostic, event-based pre-match tactical recommendation framework that reframes match outcome prediction as a tactical decision-support problem. Using StatsBomb open event data from eleven competitions spanning 178 teams and 1,411 team-match records, Sim2Win constructs five-match rolling tactical profiles, engineers four interpretable tactical feature ratios, clusters team behaviors into eight playstyles via K-Means, and trains thirteen classifiers to estimate win, draw, and loss probabilities from tactical matchup representations. The system operates without team names or identity features, enabling generalization to teams never seen during training. A rigorous Leave-One-Competition-Out (LOCO) evaluation demonstrates that Sim2Win achieves a mean ROC-AUC of 0.704 and mean accuracy of 55.4% on completely unseen teams, outperforming ELO, Pi-Rating, and GAP baselines on all 21 ROC-AUC comparisons and 19 of 21 accuracy comparisons. Among all evaluated models, CatBoost achieved the strongest in-distribution performance with 60.90% accuracy. These findings suggest that behavioral tactical representations provide transferable predictive signal under distribution shift and offer a viable alternative to identity-dependent football prediction systems.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Mouad-Ze/SIM2WIN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Sim2Win系统，一种团队无关的、基于事件的足球赛前战术推荐框架。利用StatsBomb开放事件数据（涵盖178支球队和1411个球队-比赛记录），构建五场滚动战术档案，设计四个可解释的战术特征比率，通过K-Means聚类将球队行为分为八种风格，并训练13个分类器以估计胜、平、负概率。系统不使用球队名称或身份特征，从而能够泛化到未见过的球队。严格的LOCO评估显示，Sim2Win在完全未见球队上平均ROC-AUC为0.704，平均准确率为55.4%，在所有21个ROC-AUC比较和19个准确率比较中优于ELO、Pi-Rating和GAP基线。
Motivation: 赛前战术决策依赖主观专家分析和基于身份的球探系统，无法泛化到未见过的球队，缺乏可迁移的预测方法。
Method: 使用StatsBomb开放事件数据，构建五场滚动战术档案，设计四个可解释的战术比率（如传球率、进攻区域占比等），通过K-Means聚类将球队行为分为八种风格，并训练13个分类器（包括CatBoost等）从战术对阵表示中预测比赛结果。
Result: 在留一联赛（LOCO）评估中，Sim2Win对完全未见球队取得平均ROC-AUC 0.704和平均准确率55.4%，在所有21个ROC-AUC比较和19个准确率比较中超越ELO、Pi-Rating和GAP基线。CatBoost取得最佳分布内性能，准确率60.90%。
Conclusion: 行为战术表示在分布偏移下提供可迁移的预测信号，为身份依赖的足球预测系统提供了可行替代方案。

papers.title: Large-Scale ChatBot Validation Through Customer Digital Twin Simulations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based chatbots are transforming customer service in regulated domains such as banking, but scalable and cost-effective validation remains a critical barrier to safe deployment. We present a two-part contribution for large-scale chatbot validation. First, we introduce a methodology for creating high-fidelity synthetic customer agents (SCAs) as digital twins, grounded in real transactional and conversational data, that enables automatic generation and behavioral conditioning to simulate diverse customer profiles and interaction styles. Evaluation demonstrates that SCAs achieve high semantic alignment with real customers, low hallucination rates, and successful personality trait reproduction with controllable interventions. Second, we develop an SCA-based validation framework combining automated LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, human expert testing, and adversarial probing. Scenario-based validation across emotional states, demographic groups, and linguistic factors confirms robust performance. Our approach was used to validate a customer facing chatbot at a leading UK bank, providing financial institutions with a scalable pathway toward regulatory compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于大规模聊天机器人验证的两部分贡献：创建高保真合成客户代理（SCA）作为数字孪生，以及基于SCA的验证框架。评估显示SCA与真实客户高度语义对齐，幻觉率低，并成功再现人格特质。该框架结合自动LLM-as-a-Judge评估、人类专家测试和对抗性探测，用于验证一家英国领先银行的客户聊天机器人。
Motivation: 基于LLM的聊天机器人在银行等受监管领域改变客户服务，但可扩展且成本有效的验证仍然是安全部署的关键障碍。
Method: 提出方法论创建高保真合成客户代理（SCA）作为数字孪生，基于真实交易和对话数据，实现自动生成和行为条件化以模拟不同客户画像和交互风格。开发了基于SCA的验证框架，结合自动LLM-as-a-Judge评估、人类专家测试和对抗性探测。
Result: 评估表明SCA与真实客户高度语义对齐，幻觉率低，成功再现人格特质且可控制干预。基于场景的验证覆盖情绪状态、人口统计群体和语言因素，确认了鲁棒性能。
Conclusion: 该方法用于验证一家英国领先银行的面向客户聊天机器人，为金融机构提供可扩展的合规路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Sparsity in Frozen Random CNN Feature Extractors for Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We report a striking phenomenon: deep reinforcement learning agents trained with frozen, randomly initialized CNN feature extractors spontaneously develop extremely sparse fully-connected representations, without any sparsity-inducing objective. In the first fully-connected layer (FC1, $3{,}136 \to 64$), agents compress task-relevant information through as few as 1-3 neurons out of 64 for deterministic Pong (5-11 for stochastic Pong), while trainable CNNs activate 55-64 neurons under matched conditions. We establish four principal findings. First, FC1 sparsity scales with task complexity: 1-11 for Pong, 19-26 for Breakout, and $\sim$42 for Space Invaders. Width-scaling confirms this reflects task structure rather than a fixed capacity fraction. Second, within-game scaling emerges: three identical Pong seeds produce 5, 7, and 11 active neurons. The 5-neuron seed plateaus at $+14$ reward, while the others reach expert performance ($+18.4$, $+18.7$), suggesting the random projection's usable dimensionality bounds achievable performance. Third, ablation confirms necessity: removing these active neurons crashes performance across two PPO implementations and four games. Fourth, the information bottleneck commits early: a sweep shows the active set locks by 15-30M steps, while reward turns positive 35-105M steps later. A complementary finding in Breakout shows frozen and trainable CNNs reach competitive rewards via structurally different bottlenecks: frozen agents use 17-25 active neurons (participation ratio $\sim$10-14), while trainable agents use 51 (participation ratio $\sim$3.6). Finally, wherever input dimensionality dwarfs intrinsic task dimensionality, gradient descent on a frozen random projection may reveal the effective rank of the underlying problem without explicit sparsity machinery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一个显著现象：在深度强化学习中，使用冻结的随机初始化CNN特征提取器训练的智能体，会在第一个全连接层自发产生极度稀疏的表示（如Pong任务中仅激活1-3个神经元），且无需任何稀疏性诱导目标。研究通过四个主要发现证实了这一现象与任务复杂度相关、影响性能、且信息瓶颈在早期锁定。
Motivation: 现有强化学习通常使用可训练的CNN，但冻结随机特征提取器能否有效工作及内部表示如何组织尚不明确。
Method: 通过对比冻结与可训练CNN在多个Atari游戏上的表示稀疏性，分析激活神经元数量、性能关系及信息瓶颈锁定时间。
Result: FC1层稀疏性随任务复杂度增加：Pong 1-11个活跃神经元，Breakout 19-26个，Space Invaders ~42个。同一游戏不同种子产生不同稀疏度，且活跃神经元数量影响最终奖励。删除活跃神经元导致性能崩溃。信息瓶颈在训练早期（15-30M步）锁定。
Conclusion: 在输入维度远大于任务内在维度的情况下，冻结随机投影上的梯度下降可以揭示问题的有效秩，无需显式稀疏性机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Methodology for Designing Knowledge-Driven Missions for Robots
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a comprehensive methodology for implementing knowledge graphs in ROS 2 systems, aiming to enhance the efficiency and intelligence of autonomous robotic missions. The methodology encompasses several key steps: defining initial and target conditions, structuring tasks and subtasks, planning their sequence, representing task-related data in a knowledge graph, and designing the mission using a high-level language. Each step builds on the previous one to ensure a cohesive process from initial setup to final execution. A practical implementation within the Aerostack2 framework is demonstrated through a simulated search and rescue mission in a Gazebo environment, where drones autonomously locate a target. This implementation highlights the effectiveness of the methodology in improving decision-making and mission performance by leveraging knowledge graphs.
papers.journal_ref: 2024 7th Iberian Robotics Conference (ROBOT)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在ROS 2系统中实现知识图谱的完整方法论，旨在提升自主机器人任务的高效性和智能性。方法包括定义初始与目标条件、结构化任务或子任务、规划执行顺序、在知识图谱中表示任务相关数据，以及使用高级语言设计任务。在Aerostack2框架中通过Gazebo环境下的模拟搜救任务进行验证，无人机自主定位目标，实验表明该方法能改善决策和任务性能。
Motivation: 现有自主机器人任务缺乏系统性的知识表示和利用方法，导致决策与执行效率受限，需要一种集成知识图谱的规范化设计流程。
Method: 提出一系列步骤：定义初始和目标条件、分解任务与子任务、规划执行序列、构建任务相关知识图谱、使用高级语言描述任务；并在Aerostack2框架中实现，通过模拟搜救任务（无人机自主搜索目标）进行验证。
Result: 在Gazebo环境的模拟搜救任务中，无人机成功自主定位目标，验证了知识图谱对决策和任务性能的提升效果。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种从初始设置到最终执行的连贯流程，有效利用知识图谱增强机器人自主任务能力，但实验环境为仿真，真实世界应用尚需验证。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种在ROS 2系统中实现知识图谱的完整方法论，旨在提升自主机器人任务的高效性和智能性。方法包括定义初始与目标条件、结构化任务或子任务、规划执行顺序、在知识图谱中表示任务相关数据，以及使用高级语言设计任务。在Aerostack2框架中通过Gazebo环境下的模拟搜救任务进行验证，无人机自主定位目标，实验表明该方法能改善决策和任务性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有自主机器人任务缺乏系统性的知识表示和利用方法，导致决策与执行效率受限，需要一种集成知识图谱的规范化设计流程。
summary_sections.method: 提出一系列步骤：定义初始和目标条件、分解任务与子任务、规划执行序列、构建任务相关知识图谱、使用高级语言描述任务；并在Aerostack2框架中实现，通过模拟搜救任务（无人机自主搜索目标）进行验证。
summary_sections.result: 在Gazebo环境的模拟搜救任务中，无人机成功自主定位目标，验证了知识图谱对决策和任务性能的提升效果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种从初始设置到最终执行的连贯流程，有效利用知识图谱增强机器人自主任务能力，但实验环境为仿真，真实世界应用尚需验证。
